name: 0512FarmerJump
author: Jasonlin778
description:
How to control your characters :
(1)Press space to jump , you can triple jump if you press it three times.
(2)Press shift to dash , double scores , higher speeds , and more excitement!
As a soft reminder : If you play this game for the first time , you can practice without dashing . But after you get more skillful , just dash straight as many times as you can!
If you don’t want to read obstacles introduction , I allow you to  read section 7 merely.
Rumor has it that when a plane crash the stone arch , a catastrophe will strike immediately. ? _ ?
My best score is 11960 😈, can u beat me? :) Good Luck!


Obstacles introduction :
Be cautious ! Although you can leap three times in a row , there are seven sorts of cunning obstacles on the way to prevent you from going through the route!

Common kinds:
(1)garbage cans : They queue up tightly , just dash and jump to dodge them!
(2)stone arch : Do not double jumps , unless you consider you can hop to the sky and run very fast!
(3)triple boxes : Triple jumps always go along with triple boxes ! Double jumps to get rid of them.

Special kinds:
(4)plane : They only circle in the air , but they always remain at the same speed!
(5)Orange caps : Showing up with unity , orange caps always appear four times in a row.
(6)Stone walls : It is really crafty of them to blind your horizons ! Only dashing enables them to move faster.
(7)White fences : White fences never comes single , their color are the same as the ground , make sure that you are concentrate on observing the road every now and then .After the first white fence passes through , the second one will show up in random time and random position . Just like invisible ghost twins.

author: maxxkinooo
description:
ดูหนังออนไลน์ Tee Yod 2 [ธี่หยด 2] หนังออนไลน์ฟรี เต็มเรื่อง HD พากย์ไทย,ธี่หยด 2- เต็มเรื่อง FULL HD/4K พากย์ไทย. ดูหนัง ธี่หยด 2 2023 พากย์ไทย เต็มเรื่อง (THAI-DUBBED),ธี่หยด 2 พากย์ไทย 1080p, [ดู] ธี่หยด 2 [THAI] พากย์ไท, (ดูหนัง!ธี่หยด 2 TEEYOD) ออนไลน์ฟรี ~หนัง! ธี่หยด 2 เต็มเรื่อง หนังฟรี หนัง 8K-HD ธี่หยด 2 Tee Yod 2 2023, ดูหนังใหม่ 2023 | #ธี่หยด 2

🎬▶ ดูออนไลน์หนัง ► https://t.co/ynObHk3VIu

🎬▶ ดูออนไลน์หนัง ► https://t.co/ynObHk3VIu

ธี่หยด 2 (อังกฤษ: Death Whisperer 2;Tee Yod 2) เป็นภาพยนตร์ไทยแนวสยองขวัญเหนือธรรมชาติ ที่กำลังจะมาถึง เป็นภาคต่อจากธี่หยด กำกับโดย คุ้ย ทวีวัฒน์ วันทา และนำแสดงโดย ณเดชน์ คูกิมิยะ เดนิส เจลีลชา คัปปุน กาจบัณฑิต ใจดี พีระกฤตย์ พชรบุณยเกียรติ ณัฐชา นีน่า เจสซิกา พาโดวัน พีรวิชญ์ อรรถชิตสถาพร อริศรา วงษ์ชาลี และ ปรเมศร์ น้อยอ่ำ เช่นเดียวกับภาคแรก ภาพยนตร์ถูกถ่ายทำเพื่อเข้าฉายในระบบไอแมกซ์ทั้งระบบ ภาพยนตร์เรื่องนี้สร้างจากเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้นใน พ.ศ. 2515 เสริมแต่งเรื่องราวเพื่ออรรถรถในรูปแบบของภาพยนตร์ชุดผีอมตะ ของ แซม เรย์มี ที่เป็นแรงบันดาลใจของทวีวัฒน์ เมื่อภาคแรก

ธี่หยด 2 (2023) เต็มเรื่องฟรี - สยองขวัญ ภาพยนตร์ 121 นาที. Tee Yod 2, ທີ່ຫຍົດ, Tee Yod 2, Death Whisperer;ธี่หยด 2. บทสรุปเรื่องเล่าที่เป็นตำนาน หญิงชุดดำที่มาพร้อมกับเสียง “ธี่หยด 2” ความน่ากลัวที่ไม่มีวิธีรับมือ ความสยองที่คืบคลานเข้ามาสู่ครอบครัวนี้อย่างไม่มีเหตุผล ยักษ์จึงต้องทำทุกวิถีทางเพื่อให้แย้มหายจากอาการประหลาด และทำให้ครอบครัวมีชีวิตรอดไปจากเสียงเพรียกสยองยามค่ำคืน "ธี่หยด 2" หนังเต็มออนไลน์ฟรี, ดาวน์โหลดหนังเต็มในคุณภาพระดับ HD, ดูสตรีมมิ่งฟรี

ภาพยนตร์เรื่อง ธี่หยด 2 ได้ทำการบวงสรวงก่อนถ่ายทำที่สตูดิโอช่อง 3 หนองแขมเมื่อวันจันทร์ที่ 24 เมษายน พ.ศ. 2566 และได้เริ่มถ่ายทำคิวแรกเมื่อวันพุธที่ 26 เมษายน พ.ศ. 2566 และถ่ายทำคิวสุดท้ายเมื่อวันเสาร์ที่ 15 กรกฎาคม 2566 ก่อนที่ในวันพุธที่ 9 สิงหาคม พ.ศ. 2566 ทางผู้สร้างได้เผยแพร่ภาพโปสเตอร์ของภาพยนตร์เรื่อง ธี่หยด 2 ออกมาให้ได้รับชม วันพุธที่ 6 กันยายน พ.ศ. 2566 มีการปล่อยทีเซอร์ตัวแรกให้ได้รับชมพร้อมเปิดเผยนักแสดงอย่างเป็นทางการ

แล้วจะดูหนัง "ธี่หยด 2" ออนไลน์เป็นภาษาไทยได้ที่ไหนบ้าง?

name: 3D Essentials - Rolling Balls 0.4a
author: danvxc
description:
NOW WITH - Real-Realtime ball reflections, better shadows, why are there three tables in that kitchen??? The back wall is now bouncy and I've changed the camera angle again!

Realtime GI, Reflection Probes, Probuilder, RT Enlighten... a ton of other stuff! All made for practice! Fixed to run at 60fps. I cannot get this WebGL version to run on iPhone for some reason.

Full scope of changes made:

- Changed speed that the ball rolls in the Project Physics settings
- Changed all lights to be realtime to reduce lightmap size (unsuccessfully)
- Messed with volumetrics to add a fog effect
- Probuilder was used to create the cage, including mirroring, smoothing, merging, combining normals, etc.
- Enlighten was used to add indirect bounce lighting without using baked light/shadowmaps
- External assets used were the house (+ contents), lightbox
- Cinemachine was used to add the tracking / switching cam (the trick is to use a third "camera" object that uses the CineMachine brain script!)
- FastTree was used to make 5000 trees, which was then culled down to approx. 100 because 5000 is STUPID.
- Other stuff I've forgotten!

Note: If the keyboard controls do not work, click the mouse within the game view.

Switch views using the 1, 2, and 3 keys.

In View 1: Use WASD keys to move the character back, forward, left, and right. To perform an activity, position the targeting reticle over the desired element and click the left mouse button.

In View 2: Use WS keys to move the character back and forward, and AD keys to rotate the character on its own axis. To execute an activity, place the mouse pointer over the desired element and click the left mouse button.

In View 3: Use WASD keys to control the camera's movement back, forward, left, and right. To preview the execution of an activity, position the mouse pointer over the desired element.

name: 47 Rōnin
author: keckluis
description:
The story of the 47 Rōnin on Japanese scrolls will be brought to life in a game. This will be implemented in a sidescroller that allows players to control the characters themselves and experience key scenes in minigames. The graphics will be taken directly from the scrolls to keep the original style of the images.

The project is supported by the Stadtmuseum Hornmoldhaus in Bietigheim-Bissingen. The dataset for this project consists of 10 high-resolution photographs of Japanese picture scrolls.

Our team consists of master students from the courses "Computer Science & Media" and "Design of Interactive Media" at Furtwangen University:

Salome Dieterle
Luis Keck
Lisa Räthsel
Markus Schürmann
Janine Wüst

name: 8BqrhPYQZPJDTwjL
author: Miramana
description:
Welcome to Rover Racing!

Use the keyboard WASD keys to drive.

Use the F key to shoot your autolaser, use SHIFT to boost, but be careful, they both draw power from the same source, destroy only what stands in your way, save that precious boost.

Enemies will drop a variety of items when destroyed, these can be useful (ultra sticky goo gives you amazing grip temporarily) and or extremely annoying (shock crystals disable your vehicle temporarily!), so be careful when running the little ones over, you'll automatically pick up whatever they drop. Might be a good idea to destroy a few, and avoid the rest wink

The game is difficult to play, but very rewarding to master, using real physics in a low gravity environment, weight transfer is the most important thing, learn to move the weight of your rover around on its wheels with judicious use of throttle and brake, and you'll soon master the challenging terrain!

You score points by passing the checkpoints with the highest speed possible. Completing the track quickly will get you more checkpoints, but choosing to go fast into some checkpoints might be advantageous. Learn which checkpoints can be abused and which ones to respect!

Enjoy, and Happy Holidays!

name: 100 Arrows
author: Addicting Games
description: 100 Arrows is an online archery game that prepares you for a big tournament.  Archery practice always comes in handy to make you into a worthy opponent. Before participating in the tournament, finish 30 levels of practice. Don’t worry, this isn’t a boring tutorial. This is to get you sharp and ready. 100 Arrows is a fun shooter game with medieval animation and puzzle-like obstacles. You may need to shoot moving targets, shoot long distances, or shoot through intricate designs to get to other targets. Once you get through all 30 levels, you’ll be ready for the tournament where you’ll be up against the best of the best. Don’t skip out practice, and play this online archery game.

author: Addicting Games
description: 13 Days In Hell is a free zombie tower defense game. What's worse than zombies walking the earth? Do a tour of duty in the underworld, brother. These creeps are RAW.

name: 18 Holes
author: Addicting Games
description: 18 Holes is a cute golfing game that is also a good way to practice math! Split up practicing your math games with this cute shooter game. This is a platform game that requires you to get the ball in the hole but also to grab the stars along the way. The more stars you get, the better your score. There are obstacles in the way preventing you from getting all 3 stars so think strategically. You are also limited in the number of hits you can do per level. In between each level, you will have time to practice your math skills by answering 5 correctly before you can play again. This way you break up your studying time without burning yourself out.

name: 21 Blackjack Master
author: Addicting Games
description: 21 Blackjack Master is a free blackjack game.Vegas isn't just a vacation destination it is a state of mind. You don't just need to hop on a plane or a bus to make it to Vegas and gamble your life away because you can do it here for free in the virtual world. Blackjack Casino is a game that takes place in anywhere USA and it is designed for the strategic gamblers and tactical players who live to gamble, gamble to live, and have surely transcended the surly bonds of contemporary reality and become a true player. In Blackjack Casino, you will be making choices and taking bets as you toggle the cards in your hand, the cards on the table, and the cards still yet to come. Blackjack isn't just a push your luck game in which you bet a pile of tokens and hope for the best it is a lifestyle simulator where you become a worldly card shark who hustles their way through hand after hand with a glint in your eye and a curl on your lips. This game is for all the dreamers, the players, and the blackjack kings and queen the whole world over.

name: 24 Carrots
author: Addicting Games
description: 24 Carrots is a free math game. Delicious carrots are the life-blood of the world. Some bunnies crave fame, fortune, glory, or worse. But this little bunny, this little bunny wants only one thing: 24 carrots. We here respect and admire this ambition for being both charming and safe.  You see, carrots are both delicious and good for you thus it makes perfect sense then that a bunny would want carrots and not something intangible like being famous. Our hero is the carrot craving bun bun who is determined to see their way through a maze filled with pit traps, rocks, and other hazards in order to chow down on as many delicious carrots as is bunnily possible. In this game, you guide your bunny friend through level after level of confusing and confounding spatial puzzles. You want to conquer the carrots but in order to do so, you'll need to figure out which boulders to push, where to push them, and exactly when they should be pushed. It is a mystery wrapped inside an enigma inside a riddle. It is a puzzle that would confuse even the most prolific thinker. But you're not a thinker, you're a doer and you're doing your friend a favor by getting them those carrots. Push blocks and chow down in this delicious puzzle game.

name: 360 Snake
author: Addicting Games
description: 360 Snake is a free puzzle game. The snake is unleashed!

name: 3D Air Hockey
author: Addicting Games
description: 3D Air Hockey is a sports game. All the excitement of Air Hockey is now available at the touch of your fingertips. If you don't have the time, the gumption, the friends, or the money to get up, go out and play a game of air hockey at the arcade then sit back down, fire up your phone and get clicking. Our version of 3D Air Hockey is custom made for hockey heads who don't wanna get crosschecked on their way to the rink. With but a simple swipe of your finger you'll be able to take on an unbeatable AI who has been custom designed to play nothing but 3D Air Hockey. Whether you're a hoser at heart, or just a poser chasing the puck you'll be able to appreciate the subtle ways this game simulates your favorite sport. When you play 3D Air Hockey it's all slapshots, no penalties, and hattricks for everyone; no ice skates needed.

name: 3D Bowling
author: Addicting Games
description: 3D Bowling is a free online sports game that has two-player capabilities! Play by yourself or with a pal with this online version game of bowling. This sports game is like entering a real bowling alley with its bright colors, bricked walls, and wooden lanes. Its 3D animation brings this game to life!. Enter this realistic looking bowling alley but compete against a computer opponent that’s ready to take you out. You have the option of choosing from easy, medium, and hard for your competitor. Don’t want to play against a robot? Then invite your pal over and play against them with two-player mode. Each of you can take turns and see who is the best at online bowling! You can also choose from 5 frames or 10 frames depending on how long you want the game to last. There’s plenty of in-game options to give you an exciting round of bowling each time you play. Don’t hesitate to go bowling with this online version of the game!

name: 3D Free Kick
author: Addicting Games
description: 3D Free Kick is a sports game. In life, all shots are penalty shots. Whether the goalie is an obstacle or an opportunity, if you're taking a shot at it you're probably on the outs. Soccer is no different, soccer is a game of passes and dashes. Desperate kicks and offensive or defensive plays which require strategic planning and tactical action. When someone goes out of bounds its time for the penalty kick, an opportunity to make up for the zealousness of the opposing teams play. Judge the distance, your speed, and your power levels before executing a perfect kick. Dodge the defense and land the perfect score at the last minute in this dangerously fun game of sports.

name: 4 in a Row
author: Addicting Games
description: Play multiplayer 4 in a Row online! Challenge friends or opponents worldwide—drop your discs strategically and connect four vertically, horizontally, or diagonally to win.

name: 4 In a Row Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: 4 in a row mania is a free connect four-game.

name: 4 Wheel Madness
author: Addicting Games
description: Get in Bigfoot's driver seat. Can you make it across the finish line with more than just four huge wheels?

name: 4th and Goal 2016
author: Addicting Games
description: Need more points? Well then go for 2! Need the ball back? Then onside kick. Make Big Hits, score Touchdowns, and choose plays created by current, and former high school, college, and pro football players!

name: 501 Darts
author: Addicting Games
description: 501 Darts is a free sports game. Are you the dart master, or do you risk people's lives with every throw? Get 501 points exactly to win. How many turns do you need?

name: 60 Seconds Burger Run
author: Addicting Games
description: Oh noes - only 60 seconds until the burger joint closes. Fortunately, you can catch buses to make the trip. Hustle to a bus stop and keep moving. If you waste time, you going hungry, for reals.

name: 8 Ball Billiards Classic
author: Addicting Games
description: 8 Ball Billiards Classic is the online version of your favorite pool game. This mobile-friendly game has the same simple green and brown design as any pool table that you’d find in bar. The rules are the same: use your pool stick to hit the white ball to hit either the striped or solid colored balls into the pocket holes. Avoid hitting the white ball or the balls of your opponent into the pocket hole. You have the option to play against the A.I. or, if you have a friend over, play in two-player mode. You have a top-view of the game with options to see hints for the best angles. This is the perfect casual and calming game that you can play with your friends or by yourself. Once you’ve finished a game, head over to the leaderboard to see if you made the cut.

name: 8 Ball Pool
author: Addicting Games
description: Play multiplayer 8 Ball Pool online. Challenge your friends or match up with players worldwide in quick, casual games. Aim, shoot, and improve your skills!

name: 9 Ball Pool
author: Addicting Games
description: Enjoy fast-paced multiplayer 9 Ball Pool online. Test your aim against friends or players around the globe—shoot and sink balls from 1 to 9 in order, and sharpen your skills with every game!

name: A Day at High School
author: Addicting Games
description: A Day at High School is a free escape room game. Oh, like going to school wasn't hard enough. Now you're going to make me play through the day? Fortunately, there's a payoff that's better than homework...

name: A Halloween Horror
author: Addicting Games
description: Off in the ghost world, you must jump and dodge your way to safety. The ghosts look passive, but they kill with impunity.

name: A Tale of Two Yetis
author: Addicting Games
description: It was the best of yetis, it was the worst of yetis. Abominable Escape is the tale of two yetis, well, technically one yeti from two points of view. Maybe when an abominable snow monster eviscerates you, it was just trying to cuddle because it's cold. Ever think about that?

name: Ace of Hearts
author: Addicting Games
description: Ace of Hearts is a card game with a Valentine’s Day theme! The day of lovers and friendship is full of love and happiness. Pink, gold, hearts, and everything lovey-dovey is here! Play this solitaire game based on the day of love whether you’re in a relationship or happily single. There are 3 levels of this holiday game. Each game is timed so you must act quickly and solve the card game before you run out of time. Unlike other solitaire games, you must create one single foundation regardless of suit. Start from Ace to King, and then start it again until you have used up all the cards. This makes the game more challenging as you struggle to find the right cards. If you run out of time or your run out of cards, you lose the game and have to start over from level 1. Submit your score at the end of the game to see how well you did compare to other card players.

name: Achievement Unlocked
author: Addicting Games
description: You can't make a move without earning an award in this game. On the other hand, you can't level up without earning EVERY achievement! Fortunately, hints abound and lives are plentiful. Get Your Badge On, Baby!

name: Achilles
author: Addicting Games
description: Achilles is a free fighting game. Achilles is a side-scrolling platformer that lets you live out your dreams of ancient Greece and all the drama, comedy and tragedy that follows. Play as Achilles, the fleet-footed soldier who is tasked with holding back legions of approaching troops and mythological monsters. You won't have much more than a sword, your shield, and your wits to save you in this furious but fun Flash game. Guard your neck and don't spare weak. You'll have to be outright ruthless if you want to live up to the namesake of one of histories greatest warriors. Just remember, its all fun and games until someone strikes your heel! Be brave and be victorious!

name: Addicting Slots
author: Addicting Games
description: Addicting Slots is a free casino-style game.

name: Adventure Drivers
author: Addicting Games
description: Adventure Drivers is a free racing game. You'll have to score, upgrade, and push yourself to the limit if you want to win in this free racing game. Adventure Drivers is a 2-D racing game where you compete against other opponents on an endless 2D platform. This is a game of speed and balance. If you want to be the best you don't just have to move fast but you have to do it while respecting the laws of physics. Earn coin to upgrade your ride and customize the look, feel, and playability of the game until you are ready to conquer the competition and take the number one spot. Watch out for ramps and jumps, tunnels, and various obstacles. If you want to win you'll have to be the best there is at what you do! Rocket up the leaderboard, leave your friend and enemies in the dust. This is the ultimate test of physics, balance, speed, and strategic upgrades. Prove to the world that you have what it takes to leave everyone else in the past. You are the future. You are forever now in Adventure Drivers, the ultimate balancing platform game.

name: Adventure Factory
author: Addicting Games
description: Create your very own adventure game and challenge your friends to beat it. Easy step by step game editor lets you make your very own game and then you have to try to beat it!

name: Adventure Time: Candy Scramble
author: Addicting Games
description: Princess Bubblegum has gathered teams of candy people to go head-to-head in one of the most dangerous sports in Ooo: Peppermint Ball! Dont let the name fool you. Its rough, rowdy and totally bazonkers!

name: Against The Odds
author: Addicting Games
description: Against the Odds is a math game that incorporates an action game with math skills! This is the perfect online game that your parents and teachers will have no problem letting you play. If you need to study or do homework for math, you can play our fun action game to practice your skills. Select a math skill to practice and get 5 of them correct. Once you have done this, you will get to play an action-packed session of Against the Odds. This is an online game where you are fighting an invasion of robots of all kinds! There are tiny and slow robots and stronger and faster robots. You must defeat each one and prevent them from taking your energy from your life bar. Get through as many waves as you can to get the best possible score before you die. This is a great way to get in your math study time and also getting to play a cool action game!

name: Age of War
author: Addicting Games
description: Age of War is an epic, classic strategy game. Advance through the ages in a struggle to destroy your enemy’s base before they can destroy yours in this real-time strategy game. Spawn units that are sent to the enemy base, as your opponent does the same to you. You’ll meet in the middle of the map, and the tug of war begins. Earn gold and experience for each unit you defeat, and then use that gold to spawn even more units, or build towers to protect your base. Earn enough experience, and you’ll be able to advance to the next age, upgrading your units, your base, and your towers. There are five ages to advance through. Make your way to all of them, or see if you can defeat your opponent sooner rather than later.

name: Age of War 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Age of Wars 2 is a strategy war game set in the age of the cavemen. Start as mere cavemen, and then advance your way through the ages in an epic struggle to defeat your opponent in Age of War 2, the sequel to the successful strategy/defense game. While the goal may be simple—destroy the enemy base—you have to prevent yours from being destroyed, too. To do this, you’ll need to spawn units from the selection in the top right. You’ll earn gold and experience as you go, and you can upgrade your units, build defensive turrets, activate special abilities, and of course, advance your age.

name: Air Battle
author: Addicting Games
description: You only have two balloons to maneuver your steamy, punky flying machine. Collect dem coins and practice spike avoision!

name: Air Fighter
author: Addicting Games
description: Take to the skies!

name: Airport Clash 3D
author: Addicting Games
description: Airport Clash 3D is a funny IO shooting game where you’re stuck in an abandoned airport. This third-person shooter game has nice 3D animation that creates a war-driven world in a non-functioning airport. In this anarchy, you must survive and fight against others along with the help of your team. Your goal is to kill as many people as you can to win each round. As you play and raise your score, you can unlock upgrades that will help you become a better player. You can also use the area to your advantage by hiding behind the large and stranded airplanes while you search for any enemies. Fight alongside other players to take down the enemies but also beat them out by getting the most kills. Every time you win a game, you get closer to newer weapons. Use your stars to upgrade your stats and current weapons. Shoot your way up the leaderboards in this exciting IO shooting game.

name: Airport Tycoon
author: Addicting Games
description: Forget scanners and searches. This is all about flying! Match passengers and routes; dispatch aircraft and make a profit! Loads of levels to explore as your airport skills improve. Don't forget to invest in upgrades, like faster jets and swankier lounges!

name: Aladdin And The Magic Lamp
author: Addicting Games
description: The genie is out of the lamp! Aladdin needs your help in recovering artifacts. Unlike a traditional match-3 there's no swiping here, just click on the gem you would move to make the match happen and the gems will clear the board. Can you complete each level?

name: Alien Invasion
author: Addicting Games
description: The president has sent you to destroy the dying alien race trying to land on Earth. Shoot the UFO's down before the aliens have a chance to take over.

name: Alphabet Shoot
author: Addicting Games
description: No spelling required! Shoot the letter D to eliminate the D block. Shoot the letter F to eliminate the F block. Sounds easy but gets hard fast!

name: American Racing 2
author: Addicting Games
description: American Racing 2 is a free racing game. Choose an event, strap in, and put the pedal to the metal in this old-school stock-car racing game.

name: Angry Flappy Birds
author: Addicting Games
description: Angry Flappy Birds is a free physics game. Imagine the synergy that might happen by combining two bird related games together. Angry Birds and Flappy Birds. In Angry Flappy Birds you will first launch your bird through a moderate obstacle course and then using the tap tap tap motions of Flappy Birds in order to keep the bird afloat. Just tap to avoid the tubes and pipes. This is a game for people who love games. Specifically, those other games: Angry Birds and Flappy birds. If you like those games you will love this and if you don't like them then you'll probably like this because it is different than them. So, in many ways this is the perfect game. It is an objectively perfect game in that regaurd.

name: Angry Flappy Wings
author: Addicting Games
description:
Angry Flappy Wings is a free clicker game. You're a bird, you're armed, you can barely fly and you're really mad. Welcome to the wild world of Angry Flappy Birds. A game where you fly, you shoot, and you dodge walls, other birds, barriers, and the projectiles fired at you by the enemy birds. Choose your favorite flavor of feather and take to the sky. This game is all about how far you can fly, though it is categorized as an endless runner game. You'll start the game off armed with a standard-issue bird-shooter which is serviceable and gets the job done but as the game goes on you'll be able to upgrade it to an automatic, a multi-directional shooter, and the ultimate bomb launching weapon which neutralizes and atomizes the barriers and enemies before they can get to you.

 

Angry Flappy Wings is a game of reflex and spacial reasoning. Determine your flight path, stick to it, and let your auto-fire do al the work as you dodge, weave, dive and float your way into the history books.

name: Animal Kids Fun
author: Addicting Games
description: Kids Animal Fun is a free puzzle game.

name: Animal Wars
author: Addicting Games
description: Animal Wars is a free platform game. Like Worm games? You should evolve, dude! Angry goats, slimy slugs, fire ants and poopy gorillas wage war against each other. Battle across America, my friends! :x

name: Animalines
author: Addicting Games
description: Pair up the critters to score. Hey, bears and raccoons and chickens need love too.

name: Arch Rivals
author: Addicting Games
description: Oh Hai! Wish your archery game was rounder and funnier? Here you goes! Eliminate clowns, earn fantastic badges. Two player mode, too!

name: Around The Core Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Around The Core on Steam now!

A space-themed incremental shooter where destruction fuels growth. Start small by aiming, shooting, and gathering fragments from annihilated asteroids. As you harvest wealth, you will explore a vast upgrade tree to redefine your power and escalate the chaos against an increasing variety and intensity of shapes.

name: Ashleys Journey
author: Addicting Games
description: Ashley's got a chance to do some serious traveling - and her biggest problem is the wardrobe! Pack outfits, take photos, and live the traveling dream!

name: Assault Echelon
author: Addicting Games
description: Take aim and take out the terrorists in an intense first-person shooter.

name: Attack of Infections
author: Addicting Games
description: Fly your antibiotic spaceship around until you wipe out all the infectious bacterian aliens.

name: Attack of the Influenza Birds
author: Addicting Games
description: What a better way to take care of a bunch of sick birds other than a gatling gun, in the middle of the day on an inhabited street? Hey, they have bird flu. You have to do something.

name: Bad Boys
author: Addicting Games
description: Bad Boys is a free tycoon game. Your sister is kidnapped, and you need to go criminal to save her! Steal cars, rob banks and assassinate politicians. But there aren't any rules: steal ANY car. EDITOR'S NOTE: THIS GAME IS VERY BIG AND WILL TAKE A FEW MINUTES TO LOAD -ITS WORTH IT SO BE PATIENT WHILE IT LOADS!

name: Bad Driver
author: Addicting Games
description: Bad Driver is a free car game that will let you know whether or not you’re a good driver. This is an easy online game where all you have to do is stay within the white path. If you ever stray from the white path a little you will lose the game instantly. This online game has simple animation As you drive, collect as many jewels as you can. Use the jewels to unlock cool character skins for your car. There are different colors and kinds of cars that you can choose from. In addition, you can also unlock colorful skins for your steering wheel. Play, again and again, until you unlock all of the skins. Click on the leaderboard icon, to see where you rank against other car game players in this online game. At the end of each game, you’ll find your most recent and best score. Play again to beat your best score each time!

name: Badminton Brawl
author: Addicting Games
description: Badminton Brawl is a free sports game. Welcome to the weird and wonderful world of Badminton. This is Badminton Brawl, a game about badminton and brawling. In this free sports game, you will be able to become a badminton player who is working their way up through the rankings and taking on some of the best AI badminton players on the planet. Learn timing, combos, and power. You'll have to learn how to defeat your partner with a variety of different serves, smashes, passes, and taps. Know which move to use and when then arm yourself and take to the court in this fast-paced game of rackets and birdies. You'll love the minimal graphics and intense game-play of this realistic badminton game. It is a fun way to click, react and use physics to defeat your opponenet. Choose from a variety of different skins and courts in order to fully customize the exact kind of game you might wish to play.

name: Balance Ball Castello
author: Addicting Games
description: Balance Ball is a free mobile game.

name: Balance Balll
author: Addicting Games
description: Balance Ball is a free physics game. Balance is the most fundamental rule in all of physics. Whether we are talking about your finances, your work/life balance, or your ability to tip tope across a taut rope: Balance is the key. Hold The Balance is a game where you as a human being on Earth are forced to use a canon filled with bouncing balls to fire at the bottom of opposing sides of a platform. Your goal is to keep the platform level and balanced. You will accomplish this by firing at one end of the platform and then again at the other end in order to keep it basically level. This requires a lot of negotiation between your canon, the balls, the platform, and the ancient powers of gravity itself. Switching back and forth between each side of the platform and indeed how many balls and where you fire, you may be able to keep the platform balanced and you may not. There are no guarantees in this game.

name: Balloon in a Wasteland
author: Addicting Games
description: Clever as you are, your balloon is now crashed. And little black critters love the smell of your flesh! Shoot them! Repair your balloon, buy guns and supplies when the truck comes, and see if you can live long enough to fly home, little bumblebee!

name: Balloons
author: Addicting Games
description: Balloons is a free mobile game. You may find yourself in a floating maze filled with ballons, you may find yourself as a razor sharp ebony saw blade, you may find yourself rotating in space as balloons fall all around. This is a common problem, it is an occurrence that happens all of the time. The only thing you can do is ask yourself how you got there and start flinging your bladed self around. Smash the balloons, splice through their weakened rubber skins. Your mission is to seek and destroy as many balloons as is humanly possible. The end is always near and it never goes away. Don't let the fading light behind the curtain go out on you before the end of the final act. Fling your blade through armies of floating balloons and cut them all down. Remember, they work for you now and you are an unkind master. Take out as many balloons in as few seconds as possible if you wish to upgrade the color, the shape, and the overall lethality of your blade. You can do it! You can take on and take down the living wrecks that have inhabited your maze world.

name: Balls And Bricks
author: Addicting Games
description: Balls And Bricks is a free shooter game. Take aim and blast away in this exciting, fast-paced shooter game where you'll be tasked with the goal of blasting your way through as many bricks with as few balls as possible. Use geometry to your advantage and bank your shots at exactly the right angle to maximize your total output. In this game, you'll have to choose between earning new balls or smashing the descending bricks. You are using the power of physics and geometry to bounce balls, bank them off walls, and snipe them in between crevasses in order to break as many bricks as possible. Each of the bricks has a numerical value on them which is their hit point counter. You will need to use your stream of balls to hit the brick that many times before it disappears. Collect balls, bank your shots, and use geometry and physics to blast your way to the top of the leader board in this fun and challenging shooter game.

name: Basketball Challenge
author: Addicting Games
description: Basketball Challenge is a free mobile sports game.  Brace yourselves for an exhilarating clash of skills and physics in the ultimate basketball challenge! Get ready to dominate the court like never before in a free mobile or desktop game that will take your basketball prowess to cosmic heights. In this epic showdown, players worldwide compete in a gravity-defying spectacle where the laws of physics bend to your will. Your mission? To guide the ball into a floating and moving hoop by strategically mapping out its trajectory and launching it with the precision and finesse of a world-class sniper.  Basketball Challenge takes physics-based gameplay to a whole new level. Each hoop floats, rotates, and moves through space, adding a thrilling layer of challenge to every shot. You'll need razor-sharp precision, split-second timing, and a dash of cosmic luck to conquer these celestial hoops. Whether on the go or your desktop, "Basketball Challenge" offers seamless gameplay across platforms. You'll launch balls into orbit quickly with intuitive controls and engaging mechanics. Don't let gravity hold you back—take control of your destiny!

name: Basketball G4AA
author: Addicting Games
description: The Basketball is a free physics game. Get ready to slam, jam, and carefully obey the laws of physics in the most sensational basketball showdown we've ever published. In this game, you won't be up against Shaq, Kobe, Jordan, or Byrd, but something much more harrowing. In this basketball game, you'll shoot through a series of obstacles that do not let up. Whether it is mystical portals that teleport the ball, sliding platforms, steel spikes, or concrete walls, this game is the ultimate challenge to your B-ball skills. Physics is the game's name; it is all you'll have as you shoot, bounce, rebound, teleport, dodge, and swish your way to the top of the leaderboard. All you have to do is use your mouse to click, hold and drag. You'll see a dotted line that represents your ball's arc. You aim to launch the ball where you think it is most likely to bounce into the hoop. Remember, you'll be up against all sorts of barriers and obstacles. You'll sometimes have to use those obstacles to your advantage, like the teleportation portal or the sliding platforms.

name: Basketball Kings 2022
author: Addicting Games
description: Basketball Kings 2022 is a free mobile game. Welcome to the court, king. This is an easy-to-play sports game that will keep you busy for hours. This online game is a fun basketball game where the objective is simply to get the ball in the hoop before the timer runs out. As you play and earn points, unlock all the cool and different colored character skins for your basketball. Additionally, click on the trophy icon to see the target goals that you can earn for bonuses. Your goals depend on what percentage of the game you get through before you lose. On top of challenging yourself, click on the leaderboards icon to compete against other players on this sports game. Climb up the leaderboards and become the best online basketball player for this game!

name: Battalion Commander
author: Addicting Games
description: It's not the man in the fight, it's the fight that's in the man! Or in this case, the squad! You'll start off this game as one man lost on the battle field trying to shoot his way through waves of approaching enemies and as you continue you'll recruit snipes, soldiers, bombers, and heavy infantry! Build your squad and rush the opposing military with tactics honed through blood, sweat, and tears in the trenches of future conflicts. This is war, soldier, and you won't win by cowering behind a sandbag or laying low in a shallow trench. The only way to win is to get into V-formation and charge the enemy! Beware! While you and your growing squad of men are powerful you will eventually have to face down tanks, planes, and other kinds of war machines while you --yes you-- will be armed with nothing more than your handheld weapons. You can do it. It is possible. But it won't be easy.

name: Battle Club
author: Addicting Games
description: Battle Club is a free IOgame.

name: Battle Coast
author: Addicting Games
description: Are you ready to defend your coast? Aim straight to sink the ships and earn gold coins. Purchase upgrades with the gold you earn to improve force, reload, damage, tower repairs and increase damage. Prepare to be engage in naval warfare!

name: Battle for Terra: TERRAtron
author: Addicting Games
description: The Battle for Terra is on.

name: Battle for the Galaxy
author: Addicting Games
description:
Battle for the Galaxy is a free MMO game.

 

Pilots - start your engines!

Marines - take your blasters!

Commanders - start the battle!

Battle for the Galaxy features player controlled development of the space outpost, further defending that outpost from other players, as well as attacking outposts of other players.

Resources for army training and base development are obtained either from attacks, or via mines daily production.

Players are offered to create or join corporations (groups of up to fifty people), which provide them with permanent bonuses to make defensive and offensive gameplay of a player easier and allow him to participate in a corporate wars.


- Build your base, think of smart positioning of defenders.

- Attack other bases, think of breaking through their defense.

- Enjoy cool music and outstanding graphics.

name: Battle Pirates
author: Addicting Games
description:
Greetings, Captain!
Welcome to the flooded world of Battle Pirates. You’re part of the Forsaken Council now and as one of the Forsaken, you will need to fight for Survival. Build an island fortress, customize deadly ships, and compete in monthly events on your quest to rule the high seas in this unique maritime adventure. Are you ready to become the battle pirate you have always dreamed of? Battle Pirates is a strategy game where you build empires and take them down, often in the same turn. Power up your defenses, upgrade your weapons, choose your crew, build, barter, and the battle for supremacy on the high seas and everywhere in-between. Piracy is your destiny, battle is your tool. Become the pirate you were always meant to be in this game.

name: Battle Sails
author: Addicting Games
description: Play as one of the four largest European powers during the Golden Age of Piracy in this turn-based strategy game. Can you conquer the Caribbean?

name: Battle Ships
author: Addicting Games
description: Battle Ships is a free puzzle game.

name: Battle Snake
author: Addicting Games
description: Battle snake looks more like a battle worm, until you beat a few levels and grow your snake.

name: Battleships Armada
author: Addicting Games
description: Battleships Armada is a free battleship game.

name: Battlestick 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Battlestick 2 is a free iogame. In the future, everyone will be a stick person and the whole world will be engulfed in battle. If you want to be ready for what is to come then we highly suggest you lay this game and get good at stick battling. Battle Stick 2 is a huge iogame which means your teammates and the people you go up against won't just be simple bots programmed to react to stimuli but rather complicated human beings on the other side of the planet who are just as serious about gaming as you and won't go down without a good fight. In this game, there are two modes of play, an arena free for all and a capture the flag game fought with teams. You'll start with nothing but a bow and arrow and as you progress you'll be able to upgrade your weapons, items, outfits, and overall aesthetic to become the ultimate stick figure in the world. Stick games are a classic internet game genre and battle stick 2 is no different. It is a classic in waiting and you are on the ground floor of a monumental, game-changing iogame.

name: Bear in Super Action Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: The super mean green bunny and his army of evil want to invade the planet. But, there was one thing they hadn't reckoned with. A badass teddy bear, armed to the teeth ready to defeat the invaders. Shoot hordes of villains as you try to pick up coins for upgrades.

name: Bermuda Triangle
author: Addicting Games
description: Bermuda Triangle is a free action game.

name: Best Hockey Game
author: Addicting Games
description: Best Hockey Game is a free sports game. Ignore all those other hockey games: this here is the real deal. Play as a team - pass, shoot, steal, score! And it wouldn't be hockey without fist fights. Punch your way to victory!

name: Bieber Kisser
author: Addicting Games
description: Bieber Kisser is a free avoider game. Want to make kissy faces with Justin? Sneak up on him! Elude the many bodyguards, groupies and producers. Then land a wet one on his Bieberness!

name: Bieber's Bash
author: Addicting Games
description: We should set the record straight. His name is Bieber, not Beaver! Watch out for pesky impostors, and keep the Bieb from stealing your drum thunder!

name: BigHole.io
author: Addicting Games
description: BigHole.io is an exciting online hole-eating game. Consume various props across different maps, grow larger, and start devouring other holes to become the biggest and claim victory! Gameplay: You play as a hole in a bustling city. Your goal is to survive by consuming various props, which will help you grow larger. Be cautious, though—other holes will try to consume you. At the same time, seize every opportunity to devour smaller holes to gain a significant advantage and dominate the game. How To Play: Use the W, A, S, and D keys on your keyboard to move your hole. Alternatively, you can use your mouse: simply click or tap on the screen, and your hole will move toward the pointer. On mobile devices, you can control your hole using either the mouse or the joystick located at the bottom-left corner of the screen.

name: Black Bonte
author: Addicting Games
description: Black is a free puzzle game. When the light is gone and all of the colors have faded into nothing you are left with only darkness, welcome to Black. Black is an abstract puzzle game where players are forced to pit their imagination against the machinations of deviously clever game developers who have made a truly creepy puzzle game. In this game, you will be faced with nothing but a black screen and some icons. You don't just make moves here or there to win the level, you must first figure out what the point of the game is, this makes Black a standout game in the world of puzzle games. Black is the latest in the series of color-themed abstract puzzle games and we are proud to host it for you. We think it harkens back to some of the classic games of the past while also having a modern edge. If you get stuck at any time there is a lightbulb in the top right-hand corner of the screen. Using the hint will affect your score but, hey, at least you'll get it done.

name: Blackjack Casino
author: Addicting Games
description: Blackjack Casino is a free Casino game. Vegas isn't just a vacation destination it is a state of mind. You don't just need to hop on a plane or a bus to make it to Vegas and gamble your life away because you can do it here for free in the virtual world. Blackjack Casino is a game that takes place in anywhere USA and it is designed for the strategic gamblers and tactical players who live to gamble, gamble to live, and have surely transcended the surly bonds of contemporary reality and become a true player. In Blackjack Casino, you will be making choices and taking bets as you toggle the cards in your hand, the cards on the table, and the cards still yet to come. Blackjack isn't just a push your luck game in which you bet a pile of tokens and hope for the best it is a lifestyle simulator where you become a worldly card shark who hustles their way through hand after hand with a glint in your eye and a curl on your lips. This game is for all the dreamers, the players, and the blackjack kings and queen the whole world over.

name: Blade & Bedlam
author: Addicting Games
description:
Survive bedlam in this action brawler! Use your sword to block enemy attacks and deflect projectiles.
Buy items in the shop to upgrade your knight and unlock new abilities!
Can you defeat all the bosses?

name: Bleu Bayou Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Bleu Bayou on Steam now!

 

Mobile requires a controller!
Bleu Bayou is a challenging shoot 'em up boss rush with rogue-lite elements, featuring the 8-bit aesthetic of your favorite handheld console.

Demo Features

  • Sling your trusty machete and rusty harpoon with Breakout-inspired toss-catch mechanics!
  • Challenge 5+ bosses to fast-paced combat, or to unique non-combat minigames!
  • Rogue-lite progression system featuring 35+ unique upgrades! Your build is in your hands!
  • Hone your machete, electrify your harpoon, or punish your foes with status effects like Poison, Slow, and Bleed. Grow your upgrade pool even more across subsequent runs!
  • Manage your debts wisely as you fight to stay afloat in the Bayou's harsh, predatory economy!
  • Test your skills in Time Attack mode to earn powerful rewards!
  • Meaningful player choice and multiple endings put you in control of your destiny!
  • Authentic 8-bit aesthetics, with dozens of unlockable color palettes!
  • Full controller support!

Full Version Features

  • More than 2x the number of bosses in the demo.
  • Over 100 upgrades.
  • A fully fleshed out casino.
  • Reasons to keep doing runs.
  • And much more!

name: Block Blast Puzzle
author: Addicting Games
description: Block Blast Puzzle is a free block-puzzle game. Block Blast Puzzle is a free mobile game that turns heads and challenges minds. Immerse yourself in a world where polynomial puzzles meet addictive gameplay, creating a unique and entertaining experience that will keep you glued to your screens. Block Blast Puzzle welcomes players of all skill levels with its easy-to-grasp gameplay. But don't be fooled by the simplicity – as you progress, the challenges intensify. Master the art of polyomino placement, think strategically, and elevate your gaming skills. Strategize your moves, plan your polyomino placements, and revel in the satisfaction as you conquer each level. Challenge your friends or connect with fellow gaming enthusiasts worldwide. Block Blast Puzzle brings the competitive spirit to your fingertips. Climb the leaderboards, showcase your skills, and prove that you're the ultimate Block genius.

name: Block Blast Slide
author: Addicting Games
description: Block Blast Slide is a free block game. We all love to block, we love to blast, and most importantly, we love to slide. Well, lucky for you, we've developed a game that involves blocks, blasting, and slides. We call the game Block Blast Slide, which is a real puzzle banger. In this game, your job is to slide blocks left or right to complete a line. Once complete, the line disappears and gives you room. You'll need that room because as the blocks build up, they reach toward the ceiling, and if they touch, it's game over. How long can you slide and blast these blocks? Only time will tell.

name: Block Shot
author: Addicting Games
description: Block Shot is a free clicker game. Nobody would have ever thought in a million years that you could combine a tactical shooter game with that of a cute puzzle game, yet here we are, and here is Block Shot. This is a game where you are in charge of a series of canons, your job is to activate them one at a time and only once in order to blast apart the blocks that make up the center of the screen. Each block is of an odd shape and they all interconnect with each other like some kind of neon puzzle. Your job is to time the shots of your cannons in such a way that you are able to remove each of the block pieces in a very specific order. If you do this properly you will win the level and move on to the next one. If you screw it up you'll have to start all over again and try to get it right. This is a very unforgiving puzzle in which you really only get one chance per level to get it right. There are no hit points here. Either you succeed or fail.

name: Blockbuster Jewel Quest
author: Addicting Games
description: Block Buster Jewel Quest is a free mobile game. You've played jewel games where you match three like jewels. You've played jewel games where you launch jewels at other jewels. You've even played jewel game where there were no jewels. But we offer you something different, something new, and something exciting. We offer unto you a real blockbuster of a jewel game. This is a jewel game where you are on a real quest. In Blockbuster Jewel Quest you will be placing a variety of polynominal shapes onto a massive grid. These shapes need to fill up an entire row and or column in order for them to vaporize. If they don't vaporize you don't get points and you run the risk they pile up and the game ends.

name: Bloody Day
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloody Day is a free sniper game. Back alley butchering has never been so much fun. It's like having your own barrel with moderately slow moving fish. How many kills can you rack up?

name: Bloon Pop
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloon Pop is a free popping game. The balloons are here and they are lined up and ready to pop. Nobody knows just what causes the balloons to line up by color then march their way over to your gate but we do know it is up to you to pop them before they can do anything wrong. Its pretty simple, just line up a shot on the right of the screen and make sure to aim the dart to take out as many of these balloons as is possible. in this game physics is your friend, a friend you can use to accomplish your goals and ambitions by launching a dart square into hearts of all these gathered and aligned balloons. So, aim your dart and let your aim be true. This is a game about devastation and not about sitting around. Just don't sit around and do nothing and you should do better than most. Alas, whatever reason the balloons have gathered is unimportant. All that matters is that you take aim and let them know who is boss. You are boos with your darts.

name: Bloons
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloons is a shooting game. You remember the Bloons don't you? The Bloons are everywhere. The Bloons arae taking over. We used to have cities, cars, people. Now it's all just Bloons and empty skies for as far as you can see, our only hope is the careful aim and steady hand of a monkey army that is destined to take the world back from this helium-filled nightmare. Ready, aim, fire your way to victory in this cute shooter where physics plays as much of a role in your victory as your aim does. Use your mouse to aim high and select the proper intensity level to launch your darts. You don't want to miss the bloons altogether but you also don't want to overshoot them, this is serious. Pop your way to victory as you launch dart after dart at a phalanx off rubbery, colorful, helium-filled balloons. Use your perfect aim to hit balloons that feature special abilities and powers in order to unlock cool new abilities.

name: Bloons Insanity
author: Addicting Games
description: This may be the puzzle pack that defeats the Bloons Monkey. Each puzzle is more hideous, more insidious, more ballonidious than the last!

name: Bloons Super Monkey
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloons Super Monkey is a free shooter game. Our Mr. Monkey dispenses with the bow and arrow, and takes the fight to the bloons' back yard: mid-air! Blast bloons to bits, upgrade to make your monkey even more super!

name: Bloons Survivor
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloons Survivor is a free mobile game. Bloons Survivor is the story of a monkey, a grid, and many balloons. This is an incredible IO game where you can be the monkey on a mission to destroy every balloon! But this ain't your average monkey business, oh no. This monkey means business, and he's got the weapons to back it up. Starting with a simple set of darts, you'll need to use all your monkey might to pop those pesky balloons out of the sky. But as you progress through the game, you'll have the chance to upgrade your arsenal to include canon balls and throwing stars! With weapons like that, no balloon stands a chance against you. But that's not all, friends. This monkey is as fast as he is strong, and with each upgrade, you'll be able to increase his speed and damage value. You'll need every advantage you can get because this game is about surviving as long as possible. The balloons will keep coming, wave after wave, and it's up to you to keep throwing, slashing, and punching until they're all gone. Of course, it's not just about destroying balloons. You'll need to be strategic, too, planning your moves carefully to avoid getting hit by the balloons as they come at you from every direction. But with your quick reflexes and monkey-like agility, you can dodge and weave through the chaos like a pro. So come on, true believers, join the monkey on his epic journey through the grid, and show those balloons who's boss. Unlock new challenges and rewards, keeping you hooked for hours on end. It's an IO game, filled with excitement, action, and more monkey puns than you can shake a banana at.

name: Bloons Tower Defense
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloons Tower Defense is a free tower defense game. Monkeys Fight Creepy Bloons!

name: Bloons Tower Defense 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloons Tower Defense 2 is a free tower defense game. The monkey returns to pop some more of those pesky helium-filled bloons. This time, you'll need more than just darts to win. Fortunately, you have glue, bombs, and road spikes added to your arsenal.

name: Bloons Tower Defense 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloons Tower Defense 3 is a free tower defense game. create an impressive armada of defensive monkeys to clear the waves of balloons before they can reach the end of the path. If balloons were to ever rise up against their human creators, then this game gives us a good blueprint for winning the insurrection. Get a few good monkeys, give them bangarangs, and listen as the balloons pop one by one by one.

name: Bloons Tower Defense 4
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloons Tower Defense 4 is the fourth game in your favorite tower-defense series. This is a different kind of tower-defense game, Instead of orcs, soldiers, monsters, and knights you're fighting against dangerous balloons. Yes, you heard us right. Balloons are your enemy and your objective is to pop them before they reach past the post. On your defensive team, you have a league of skilled monkeys with amazing popping skills. There are monkeys with pins and monkeys that have awesome ninja skills. On top of fighter monkeys, you have other devices like cannons and spikes that can help you to pop the balloons. This is a one-of-kind online game that requires a strategy to defeat the evil balloons!

name: Bloxorz
author: Addicting Games
description: Bloxorz is a free puzzle game. All that we ask is that you help us maintain order. A square peg into a square hole. It's simple. Geometric shapes and their ability to interlock are the basic building blocks of order. If we can't move them around and drop them into place, we have anarchy. We don't want anarchy. We don't want our shapes walking all willy nilly off the sides of platforms, beyond the edge of the grid, or into the oblivion of the unknown beneath it. There is a certain beauty in order and an undeniable deformity in chaos. An ugly, insidious aesthetic which robs the natural world of its god-given balance and beauty. And all that we ask is that you help us maintain order That you help us keep the world beautiful, that you keep the square pegs snugly in their square holes. This is done for you, for me, and for thee betterment of the world.

name: Bobble Ball
author: Addicting Games
description: Bobble Ball is a free sports game. Volley Ball is now and has always been a game of kings, queens, Jacks, princes, some jokers, and even knights. Now you can become basically as cool and talented as a world-class soccer player and feel as powerful as a monarch in this free and exciting Volley Ball game: Bobble Ball perfectly re-creates the fast-paced world of volleyball with an amazingly accurate physics engine and am AI that knows your every move before you do. Games are scored out of three and the first player to make it all the way to three is the winner. You can choose from easy, medium, and hard skill levels as you tackle the world of volleyball. Simply move forward or backward and become one with the physics engine in order to understand how it all works and achieve your wildest dreams.

name: Books Tower
author: Addicting Games
description: Books Tower is a cute and simple stacking game based on books. If you’re a book nerd and you love seeing books stacked up to the top, then you’ll love this cute online game. Your objective is to stack as many books as you can without having the tower topple over. Sure that might seem easy, but as the books oscillate from right to left you’ll find it to be more difficult than it may seem. You have to click on the screen and get it to drop at the perfect time to perfectly align the books on top of each other. Stack your books of varying colors on a simply drawn desk as peppy music plays in the background. Click on the leader board to see how well you stack up against other book stackers on this online game.

name: BoomRockets
author: Addicting Games
description: Our fireworks are so dangerous, we have to keep them online! Launch your rocket, gather fuel, money and points as you go, then let one rip with a giant explosion! Blow away that Independence day crowd with your pyro skillz! Can you impress your cranky Uncle Sam?

name: Boomshine
author: Addicting Games
description: Boomshine is a free puzzle game. Action, reaction, bubbles floating and popping. Trip out with a flashlight in a room full of colors. Can you make them all go boom?

name: Boo!
author: Addicting Games
description: Boo is a free puzzle game. We hope you can follow instructions and follow your gut. In Boo! you'll be competing with yourself to decorate your pumpkin in the most accurate way possible. You'll need to carefully match the designs on the right-hand side of the screen through a series of complicated filtering and masking. This game is a lot of fun but it is really hard. You'll need to think like an artist and an engineer if you want to perfectly match the pumpkins and save Halloween. This game requires you to use different masking agents like hats, masks, eye-patches, and fake teeth in order to cover up the pumpkin and preserve the paint underneath it while you are adding a new color on top of it. It all must be done in layers and those layers must be precise or you'll never win. Just like in life, this game is complicated but rewarding. A splish splash of spectacular tricking, some treating and a lot of ghoulishly cute jack-o-lantern designs for your friends and you to enjoy.

name: Bot Arena 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Bot Arena 3 is a free arena game. Battling bots of blazing fury! Now with shinier, faster, happier robots. Will your bot survive the metallic holocaust?

name: Bounce Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Sling a purple blob from platform to platform, collecting coins, in this cute platformer.

name: Bounce Ball
author: Addicting Games
description: Bounce Ball is an easy clicker game where your objective is to get the ball through each sliding block! This online game is set against a solid background with simplistic animation. With every game, you get a different pastel-colored background like gray, blue and purple. This game was designed all-around to be entertaining, easy, and relaxing. All you will see is a basic white ball and basic white blocks sliding together as you play through the game. Click on the ball to navigate through the game and avoid the sliding blocks. Keep going as far as you can to beat your own personal best score or to rise up the leaderboards. From the main menu, you can click on the leaderboards to see if you’ve made the cut and see how well you did against your friends here on AddictingGames. You can also click to replay the game to beat your most recent score. This is a great time-killer game that you can play on your mobile device or your computer. There is no tutorial needed because it’s that easy to play!

name: Bowja 3: Ninja Kami
author: Addicting Games
description: A stolen amulet has disturbed the Ninja Spirit! Outwit and outfight baddies to return the amulet and restore order in this tiny universe!

name: Bowman 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Bowman 2 is a free archery-shooting game with simple stickman animation. This is the sequel to your favorite archery game, Bowman. In this online game, your objective is to aim your arrow and hit your living opponents. You can play the game in four modes: computer, human, practice, and bird hunting. Choose the computer if you want to play on your own to compete against an AI. If you have a friend over, then you can choose the two-player mode to take turns at taking shots at each other. If you rather just play casually you can either practice or choose to shoot down birds. When fighting against archers, you’ll want to aim for the head to get a clean kill. Otherwise, you may only injure your enemy which means they can still take you out. Although your objective is to kill, this is a slow-paced game that requires thought and skill versus speed and strength. Practice your archery skills and aim well with this casual shooter game. Test. test 2

name: Box Blitz
author: Addicting Games
description: Back and forth, back and forth, move the box back and forth. Avoid the spikes. Avoid the spikes, the box keeps going back and forth as long as you avoid the spikes. There's a rhythm to this game, how long can you keep up the delicate dance? Click to jump from side to side, earn some coins to modify your experience and climb to the top.

name: Box Hero
author: Addicting Games
description: Box Hero is a free avoider game.

name: Boxhead 2Play
author: Addicting Games
description:
Boxhead 2 is ta free online combat games. Lock and load your favorite item, take on the whole world in slo mode or tag in a friend to blast away at the competition back to back like in your favorite action movie. The choice is yours! Customize your character, unlock the items and upgrades you need to defeat your opponents and the cool skins and hats you want to look cool: just like in real life! The real cool thing about Boxhead 2 is that unlike most free online action games, this game allows you to share the link with your friend and become an unbeatable dynamic duo! You'll be going toe to toe with other players from around the world. Some will be solo aandsome will be duo's. This kind of competition is the perfect way to test your skills against real human opponents. Even the best AI can be defeaated through simple human cunning and rational thinking, but people? Real live honest to goodness human beings sitting on the other side of the scrreen? They are going to require a little bit more gumption than your average non player character! 

Do you have what it takes? Does your team mate have what it takes? Will you work with a friend who is a thousand miles away or cosy up together in the same room? The choice is yours!

name: Boxing
author: Addicting Games
description: For some reason, the only two boxers you have a choice of using are either Al Roker or Starr Jones parodies. No real boxers.

name: Boxing Punches
author: Addicting Games
description: Boxing Punches is a free clicker game. Wax on and punch out the competition in this hard-hitting boxing simulation where you can fight another player or go head to head with the computer in a no holds barred fight to end. Test your reflexes and click your way to victory as different enemies, objects, and bystanders pop up and disappear just as fast. If you want to build points you'll need to hit fast but also hit smart. The different objects, enemies, and bystanders are a challenge you will use to sharpen your skills. Hit the bad guys, but save the bystanders, smash the objects and not the kitties.; We have to save the kitties, folks, we don't think that needs to be repeated. If you're feeling down a good punch-up will help you get to the top of the charts in this fast, fun, and ferocious boxing game. If you're playing on desktop you can even slide into two-player mode and take on a friend for real in the comfort of your own home.

name: Boxing Stars
author: Addicting Games
description: Boxing Stars is a free-action game.

name: Braains.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Braaains.io is a free IOGame. Being a human is hard but being a zombie is harder.  Imagine what it might be like to be a zombie wandering around with a swarm of other zombies in a lonely old farmhouse as you look for foolish humans to eat. Perhaps the opposite is true, you are a human who is trying to outrun the angry hordes.  Use available weapons to kill as many zombies as possible or use your feets to run around and chomp down on as many humans as possible. The longer you survive the more points you will earn to unlock weapons that you can purchase and then upgrade. Destroying zombies is a noble pursuit just like eating humans is. This game allows you to choose who you would like to be and what you want to accomplish.

name: Brain Trainer
author: Addicting Games
description: Brain Trainer is a free puzzle game. Brain Trainer is like one of those clever quizzes that is absolutely impossible to guess, it's like a test for idiots that only the most brilliant people around can pass. Brain Trainer will trick you into seeing the world from a new point of view. You'll thrill to the different types of questions and their audacity, hilarity, and originality. Brain trainer is a clever quiz game that is designed to get inside your head and live under your skin. These are questions that will tease your mind, tickle your consciousness, and make you ask the big questions about life and everything. Brain Trainer is a game designed for people who know everything but are open to learning everything else. This is a series of questions that will have you facepalming, cheering, and pulling your hair out. We know that Brain Trainer is a special game. It is a game that takes its rightful place in the long and hallowed tradition of quiz games that are more clever than most of their players. If your think you have what it takes to beat this game then we double-dog dare you to prove it.

name: Brickbreaker.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Brickbreaker.io is a free IOgame.

name: Britney Spears Wedding
author: Addicting Games
description: Aw, Britney - ready for love again! And only two minutes to make it to the altar! But what is all this...baggage? Cheetos, ex boyfriends, and delicious snacks! Fortunately, there are a few powerups to make this wedding happen. All the cheezy puffs in the world can not stand in the way of love!

name: Broken TV
author: Addicting Games
description: Broken TV is a free, mobile puzzle game. Everything can glitch and anything can go wrong. In Broken TV you will take on the role of a TV repair-person who will be tasked with unraveling the broken fragments of television and putting them all back together like a puzzle. The true twist behind Broken TV is that the particular puzzles you'll be trying to piece together aren't static, still images. No, in this game the puzzle pieces are segments of a looping gif. If you thought putting together a puzzle was hard, now its a moving, looping target. It is much more difficult to figure out where a piece goes when the piece is moving. Harder but more fulfilling when you ultimately do get it right. You can also toggle the difficulty of the game by increasing the number of pieces the picture will be split into, thus increasing the replayability of the game and ensuring that older levels will remain fresh and challenging for even experienced players. Broken TV is an aesthetically pleasing game that offers a unique challenge for even the most hardcore puzzle fans. If you're bored of static images then step up to another level.

name: Broski
author: Addicting Games
description:
Broski is an endless runner game with funny-stylized pixel graphics, inspired by Chrome Dino, but you have a gun!
Run through different variants of enemies, either jump or shoot, while your speed velocity increases! Last as long as you can and reach your highest score!

name: Bruh.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
Bruh.io is a free io arena game. Welcome to Bruh.io, a 2D shooter game that has 3 different modes. In this game, you can jump into the arena as a solo player and take on the world all by yourself. Or, if you're feeling adventurous you can also team up with a real-life friend and play duo battles where you tag-team against other tag teams. Finally, there is the squad mode which will allow you to team up with your real-life friends in order to take on various other squads of real-life people doing exactly the same thing. Bruh.io offers a lot of cool tactical and strategic choices for the players to make, as well as a healthy assortment of weapons, items, armor, and all sorts of cool stuff. Bruh.io is already a modern classic in the world of iogames so you might as well jump in and get familiar with the frenetic energy of the game.

Choose your team, choose your weapons, and battle it out for victory in an arena-style deathmatch that you could scarcely dream about in even your wildest fantasies. Bruh.io is the ultimate in arena showdowns.

name: Bubbits Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Bubbits on Steam now!

 

Pop your way to victory in a colorful next generation Bubble Shooter. Perfect for casual and competitive players alike! Compete in a 25 Player Battle Royale or go solo in the Daily Challenge or the Adventure Mode. Customize your playfield, unleash Power Ups and experience crazy battle events that shake up the game!

name: Bubble Invasion
author: Addicting Games
description: Bubble Invasion is a free bubble shooter game. Welcome to the true Bubble invasion. In this game, you are in control of a crazy chromatic canon that fires ponderous orbs of different colored ammo. It is your mission to match the various colors in groups of three or more and get combos to disappear the variety of colors from the map. The longer you wait to make your shot the more likely the wall of colors is to slowly creep towards you. You'll have to think fast and aim true but also think about where you're landing the bubbles. Remember, a well-placed shot can knock off massive chunks of the rainbow wall if you place the shots perfectly by banking them off of the wall. Strike at a hidden artery of the wall and bring the whole thing down for bonus points. You are the commander in charge of this game and it is your mission to maximize your points by optimizing each of your shots to achieve the ultimate in damage. This is war and you are the last general in the rainbow army.

name: Bubble Paradise
author: Addicting Games
description: Bubble Paradise is a bubble shooter game that is easy to play. Enter into this cute paradise with a helpful zebra who will show you the way. Through the waterfall, you will find a group of bubbles that you need to destroy! This game is fairly easy, just aim and shoot at matching bubbles. As you shoot the bubbles, more bubbles will be added to the bunch and it will begin coming down. Whatever you do, do not let the bubbles pass the white-dotted line! As you keep playing, you will sometimes find power-ups like bombs that will let you blast the group no matter what color they are. Blast as many bubbles as you can for the best score possible! Play the game over and over by challenging yourself and beating your best score every time. Click on the scores icon to drop down the list of the high scorers of this bubble shooter game. Will you make the list?

name: Bubble Pop Valhalla
author: Addicting Games
description: Bubble Pop is a free clicker game. Pop the bubbles it's nothing new, in groups of three or maybe two, if the colors you cannot see then use the logos to guide your tapping spree. Bubble Pop is a game that challenges your ability to see patterns, smash them, and pivot to the next challenge. Each correctly popped set of bubbles will inherently alter the playing field and in doing so the game will be altered irrevocably. This is not the end of the world for those that have the ability to see ahead. The true masters of this game are the people who are able to see 3 potential pops and optimize which cluster they'll bust by pre-determining the outcome of the pop and thinking one move, two moves, even three moves ahead. If you feel overwhelmed by problems stacking up without a solution site then you'll love this game where every obstacle can be popped and disposed of without nary a thought. Challenge your friends, defeat your enemies, the world is yours all yours, so long as you are able to play along and devastate the competition. Do you feel like you have what it takes to make it all the way to Bubble Pop Valhalla? Then prove it with the tips of your fingers and the skin of your teeth in this thrilling new bubble popping bonanza.

name: Bubble Shooter Classic
author: Addicting Games
description: Play Bubble Shooter Classic on Addicting Games! Match and pop colorful bubbles in this timeless, free puzzle game that’s easy to play and hard to put down.

name: Bubble Spinner
author: Addicting Games
description: Play Bubble Spinner, the classic bubble shooter game! Match colors, clear bubbles, and spin your way to a high score in this fun, casual puzzle game.

name: Bubble Trouble
author: Addicting Games
description:
The original arcade classic that started it all - pure, addictive bubble-popping action with simple controls and increasingly challenging levels.
Bubble Trouble is a retro-style arcade shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat armed with a spike gun. Pop bouncing bubbles that split into smaller, faster threats with each hit. Dodge and shoot your way through increasingly chaotic levels, clearing the screen before the bubbles overwhelm you. Quick reflexes are your best weapon!

name: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
author: Addicting Games
description: Help our hero in the trench coat pop many colorful bubbles once again! Stand right under a bubble to shoot your harpoon upwards, and watch the bubble multiply. Now pop the newly emerged bubbles, which will again multiply until they are small enough to be destroyed completely. Pay attention to dodging the bubbles at any cost, as you will lose the round if a bubble touches you. This addictive and legendary flash game is now back! Can you pop all the bubbles until there are no more?

name: Bubble Trouble 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Bubble Trouble 3 is an arcade bubble shooter game that is also referred to as Bubble Struggle. Your objective is to blow up all the balls on the screen with your trusty harpoon. Stand right under a bubble to shoot your harpoon upwards, and watch the bubble multiply. Now pop the newly emerged bubbles, which will again multiply until they are small enough to be destroyed completely. Pay attention to dodging the bubbles at any cost, as you will lose the round if a bubble touches you. There is a 2-player mode in the third instalment, so you can now enjoy this experience with your friends. This classic flash game sure will feel nostalgic.

name: Bubble Woods
author: Addicting Games
description: Bubble Woods is a free shooting game with cute and colorful animation. Help out this adorable squirrel as she works through the night trying to blow up all the bubbles in the woods. There are several levels in this online game waiting to be beaten by you! Aim your bubble at the crowd of bubbles as it slowly comes down and giving you more of a challenge.
