Don’t let it come down past your character or else you’ll lose before time is up! As you unlock levels, there are boosts you can also unlock that help you gain higher scores. For instance, the first boost is a timer that you can use to increase your time playing the levels. You can also earn boosts during the game like the fire cannon that will blast all the bubbles no matter the color. For every level you pass, the leaderboard will dropdown to let you know where you stand against other bubble shooter players.

name: BuildRoyale.io
author: Addicting Games
description: BuildRoyale.io is a battle-royale IO game where you use your surroundings to build a barrier to survive. This is a massive multiplayer game where you’re dropped into game with absolutely nothing but an ax. Use the axe to defend yourself and gather materials. You’ll be able to create a barrier to protect yourself once you have enough materials. In the meantime, search for weapons and other supplies to survive because others will take advantage of your weak state and try to kill you. You must upgrade as fast as possible because your goal is to be the last player standing. Fight, gather, and build in this multiplayer battle royale game. You have the option to play solo, in a duo team, or join a team for better chances of surviving. Invite your friends or play it out alone in this epic IO game where you build and fight to survive.

name: Bulletleague.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Bulletleague.io is a free IOgame.  All the world is a league and we are just the bullets caught in the great arena of life. This is why such a game needed to exist and why we needed to publish it. Bulletleague.io isn't just your average arena shooter, it is the ultimate arena shooter, the kind of arena shooter that songs will be written about and stories will be told about for generations yet to come. Broadly speaking, Bulletleague.io is the ultimate arena shooter with a ton of weapons that players can use to devastate the opposition. We suggest this game for people who have played all the other games like it and enjoyed the basic idea but felt there was something lacking and found themselves asking for more, for better, and for faster bullets in more of a league-like setting. We are confident that this is exactly the kind of game you'll be into playing until your fingers bleed and your thumbs fall to the floor. What are human beings for but to be opposing players in an epic game like this? You'll see, you'll all see in this brilliant and blazing game of bullets and leagues.

name: Bunny Goes Boom!
author: Addicting Games
description: Strap your bunny to a rocket and try to avoid the bombs!

name: Burger Ran
author: Addicting Games
description: Burger Run is a free endless avoider game.

name: Burger Tycoon
author: Addicting Games
description: Burger Tycoon is a free resource management game. In the strategy/management game, Burger Tycoon, build your own fast-food burger empire from the ground up and then give the hungry people just what they want, nice and juicy hamburgers. With as many fast food places there are in the world, you’d think that creating your own would be as easy as, well, a hamburger—boy would you be mistaken. To succeed, you have to successfully manage every step of the process, from the cow to the counter, as well as the company itself. Lose too much money and go too far into the red, and you’ll go bankrupt, and it’s game over. Succeed, and you’ll become nothing short of a Burger Tycoon.

name: Cake Shop
author: Addicting Games
description: Cake Shop is a free resource management game. Bake cakes in this fun time-management game. You’re a chef in this cake shop and it’s your job to both make and serve cakes to customers. Each customer is different, so you’ll have to put together a different cake with filling each time. The faster you serve the cake, the better tip you’ll get. It also helps if you get the order right. If you get it wrong, you’ll have to trash because the customer won’t take it. With every shift, you’ll earnings will all be calculated together. You’ll be able to get equipment that can help you run your shop. For instance, you can work to get a coffee machine that will add another item to your sales. In this fun time-management baking game, you’ll start off slow but each level brings you more customers and more items to serve. You’ll eventually get a table to help you make items ahead and stay ahead of the crowd. As it gets more difficult, you’ll have to speed up but still remain accurate so you don’t have upset customers. The worst thing you can do is have a customer wait so long that they leave the shop. If you make a mistake you can throw your cake away in the trash. If you don’t make enough cash that day, you can replay the level.

name: Cake Shop 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Feeling Sweet? Share your cupcakes and cookies with the neighborhood. Upgrade your bakery, expand, and dominate the dessert world!

name: Cake Tile
author: Addicting Games
description: Cake Tile is a free puzzle game.

name: Calamity King
author: Addicting Games
description:
Endure the Calamity and rise victorious as the Calamity King!

In this chess-themed bullethell, you'll hop, dodge and strike your way across a chess board arena as you endure an endless onslaught of enemies! Each enemy is a different chess piece with unique attacks, so you'll have to learn their patterns and strike when they're vulnerable!

Can you defeat five levels of Calamity and secure your reign?

name: Call of War: World War 2
author: Addicting Games
description: What if World War Two didn't quite go the way we remember? History is not written in stone and through war all things possible. In this massively multiplayer online role-playing game you will play the role of a country during World War Two. You may choose between the Axis or the Allied powers. Your choices in regards to infantry placements, attacks, the types of tanks, and armor that you buy, as well as what you invest in your navy and air force could completely re-define the course of human history. But conquest doesn't just come at the end of a gun. In Call of War, you'll be able to not only conquer provinces but also forge alliances with other players in order to build up your own economy. At its heart, Call of War is a resource management game. So, you'll also be investing time and money into researching secret weapons which might bring about the end of the war.

name: Candy Bubble
author: Addicting Games
description: Candy Bubble is a free bubble shooter game. Candy is a sweet treat and bubbles are airy fun. When you combine the two you get a crazy, floaty, and dreamy synthesis of fun and excitement. Use your aim and try to recognize the patterns as you blast your way through various levels filled with multicolored balls that are slowly filling up.  You'll have a blast taking potshots at the wall of candy-colored bubbles and trying to keep them at bay before they are able to overcome you. You'll have to be fast, you'll have to be accurate, and you'll have to have fun in this fast-paced shooter game. Line up the colors and take your shot as you try to climb your way up the leader board. Oh boy if only you could just use your cannon to launch yourself to the top but that wouldn't be fair and that's, not how life works. You gotta work.

name: Candy Connect 2
author: Addicting Games
description:
Candy connect 2 is a free puzzle game. There is a world of treats out there just waiting to be eaten. Colorful and delicious snacks that you can chow down on as long as you have the ability to recognize patterns and connect them. Candy, donuts, licorice treats, brownies and yes even ice cream. You'll have to recognize the difference between all of these candy-coated snacks if you want to make it to the top of the leaderboard in this game.

Connecting the same colored tiles will cause them to disappear. The level is cleared when you have successfully connected all of the tiles. Your score will be based on how fast you are able to clear a level. In order to optimize your strategy, you'll want to connect tiles that open up or unlock tiles behind or beneath them. You may also have multiple tiles in the process of connecting at once so long as they can legally be connected. Try to think a few moves ahead, start on the outside and move in. Always be aware of how a move you make might alter the playing field.

name: Candy Pop
author: Addicting Games
description: Candy Pop is a matching game where you get to match delicious candies! You don’t have to have sweet tooth to play this online game. Just bring your quick clicking skills to match as many candies as you can. This online game has easy controls with cute and bright animation. There are a variety of candies from peppermint, bubble gum, tangerine, and even chocolate! Your objective is to find 2 or more matching candies to click on. The candies must be either next to each other or above each other. Candies cannot be matched diagonally. New candies will fill the top as your matches disappear. At the end of each match, you will get your current score and best score. You will also get a badge to indicate your abilities. Play to challenge yourself beating your best score and earning the gold badge!

name: Candy Stacker
author: Addicting Games
description: Candy Stacker is an educational game that will help you with your math skills! If you need to practice your math skills but you rather play games, then try out this sticky-sweet stacker game. Your objective is to create the highest stack of sweets that you have ever seen! There is candy, ice cream, donuts, and cake for you to place on top of each other as they reach to the sky. If you get one problem wrong, then the whole delicious tower will come tumbling down. You must not admit defeat though! Play again and beat your best score every time. Math is all about repetition so play until you conquer each skill. You don’t need to be bored when it comes to math with this fun math game!

name: Candyland Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Candyland Mahjong is one of the sweetest tile-matching games on the web. Check out all 60 levels of varying difficulty and layouts. This online mahjong game has a colorful candy-themed background with equally uplifting music. Your goal is to match all of the vibrant candies that you'll find on the tiles. In the right-hand column, you can find your level, score, and a timer to help you in keep track with the game. Try to work as quickly and efficiently as can to gain all three stars per level. Beat all the levels and then submit your score to see who is the best!

name: Cannibal Cafe
author: Addicting Games
description: Use your skills a sushi chef to concoct cannibal delicacies. Just don't get the proportions wrong, because too much rice in a hand roll is kind of gross.

name: Cannibal Casserole
author: Addicting Games
description: Castaways are edible, but require thorough cooking. Use your catapult skills to toss wayward humans into your giant cooking pot. Obstacles abound: aim carefully, monkey!

name: Cannon Ball
author: Addicting Games
description: Take turns lobbing cannon balls at each other’s castles, until one of you is blown back to serfdom.

name: Cannonbolf
author: Addicting Games
description: Long before Golf was invented all they had was Cannon's so here's a faithful recreation of Medieval soldiers pass time. That's right CANNONBOLF

name: Countries Of The World Trivia
author: Addicting Games
description: Countries of the World is an educational game that teaches you where all countries in the world are located. Geography can be hard to memorize but with this map game, you will learn all of your countries in no time. There are 3 levels of this online game to help you study for the next big exam or if you want to just brush up on your geography skills. Each level contains 30 questions regarding each country you need to identify. You need to pass a certain amount of questions in order to advance to the next level. Don’t worry, though, this is an educational game so it teachers you when you get the answer wrong. Show off to your friends or study for your geography class using this fun and educational game!

name: Capitals of North America
author: Addicting Games
description: Capitals of North America is a free geography game. Welcome to the wide and wonderful world of trivia for fun. Do you really know this great land of ours as well as you think you do? Well, now is your chance to prove it with this fun game of geographic trivia. Confident about Connecticut? Feeling like you know Michigan like the palm of your hand? This is a pop quiz hotshot and you need to prove whether or not you're as well versed in capitals as you like to think. We are giving you the opportunity to prove what you know and learn what you don't in fast, fun, and free geography-based trivia games. So, sharpen your mind, and share your knowledge as you click, tap, and answer your way through a series of questions that celebrate this great nation's great capitals.  This is a mobile game where you will be drilled with questions about where specific capitals are in the United States. You will have the ability to answer these questions by clicking on the map and selecting the region you think is the correct answer. Wrong answers will turn red and the right answers will glow green.

name: Capitals of South America
author: Addicting Games
description: Capitals of South America is a geography game that is available here on AddictingGames to advance your education. Locating countries is one thing, but knowing all the capitals of South America will really impress people. Do you know where the capital of Cayenne or Quito is? What Georgetown or Caracus? If you are completely stumped or you just want to show off your knowledge, Capitals of South America is the educational game for you. There is only 1 level and it only contains 14 questions. Even if you get it wrong, this online game will teach you along the way letting you know which capital you did select. Pay attention to these notes and get better with every round of this game. Geography doesn’t have to be boring when you have an interactive game like this one. The timer on the game lets you know how fast you finish the game each time.

name: Car Eats Car: Arctic Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Car Eats Car: Arctic Adventure is a free IOGame.

name: Car Eats Car Dungeon Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Car Eats Car Dungeon Adventure.

name: Car Eats Car: Undersea Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Car Eats Car: Undersea Adventure is a free desktop game.

name: Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure is a free racing game. You're going to need some slippery skills to get behind the wheel of this fishy truck and pull off sharky stunts to score sharky points and make sharky cash. Car Eats Car: Underwater Adventure is an endless racing game where you race until you die. After you die that means you can upgrade your wheels, hull, engine, fuel, and bumper with all the cash you made and get back on the track to win some more. See how far you can go and make it to the top of the leaderboard. The best part of this game is when you upgrade your shark-shaped truck all the way to the top of the leaderboard. So,  upgrade your bumper and smash your way through the underwater enemies. Increase your engine and go faster for longer.  Get some new wheels and outmaneuver the competition. This is your game it is all about you.

name: Car Eats Car: Volcanic Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Car Eats Car: Volcanic Adventure is a free racing game. Sidescrolling race games are the new hotness, in fact you should take it from us: You're going to be seeing a lot more of them around these parts. Cars are crazy. Cars that are trapped in an infernal volcano filled with giant spiders and demons? Also really cool. This is a game about a car that is trying to fight giant spiders in hell. If you think any of that sounds cool or like stranger things then you will like this game. In this game you move fast and destroy everything. Evil is in your way and you got 6 wheels and a whole lot of torque behind your response. Don't let em get you down.

name: Car Eats Car: Winter Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Car Eats Car is a free racing game.

name: CARDLIKE
author: Addicting Games
description:
Cardlike is a high-stakes deck-builder that blends fast-paced gameplay with strategic depth while remaining easy to pick up.

 

Choose your strategy by creating unique original combos and dominate using your intellect.

 

Core Gameplay
Match Card Hands - Build the ultimate hand to score big!
Crazy Combos - Discover powerful card interactions and go infinite!
Optimize - Refine your deck to surpass target scores!
Win - Outsmart the RNG and secure the run!

 

Features
200+ unique cards and consumables!
Infinite replayability!

name: Carmela Sutera Wedding Dress Up
author: Addicting Games
description: This demure damsel needs your help in dressing up for her big day. Can you choose the best dress for her ceremony?

name: Casino Blackjack
author: Addicting Games
description: Casino Blackjack is a casino game for you to play without fear of losing real money! Enter a digital casino where the chips are fake but the game is still fun to play. Each game starts you off with a certain number of chips for you to get started. Just because the risk is not real, you have to play the game with effort in order to get through all the levels. There are 5 levels of this card game, and each level has a certain goal you must reach in order to advance to the next one. Use your chips wisely but do take risks when you think you have a good hand. Playing safe will only get you so far! Submit your score to see if you are a high scorer!

name: Casino World
author: Addicting Games
description: Casino World is a free casino game.

name: Castle Crashing the Beard
author: Addicting Games
description: You're a brave knight battling against a horrible, terrible, horrific... Beard!? Yeah, and your weapon is a toilet plunger. Into battle!

name: Castle Wars: Legacy
author: Addicting Games
description:
Castle Wars: Legacy is a free browser-based card strategy game where two players compete to destroy each other's castle. Collect and play resource, attack, defense, and magic cards each turn to build up your fortress or crush your opponent. Challenge the AI in a 6-level story campaign, climb the ELO leaderboard, compete in daily tournaments, and unlock achievements.

 

Wall absorbs damage before your castle takes a hit. Once the wall is gone, your castle is exposed.

Win by: destroying the opponent's castle (reduce it to 0) or being the first to reach 100 castle HP.

Campaign — fight through 6 story levels against the AI and earn up to 3 stars per level.

PvP — challenge real players, earn an ELO rating, and climb the leaderboard.

Tournaments — three arenas host daily tournaments with a coin prize pool.

name: Cat Fun
author: Addicting Games
description: Play Cat Fun on Addicting Games! Tap matching kittens to clear them, create powerups, and enjoy endless fun in this colorful and adorable puzzle game.

name: Cat Wars
author: Addicting Games
description: Cat wars is a free educational game. Cats are the alpha predators of the night. Furry creatures that are all claws and teeth who will wake you up at all hours of the night, follow you everywhere or become completely aloof and ignore you as they stare listlessly out the window. When you do finally succumb to their petulant meowing, cats love to venture outdoors and get into all kinds of trouble. If you've been ever interested in exactly what kind of trouble then wonder no more, for this game will show you the hijinx your favorite feline friends are up to at this very moment. Join your cat friends as they enter the night and get into territorial battles over delicious sausage. Another thing most people don't know about cats is that they're really good at math. Math games are an integral part of what makes a cat a cat, how do you think they got nine lives? Math. So, join your favorite furry friends and answer a bunch of math questions in order to help them win a tug-of-war over sausage. May the best kitty win.

name: Cat with Bow Golf
author: Addicting Games
description: Cat with Bow Golf is a free physics game. Try not to send this kitty sailing out of bounds. Getting the cat on target is harder than it looks, but the usual rules of golf apply to these floating greens.

name: CAT Z Studio
author: Addicting Games
description:
CAT Z Studio is a music creating tool and game with a drag and drop mixing experience. It's built of 10 different game modes and focuses on a specific music style that contain upto 12 different
loops and beats. The game features equalisers and other settings to deliver the best possible gaming experience. When you are satisfied with your mix you can save it to enjoy it later.

name: Catch the Turkey
author: Addicting Games
description: This turkey is way too excited about its impending death. Can you turn this turkey into dinner with a smile?

name: Cats VS Dogs
author: Addicting Games
description: Cats VS Dogs is a free clicker game.

name: Chain Sums
author: Addicting Games
description: Chain Sums is a free puzzle game. Sometimes you have to add it all up and sometimes you have to subtract it all. It is extremely hard to know what the right thing is to do sometimes and that is why math is so satisfying. Math is simple, it is straightforward, and math has absolute answers to specific questions. Math is right or it is wrong, there is no gray zone. That is what makes math so fun and it is why so many people love math. In Chain Sums, you will take control of the algorithm itself. It is your job to take all of the disparate numbers and their associated mathematical symbols and then place them in such an order that you will accomplish the goal. The goal of this game is to arrange and re-arrange the available numbers in such a way that you can chain them together in order to unlock the pre-determined sums at the top of the screen. At first, this will be easy and the numbers will just flow but it gets tricky, especially as there are more numbers and symbols added to the grid. But you can do it, it can be done. this is a puzzle game with a fixed outcome and all the data you need to achieve the outcome.

name: Champion Archer
author: Addicting Games
description: Champion Archer is a free stick game. Your life depends on your aim with arrows. Will you be able to slay enough stick soldiers to grab the illustrious quick shot?

name: Charger Escape
author: Addicting Games
description: Charger Escape is a free escape game. Horses don't have thumbs. That's why they need your help! Get this horse out of the stable, escape-style!

name: Checkers Online Foony
author: Addicting Games
description: Play multiplayer Checkers online! Challenge friends or players worldwide in this classic strategy board game—jump, capture, and crown your pieces to victory.

name: Checkerz Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Checkerz Mania is a free checkers game. Get ready, get mad, get mad because this is a strategy game that you can enjoy from your computer or mobile device. This is an online game based on the classic board game of checkers. If you are looking for a simple game with classic rules, this is the online game for you. Depending on your expertise or even your mood, you have the option to select from easy, medium, hard, and expert. You also have the option of playing either the black or white piece. Even though you are playing against a computer, do not feel intimidated! The game will give you hints and strong suggestions as to what is the next best possible move. This is a great casual game that will train your mind without being overwhelming.

name: Chemz
author: Addicting Games
description: Chemz is a free iogame. This is the future where chemicals are sprayed from planes to troll the populace. Those who make the most money an have the most power are the few, brave, the only pilots who are able to troll the most citizens. Pilot your plane and fly tactically in order to leave a trail of angry red-faced citizens in your wake. There is an arena full of citizens who are there to be conquered. All you have to do is deliver the toxin. As you play the game, collect as many resources as you can to upgrade your various weapons. Collect power-ups that let you do three different things: speed up, fire missiles at competing pilots, or drop bombs to protect your crop dusted persons. As you take over more and more of the map your plane will grow in size your wingspan will get even better. This makes it easier to crop-dust but it also makes you a bigger target so you'll have to pay attention.

name: Chess Arena
author: Addicting Games
description: Chess Arena is a free IOgame. You have beaten all the masters of the world in sweaty, tense, one on one match-ups. You eat, sleep, and breathe chess, it has become second nature to you and now there is no more challenge. Well, what if told you the real gambit is to take it to the next level and build an empire in Chess Arena. This is an arena fighter game where the only rule is the rules of chess. That's right you are a team of chessed up baddies who move just like normal chess pieces but you have transcended the 8x8 grid into a sprawling arena filled with chess thugs like yourself who are looking for the latest hit and the greatest taste of success. In a normal chess match, you pit your petty little wits against the machinations of an opponent of equal skill. It is an ordinary way for ordinary people to enjoy themselves but once you have fully grasped the true nature of chess you will find that only Chess Arena can scratch that itch. So, strap in, settle down, and let's get ready to chess in chess arena.

name: Chibi Princess DressUp
author: Addicting Games
description: Chibi is Japanese for 'little person.' See? Even dress up games have something to teach you! Now lets get pretty, shall we?

name: Chicky Jumper
author: Addicting Games
description: Chicky Jumper is a free clicker game. You are the cutest cube-based chick that ever did cluck and all you want to do is fly your way home. The problem is that your path is beset by obstacles of all kinds, flaming roosters, spinning spikes, emerald lasers, and the dreaded floating platforms of doom. All you can do is click, wait, and click again but all at the right time. Clicking is how you fly and every click will take you up and let you drop in predictable increments. Your mission is going to be to use those clicks to fly and avoid the worst obstacles possible in order to make it to the top of the leader board. Rise up ever higher in this endless runner style clicking game where every click brings you closer to the sweet, sweet taste of victory.  You want to grow up to be a strong confident chicken but you're going to face a lot of obstacles. Not all of them will be as literal or as deadly as the fire-breathing roosters and emerald lasers that block your path but all of them will challenge and change you. Raise your beak, straighten your back and learn to overcome before you become overwhelmed in this fast, fun, and free clicker game.

name: China Temple Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: China Temple Mahjong is an online mahjong game. This is a classic online version of mahjong for you to play from your computer or mobile device. The tiles are set against beautiful and traditional backgrounds from China. Match two open tiles until you make them all disappear in this online mahjong game. To help you out, open tiles will appear brighter and tiles you cannot use will have a gray shadow. Try to free tiles to be able to use them and to beat the game. There are 20 levels of this mahjong game for you to solve! This is a timed game so do not hesitate and work quickly. At the end of this online game, submit your score to see if you made it to the top online players.

name: Chocolate Shop
author: Addicting Games
description: Chocolate Shop is an exciting time-management game that you have to play. This restaurant game has 10 levels for you to complete. Your goal is to keep all of your customers happy, make chocolate, and keep the business running. This is a tycoon game that's fun to play and will keep you interested with its fast-paced duties. On the top tab, you'll find your goals, score, a timer, and your level to help you keep track of your success. Don't forget to submit your score!

name: Christmas Balls
author: Addicting Games
description: Christmas Balls is a cute shooter game with a Christmas twist! For those of you who like shooter games but hate violence and gore, this is the perfect shooter game for you. This shooter game is set against a mint green background with fir trees along the sides as snow falls down. The objective of the online game is simple: aim at the bells in the middle of the spinning wreath. The wreath has an opening that you must wait for because shooting any part of it will cause you to lose the game. On top of hitting the center, to gain points, you must hit an oscillating gold star. To keep things interesting, sometimes the wreath will start spinning in the opposite direction so stay alert. This is an easy game, so just click on the screen and start playing!

name: Christmas Merge
author: Addicting Games
description: Christmas Merge is a free merge game. This time only comes once a year and it doesn't last very long so when it is here you should probably make the most of it. That is right, we're talking about merge time, merge time is everyone's favorite time of the year when they stop to reflect upon numbers from 1-9 and how to merge adjacent numbers together in order to become those other numbers. Christmas Merge is kind of a puzzle game and kind of a math game. It is a little bit of both and in fact, you could even say that we merged the two in order to create this game. However, that is technically a different type of merging than what is happening in this game. In this game, you need to click on one tile in order to bring its number up by one and thus match at least two adjacent tiles. Once you do that you'll merge all three tiles into the next chronological number and eventually what you're trying to do is get the highest possible merged number before you run out of possible tiles to merge. If you like to merge things and also like tile games then this is the game for you.

name: Civilization Wars: All-Stars
author: Addicting Games
description: Civilization Wars: All-Stars is an epic game of strategy and smarts. The world is at war, now and forever. In Civilization Wars you won't just choose a side you'll run it. Civilization Wars is not a simple game for simple people but rather an epic and intense game of global conflict that will ensare the lives of countless thousands. Choose your side, stake out a place on the map and then build your army, upgrade your weapons, train your soldiers, develop transport and supply lines, plot hostile take-overs of your neighbors, go to war and never give up. Civilization Wars is a game which rewards long term strategy and slowly bidding your time before you strike. In battle, you might need to use tactical logic to ascertain the most optimal form of combat but long term this game will be won by generals who know how to plan, pivot and push forward. In this variation of Civilization Wars you'll also have access to its three sequels. Each game is fully fleshed out and has its own unique world and choice of warriors from which to build your new world. Playthrough and finish all 4 titles if you dare. The more time you invest in learning the nuance of Civilization Wars the more you are likely to get out of it.

name: Civilizations Wars: Ice Legend
author: Addicting Games
description: Build up your civilization and upgrade your skills as you try to conquer the world! Send your elves to the claim buildings that are scattered on the battlefield. Claimed buildings will produce units; the larger the building, the faster it will produce units. There are also crystals on the battlefield, which will produce crystal energy when captured. Crystal energy allows you to cast various spells on your enemies. Completing battles will grant you experience points and skill points. As you level up, new battle modes will become available.

name: Clan Wars
author: Addicting Games
description: Clan Wars is a free strategy game. Create an army of goblins to destroy your enemy’s stronghold before they can destroy yours in Clan Wars, a strategy game of tug of war. As anyone who’s played tug of war knows, it’s all about the push and pull. Spawn units from your stronghold, and then watch as they march forever to the right of the screen—at least until they run into the enemy goblins. From there, it’s a battle to discover who’s the fairest goblin in the land.

name: Clanker.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Clanker.io is a free IOgame. Gear up and step into the thrilling world of Clanker.io, the ultimate IOgame that mixes heart-pounding action and over-the-top combat in a colossal arena where players worldwide clash as mighty mechs! This is an adrenaline-fueled IO gaming experience like never before, as you pilot your own mechanized war machine, aiming to dominate the arena and prove yourself as the mightiest mech warrior of all time. This game has two arenas to choose from and one starter mech. You can pick up shields, health packs, and weapon upgrades as you play. This will allow you to keep a competitive edge over the enemy. Players can pick from five different main canons and three different mines, allowing for various strategies and tactics to make yourself the best clankin' mech this side of the scrap pile.

name: Claritas Dungeon Crawler RPG Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Claritas Dungeon Crawler RPG on Steam now!

 

Claritas is a pure gameplay-driven, turn-based dungeon crawler that strips away the story to focus entirely on strategic party-building and tactical combat. With a vast roster of heroes, unique skill fusion mechanics, and the ability to freely swap and customize your party, every run offers new possibilities. Take on challenging bounty contracts, adapt to unpredictable dungeon events, and unlock hundreds of achievements as you refine your perfect strategy. Whether you're a casual adventurer or a hardcore RPG fan, Claritas delivers deep, rewarding gameplay with limitless replayability.

name: Clash Of Warriors
author: Addicting Games
description: Clash Of Warriors is a free strategy game. This is a strategy game where players build their own decks, customize cards, buy cards, and finally take them to battle against an evil warlord. In this free game, you and the warlord play cards one at a time in alternating turns. The cards must be laid down next to each other on a simple 3X3 grid. Each card has different attack, defense, and action powers which are located on the corners and sides of the cards. Depending on where you place them, different powers will be activated. The cards also have a health value which attacks can slowly drain. Your goal is to have the most amount of cards in play in the grid when all nine spaces have been filled, and no more new cards can be placed.

name: ClashBall.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
ClashBall.io is an exciting, competitive, fast-paced multiplayer game that requires precise timing, sharp focus and strategic gameplay.
Set in a dynamic, enclosed arena, players must avoid a dangerous homing ball that relentlessly chases them, knocking them out with a hit.
The ball will turn red when it's targeting you. Slash it with your weapon at the right time to deflect it toward an opponent, but be warned: each deflection causes the ball to accelerate, making it even harder to dodge.
Level up to unlock unique abilities that give you the edge in battle. Use your special power wisely to outsmart and eliminate your rivals.
The ultimate goal? Be the last player standing to claim victory!
Earn coins, open skin boxes and unlock a variety of outfits, hats, hairstyles and swords. Customize your character and show off your champion status in style!

name: Classic Bubble Shooter
author: Addicting Games
description: Match the bubbles! Remember that classic arcade game? It's still as relevant and fun as it was back in the day. Clear the board of all the bubbles and try to string together the largest collection of bubbles that you can.

name: Classic Freecell Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Classic Freecell Solitaire is a card game for you to play! If you are a fan of solitaire games and are looking for the classic, then this is the online game for you. There are no bells and whistles to this online game. Instead, it has a classic theme with simple controls. The objective is the same as any other Freecell solitaire card game: build 4 foundations from Ace to King. There are 4 free cells you can use to help you win the game. Each game is timed so the faster you finish, the better your score. Each score is submitted to the leaderboards where you can either challenge yourself or other players!

name: Classic Gin Rummy
author: Addicting Games
description:
Step into the world of Classic Gin Rummy, a timeless card game of skill and strategy. Play against AI opponents in fast-paced matches where the goal is to form sets and runs of cards to score points.

Skillfully manage your hand, making smart decisions to create winning combinations and minimize your opponent's chances. Use your knowledge of card sequences and combinations to outwit your rivals and declare victory.

With simple rules yet deep gameplay, Classic Gin Rummy offers endless entertainment for card game enthusiasts. Are you ready to shuffle, deal, and show off your Gin Rummy skills?

name: Classic Snake
author: Addicting Games
description: You are a crystalline being made of pure light. A robotic snake who is made of lasers and lives by consuming electro apples in a future grid. It is a yummy, exciting existence but also a dangerous one. Even though you have the ability to teleport yourself from one side of the arena to another by simply slithering through a wall, you also are in danger of destroying yourself if you let the length of your snake body grow too large and you inadvertently smash into yourself while slithering through the grid.

name: Claw Machine Hero
author: Addicting Games
description: Claw Machine Hero is a relaxing claw machine game where your prizes fuel your power! Catch items with the claw to earn Action Points. Your hero will automatically spend these points to attack monsters! Collect all the fruit to unlock a Bonus Game where you can grab extra coins to help upgrade your hero.

name: Clay Pigeon Hunter
author: Addicting Games
description: It's a simple target shooting game. You're not really hunting anything. If you consider this hunting, you would consider reading a menu to be eating.

name: Clear Vision
author: Addicting Games
description: Clear Vision is a free sniper game. Between assassination jobs, learn the dark truth about this stick dude's past. It's not pretty. But he does have a nice apartment! This is a stick sniper masterpiece where you take on the role of an assassin who has lead a hard life full of cold blood and hot women. It's a dark world when you're an assassin for hire and even though he may be the best there is at what he does, that doesn't mean what he does is very nice! Use basic sniper mechanics to delve into the questionable past of this hitman as you rack up a kill count and blast your way through his story. This is a story based stick sniper shooter which brings the duo-tone world of hyper-violent stick games to life through its deep characterization, and complex storytelling. You'll be introduced to characters you might not like but you will definitely understand. You will be forced to question your own morals and ethics as you stare down the barrel of a gun and into the yawning chasm of imperfect humans. Stick games are a staple of the casual gaming industry. They have been around longer than any of us and will probably be around a lot longer than any of us. Clear Vision is a step above the rest. It is truly one of the greatest stick sniper games available.

name: Clear Vision Elite
author: Addicting Games
description: Clear Vision Elite is a free stick-sniper game. Clear Vision is back! This time with a kitchen, a computer, an office, and all sorts of things that aren't sniping --which is the point of the game. But, don't be confused, this is a sniper game. You'll have to click through lists, and go through different rooms and get all wrapped up in a plot line but at the end of all that after you bought your ammo and checked a name off a list and cleaned your kitchen or whatever: You will finally get to do some sniping! And it is worth it. The physics, the puzzles, the stick men, the aiming. It all comes together with your choice of guns and ammo to create a truly immersive sniper experience. Is it revenge, are you trying to save the world? Are you doing it just for the money? Only those who read through the multiple screens at the beginning of the game will know for sure. This is an exciting sniper adventure where you take on the underground gangs of the world and dish out justice from behind the business end of a smoking gun. Ready, aim, fun!

name: Clear Vision II
author: Addicting Games
description: Clear Vision II is a free sniper-style game with stickman animation. You’re a hitman for hire and business is booming. Even your average joe can gather a load of cash to take out someone who is an inconvenience. From getting rid of their ex-wifes to wanting to get rid of a coworker, it doesn’t matter the reason as long as they pay you. It’s not all fun and games until you’re discovered and recruited by the government for your eagle eye skills. Will you change your ways and work for good? This is an adventure shooter game where you slowly find out more about the main character and how he came to this line of work. This shooter game has simplistic animation, easy controls, and an interesting story to follow.

name: Clickage
author: Addicting Games
description: Only fast clickers need to click here! If your mouse were real, it would beat you up after you played this game. How fast are you?

name: ClickPLAY Time 5
author: Addicting Games
description: ClickPLAY is back to test your reflexes and your cow-saving abilities!

name: Close Numbers
author: Addicting Games
description: Close Numbers is a free puzzle game.

name: Coffee Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Coffee Mahjong is one of the best games to play in the morning. It has a fun twist on your regular mahjong game with its coffee-themed layout. It also has a chill and relaxing tune that will help you start your day. This is an amusing tile-matching game with 17 levels of a variety of difficulty. Each tile is decorated with a different java-related image like iced coffee, coffee beans, and pastries. It’s perfect for your early morning wake-up game. Once you’ve played, you can also submit your score to see how well you did against other players.

name: Coinsweeper Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Coinsweeper on Steam now!

 

Coinsweeper - Minesweeper meets Roguelike

Turn Minesweeper into a high-stakes treasure hunt! Reveal tiles to 
collect coins, upgrade your abilities between runs, and compete for the highest 
score. Will you play it safe or risk it all?

Features:
✓ Risk/reward gameplay - cash out anytime or push your luck
✓ Meta-progression with permanent upgrades
✓ Relaxing yet strategic gameplay

name: Cola Factory
author: Addicting Games
description: Build a pipeline to deliver cola from the main tank to vans. Turn pipe tiles to make a correct pipeline, so cola can be released.

name: Color Clash
author: Addicting Games
description: Color Clash is a free mobile shooting game. Color Clash is one of those free games that rests between competing genres of mobile games. On one hand, it is a shooting game where patience and aim are required in order to effectively line up a shot. On the other hand, this is a game that requires you to solve each level like a puzzle. In this game, you aren't taking a shot at a specific target. Instead, you will be trying to launch your round in such a way that it manages to hit and bounce off of successive walls and barriers in such a way that you are able to hit all of the barriers with one shot. This makes each level a puzzle. A puzzle you solve by taking aim and firing. There is only one solution per level and even once you find the right place to aim you'll need to find the right amount of momentum to fire with. Color Clash truly is a riddle inside of an enigma inside of a mystery.

name: Color Pixel Art Classic
author: Addicting Games
description: Color Pixel Art Classic is a relaxing casual game that is great for players of all ages. Coloring was a fun task when you were just a kid in elementary school. Somewhere along the line, it stopped being a homework assignment and you ended up with books, math, and other more complicated stuff. However, don’t let your age stop you from enjoying a relaxing time coloring. Pick from one of our many categories like food, animals, people, and even fantastical creatures. There are adorable items and animals to color like a donut, a cat, a unicorn, and even a fidget spinner! There’s no competition and there’s no timer. This is just a casual online game that you can enjoy without any stressful goals or rage-inducing bosses. It’s a cute game that you can jump into whenever you have time to kill or you just want to take a break from work or school. There’s nothing to overthink with this casual online game.

name: Color Rings
author: Addicting Games
description: Color Rings is a free puzzle game.

name: Color Rotator
author: Addicting Games
description: Color Rotator is a free puzzle game. Color Rotator is a game that combines the unholy magicks of color, space, and mathematics into one unified field of puzzley fun. Color Rotator is a classic three in a row style game with a twist and a half. The big difference in this fun and free mobile game is that you won't be rotating one single square at a time, you will instead be spinning a square containing multiple colors. In this regard, you will be trying to spin the squares in order to line up with other like-colored squares in as optimal a way as possible. You are going to want to maximize each spin because time is limited and if you are able to make one single spin line up more than a single three in a row, you will be able to either clear the board faster or maximize your overall score. It is a fun challenge and one that we think you are up for.

name: Color Shape
author: Addicting Games
description: Color Shape is a free clicker game. Welcome to Color Shape where the only way out is up and the only thing holding you down is gravity. As you rocket through this never-ending clicker you'll have to navigate through twirling chromatic obstacles which you can only pass if you are able to match your own color to theirs and unlock the barrier. This is a game of timing, reflexes, and learning the inherent physics of a world before finally overcoming them. Color Shape is a game that breaks the mold of conventional endless clickers by offering you nested obstacles which spin inside of other, bigger obstacles thus forcing you to wait for multiple barriers to line up before you can make your move. Some of the obstacles in this game are also asymmetrical and will be offset at odd angles and with jagged and unpredictable edges. Your only ally in this game will be your will, your reflexes, and the sheer power of your clicking finger as you click-click, wait, click, wait, wait, wait, and click again to propel yourself to the top of the leaderboard.

name: Color Shooter
author: Addicting Games
description: Color Shooter is a free mobile game.

name: Color Tower
author: Addicting Games
description: Color Tower is a simple stacking game for casual game players. Enjoy this game with simplistic artwork as you stack multicolored blocks against a black background. Your goal is to stack colorful blocks all the way up to the top of the game’s view, at which point the game will reset and start you back at the bottom. The concept might be deceivingly simple but you will see that keeping the balance can be quite difficult. Just one off-balanced block can cause the whole thing to wobble. You can try to get the balance back but that one block could cause the whole thing to topple over and resetting your entire game. Think you can be the best stacker? Stack as many columns as you can to beat your own score or to beat out other players on the leaderboard in this online game.

name: Coloring Book: Mandala
author: Addicting Games
description: No description available.

name: Colorization
author: Addicting Games
description: Colorization is a simple and relaxing game that gives the player a sense of progress as they upgrade different regions of their character's brain in order to create inventions, engage in dialogue, and colorize a black and white world infested by zombie-esque tribes, who can be converted and led to help you on your mission to reinvigorate the game world.

name: Combines.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Combines.io is a free IOgame. A lot of people think of farms as being a quiet, uncomplicated life, but they are wrong. Dead wrong. In Combines.io you will take to the great wild west, the heartland of this great country, and enter a cornfield arena where it is you vs the rest of the world. You'll have to navigate your massive combine around a cornfield and try to collect as much corn as possible. The more corn you reap the longer you get, which is the point of the game, however, the longer you become the more unwieldy you become. You will have to manage both your speed and size while avoiding other players and collecting as much corn as possible. Be careful to not sabotage yourself by turning around and running your combine into yourself. This is a fast-paced IOGame where the competition is deadly and the gameplay is addictive. Become the master of the heartland and prove yourself to be the ultimate farm hand in this awesome IOGame of farming, speeding, combat, and victory.

name: Conflict of Nations: WW3
author: Addicting Games
description: Well, what are you waiting for? The world isn't just going to take over itself. Chaos reigns and the world has become a powderkeg just waiting for a madman to light a match. It might as well be you and it might as well be now! Choose your country --or let the computer do it for you-- and then devise a strategy! The world is at war and it is waiting for you to take control. Grab this writhing mess by the reigns and ride it into submission. Choose your infantry, your armor divisions, your airforce, and maybe even your navy! Upgrade each of these units while you map out a strategy to provide resources and manage the economy of your burgeoning empire! There is an opportunity in chaos, the opportunity for order. You can be that order. You can be the spark that will light the flame that will burn down the terror and chaos of the future.

name: Connect Four
author: Addicting Games
description: Connect Four is the strategy game that we all know and love. It’s the future now and it makes sense why a classic like Connect Four would need to be updated. Walk into memory lane with this classic game where you play against a computer opponent in connecting, you guess it, 4 pieces before your opponent does. The pieces can be connected vertically, horizontally, and even diagonally. You have the option to play as red or yellow as well as choosing your difficulty level. In harder levels, you still have to connect 4 pieces but you will have more spaces and slots to choose from. If you lose or win, you can play another round against the bots as many times as you want. Challenge yourself by choosing more difficult levels every time you play. The bots aren’t fools so try your best to challenge it and trick it into letting you win this round.

name: Conor Martin's RV Mayhem
author: Addicting Games
description: Conor's been partying in the Dental RV while his parents are out. But they'll be back any minute! Clean every room to stay out of trouble, quick!

name: ConquestBall
author: Addicting Games
description: ConquestBall is a fast-paced arcade game of strategy and precision where players battle for dominance over a dynamic grid. Hit the ball to claim squares in your paddle’s color, and collect power-ups to gain an edge. Powerful shots and scoring into your opponent's side expand your control even further, rewarding skill and timing. You can level up tiles for every consecutive hit, making every move critical. Whether against AI or a friend in local multiplayer, quick reflexes and smart play turn every round into an intense contest of wit and skill.

name: Cookies 4 Me
author: Addicting Games
description: Cookies 4 Me is a free math game. In this yummy game, you'll be playing as a monstrous cookie fiend who is addicted to the crunch of fresh baked cookies. It doesn't even matter what kind of cookies, they could be chocolate chip, cream filled, covered in sprinkles, peanut butter or full of nuts. Your only concern is hunkering down and eating up all the fresh baked snacks placed strategically all around you. But beware! like all adddictions, these cookies are only part of the plan. You aren't just eating them for the calories, for the fun, or for the reputation. You're doing it because you're trapped and you need to get out of this maze of baked goods and thus unlock new levels that are even more complex and feature even more cookies!  So, get snackin' and get thinking because you'll have to figure out a way to eat in the correct order and unravel the logic puzzles inherent in each level. This is a delicious puzzle game where you're trapped in a maze filled with cookies and you must eat them in the right order if you want to survive and escape.

name: Cooking Connect
author: Addicting Games
description: Cooking Connect is a free mobile puzzle game.

name: Countries Of Asia
author: Addicting Games
description: Countries of Asia is a trivia game. You may think you know the world, you may think you know Asia, but the truth is the world is much bigger than you could ever imagine. Asia is a massive continent, it comprises many countries and each has its own unique, and diverse people, culture, and way of life. In Countries of Asia, we will test your knowledge of this massive landmass and all of the countries within its borders. You'll be scratching your head and stroking your chin as you puzzle over the exact locations of Hong Kong and Taiwan. Plus let us not forget countries like India, who's bordering confound even the most learned of scholars. Whether your goal is to show off your knowledge of the world or maybe to sharpen it a bit, the truth is you'll have tons of questions to answer in this fast and fun trivia game. Challenge yourself, challenge a friend. The choice is yours and so are the consequences. Maybe after you've played this game a few times you'll have broadened your horizons enough that you can outwit anyone? Only time will tell.

name: Countries of South America
author: Addicting Games
description: Countries of South America is a geography game where you must identify the countries of South America. South America is home to amazing culture, diverse people, and beautiful rainforests. It is no wonder it is a common vacation spot for travelers. Do you know every country of South America? Play this map game to learn about the countries of South America. There are 14 countries in total that you must identify. South America has countries like French Guiana, Peru, Columbia, and Brazil. By the end of this map game, you will be an expert in knowing exactly where each one of those is. Play through the Play Geography series which covers different areas of the world! Play this online quiz game to become a geography expert or use this to study for tests at school.

name: Countries Of The World Level 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Countries of the world pt 2 is a free geography game.

name: Country Shooting
author: Addicting Games
description: Country Shooting is a free target game. Welcome to one of the greatest free shooting games available for free online and on your mobile device. Country shooting is a game about the power and beauty of operating a shotgun to shoot bottles. Test your aim, sharpen your aim. Have fun as you set your sites high and aim for the top of the leader board. Pull the trigger on a good time in this country-themed shooting game. A game about shooting bottles in your backyard. Each level you will progress to more and more bottles in different parts of the screen. Some big, some small, some moving, some still. It is a fun system where you level up your shooting skills one level at a time in a game that becomes progressively harder. Do you have the sharp-shooting aim required to blast those bottles and ensure that you'll be the number one bumpkin in the country? Find out and prove it in this addicting and free shooting game.

name: Craft Raft Battle
author: Addicting Games
description: Craft Raft Battle is a free iogame. Welcome to a world of water, a water-arena, if you will. In this tactical game of building and destroying you will craft yourself the perfect raft with which to take on your opponents and ultimately rule the leader board. There can be only one and in this game that will mean you build yourself a powerful craft, take it to the high seas and use it to take down your enemies. This is an iogame where you collect items in the water while avoiding enemy boats. You use those items to craft weapons and a larger raft and then try to take on as many enemies as possible. The game is fun but doesn't think it's easy. This game may have simple controls and an intuitive interface but the gameplay is as deep as any ocean and as wide as any sea. You may just find yourself drowning in a good time if you let yourself go into a world of crafting, rafting, and also battling.

name: Craftnite.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Craftnite.io is a free iogame. Tonight you will craft. Tonight you will mine. Tonight you will win or die trying. This is Craftnite.io and this is your time to shine. Use your pickaxe to slowly and methodically collect a variety of different resources. Then use those resources to build yourself a base, a tower, s humble abode. It's really up to you, but beware! For there are enemies all around you, and all of them want to make this nite your last nite. That is why you'll also be armed with a Glock and need to scavenge for ammo. This game is not just some zen garden, my friend. No! This is a dangerous but rewarding challenge for only the strongest of the strong. Will you survive? Will you craft? can you make it through the nite? Probably not, but it'll be a lot of fun trying. Also, try to avoid falling off of the edge of the island because you'll land in an endless ocean and there is literally no way out of there.

name: Craftz.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Craftz.io is a free IOgame.d to win and win to build. This is a game about the struggle to create, the struggle to live, and the struggle to persevere in a world of violence and alienation. The other crafters are bent on your destruction they will create a weapon that is absolutely optimized to find your weaknesses then exploit them and then ultimately destroy your craft. But don't worry because you can do the same thing. You can optimize your craft to be the most dangerous and aesthetic weapon on the battlefield. Now yes, this game is two-dimensional and you will be fighting other players by simply moving side to side but within that matrix, there is a lot of room for you to grow, develop skills, and triumph over your competitors. Make custom weapons, armor your vehicle, and choose from dozens of blade weapons, blunt weapons, and projectile weapons. This is a game for the most powerful players in the game, those who don't do what they build. Kill em all and let the scoreboard sort it out in Craftz.io a unique multiplayer iogame.

name: Cram Blocks
author: Addicting Games
description:
Cram Blocks is a free puzzle game. Prepare to embark on a mind-bending journey that will challenge your spatial acumen and unlock the true depths of your puzzling prowess. Behold "Cram Blocks" - a free mobile game that combines the artistic genius of floating polynomial objects with the brain-teasing wizardry of shape manipulation. Brace yourself for a colorful, multidimensional adventure that will leave you spellbound, available on mobile and desktop. In the vibrant universe of "Cram Blocks," you are the architect of the impossible, tasked with merging a series of floating polynomial objects into the intricate contours of a predetermined 3D shape. As you embark on this tantalizing puzzle-solving quest, you'll discover a world where geometry dances with creativity, and precision becomes your most valuable tool. Each polycube holds the key to unlocking the enigma, and it's up to you to navigate their spatial relationships with ingenious finesse.

Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing experience where the boundaries of perspective are shattered. "Cram Blocks" empowers you to rotate your screen, observing the puzzle from different angles, unearthing hidden connections, and unveiling new paths to success. With each twist and turn, you'll reveal a kaleidoscope of possibilities, unveiling the true majesty of three-dimensional thinking. But the true magic of "Cram Blocks" lies in the hands of its players, for you hold the power to manipulate the shapes themselves. Utilize the six-way controller to rotate and pivot the polygons, crafting an intricate dance of form and function. The colorful shapes come alive under your command, moving with an elegance that mirrors the brushstrokes of a master artist. Can you unlock the secrets that lie within their enchanting geometries? This is not merely a game of logic but an artistic odyssey that ignites the imagination. The vibrant, kaleidoscopic shapes that populate this extraordinary realm captivate the eye and transport you to

name: Crash Or Pass
author: Addicting Games
description: Crash Or Pass is a free racing game. You're trapped on an infinite loop in this fun, free racing game. you cannot stop or start. All you can do is slow your car down or speed it up at the appropriate time in an effort to avoid the other clueless drivers on the road. Remember, this is a game about reflexes and speed. You've got to know when to speed up, when to hit the brakes when to slow it down, and when to pass. The one thing you don't want to do is crash. In this game, the only thing you can really screw up is crashing, and once you crash, that is it. It is literally game over. This is an endless game where the longer you stay alive and the more levels you play the bigger your score is, so pass. Don't crash.

name: Crazy Caves
author: Addicting Games
description: Crazy Caves is a free clicker game. Somewhere inside the caves, you will find a prize, a prize that might very well change your life. But in order to access it, you'll have to click, tap, avoid and persevere against the tyranny of falling rubble. In Crazy Caves, you'll face down an avalanche of collapsing rock but if you are able to dodge the debris and shoot the shrapnel you'll be able to unlock money, jewels, prizes, and the sweet taste of victory that comes with blasting your way through sedimentary rock. This is a world where riches and the glory that come with them can be yours but you'll have to work for them. Click or tap as fast as you can to throw pick axes and destroy the boulders as they fall towards you. Feast on the delicious jewels and emeralds inside and you'll rejoice in the glory that comes from devastating the rocks. Collect the money and jewels in order to level on up and you'll be rewarded with cool new powers and abilities.

name: Crazy Eights
author: Addicting Games
description: Crazy Eights is an online card game based on the classic game. If you are a fan of the classic card game then you can now enjoy the online version from your phone or computer. If you have never played the game before, you may have seen other variations of it. The original game was invented in the 1930s in the United States. The goal is to get rid of all of your cards. Play against 3 AI players that are ready to beat you at this game. You will get helpful hints, for instance when you have no playable cards, to help speed things along. There are 4 rounds and your goal is to dominate them! Once you get your final score, check to see how you rank against the top card players for this game in High Scores.

name: Crazy Kimono Doll Assault
author: Addicting Games
description: A turret shooter in which your opponents are kimono dolls with knives. Strangely creepy!

name: Create a Ride
author: Addicting Games
description: Create a Ride is a free car game. Pimp your ride and take it out on the road in this top shop. With so many options, you can customize your car to suit your style. Will this be your dream ride?

name: Creeper World
author: Addicting Games
description: Creeper World is a free tower defense game. The creeps are coming! You'll need to get off this planet, but you'll have to fight your way out. Collect resources, build turrets, and capture territory: FTW!

name: Creepy Halloween Difference
author: Addicting Games
description: Is Halloween failing to scare you? Double your creature feature by spotting spooky differences! Does that witch have three moles, or four? Is that mummy looking at me, or looking at you? Stay brave, keep your eyes open, and ignore that creepy scratching at your door...

name: Cricket Hero
author: Addicting Games
description: Cricket Hero is a free sports game. Woah, here we go. We all love sports, the crack of the bat, the swish of the balls, the tension before a goal, and the exuberance after you win. Cricket is a game, it is not just a small annoying creature that sneaks into your apartment and sings for hours on end as you try to live your life like a normal person. The rules of Cricket are actually somewhat similar to the rules of the American classic Baseball. The part of Cricket that is most like baseball is where you as the batter have a bat and stand on a diamond as the opposing team pitches a ball to you. At this point the onus is on you, the hitter, to hit that ball as far and as fast as you can. Your goal is to keep the other team distracted long enough for you and any other players out on the bases to run home. It is a cyclical game with almost no violence. In this hit video game you will be taking on the role of a hardcore cricket hero who is smashing the balls into the stratosphere.

name: Crossbar Kevin
author: Addicting Games
description: Crossbar Kevin is a reflex game. Kevin and his father have a strained relationship. The only thing that matters to the old man is his son's ability to kick a soccer ball and hit the crossbar. For some reason, his dad isn't all that concerned with scoring. It's really just about hitting that crossbar. It's weird, we know. Don't try and figure it out. The point is Kevin has never been much of a jock. He'll have to learn how to hit that crossbar or receive a vicious and humiliating tongue lashing from his father. That is where you come in. Your job is to help Kevin make his dad love him. You need to take aim and boot that ball right into the crossbar. If you don't you'll be hearing about it from the dad. And the dad is mean. So, choose the angle of the kick and then chose the amount of force you put into it. If you can negotiate the correct shot then maybe Kevin's dad will finally love him. If not, you'll have to think about therapy.

name: Crowdedcity.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Crowdedcity.io is a multi-player game. There really are just too many people in this world. Running around, absolutely no direction, no purpose, no reason. Just spinning their wheels and flapping their lips until they finally shuffle off this mortal coil. They need a leader. They need you. In Crowdedcity.io you'll take command of citizens who are lost, directionless and with no rudder. You must organize and manage them and use them as a force for good to run around and convert other non-believers to your side. If you're smart enough, fast enough, and powerful enough you'll take over the entire city and wield your unholy power for good.

name: Crush the Castle 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Crush the Castle 2 is a free launch game. the original physics launch game. You are a siege master working for King Redvonian in this casual slingshot-style game. It’s up to you to defeat and bring down each kingdom. Along with the help of your other allies which include a mason, engineer, and wizard—you must create the best way and items to use in each shot. Use a catapult to toss logs onto the enemy castle to bring it down. With each level that you pass, you will be awarded different ammunition. It’s up to you to decide which would be best to take down each castle. You can use your mouse to take a view of the castle to find its weak spots and aim for them. On top of bringing down their establishments, you must also defeat the knights and bring in their royals. This casual game is also two games in one! Build your own castle and share it with your friends or other players. Build anything as simple or as complicated as you’d like. Choose from different materials to create walls and floors. You can even choose the difficulty level by selecting hills that can encase your creation. To play the game, select your item, and click again to choose the angle at which to toss your ammunition. Be careful of nature’s barriers as hills may serve to block your logs or stones.

name: Crush the Castle Players Pack
author: Addicting Games
description: Crush the Castle Players Pack is a free launch game. Anyone who makes a castle is just asking to have it crushed. These folks sent in their best castles, just so you could try to wreck them. Huzzah!

name: Cube Escape: Harvey's Box
author: Addicting Games
description: Cube Escape: Harvey's Box is a free escape game. It's 1969 and Harvey is trapped inside a box moving to Rusty Lake...Find out what's going on and help Harvey escape by solving the mystery. Be warned, things are not what they seem.

name: Cube Escape: Seasons
author: Addicting Games
description: The year is 1964, and you're trapped in a very mysterious room (with a parrot). Put on your smarts and try to escape!

name: Cube Killer
author: Addicting Games
description: Cube Killer is a free mobile game. You are a pig-shaped war machine on a never-ending march to the heart of the empire. Your snout is a double-barrelled canon that belches out hot-leaded justice in the face of the big bad. Use your reflexes and heavy auto to mow down legions of enemies as they charge toward you, guns blazing. This is a game for the most fearless players out there. Those who wish to take on the empire do so at their own peril. When you play "Cube Killer" you are the last hero in a corrupt world.

name: Cube Trap
author: Addicting Games
description:
Cube Trap is a puzzle game. Welcome to the Cube Trap, a laser maze game about escaping from the vertical and horizontal cage that imprisons us all. In this fascinating tactical and strategic puzzle game, you are trapped within a maze and the paths are always changing. This is a 2-D top-down game where you can only pass through the walls which are the same color as your cube. You can alter the color of your cube by entering an area through a like-colored wall and using the random color power-up located within to change your color. The power-ups are also worth a different point value.

So, you'll be trying to maximize your points by staying alive as long as you can and picking up the different power-ups. You will die instantly if you accidentally run into a different colored wall or if you manage to puzzle your way into a corner you can't walk out of without hitting a differently colored wall. Think fast, think ahead, think hard, and think to win. Cube Trap is an easy game with few rules that can quickly turn tragic if you make poor choices: just like real life!

name: Cubefield
author: Addicting Games
description: Cubefield is a free racing game. Navigate your triangle through a treacherous field of cubes. It's more like a steering game than a driving game.

name: Cupcake Kerfuffle
author: Addicting Games
description: Cupcake Kerfuffle is a free management game. Everybody has dreamed about starting their own business. Thrills and chills of franchise management and the adrenaline-pumping joy that comes from baking, icing, and serving cupcakes to customers are truly second to none. In Cupcake Kerfuffle you will take command of a cute little bakery and it is your job to take customers' orders, make the correct cupcake, ice it just the way they want, serve it to the customer, and then collect their money. You must do this in an orderly and timely manner if you wish to optimize the amount of money you make and grow your business. Pay attention to the long line of customers and be sure to get everyone the correct order in the allotted time or they won't pay and they'll be unhappy. This is a fun game that offers you but a taste of the real-world, of a job, of responsibility, and of the delicate but satisfying pressure to perform a task and doing it properly. Be timely and be smart in this fun resource management style game.

name: Cure For The Prince
author: Addicting Games
description: Cure For The Prince is a free mystery game. Objects are all around us. Objects make up so much of our lives from the clothes that we wear, the food that we eat, the cars that we drive to the furniture that we sit on. Many things which are not concepts are objects. In fact, most people would say that all things which are not conceptual or sentient are indeed objects. Why an object can be the meteor, the house that it strikes, and the furniture inside that is destroyed. Objects are all around us. Objects make the world that we call the world. When objects are hidden then the world becomes more complex. Especially when those objects are integral in doing something important like curing a prince. In this game the prince is sick and you will be tasked with collecting the correct objects in order to cure them. The objects are all hidden within different rooms and locations around the kingdom it is up to you to save him! You can do it thou, we trust you but please do it as quickly as possible. As the world turns and the prince gets sicker, time will run out. When it does it may be too late to save him and then what is the point.

name: Cursed Treasure
author: Addicting Games
description: Cursed Treasure is a tower defense game. They want your treasure, little do they know the treasure is cursed. The big secret behind your treasure is that it will be the doom of anyone who tries to take it. Still, it is your treasure. You don't want anyone to take it, even if it dooms them. So, you must build your defenses. To withstand all intruders. Ice towers will freeze your enemies in their tracks. Volcano towers will melt them where they stand and several archery towers will let your army take deadly aim. Think far ahead and strategize a perfect plan to take out your enemies. Build towers, upgrade towers, as the enemies get worse your towers must become more powerful. Stay a few steps ahead of them or they'll walk all over you. This is the exciting world of 'Cursed Treasure' an epic game of towers, defense, and survival.

name: Curve Ball
author: Addicting Games
description: Play Curve Ball on Addicting Games! Test your 3D pong skills, master the curve, and see how many levels you can clear before the blue balls run out.

name: Cut Bowling
author: Addicting Games
description: Cut Bowling is a free, mobile physics game. Unleash your prowess as a cosmic baller, a master of unconventional strikes. In "Cut Bowling," the universe is your playground, and the laws of gravity bow before your whims. Engage your strategic mind on a journey where timing and strategic thinking will tip the scales of fortune in your favor. This game is an experience that will shatter the constraints of your reality and transport you into a realm where the laws of physics dance upon the strings of destiny. In "Cut Bowling," you are beckoned to partake in a great test of skill, precision, and sheer audacity. Your objective? Manipulate the fate of a pendulous bowling ball suspended from a fragile thread. With each swipe of your finger, you have the power to sever that tether, propelling the ball toward a constellation of pins. Each cut of the rope becomes an act of defiance against conventional wisdom as the ball swings forth, propelled by the force of your ambition. With a delicate touch, you can guide it towards a cascade of pins, where victory awaits like a dormant supernova, ready to explode in a cataclysm of triumph. The very fabric of reality becomes pliable, morphing and twisting in response to your every move.

name: Cut the Rope
author: Addicting Games
description: Om Nom is hungry for candy, and it's your job to help him out! Collect gold stars, discover hidden prizes and unlock exciting new levels in this addictively fun, award-winning, physics-based game!

name: Cut the Rope Time Travel
author: Addicting Games
description: Join this new adventure filled with time-traveling, candy-crunching, physics-based action! Visit exciting locations including the Middle Ages, the Renaissance, a Pirate Ship, Ancient Egypt, Ancient Greece, the Stone Age, Disco Era, and the Future.

name: Cute Snake
author: Addicting Games
description: Cute Snake is a free mobile game.

name: Cyclomaniacs
author: Addicting Games
description: Cyclomaniacs is a free racing game. Accelerate, tilt, stunt, and destroy the competition! In Cyclomaniacs you are an over-ambitious pedal pusher who is strapped to a ten speed and racing against an army of weirdos! Ninjas, dragons, orcs, skeletons, aliens, and even robots! This is the ultimate race of ultimate destiny and it features almost every kind of fantasy or sci-fi trope you could ever possibly imagine! In order to win you'll have to not just be fast but pull off radical stunts! Use your cash from each win to upgrade your bike and improve everything from your speed to your handling, to your weight, and your potential for stunts. You will also be able to unlock new and interesting characters. Creepy characters. Weird characters! Half the fun is the bizarre choice of players and theme in this game so rev up your BMX and hit the road!

name: Daily Binario
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Binario is a solo math game. Binario truly is a game of kings. A game which has lived on and been passed down through the ages for generations. It requires tactical skill and long term strategic choices. You must manage numbers and the factors in your multiple lines. On your top left, you'll want to use division and multiplication, but on your bottom rows, you'll be counting and subtracting. The only way to finish the game is to make sure all of your rows add up and the rows are neatly accounted for in the upper left rows. Four separate stacks. It's up to you to get it right!
