Do you have the same patience and pattern recognition abilities as generations of monarchs before you? In this version, there are three different levels of difficulty, easy, medium and hard. Each comes part and parcel with its own challenges and rewards. But ultimately the game remains the same: Sort the equations in as few moves as possible. It is truly a game that tests your mind as much as your reflexes or aim. Perhaps you have some royal blood in you.

name: Daily Calcudoku
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Calcudoku is an online game for our math-loving community! If you are a fan of sudoku games and math in general, then you will love this daily game. Start your morning or end your night with a daily mathematical challenge. There are four options to play: 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, and 8x8. There is a challenge for every level of difficulty you could want. If you want to play easy or if you want a challenge, then it is your choice. You can also play and solve all four if you just love sudoku games. Do not hesitate to play this challenging sudoku game!

name: Daily Code Words
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Code Words is a word game where you must decipher the letter behind each number. If you are a fan of crosswords but want to really challenge yourself, then you need to check out this difficult game. Test your knowledge of words without hints as you try to figure out the letters for each number.  Each daily game will give you the answer to 2 numbers. It is up to you to find the rest of the letters. This is not a bunch of random letters as they will spell out either words or names. You have two modes to play in depending on how much of a challenge you want: 13X13 and 15X15.

name: Daily Cross Word Neon
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Crossword is the online version of your favorite newspaper puzzle. Show off your dictionary knowledge with a daily dose of crossword puzzles. Tune in every day for a different crossword puzzle to solve. Look to the lefthand panel, and use the scrollers to look up and down the lists for the rows and columns of each word on the board. The objective of a crossword puzzle is to figure out the word based on the number of slots available and using the definition or hint available. Fill in all the slots with the correct words to win this online game. Finished the game and you want more? Click on the date to play previous dates or play future dates.

name: Daily Flood
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Flood is a casual puzzle game that’s great for unwinding at the end of the day. The objective of this colorful online game is to fill up the entire grid with the same color within a limited number of moves. You have the option of playing easy or hard with grids of 10x10, 12x12, 14x14, and 16x16. There’s a new puzzle on a daily basis so tune in to start off your day or to relax at the end of one. This is a great puzzle game to exercise your mind without being overwhelmed as it has simple mechanics. Couldn’t solve it the first time around? No worries as you can replay this puzzle game and try a different strategy until you get the hang of it. Daily Flood is the perfect daily game to add to your routine.

name: Daily HexNum
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily HexNum is a puzzle game to help you work your brain! If you are a fan of sudoku, then you will like this numbers game that follows just about the same concept. Tune in every day to find a new daily puzzle to play! You can choose from different difficulty levels and numbers and cells to keep you entertained all day. To play this online game, each group of cells can only contain each number once. The red numbers cannot be changed and some cells overlap so you must check for repeats in each one. Solve a game a day to give your mind its daily exercise!

name: Daily Kakuro
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Kakuro is a puzzle game with numbers. If you have never played Kakuro, it is similar to crosswords but uses numbers instead of letters. The white numbers on the sides serve as hints. The rows and columns must add up to those numbers. This online game comes in 4 modes: easy, medium, hard, and expert. You can play four different games daily by selecting different modes. You can also print out the puzzle and do it by hand to take a break from your screen. Tune in every day for a new puzzle. Click on the calendar if you want to play past puzzles or get ahead on tomorrow’s puzzle.

name: Daily Pipe Match
author: Addicting Games
description:
Pipe Match is a rotating card game where the goal is to connect all pipes to the end.

Click on a pipe to rotate it clockwise. Pipes that are faded out are not connected and pipes with a dark gray background can’t be moved. To undo a previous move, click the rotating arrow button. To restart the whole puzzle, click the arrow in the circle.

name: Daily Shikaku
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Shikaku is a puzzle game that will help give your mind daily training. If you are looking for a daily challenge, then look no further! The objective is to divide the grid into rectangular and square pieces such that each piece contains exactly one number, and that number represents the area of the rectangle. Whether you want something easy or want to really hurt your brain, this game has different modes for you to play. This online game has 4 modes: 5x5, 7x7, 10x10, and 15x15. Select the mode, and start playing! If you really want to challenge yourself, play all 4 modes in a day. If you cannot get enough of this puzzle game, click on the calendar icon to play the puzzles from the archives. You can even get ahead and play tomorrow’s daily game! Daily Shikaku is the perfect game for the player who enjoys mind games.

name: Daily Snake
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Snake is your daily dose of brain-teasing puzzles. It’s true that you should work out to train your body but you shouldn’t forget about your brain. You should challenge your brain every day by solving puzzles. You don’t have to solve an overly difficult puzzle if you’re not in the mood. Choose from 4 different levels of difficulty: 6X6, 8X8, 10X10, and 12X12. Your objective is simple but the execution will require time and thought. Using only your limited amount of tiles as well as the hints on the board, connect the head of the snake to its tail. If you get stuck, you can either undo the last move or clear out the board and start over.

name: Daily Sokoban 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Sokoban is a daily puzzle game where your objective is to push all the boxes to the spaces marked with an X. Play as an adorable factory worker character with overalls and a green little hat. You’re dressed and ready to get the day started and get all of the storage boxes to their rightful places. Every day there is a new pattern and challenge for you to solve! The red blocks are walls that you can get through. You must push every single box into a marked spot until you see the green checkmark. If you get stuck, don’t stress! You have the option to undo a move or simply start over! This is a challenging puzzle game but don’t overthink it. It’s the perfect puzzle game to get your morning started or to unwind after a long day.

name: Daily Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Solitaire is a solo card game. Solitaire truly is a game of kings. A game which has lived on and been passed down through the ages for generations. It requires tactical skill and long term strategic choices. You must manage your hand and the cards in your multiple lines. On your top left, you'll want to count up from Ace to King, but on your bottom rows of cards, you'll be counting down from King to Ace. The only way to finish the game is to make sure all of your cards from the draw pile and the rows are neatly accounted for in the upper left rows. Four separate stacks from Ace to King. It's up to you to get it right! Do you have the same patience and pattern recognition abilities as generations of monarchs before you? In this version, there are three different levels of difficulty, easy, medium and hard. Each comes part and parcel with its own challenges and rewards. But ultimately the game remains the same: Sort the cards in as few moves as possible into 4 separate piles of ascending suits from Ace to King. It is truly a game that tests your mind as much as your reflexes or aim. Perhaps you have some royal blood in you.

name: Daily Suguru
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Suguru is a puzzle game that you may find similar to sudoku. In a game of Suguru, you must only use one number each per the grid, and the same numbers cannot be next to each other. This is an online game that requires the use of logic. Each grid is unique with different patterns creating a new challenge for every daily game. There are three modes to play: 6x6, 8x8, and 10x10. Choose your daily challenge or play all three. Click on the calendar icon if you want to play tomorrow’s game or if you want to solve any archived puzzles. Tune in every day for a new daily game!

name: Daily Takuzu
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Takuzu is a puzzle game that will help you exercise your mind on a daily basis. Play every day for a different puzzle and challenge that you can select. You have the option to choose Easy or Hard. From there, you have the option to select 8X8, 10X10, 12X12, and 14X14 depending on how long you want to play. Complete one challenge or complete all 8 if you’re on a roll and feeling confident. The concept is the same as any other takuzu game except you are using red and black squares. This online game is set against a tranquil background with soothing music to help you concentrate. This online puzzle challenges your mind without being overwhelming or putting pressure on you. Create your own challenge every day by sitting back and solving your daily puzzle!

name: Daily Tracks
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Tracks is a daily challenge where your objective is to create a track based on the hints given. This is an online daily game that will help train your mind without driving you crazy. This is a unique puzzle game where you must create a track that matches the number on the grid. The track must also start and end on the indicated tiles.  Depending on what you’re feeling like you have the options of selecting either easy or hard. From each level, you have the option of selecting from 6x6, 8x8, 10X10, and 15x15. Tune in every day for a different puzzle to solve and to get your day started or to unwind from a difficult day.

name: Danger Light
author: Addicting Games
description: Danger Light is a free puzzle game. You must follow the pattern, you must remember the pattern, you must repeat the pattern. The pattern is how you will save yourself by avoiding obstacles and staying on track until you make it to the end of the level and collect your points. This is a game that requires deep concentration as well as a steadfast dedication to recognizing and following patterns. In this game, you will follow a set of blinking lights. In order to navigate your spaceship through an asteroid field and against enemy fighters. By repeating the pattern exactly as it was played for you, you will take control of the ship and avoid any incoming hostile threats. This is a game where attention to detail and pattern recognition is absolutely paramount to victory. You cannot win if you do not follow along or click when you're supposed to then you run the risk of failure and failure in this game can mean only one thing: defeat! Defeat means no top score on the leaderboard, it means no second chance, it means death. But don't worry this game is free, it is fun and you can play it over and over again until you get the knack of it.

name: Danger Pit
author: Addicting Games
description: Danger Pit is an education game that combines action and math! You have fallen into a dangerous pit full of everything horrible that you can possibly imagine. There are slime monsters, snakes, chemical toxins, and spiked traps coming towards you on a conveyor belt. Solve the math questions correctly to blast away these dangers before they reach and damage you. Each game starts with only 3 lives! However, you may find heart boosts on the conveyor belt that will give you an extra life. As you keep playing, look to the XP bar in the lefthand corner. Every time you fill this up, you level up! Go through all the levels and defeat every single creature in this dangerous pit. This is a fun and exciting way to incorporate math into your day. The math skills go from preschool to the 8th grade.

name: Dangerous Danny
author: Addicting Games
description: Dangerous Danny is a free-avoider game. Dangerous Danny is on a daring dive to the deepest depths and it's your job to keep him safe and make him rich. Dangerous Danny is an avoider game where you must help Danny traverse the depths in order to collect sunken treasure, but beware! For within the waters of the world there are threats the likes of which you could never imagine. Help Danny dodge octopi, blood-thirsty crabs, sharks, and even the occasional starfish. When diving seems out of the question there is also your trusty harpoon gun. The harpoon gun has limited ammo though, so, you're going to want to keep that thing fully loaded and ready to go just in case you find yourself in some weird situations. It won't be easy but diving into the great unknown will be fun with Dangerous Danny the daring diver who isn't scared of anything.

name: Dart Master
author: Addicting Games
description: Dart Master is a free target game. Darts are a classic age-old game of physics and skill. Where you must master your hand-eye coordination to overcome the tyranny of gravity and land shot after shot of bullseyes to beat your competitor. But that was ages ago, the game has changed. Now in the 21st century, you won't just be throwing one dart at one board. Oh no, friend. you will be throwing, multiple darts at multiple boards and here is the kicker: the boards are moving. This is 2021 and everything has changed the world is a different beast than it was even five years ago. While the effects of gravity and physics are no different they have become more pronounced and more obnoxious as you must equally concur with the added dimension of moving dart boards and multiple dartboards. If you still think that you can land a bullseye under these conditions then you must be crazy. the fact is only the best dart-throwers can land bullseyes under optimal conditions and now things have gone totally crazy. This is a game that will challenge your hand-eye coordination, your patience, your timing, your grasp of gravity, and possibly even your mental well-being.

name: Day D Tower Rush
author: Addicting Games
description:
Day D Tower Rush is a game that lets you re-live the second world war. Everyone wants to go back in time, but no one wants to get stuck there! In Day D Tower Rush you have traveled back to the dinosaur age only to accidentally fry your chrono displacement mechanism! You now have two choices: either you can wait a few million years to return to your own time, get eaten by a dinosaur or hunker down, make some weapons and defend your base! Day D Tower Rush is basically a tower defense game where you are defending your time machine from the rabid advances of carnivouros dinosaurs in the hopes that you can hold them off while you gather the resources needed to rebuild your time machine! But you'll also have to build new items and weapons in order to better deefend yourself against the increasingly dangerous and depraved dino detractor! Plaace your battlements, upgrade your weapons then lock and load and lets go!

 

Instructions / How to Play:

Please use your mouse to select where you'd like to place your base, the kind of base you'd like to build and any and all other modifications to the base. You may upgrade your defences, your aggressive capabilities, time travel devices, the damage value of your attacks, as well as the range, frequency, and overall intensity of the attacks. You may plan, place and build your towers anywhere you want along the path of the invading dinos.

name: Days 2 Die 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Days 2 Die 2 is a free tower defense game. Those hungry hungry zombies are back, and they are very, very angry! Can you and your new buddy, Frank, defend yourselves against those irked brain eaters?

name: Dead Zed
author: Addicting Games
description: Dead Zed is a free zombie shooting game. Here is the scene: you wake up in the middle of a zombie apocalypse and you have 40 days until help arrives, no time for questions. Whose farmhouse is this? Zed. Who is Zed? Dead Zed, baby. Dead Zed.

name: Deadly Demons
author: Addicting Games
description: Deadly Demons is a free first person game.

name: Deadshot.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Deadshot.io is a free IOgame.

name: Deck of Cards Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Deck of Cards Mahjong is a puzzle game that mixes elements of poker cards and mahjong puzzles. This online game is set against a sepia-colored background with delightful music. Basically, this online game follows the rules of mahjong but uses poker cards for you to play. Instead of matching mahjong tiles, you are matching cards with the same suit and number. If you think this is a quick game, then think again. There are 120 different levels with different patterns and challenges for you to conquer! Some patterns spell out words and others are just pretty designs. All of them are their own challenge and require their own strategy in this online game. Select the High Scores to see if your score lands you in the top 200 players for this card game. Play again until you make it on the High Scores list!

name: Ded Guy
author: Addicting Games
description:
Wet from an unforgiving rain and covered in the mud of his own grave, Dudley stands atop an altar gripping a revolver buried in its stone face. Ignoring the pain, the confusion, and the fear, Dudley tightens his wretched skeleton fingers around the pearl handle and begins to pull. An unholy strength pulses through his corroded muscles —the revolver budges. In his lifetime Dudley saw kings, holy men, the righteous, and the profane all try freeing the gun from the stone. All spoke of entitlement and fate. All tried to wrest the revolver from its stone sheath and all failed. Now, in the wake of his resurrection with the fog of consciousness setting in and memories of the void fading: Dudley knows he will not leave empty-handed.

His slippery fingers strangle the revolver, it wiggles like a loose tooth and in a pale flash is freed from the stone. Mad laughter echoes into the night sky as Dudley twirls his prize on the end of his trigger finger.  Aiming at the ground Dudley fires three times, each shot lifting him higher and higher into the sky. The cylinder cycles but never empties Landing on his back Dudley stares at the wicked weapon in his gnarled hands. He knows that the revenge he promised those who betrayed him would finally be fulfilled. The only question is who first and how bad was he gonna make 'em hurt?

name: Deepest Sword
author: Addicting Games
description:
Welcome to Deepest Sword, a thrilling physics-based game where you must slay a mighty dragon using a sword that grows longer with each successful strike. Navigate through challenging environments, timing your swings to get from platform to platform.

As you progress, your sword lengthens, increasing both your reach and the challenge of wielding such a massive weapon. Master the art of swordplay and strategic movement to overcome obstacles and defeat the dragon in this epic battle.

name: Defence of the Portal
author: Addicting Games
description: Soldier, here is your mission: Defend the portal against an onslaught of zombies and other baddies. You have many weapons to choose from, so you know, have fun, be creative. Kill everything in sight.

name: Defend Your Nuts 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Defend Your Nuts 2 is a free tower defense game. You want my nuts? Just try and get them! Mr. Squirrel is no stranger to nut danger, and he is ready to pop any creeps who make a move for his nuts. Fierce mice join your battle as you upgrade your weapons and nut defenses. Unfortunately, the creeps get faster and badder, too. Lock and Load, Little Nutjobs!

name: Defense 1942
author: Addicting Games
description: Defense 1942 is a free shooter game. Hordes of enemy soldiers keep coming: defend your territory with flamethrowers, snipers and more!

name: Defense Designer
author: Addicting Games
description: Defense Designer is a strategic tower defense game where you build and upgrade towers, place walls, and collect powerful relics to defend your castle from waves of enemies. Choose from different tower types, plan your defenses, and survive challenging boss battles. Each run offers new strategies and upgrades, making every playthrough unique and engaging.

name: Demolition Dude
author: Addicting Games
description: Explosives? HAH! Dude destroys buildings with...himself! Launch D.Dude into various buildings until you flatten the earth!

name: Denim Rocks Dress Up
author: Addicting Games
description: You've got attitude, so let them know. Dress this girl to kick some crass into style.

name: Departments of Colombia
author: Addicting Games
description: Departments of Columbia is a free geography game.

name: Destroy Number
author: Addicting Games
description: Destroy Number is a free math puzzle game. This week we are all about zeroing out the tiles. there are too many numbers, and their values are too high, we have to stop them, we have to decrease their value and then have them zero out. In this game, you will be tasked with zeroing out all of the values onscreen by ramming the numbers into each other until there are no more numbers. This is like math class but actually a lot more fun. It is applied mathematics or at least applied addition. You need to add numberss together until you get at least two that are the same and then smash those together so they zero each other out. Of course, we realize that this all sounds simple but it absolutely isn't, it is actually extremely hard. There are people who started playing this game five years ago and they're still playing it and they've actually been playing it the whole and they're also really smart people it is not like they're dumb or something. So, if you think you're better than this game, better than us, or better than our game-testers then we dare you to actually play it and prove it to us.

name: Diebrary
author: Addicting Games
description: Diebrary is a free IOgame. Enter the Diebrary! Test your reflexes and wit in this fast-paced arena roguelike, where you must fight through thousands of hordes of enemies to make it out alive. Choose upgrades and power-ups to increase your chances of survival, then vote on new Twists to spice up your next run! Get ready for an epic adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat every page you turn.

name: diep.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Diep.io is a free IOgame. All the world is a gridded arena, and we are merely the weaponized polygon tanks within it.  In this IOgame, you will test your skill against the might and strategy of your opponents, who themselves are real people from around the world. Diep.io is known as a survival game. It is a game where players start as a weaponized circle and slowly grind their way up by blasting different types of terrain and other opponents. The blasting equals different resources which can be spent to upgrade the player's weapons, attack values, and various player powers.

name: Dino Run
author: Addicting Games
description: Extinct? No Want! Run, run and run some more. Many powerups will keep you alive; avoid nasty creatures, and, of course, that wall of lava behind you...

name: Disc Pool 2 Player
author: Addicting Games
description: Disc Pool Player 2 is the second part of your favorite sports game, Disc Pool Player. Play against the computer in this casual sports game. This is an online game decorated with neon colors as you play on a classic wooden board. On the right-hand side, you will see your level, score, and goal for that level. There are 3 levels for you to fight against the computer and win like the champ you are!. You’re on the green team and they’re on the red team and your goal is to get all of your discs into the pocket. If you don’t get any disc in or if you get the yellow or red disc in, it’s the computer’s turn. If you get your own green disc in the pocket, then you get to shoot again! Once you’ve finished all 3 levels, head to the High Scores icon to see if you’re in the top of the ranks for this puzzle game.

name: Discover Petra
author: Addicting Games
description: Discover Petra is a puzzle game based on the archeological discoveries of Petra. Travel with Petra as she uncovers artifacts from all around the world. There are vases, musical instruments, books, and other interesting items. At the bottom of the screen, you will find 4 people who are looking for a particular artifact. Find their item as fast you can to get the best possible score. There are 10 levels of this casual hidden object game for you to solve. Play quickly as you can to beat the clock!

name: Diwata Dress Up
author: Addicting Games
description: Dress this girl up in style. Do you have the fashion skills to make this girl shine?

name: Dog Fight: The Great War
author: Addicting Games
description: Dog Fight: The Great War is a free-flying game. One or Two Player modes - blast baddies, then your buddies! Hint: Try not to crash into the ground.

name: Dominoes Classic
author: Addicting Games
description: Dominoes Classic is the online version of your favorite board game. There are three modes to play this classic domino game: original, block, and all-fives. With each mode you can adjust the difficulty level which changes how the AI plays. Dominoes is a fun board game that we use to play with friends and family. Sometimes you’re in the mood to be alone or you just want to play a quick game and don’t have anyone around. That’s where this Dominoes Classic game comes in. You can play against the AI in this online version of the classic board game while enjoying your time by yourself. You can shake things up by playing it in different modes and difficulty levels.

name: Don't Fall
author: Addicting Games
description: Don't Fall is a free balance game.

name: Don't Fall In Lava
author: Addicting Games
description: Don't Fall In Lava is a free-avoider game. In this game, you'll find yourself ferrying a stick person across a treacherous landscape with lava forever below you, using your knowledge of physics to keep the stick person safe from harm. With every level, the challenges become more daunting, the obstacles become more perilous, and the rewards stay basically the same. In this game, you need to draw a line for the stick person to ride across, like a zipline. But beware - this is no simple task. With lava pits, spike traps, spinning saws, falling rocks, maybe lasers, and we’re guessing sharks in your way, you'll need to use your wits and your quick reflexes to keep your character alive. This mobile and desktop game is designed to be accessible to players of all skill levels. This is why the early levels are a little easier than the later ones. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a flavorless newcomer to the world of physics puzzles and stickmen, you'll find the challenges to be satisfying. “Don’t Fall In Lava” can be played on both mobile and desktop devices, so you can take the challenge with you wherever you go. Whether you're killing time on your commute, killing time at work, killing time at home, killing time in bed, killing time while watching a boring streaming show, or killing time while talking to a friend and or relative, this game is the perfect way to waste your time. It's time to embark on a thrilling adventure and show the world what you're made of. With simple gameplay, pulse-pounding puzzles, and the ability to play anywhere, this game is your new favorite.

name: Don't Shoot The Puppy
author: Addicting Games
description: Don't Shoot The Puppy is a free puzzle game. Lock and load a barret 50 cal automatic rifle that can take helicopters out of the sky or strafe a platoon from a distance. Do whatever you want with the gun, just don't shoot the puppy. That's right. It's all fun and games until a puppy gets shot, then you lose the game. So, as I said: you have your machine gun and there is a puppy, both of these things should co-exist without ever crossing over. For example, you can shoot your gun, but don't shoot it AT the puppy. This is basically all you need to know to play Don't Shoot the Puppy. A lot of people get confused. They see the title and they see the game and they wonder 'can I shoot the puppy?' I'm here to tell you 'no, don't shoot the puppy.' I don't want to have to repeat myself but I understand there might be a language barrier, maybe you have a hearing problem or perhaps it's just so ludicrous to not shoot a puppy. But to be clear: We will not be shooting puppies in this game. Maybe you've played other games where puppies are shot, and that is horrifying, but it's not how we do things around here.

name: Dot and Cross
author: Addicting Games
description: Dot and Cross is a clicker game that looks easy but really isn’t. This online game is set against a white background and you will only see two options to click on: A dot against a green background and a cross against a yellow background. You want to click on the dot and not click on the cross. The bold colors help you differentiate between them. There is a turquoise bar at the bottom that tells you how much time you have to make the right choice. Sounds simple, right? You will be surprised at how many times you can mess this up. Hit the cross and you automatically lose the game. Play again to see if you can beat your last or best score. Click the leaderboard icon in the lower right corner to see where you rank against other dot clickers. Each level has a bar at the bottom of the screen too and with every correct choice, you will inch closer to pass it. Try to pass all the levels in this deceivingly easy looking online game.

name: Dot Dash Connect
author: Addicting Games
description: Dot Dash Connect is a free mobile puzzle game. In Dot Dash Connect it is your job to draw a dot-dash, dot-dash and don't crash. Don't crash. There will be balls that need to get from point A to point B and you are in charge of drawing a ramp, a line, or a series of ramps and lines in order to connect everything. Remember after you're finished drawing and you hit play the laws of gravity will come into effect and things drop, fall, push and pull! It is an interesting challenge and a very unique puzzle where time, space, physics and your ability to draw will all intersect to become one awesome game. See how far you can get, how fast you can get there, and how many tries it takes in order to win, then try to beat that score. You can do it. It won't be easy, but puzzle games aren't fun because they are easy they are fun because they are challenging. So, have fun by challenging your creative side and taking on this super fun puzzle.

name: Dots Attack
author: Addicting Games
description: Dots Attack is a simple puzzle game that you can play on your phone or computer! No tutorial needed for this instant online game. This is a simple game with clean animation showing either a pink or blue dot against a white starry background. Use your mouse or finger, to click on the screen to change the color of the dot to match the one that is attacking it. As long they match when they are connecting, then you got it right! This online game will speed up making the switch more and more difficult. Test your reflexes with this quick online game until you slip up. If you think you are playing well and have an awesome score, select the leaderboard icon to see if you made the list with other top players. Play again to beat your own best score and do not stop until you are at the top of the leaderboards!

name: Drag Racer v3
author: Addicting Games
description: Drag Racer v3 is a free racing game. Put the pedal to the metal—without blowing out your engine—in this drag racing arcade game. Either jump into an arcade race, pitting any car of your choosing to any other car, or start a career, and build up your drag racing prowess from scratch. The arcade mode can offer up a fair bit of fun, but the career mode offers up plenty of depth and vehicle options. You start by buying a vehicle, and then you’re able to race it to your heart’s content, either for fun, or for money, or even for the title to a vehicle. Make a few bucks, upgrade your vehicle further, allowing it to perform better and leaving you more confident to wager against other racers. Once you’ve customized, you can start to put on car shows for even more money. Eventually, you’ll advance in rack, unlock additional vehicles to race—faster and more exotic ones—proving just what a speed demon you are.o!

name: Drag Racing Club
author: Addicting Games
description: What segment of a mile do you choose to live your life in?  A lot of people like to do a quarter mile at a time. That is fine. That is there choice. No one wants to take that away from them. But what if you wanna live your life a half mile at a time, or three-quarters of a mile at a time or really even a full mile? It should be your choice. You should be allowed to make that choice and we here at Addicting games support that choice. That is why we publish a game like Drag Racing Club. Drag Racing Club is a fast-paced side scrolling racer game where players compete to get the fastest time and beat their opponents.  You can upgrade your car you can collect power ups, you can cut the other drivers off. There are all sorts of little tactics you can pull in order to be number one. And we support all of these tactics. We support the liberation of the self through horsepower, raw speed, and pure power. If you think you're fast enough, smart enough or tough enough to jump into the driving seat of a game like this, we'd love to see you try. We encourage you to live your life as fast and as far as you want

name: Dragon Awaken
author: Addicting Games
description: Dragon Awaken is a strategic dungeon dive set in a fantasy world! In this dangerous fantasy reality, you are warrior destined to do great things. Following the orders of your commander, you attack a dragon lair with your comrades but something goes wrong. You end up possessing the power of the dragon and becoming one of the legendary dragon knights! Now, you will have to find the meaning of your newfound powers. But it won't be easy. Like in all mmogames you'll have to start small and grind your way up to the top of the food chain. Life in the dragon age is hard can you take it?

name: Dragon Dash
author: Addicting Games
description: Soar through the sky, grabbing gems and avoiding the birds. Fly, adorable dragon, fly!

name: Dragon Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Find matching pairs and eliminate all the tiles.

name: Dragon Slayers 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Dragon Slayers 2 is a free target game. The dragons are back again. Firebreathing down your door and bent on revenge since you slew thier scaly cousins during the last dragon assault.

name: Draw4Play
author: Addicting Games
description: Get your little dude to the door. Draw a path; erase a path. Be careful; some obstacles will mess with your lines! Timing counts.

name: Draw4Play 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Little dude is back, and looking for more adventure! Spraypaint a path for dude to run on. Carve out new routes with your eraser. And pay attention; levels got obstacles that will wreck all your pretty lines, and maybe crush your dude. So paint fast and run faster!

name: Drawn Together: Cavity Search
author: Addicting Games
description: Cavities aren't good for your teeth.

name: Dream Car Racing
author: Addicting Games
description: Dream Car Racing is a free racing game. Tinker with this wobbly car and get ready for action! Put the long spring thingy here, the wheel there, and put that somewhere too, then get on the road. Collect coins along your way to trick out your ride, son!

name: Dreamy Realm
author: Addicting Games
description: Dreamy Realm is a free hidden object game. Oh wow, 12 whole levels of hidden object fun. Bet you can't play just one! You're going to love Dreamy Realm for both its dreaminess and its realness. There are 12 levels of this dreamy hidden object game for you to play consider and ultimately master. Take our hand and enter this delightful fantasy world and help the fantasy creatures find and clean up their magical items. They are missing their magic stuff, their fairy stuff, their elf stuff, and maybe even ghost stuff?  Come prepared to find many more random objects. It will not be easy to find them. Look to the bottom of the screen for the missing items that you must find quickly. Every time you find an item, a new item may appear in its place to be found. Find all the items as fast as you can to earn a higher score. Some items may be tiny and some may be more obvious. If you get stuck there are all kinds of cool hints. You only have this option when the circle is filled with green though and it does lower your score. Click on High Scores to see where you rank against other hidden object players.

name: Dress Code 60s
author: Addicting Games
description: Cast your fashion sense back about 40 years. Ready to get your miniskirt on? Let's do it!

name: Dress Code Nightclub
author: Addicting Games
description: Dress Code Nightclub is a free dressup game. If you don't look dope, you'll never cross the velvet rope! Get your best nightclub look on, and hit the hot spots!

name: Dress Me Up Clockwork Couture
author: Addicting Games
description: Feeling a little Victorian? Wish you had more monocles and corsets in your life? Get your steampunk fashion on here, baby!

name: Dress Paris in Jail
author: Addicting Games
description: How good can you make this bird in jail look? Will she fight for Sparta, or simply dress to impress the other inmates?

name: Dress Up Barack
author: Addicting Games
description: Dress up the presidential candidate in a variety of wacky outfits. Today he's a game, tomorrow he's a trivia question.

name: Dress Up Hillary
author: Addicting Games
description: Will Hillary have bare feet, or bear feet? You decide what she wears for her next big speech. Are you going to make her a voice to be reckoned with, or a complete idiot?

name: Dressy Woman
author: Addicting Games
description: Dressy Woman is a free dressup game. You're ready for a date - almost! What to wear? Pick right. Your date is VERY serious about first impressions...

name: Dropdom Jewel Bast
author: Addicting Games
description: Dropdom Jewel Bast is a simple puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours! Check out this block blaster game where your goal is to blast the jewel-colored blocks before it hits the top of the screen. Swipe the blocks left and right until they drop down and blast other blocks out of the screen by creating a single line of blocks. Every time you swipe, new blocks will be added from the bottom of the puzzle as it climbs up the screen making it more of a challenge. However, your objective is to blast the blocks and keep them from hitting the top of the screen. Click on the leaderboard icon to view your score and see where you stand against other block blasters. At the end of each game, you will see your most recent and best score. Play again until you beat your best score and watch as you rise up the leaderboards beating out all of your friends. This is a mobile-friendly game that you can play on either your mobile device or your computer!

name: Ducklings.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Ducklings.io is a crowd building iogame. We all wanna have the most friends and build a better life for ourselves. In Ducklings.io you can do exactly that except with birds instead of friends. Birds are actually probably better for you, long term, than people, are anyway. This is an adorable crowd building game about ducks competing to have the biggest flock of ducklings. You will start off as a hapless lonesome duck who must float out into the big bad world to find followers to bring back to your nest. The more ducklings you are able to convert and bring back to your nest, the more points you will score. It is not as simple as it sounds though, beware the machinations of competitive ducks who wish to intercept your flock and steal your followers for themselves. You will need to be able to spot them, outflank them, avoid them and keep your flock on the straight and narrow. You'll probably have to make multiple trips back to your nest in order to maximize your score and keep mama duck happy. Also, you yourself can intercept opposing ducks flocks in order to steal their ducklings. Don't feel too bad about it, that is the name of the game.

name: DuckyFly Go!
author: Addicting Games
description:
Fly as high as you can with Ducky! Help Ducky navigate the difficult
path up and collect feathers to recharge him with more energy.
As you fly up, Ducky's confidence goes up as well!
Help him reach greater heights!

name: Dude and Zombies
author: Addicting Games
description: Is there anything more annoying than a swarm of zombie bunnies trying to bite you while you fix your truck? Yeah, bigger zombies. Blast at the undead interference while you repair your truck. Use experience points to protect yourself; use money to buy...yes, Bigger Guns!

name: Dumbocalypse
author: Addicting Games
description: Dumbpocalypse is a free game. The world is getting dumber. So dumb in fact that it might lead to the end of the world itself. Unless of course someone with the foresight to avoid obvious disasters is able to step forward and take control of the world's direction before it is too late. This is the premise of Dumbpocalypse, a type of puzzle game where you will have to make decisions based on limited information and hope you've somehow intuited the right answer. The clues are everywhere, you just need to pay attention and think critically. Easier said than done, but not impossible. Dumbpocalypse is the only game desktop game that lets you save the world by simply not doing the obviously dumb thing. It is a novel idea. This game is part strategy, part critical thinking, part role-playing, and all fun. It is the kind of game you'll want to share with your friends just to see if they are as dumb as you think./ They probably are, but with this game, you'll be able to prove it one way or another for good.

name: Dungeon Surge
author: Addicting Games
description: All of our kittens have been kit-napped! Only you are noble and foolish enough to try and rescue them all. You can unlock and complete quests to earn achievements within the subterranean tunnels. Fight monsters, complete quests and rescue kittens!

name: Dustbound Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Dustbound on Steam now!

 

Mobile requires a controller!

Dustbound is a deckbuilding survivors-like roguelite where you build your deck by finding lost treasure. Between waves of monsters take time to upgrade your cards and shape your character’s build—then dive back into the fight.

name: Dwarf Legacy Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Dwarf Legacy on Steam now!

 

Mobile requires a controller!

Dwarf Legacy is a difficult bullet-hell precision platformer. Embark into the depths of The Mountainhome. Climb treacherous vertical dungeons and reclaim your lost legacy. Your wits, agility, and determination will be pushed to their limits.


Climb Vertical Dungeons
Master the art of precision platforming as you navigate intricately designed levels filled with peril. Each ascent presents new challenges, from devious traps to relentless foes, ensuring no two climbs are ever the same.


Gather Precious Resources
Discover and collect valuable resources scattered throughout the depths of The Mountainhome. Bring your findings back to the expedition base to enhance your equipment and increase your chances of survival.


Upgrade Your Gear
Every decision shapes your journey. Strategically balance resource collection and equipment upgrades to maximize your potential. Tailor your gear to your preferred playstyle and adapt to the ever-increasing challenges of The Mountainhome.


Challenge Yourself 
For the brave and determined, each level offers optional feats of daring. Conquer these formidable tasks to earn bonus resources, bolster your gear, and prove your mastery. Rise above your peers and earn your place as a legendary dwarf.
Immerse yourself in the atmospheric world of a forgotten dwarven stronghold. Explore beautifully crafted environments, where danger lurks in every shadow and each step brings you closer to reclaiming your heritage. Will you have the courage to rise to the challenge and restore your legacy?


Supported Languages

name: Earn to Die
author: Addicting Games
description: Earn to Die is a free platform racing game. No silly zombie is going to ruin your roadtrip across the U.S. of A! Upgrade your ride, turn up the tunes, and show em who is boss!

name: Earn to Die 2: Exodus
author: Addicting Games
description: Earn to Die 2: Exodus is a free platform zombie game. Unlock and upgrade vehicles and drive your way through cities overrun by zombies!

name: Earth Defense
author: Addicting Games
description: The planet is counting on you!

name: Easter Egg Hop
author: Addicting Games
description: Don’t mess with the hens—their beak is worse than their bite. Your reward is a chocolate bunny if you can catch all the chicks.

name: Easter Eggs
author: Addicting Games
description: Look, I don’t mind that they’re dyed eggs, but when you call a game Easter Eggs I expect there to be hiding or searching. The game has neither, there’s only arranging.

name: Easter Golf
author: Addicting Games
description: Help the Easter Bunny collect eggs and score a Hole in One!

name: Easter Mahjongg
author: Addicting Games
description: No description available.

name: Echolocation Shooter
author: Addicting Games
description:
Shoot to see in the dark!

Eliminate all the neon enemies, in the horroristic level!

The only way to see in this FPS is to generate soundwave with your weapon.

Survive endless waves of the wide variety of enemies, where the only way to see is to shoot. Unleash soundwave rifles, laser cannons, and grenades to light up the battlefield, upgrade your gear, and fight deeper into the horde.

Every shot reveals the world—every wave pushes your limits.

name: Edward & the Strange Invasion
author: Addicting Games
description: Complete quests to discover what happened here. Where are the people? Where did these dangerous plant monsters come from? Are these advisers real, or are you going crazy-go-nuts? Better find a weed-whacker, and quick. And remember to fuel up at the vending machine!

name: Effing Worms
author: Addicting Games
description: Effing Worms is a free stick game. Don't you wish you were a giant worm? Dig fast tunnels, and surprise hippies, cops, cows and pedestrians from below! Feed the beast, baby!

name: Eggcellent Equations
author: Addicting Games
description: Eggcellant Equations is a math game mixed with an action game. There are eggs falling from the sky! No one knows why but this chicken is out to save the life within each egg. Help this chicken collect as many falling eggs before they fall and crash to the ground. Some eggs are falling slow and some eggs are falling fast. Some are big and easy to catch, while others are small and hard to catch. For every egg you let fall, you lose one life. When your game session ends, that’s when the math begins. To play another session, you must answer math questions correctly. There are several skills for you to practice like addition, subtraction, and counting. For upper-level students, there is also geometry, algebra, and percentages.

name: Egypt Pyramid Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Egypt Pyramid Solitaire is an online card game with an Egyptian theme. What better than ancient Egypt to use as the backdrop for a game of pyramid solitaire? Pharaohs, hieroglyphics, and, of course, pyramids are part of the amazing decoration for this online solitaire game. If you have never placed before, you must pair cards to add up to 13. Each level must be solved within the allotted time. You can find your score, level, and the timer in the righthand panel. There are 40 levels of this card game for you to play! Once you have defeated all 40 levels, click on the High Scores to see if you are one of the best of the best!

name: Election Jammer 2008
author: Addicting Games
description: Fly your candidate high up into the sky so he can buy.. I mean _earn_ votes! Just don't run out of steam and crash before the end of the election!

name: Electric Man 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Electric Man 2 is the sequel to the action stickman game, Electric Man. You're in a tournament against other stickmen who are trying to beat you for the grand prize. Beat out every one of these stickmen using your electrifying power moves. There are no rules and several rounds with a varying of opponents that you need to defeat. Your goal is to keep your title and be the best of the stickmen universe.

name: Elvenar
author: Addicting Games
description: The world is in chaos! Emeralds, gems, diamonds, and other crystals of power have been scattered across the hostile lands of Elvenar! You will need to rally your tribe, stick together and build a bustling city if you wish to survive the horror of invading tribes, natural phenomena, and the always present concept of entropy. First you will choose your preferred race: Human or Elfen. From there you will have to explore the map of this massively multiplayer online role-playing game in order to find a place to settle and begin building your empire. Stay one step ahead of your competitors and always prepare for the worst. You'll have to manage your resources keenly if you want to survive.

name: Emmas Christmas Sweets
author: Addicting Games
description: Think you have what it takes to serve sweets and hot chocolate this holiday season? Well, you don't. But Emma does, so help her out!

name: Emoji Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Emoji Mahjong is an online mahjong game based on your favorite emojis! The world is changing and so is language. These days people communicate the best with emojis that help express emotion and actions. There are smile faces, angry faces, sad faces, and funny faces! You can even find monkey and cat emojis. This online puzzle game incorporates emoji tiles with emoji-based patterns for you to play with and solve. In the right-hand panel, you’ll find your level, score, and a timer. If you get stuck on a pattern, you have the option to use a hint or shuffle. However, these options will lower your score so use them rarely and wisely. There are 80 levels of various emoji-based patterns for you to solve! When you finish all 80 levels, check the High Scores board to see if you made it to the top of the list! Check out this emoji-based mahjong game that you can play for hours!

name: Emoji Run
author: Addicting Games
description: Emoji Run is a free mobile game.

name: Empire: World War 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Dread it, run from it, the final battle will still come all the same. We thought world war one was the war to end all wars, and the world war two, but now at the dawn of a new millennium we are faced with a worldwide global conflict that will rue the fate of humanity evermore! Empire: World War 3 is a futuristic massive multiplayer online roleplaying game that puts you in command of your own sect of tech warriors and lets you build up your crew to possibly take over the world. You have the potential to upgrade your airforce, your armor divisions, and even your infantry into an absolutely unbeatable legion of unholy futuristic terror. If you have the will to grind your way up the ladder and know how to properly manage your resources than domination of the entire planet is within your grasp! Strike now while chaos reigns, this is the time to rise from the shadows of your fortified bunker and launch a crusade against the armies of man that will echo from here to Valhalla!

name: Enchanted Garden
author: Addicting Games
description: Enchanted Garden is a puzzle game where you must find all of the hidden objects in a garden. Enter into a magical garden that is full of beautiful flowers and other exotic plants. Find flowers, numbers, plants, mushrooms, and keys among the majestic background. There are 3 levels for this online game but don’t let that fool you into thinking this is a quick game. Each game has a limited amount of turns and you must complete categories to gain more turns. If you get stuck, use the zoom feature to find objects that are cleverly hidden. Some items may be a different color, transparent, or just extremely small. Do not leave any stone unturned in this hidden object game. You are not punished for clicking items not on your list, but items in another category do take up a turn. Select the High Scores tab to see where you rank against other puzzle players!

name: Endless Roller
author: Addicting Games
description: Endless Roller is a free racing game. This is a fast-paced endless runner style game where you need to survive for as long as you can. As a humble ball, you'll try and roll your way to victory by dodging many obstacles and challenges in this fun, free racing game. This is a game all about durability and survival. The winners will be those who are able to dodge the blocks, take the jumps, avoid the pitfalls, and stay on track towards a glorious 8-bit future. The game only gets faster and harder the longer you play, so, don't expect any reprieve from the suffering until after you die. Such is existence in a future world where rolling is the only escape and there is no end. Endless Roller us a game which requires Laser fast reflexes and razor-sharp precision in order to navigate your way through the floating space maze in the sky. Your only way of gauging your distance or your success in this game will be by keeping close tabs on the leaderboard. How far will you go and how long will it take you to get there? Only time will tell.

name: Endless Rush
author: Addicting Games
description: Endless Rush is a free racing game. The rush never ends. Not when there are coins to be collected, obstacles to dodge, and miles to put behind you. That is right! There’s no traffic cop around and you’re in a rush to get to your destination. Weave in and out of traffic without hitting other cars. Some cars stay in their lanes but some of them will switch without signaling. The nerve! Earn and collect coins as you get further and further with each play. Use the coins to unlock all the character skins for your car so that you can choose from many options. The car game will speed up as you zoom through traffic and it becomes difficult to avoid bad drivers. Drive as far as you can each time to earn cash and get a better chance of landing on the leaderboards. Do not stress if you don’t get too far at first. This is the kind of online game to play over and over again to beat your own score. You are your own competition in this fun racing game!

name: eParkour.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
eParkour.io is a free iogame. Picture this: platforms, suspended in mid-air, hover above an endless expanse of the majestic ocean. Your objective? Navigate these floating islands, making spine-tingling jumps and heart-stopping leaps to reach the end of each level. In "eParkour.io," you become the ultimate parkour virtuoso. Channel your inner daredevil as you jump, flip, and twist your way through a dazzling array of gravity-defying obstacles. Run along the edge of a precipice, launch yourself into the abyss, and rebound with unparalleled finesse. Your agility will be your superpower, and precision will be your ally.

But wait, gamer-friends, that's not all! We're not content with just pushing you to the brink of your parkour prowess. We've included an epic boss battle that will leave you breathless. As you conquer the treacherous platforms, a colossal water titan awaits you at the finale. This gargantuan adversary is no pushover; you'll need lightning-fast reflexes and impeccable timing to defeat this aquatic behemoth. Will you emerge victorious or succumb to the immense power of the deep? And remember, the best part is that "eParkour.io" is absolutely free to play! All gamer friends should have the chance to experience the thrill of defying gravity and conquering death-defying stunts. So gather your friends, unleash your competitive spirit, and embark on this exhilarating journey together!

name: Epic Celeb Brawl: Punch The Trump
author: Addicting Games
description: Welcome to the Epic Celeb Brawl series! Hit him with a low and high punch! Buy special weapons, such as a baseball bat, ninja stars, gold bars and more! Master all the special combo moves. Have fun and shut him up once and for all!

name: Escape Camp Crystal Lake
author: Addicting Games
description: Escape Camp Crystal Lake is a free escape game. Escape? Not so fast. There are puzzles, boss battles and some angry kid in a hockey mask standing between you and freedom. So buddy up, 'cause it's going to be a long night.

name: Escape From The Mall
author: Addicting Games
description: Escape From The Mall is a free escape game. You’re locked in a mall and must figure out how to escape in this point and click adventure game. Well, isn’t this embarrassing? You’ve gone and dozed off inside the mall, and when you wake up, the entire thing is locked shut and there’s a crime scene blocking the escalator. You must use your keen puzzle skills to figure out a way out of here, and just in case you were wondering—it’s not as simple as going through the front door. If you’re going to successfully Escape from the Mall, you’re going to need to put some effort into it.

name: Escape From the Oval Office
author: Addicting Games
description: Escape From the Oval Office is a free escape game. After eight years, it's time to leave town. But how? There's skeletons in the closet and stuff I don't even remember. Escaping has never been so treacherous!

name: Escape: The Bathroom
author: Addicting Games
description: Escape the Bathroom is a free escape game where your objective is to get out of this bathroom. How did you even get stuck here in the first place!? You don’t know how it happened but it’s up to you and your ingenuity to figure your way out in this puzzle game. In order to Escape the Bathroom, you’ll need to figure out a series of point and click puzzles. Then, and only then, will you be able to find you way out of this room. Don’t try to simply leave through the door, either. Those lasers probably hurt. Play this funny escape game and figure how to use the seemingly normal bathroom items you find.

name: Escape: The Car
author: Addicting Games
description: Escape: The Car is a free escape game. You're trapped in a car like a bad mafia movie. It's either figure out a way to escape or die trying. Can you click your way to freedom?

name: Escape the Coffee House
author: Addicting Games
description: Trapped in the Cafe! is a free escape game. Trapped, again? This time, it's a coffee house. So you can munch on danishes and stay nice & jittery while you look for a way out. Sweet, huh?

name: Escape the Office 2015
author: Addicting Games
description: Escape the Office 2015 is a free escape game. You're trapped at work! Point and click your way to freedom!

name: Escaping the Prison
author: Addicting Games
description: Escaping the Prison is a free puzzle game. It's a bum rap. Somebody sold you up the river and you were sentenced to more time in prison than you've even been alive. It doesn't seem right that a fellow ought to be locked up longer than he's been on Earth. Where is the justice in that? Someone has to pay and that someone shouldn't be you. Furious with the inequities of the criminal justice system you have formulated a plan: you will escape, you will prove your innocence and you will figure out who wronged you. Easier said than done of course. But if anyone can do it, it's you. It'll be hard, it'll take a lot of trial and error and you'll be forced to reconcile with your own past mistakes as well as puzzling out the subtleties of various different obstacles. This is a point and click choose your own adventure game that goes heavy on the story and has a lot of different endings and routes it can go before you finally figure it out and make it to the end. Pay attention to the clues, interrogate every crime scene. You were already found guilty once and you can't be found guilty again! This is your time to shine. Your time to prove yourself to a jury of your peers and indeed the whole world watching at home.

name: Eternal Fury H5
author: Addicting Games
description: Eternal Fury is a an epic fantasy set in the world of a massive multi-player online role playing game. Those who dare to venture into its murky world of rogues and scoundrels will learn what happens when players will take on the role of a lost soul. He was attacked and injured, and now he can’t remember who he is and what’s his mission but he will still fight for justice until he regains his memory and discovers the plot behind the havoc aroused in the kingdom. In this journey, players will not only live a fun experience improving their skills but will also be accompanied by powerful weapons, mercenary partners, and become part of a grand warriors’ Guild.

name: Even More Capitals Of The World Level
author: Addicting Games
description: Even More Capitals of the World is a geography game that will help you learn all the capitals of the world. Whether you are a geography geek or you need to study for that big geography test, this map game will help retrain your brain. Tokyo, Japan, Bangkok, and Buenos Aires are just a few of the capitals that you will need to memorize to beat this game. There are 3 levels and every level has 30 questions. Answer all 60 questions and try your best to keep your points. This is an educational game so even when you lose you are winning. The map game will let you know the correct answers which will help you memorize all of the capitals of the world.

name: ev.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
Ev.io is a free IOgame. The game currently supports two game modes. In deathmatch, compete in a free-for-all against other players to score the highest number of kills. In team deathmatch, work with your team to achieve the highest number of collective kills. The weapon system in ev.io is a bit different than other browser shooters, like Krunker or Venge, in which you cannot pick up weapons on the map. In ev.io, you choose the primary weapon you start with: a hand cannon, auto rifle or laser rifle. Each of the different primary weapons falls into a different archetype. For example, the auto rifle does low damage but has a fast rate of fire. The laser rifle has high damage but a slow rate of fire. 

In addition to choosing a primary weapon, you can also pick up weapons on the map. There are three possible weapons you pick up: the shotgun, sniper and rocket launcher. The pickup weapons are quite a bit stronger than your primary weapon, but have limited ammo. So you need to make your shots count to take full advantage of them. The game also has a pretty complex ability system, which is mostly centered around movement and grenades.

name: Exploder.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Exploder.io is a free IOGame. In this game, you'll be using retrobit styled explosives in order to blast away the grid maze that surrounds you and find your way to the center of the puzzle. This is a game where players are in direct competition with hundreds of other players from around the world. All of you are headed toward the same goal and you cannot be stopped. Collect items and open up new doors and channels using explosions. Try to outsmart the other players in the game by tricking them into getting nuked by your errant bombs. This is a game for people who like to think ahead and are in direct competition with other people. Play hard and play fast as you trick your other friends into getting blown up by your timebombs and your perfectly placed nukes. This is a game based on the classic Bomberman series except you're up against way more players and have way more to do. If you feel like you're ready to win then it's time to jump on in.

name: Extreme Heli Boarding
author: Addicting Games
description: Extreme Heli Boarding is a free physics game. Shred through the stars. Logs and pigs are the only things that stand in between you and some wicked air.

name: Falling Candy
author: Addicting Games
description: Falling Candy is a cute matching game for you to relax and enjoy. Similar to the game of Tetris, instead of boring old blocks, you have adorable and colorful candies to stack. The game is set against a brightly colored background of a witch's home as she waves her wand for every candy that falls down from the sky. Unlike in Tetris, the candies may fall stuck together but will separate to fill up any open spaces. Your objective is to either create a row or column of at least three matching candies. With every match, you’ll gain a point and get closer to your goal. This is an easy online game but still has enough of a challenge to get you addicted. There are 25 levels for you to pass as you climb up the leaderboards. Once you’ve solved all 25 levels, submit your score to see how you rank against other candy stackers!

name: Falling Monsters
author: Addicting Games
description: No description available.

name: Falling Sudoku
author: Addicting Games
description: Falling Sudoku is an online sudoku game with a mix of falling blocks. If you are bored of the same old sudoku games then try this online game for more of a challenge. You will receive random blocks of blank blocks or numbered blocks and you must stack them according to sudoku rules. To help you out, you can see the upcoming blocks to make sure you do not run out of legal spaces. You only get 3 chances to make a mistake, otherwise, you lose the game. There are 3 levels of this game for you to play and win! Golden blocks increase your score so use them correctly! When you finish all 3 levels, submit your score to see where you rank against other online players.

name: Familiars.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Familiars.io is a free IOGame. Gather round and hear a tale as old as time. A tale of a trainer who decided to train his familiars and enter the competitive world of pocket-familiar battles and prove his worth as a pocket-familiar battle person. In this game, you will choose your character and then you will choose your familiar, and then you will test your mettle against the other familiar battlers of the world. Train them, optimize them, learn which skills beat other skills, then build a team. It is pretty cool, and it makes you feel like you're playing a real sport. In fact: who is to say this isn't a sport? One day familiars.io will be in the Olympics and you'll probably wish that you were all trained up and playing at an Olympic level. But until then you can just enjoy this game for what it is: a fun retro-style pocket battler game with completely new and original mechanics.

name: Fams Word Search Classic
author: Addicting Games
description: Word Search Classic is a free word game.

name: Fancy Pants Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Fancy Pants Adventure is a free racing game. Is a stick man still a stick man if he's wearing stylish, puffy, orange pants? What if he has wavy hair that distinguishes him from the hordes of violent stick people roaming the internet? Such questions may be too heady and too philosophical for us to answer here and now. But what we do know is that Fancy Pants Adventures is considered to be a classic stick game and that it is one of the best, most visceral platform experiences available online. Thrill to the realistic physics, the challenging level design, and the subtle but poignant animations. You don't get to be a classic by being too predictable and fancy pants is anything but. Each new level is a puzzling level of obstacles and choices which will leave you running, jumping, reacting and finishing --if you're lucky. Fancy Pants is as good now as it was when it was first released, years ago. The animations on the characters and the vibrant colors of the world as well as the fluid motion tracking in the game were so ahead of their time that you'll swear it was the latest release on steam. So, sit down and enjoy a piece of stick figure history.

name: Fancy Pants Adventure 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Fancy Pants Adventure 2 is a free endless runner game. At last, Fancy Pants returns with a fresh adventure! Select your fanciest pants and get ready for World 2!

name: Fancy Pants Adventures Remix
author: Addicting Games
description: A brand-new build of an awesome platformer adventure!

name: Farming 10 x 10
author: Addicting Games
description: Farming 10 x 10 is a puzzle game based on farming. Farming is a tough job but you have to plant your crops of the season. You have eggplants, tomatoes, corn, wheat, and even daises. Ideally, as a good farmer, you must plant your crops in a row or column. This will make it easier to pick your crops. Once you have a completed row or column, a farmer will hop on the screen to clear out the row or column earning you points. The more rows and columns you create, the better your score. Play this online game, again again, to beat your best score while rising up the leaderboards.

name: Fashion Boutique
author: Addicting Games
description: Fashion Boutique is a free dress up game. Design high fashion clothing, and then sell it! Can you spot market trends, or are you making yesterday's clothes?

name: Fashion Expo
author: Addicting Games
description: Fashion Expo is a free tycoon game. Do you has style? Select your models and dress them as instructed: casual, professional and fancy. Then see what the critics say!

name: Fast Arrow
author: Addicting Games
description:
Fast Arrow is a target and shooting game. With Fast Archer, you can become the dead-eyed marksman you've always wanted to be and you won't have to worry about proper posture or tugging a 50-pound bow.  Take aim at the spinning target and try to land a shot on its sie as it spins toward infinity. The real challenge isn't landing a shot, that should be easy after all your arrow goes in a straight line directly to the target. The real challenge will come after you've landed a few arrows and you want to land some more. You will be scored on how many different arrows you are actually able to land successfully on the spinning target without accidentally hitting one of your own previously shot arrows.

The more arrows your fire, the more space you will take up, this will require you to plan your moves and be more careful. There are dozens of different strategies, all of them require you to pay attention to the spinning wheel and have a pretty good idea of how long it will take for an arrow to hit the target after you've fired it.

name: Fast Warrior
author: Addicting Games
description: Fast Warrior is a free avoider game. In this game, you are a speedy soldier of fortitude who is becoming a soldier of fury and fame. Fast Warrior is an avoider game where you must balance, run, stab, and pillage upon a razors edge. Wade through dozens of enemies as you dash and dare with all your might. With one hand you will thrust and the other you will grab. Use your trusty sword, pick up health packs. This game is actually a lot of fun and you're gonna like it. So, sharpen those elbows and hey let us go! This is a game of kings, a game of queens, and a game of swords. If you have the grit, the gumption, and the guts maybe you'll be able to turn some of that warriors fury into some warriors fortune. If not you might wind up blown to bits at the boots of your enemies. Either way, you'll probably have a lot of fun getting there and know that we are beside you every step of the way in spirit.

name: Fast Words
author: Addicting Games
description: Fast words is a free word game. Tap to spell, spell to win, win to live. Fast Words is a mobile word game where you will be fed a word upfront and then forced to tap the individual letters of that word out of the air, in order, as they fall in front of you at a faster and faster rate. If you think spelling a word like 'VOLCANIC' is hard, just try doing it one letter at a time while each letter flutters past you at an ever-increasing speed. the hitboxes on these letters are really small, so don't get cocky. For those of you with fingers of size, you might find this game to be more complex than is warranted for such a simple concept. But the truth is that Fast Words is a game that will stick in your head and bust out of your fingers as you tippy tap your way through a drizzle of deconstructed words that fly by in a blur. The faster you're able to do it the higher your score and the better your chance of totally dominating the leader board.

name: Ferge.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Ferge.io is a free IOgame.

name: Feudalism
author: Addicting Games
description: Feudalism is a free strategy game. Vanquish foes! Slaughter enemies! Recruit and equip your armies! Conquer foreign lands! Tax citizens and provide municipal services! Oh, ok, you can skip the last part.

name: Fidget Spinner Creator
author: Addicting Games
description: Fidget Spinner Creator is a free Fidget Spinner Game.  Fidget spinners were all the rage. Whether you had actual fidgeting problems or liked doing cool tricks with them, fidget spinners were everywhere. From teenagers to business people, fidget spinners caught on as a way to take a break from all the noise. Now you can play with a fidget spinner without carrying it around with you from the comfort of your computer or smartphone. The objective of the game is simple: swipe and spin your fidget spinner as much as you can to gain coins. Use your coins to purchase upgrades that will make your spinner faster and have less friction. You can also use your coins to unlock cool character skins for your fidget spinner. Click on the leaderboards to see how you stack up against other fidget spinner players

name: Fidget Spinner Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Fidget Spinner Mania is a fun and easy game based on those popular fidget spinners. Fidget spinners were all the rage. Whether you had actual fidgeting problems or liked doing cool tricks with them, fidget spinners were everywhere. From teenagers to business people, fidget spinners caught on as a way to take a break from all the noise. Now you can play with a fidget spinner without carrying it around with you from the comfort of your computer or smartphone. The objective of the game is simple: swipe and spin your fidget spinner as much as you can to gain coins. Use your coins to purchase upgrades that will make your spinner faster and have less friction. You can also use your coins to unlock cool character skins for your fidget spinner. Click on the leaderboards to see how you stack up against other fidget spinner players.

name: Field Of Fury
author: Addicting Games
description: Fields Of Fury is a free IOgame. Welcome to the deadly world of fields of fury. It is a fun first-person shooter where you can choose between three roles with one goal: survive. This is a cool war game, in fact, this just might be our favorite war game, the graphics are next level, and thus you will experience intense fighting in a second world war zone to eventually gain the ultimate honor. Fileds of Furys is fun to play and easy to control. You will experience an incredible virtual reality world of war and survival. There are three different types of weapons in this game, and those different weapons will be indicative of your particular role. Slam into some rifles, automatic rifles, and bazookas. You can choose your favorite weapon to start a war to win honor for yourself. The game has one amazing map to challenge you and your abilities which makes it more challenging, interesting, and fun. There are a ton of soldiers in enemy territory waiting for you to attack and take 'em down. Don't worry about your life because as you'll see glory is far more important. If you lose all your health in battle, you can find your way to Valhall to brag of your accomplishments in the mortal realm. In order to win this war game, you'll need to move fast, move smart, shoot first, and shoot to win. Good luck.

name: Fierce Fashion Agents
author: Addicting Games
description: Fashionable sniper action? C'est tres chic! Use your sharpest sniper skills to perform some desperately needed make overs! Upgrade your weaponry and lead the fashionista army!

name: Fight to the End
author: Addicting Games
description: Players control a protagonist, an assault soldier, who needs to keep moving and fend off enemy attacks during the battle to survive until the end. Each time the protagonist levels up, the player can choose one of three randomly offered buffs, which are divided into skill - type and bonus - type. Skill - type buffs allow the protagonist to add or enhance skills, while bonus - type buffs are related to the character.

name: Findcat.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Findcat.io is a free IOgame.

name: Fire Crush
author: Addicting Games
description: Crush the matching colors, with FIRE! Fire Crush is a challenging puzzle game that requires steps of logic to clear the field. The survival of the galaxy depends on your skills! Well... not really, but this is a really fun game!

name: Fireboy and Watergirl 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Fireboy and Watergirl 3 is a free platform game. I am Jake, the Black Ranger. I love to stomp monsters and explore exotic locations, like the mysterious caverns in Fireboy and Watergirl 3!

name: First Day
author: Addicting Games
description: First Day is a free desktop bullet-hell game. It's your first day at a new job and nothing makes any sense. Welcome to life in an absurd future of cubicles, computers, and bosses. Never-ending bosses.  Your boss has an awful task for him, you need to take notes in the most unusual manner possible. Keep your eyes on the left-hand side of the screen for the words and letters you're supposed to spell. When the game starts whole alphabets full of letters will begin to rain down from the sky, your job (literally your job) is to fire at the letters and make sure to only hit letters from the specific words and nothing else. Missing the appropriate letter will end in your termination, and you do not want to be looking for a job in this market. This is a game that teaches you the rigors of the real world and the terrible practices and policies of office politics. The first day is a classic game in the mold of our older Flash games. We think you'll really like this one.

name: Fishy Math
author: Addicting Games
description: Fishy Math is an educational game that mixes matching with math. Deep in the ocean, you will find beautiful schools of fish ranging in different colors. On top of fish, you will also find jellyfish, starfish, and even sea mammals that you can match.
