Your objective is to catch these sea creatures by using your finger or mouse and run through them and link them. Have fun during the bonus segment where you will find tons of falling jewels to match for extra points. On top of this fun online game, practice your math skills in between each session. There are math skills from kindergarten to eighth grade. There are math skills from every level from addition, subtraction, and counting, but also algebra, geometry, and graphs. Once you answer 5 questions correctly, you will be allowed another session of the matching game.

name: Fisquarium
author: Addicting Games
description: Fisquarium is an idle clicker game that combines the joy of clicking with the soothing atmosphere of an aquarium. In this game, players click to earn fish, unlock diverse species, enhance production through upgrades, discover new fish types, collect trophies, and immerse themselves in the relaxing world of aquatic wonders. Whether you're a casual player or an avid clicker fan, Fisquarium offers a laid-back and enjoyable experience!

name: Fite.LoL
author: Addicting Games
description: A MOBA-style Battle Royale game you can play right in your browser! Pick from 4 unique characters, including a ghost that can possess different creatures. Use awesome abilities, outsmart your opponents, and take control of the battlefield in this fast-paced PvP showdown!

name: Fix The Sun
author: Addicting Games
description:
BE SURE TO MUTE THIS TAB BEFORE PLAYING, THERE IS A BUG WITH THE INTRO AND IT IS ANNOYING AND LOUD

 

One day the sun burnt out and everything was plunged into darkness. Don't be afraid of the light! Help your ember find his true calling in life and fix the sun!!

name: Flag Quiz
author: Addicting Games
description: Do you think you know all the flags of the world? Flag Quiz will put your memory to the test. There's a few that look similar that might trip you up, but there's plenty of mnemonic techniques that will help you succeed. Too bad we can't remember them...

name: Flags Maniac
author: Addicting Games
description: Flags Manic is a trivia game that will test your knowledge of flags! Do you know the flags of every country or nation of the world? If you think you are a flag geek or you will simply like to learn, Flags Manic is the online game for you. Some flags may be easily recognizable because you have seen them before, and other flags look similar to others. If you want to know the flag of lesser-heard-of nations, then click to play this trivia game. Challenge yourself by submitting your score and working to rise up the leaderboards. Or beat your own personal scores with every game session. Educational does not have to be a bore with this fun trivia game. Play from your computer or phone whenever you need to brush up on your flag knowledge!

name: Flags of Europe
author: Addicting Games
description: Flags of Europe is a map game that teaches you about European geography. Are you a pro at identifying flags? Do you know the flags of Greece, Italy, or France? Can you tell apart the flags of Austria, Croatia, and Ukraine? Even if you are not a flag geek, this is a great game to help teach you the flags of Europe. Whether you have a big test or you just want to impress your friends, Flags of Europe is a great educational game to train your mind. Not only must you identify the flag, but you must click on the correct location on the map. Bad at this map game? Don’t worry, the game teaches you as you play so that you get better every time. Learn about European geography and the flags with this fun educational game.

name: Flaming Zombooka
author: Addicting Games
description: In some situations, a bazooka might be overkill. But when it comes to eliminating zombies, you want all the extra firepower you can muster. Oh, zombies...I have something for you!

name: Flappy Cannon
author: Addicting Games
description: Flappy Cannon is a free clicker-style idle game. Math is hard, flying is hard, clicking is hard, shooting is hard and in Flappy Cannon you will have to balance all of these hard to master skills and combine them in an elegant game of flapping, flying, shooting, and distance. This is a flappy style game with a twist. You don't just dodge the barriers you have to blast through them! But the hit point value for each barrier is listed on it so you'll have to do a quick calculation on how long it will take you to blast through the walls. And you think that is tough? Well, there is more! In this game, you'll be collecting stars that you save up and use to buy upgrades. You can either upgrade the power of your weapon or the speed at which it fires. Another interesting decision point. As you are playing keep your eyes open for power-ups which will give you a limited amount of the kind of power-ups you can buy. This is an endless racer style game so your place on the leaderboard will be based on how long you can last. So, load up on upgrades and get flapping!

name: Flappy Shoot
author: Addicting Games
description: Flappy Shoot is a FlappyBird-style sports game that’s fun to play on mobile devices. Instead of flying in between pipes, you must guide your winged basketball through various basketball hoops. Avoid bumping into the hoops or the ceiling or else you lose the game. The hoops are stationed at different heights that you must drop your ball into to increase your score. Also, pay attention to the coins found along your path. Collect the coins to unlock all 12 of the cool character skins for your player. This is a fun instant game that’s easy to play because of its simple instructions. There’s no need for a tutorial with this sports game. Just hit the play button, and get straight to the game using just your finger or mouse. Click on the leaderboard to see how you rank against other Flappy Shoot players.

name: Flappybird Classic
author: Addicting Games
description: Flappybird Classic is an online clicker game that looks deceivingly easy. Navigate a funny-looking orange bird through green pipes of various lengths and heights. Your character flies across the blue sky with skyscrapers far in the background. The objective of the game is to pass as many points as possible without running into or hitting any pipes. The more points you pass, the better your score. If you fall or run into a pipe, you lose the game! This is the kind of game you play over and over again.  At the end of each game session, you will receive your most recent score and best score. Click on the leaderboard to see if your score is good enough to place and be at the top! Play again to beat your score as you rise up the leaderboards and beat all your friends! Play this classic clicker game on your phone or computer for hours of addictive fun!

name: Flash's Bounty
author: Addicting Games
description: Get into some serious medieval battle in this turn-based RPG game.

name: Flip Cube
author: Addicting Games
description: Flip Cube is a fast-thinking online game with a clean and simple animation. The objective is easy: don’t hit a spike. As your cube runs up your screen, spikes will appear on either side of the gray vertical line. Sometimes the game starts fast or you have many spikes to avoid, there’s no telling how difficult each game will start. The clean bright blue background creates a contrast against the orange spikes for you to easily decipher which side the cube should be on. Sometimes you don’t have time for tutorials and this is one of those online games with an easy to understand concept. Just hit play, and start playing trough trial and error. It’s an instant game that’s instant fun.

name: Florence The Fifth Element
author: Addicting Games
description: What if Catan was a video game? Gather resources and gain more victory points than your opponents by gathering resources in this pixelized take on the strategy board genre

name: Flower Dimensions
author: Addicting Games
description: Flower Dimensions is a colorful puzzle game for our gardening-loving players. This online game is a 3-dimensional version of your favorite puzzle game,  mahjong. Rotate the screen and match together 2 open blocks until you’ve solved the entire puzzle or earned enough points to advance to the next level. The puzzle game is based on gardening icons like various flowers, gardening tools, and colorful butterflies. The 3D tower is set against a lovely and bright background based on gardening themes. You will find your level, score, and the timer on the righthand panel. You must complete each puzzle within the allotted time to get the best score possible and to advance to the next level. If you get stuck, you can take a hint or restart the level. Each level its own challenge with a different time and pattern for you to solve. Once you’ve solved all 80 levels, select the High Scores to see if your score gets you at the top with the other amazing puzzle players!

name: Flower Garden Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Flower Garden Solitaire is a card game based on beautiful flowers. If you are a fan of flowers and solitaire, then you will love the aesthetics of this online game. Each game session is set against a lovely garden-based background. Some of the cards are also decorated with flowers that you can enjoy while you play. While this is a casual game, each session is timed. Complete the game before you run out of time and have to start over. If you think the game cannot be won, you can also restart the game. Each restart gives you a different combination of cards. From the menu, select High Scores to see if your best score lands you on the top 200 players. Play another round of solitaire to increase your score or just to unwind.

name: Flower Mahjong Connect
author: Addicting Games
description: Flower Mahjong Connect is a mahjong game based on gardening. Unlike other mahjong games, this one requires there to be no more than two 90-degree angles between matching tiles. The tiles in this online game are garden-themed with icons like flowers, rakes, buckets, trees, and butterflies. The tiles are set against bright and lively garden scenes like cottages, tea time, and yards. There are 40 levels to this online game for you to play. Each level presents its own challenge and is limited with time. Match all the tiles before the timer runs out to advance to the next level. If you fail to match the tiles before the timer is up, you lose the game. At the end of the games, submit your score to see if you land on the list with the top players. Play again to rise up the leaderboards and be the top player!

name: Flower Mahjong Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Flower Mahjong Solitaire is a free solitaire game. Flower Mahjong is a puzzle game based on one of your favorite tabletop tile games from the ancient east. This free online puzzle game is the digital version of everyones grandmas favorite way to match pieces and make it rain: mahjong. This game is true to the original mahjong rules but uses a floral style in its symbols and characters, thus transporting you from your dull workaday life to the exciting high-stakes world of a small flower shop. Like other popular mahjong games, similar tiles of certain types can be matched and don't need to be exact. For other tiles, you must select the same matching tile and it must be a tile which is not covered on more than two sides by other tiles. If you find yourself stuck, click the circular restart button, doing so will negatively impact your score so try to tough it out.

name: Flower Shop 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Flower Shop 2 is a tycoon game and matching game in one! You are a optimistic business person who is taking a chance and opening a flower shop. Each level is timed, with a customer goal, and money goal. Once you reach these goals, you must complete a matching game. The matching game will have its own goal to complete in order to pass the level. There are 10 levels of this online game for you to solve!

name: Flower Shopper
author: Addicting Games
description: Flower Shopper is a girl game that takes place in a fairytale! Play as a cute fairy who is running her very own flower shop. You will be selling beautiful plants in both pots and vases. Princesses, little red riding hoods, maidens, princes, and other fairytale characters are coming from all over the land just for your arrangements! There are 10 levels of this online game. Each level adds a new challenge with a new item to sell and more customers to keep happy. Be quick in this game and reach the customer before their patience runs out. If you take too long, the customer will storm off unhappy. Submit your score and try to rise up the leaderboards with every play!

name: Fluffy McFluffenstein
author: Addicting Games
description: The bloodiest cat and mouse game youve ever seen. Jump on the mice with your kitty, and they explode. After time runs out, so do you.

name: Fly Pig
author: Addicting Games
description: There are flying pigs. You have a shotgun. Guess what you're going to do? That's right, shoot the flying pigs out of the sky with complete abandon.

name: Flying Squirrel
author: Addicting Games
description: Blast a Flying Squirrel in the Chatdy Cannon!

name: Fold Paper
author: Addicting Games
description: Fold Paper is a free puzzle game.

name: Foon-o
author: Addicting Games
description: Foon-o is the ultimate online multiplayer card game inspired by Uno and Crazy Eights, blending the fast-paced fun and strategic twists of classics. Race to clear your hand first while outsmarting friends, family, and players around the world. Each match hones your skills, fuels your competitive spirit, and keeps you coming back for more. Ready to flip cards, match colors, and make daring moves? Jump in now and experience why Foon-o is the go-to choice for nonstop, luck-meets-skill excitement!

name: Foot Golf
author: Addicting Games
description: FootGolf is a free mobile golf game. Golf is all about patience, physics, and accuracy. Football is all about tactics, stamina, and athleticism. What would happen if you were able to combine both of these disciplines into an unholy alliance? What if you were able to take the tactics and athleticism of soccer and mix it with the physics and accuracy of golf? Then, my friend, you would have Footgolf. Footgolf is a game for royalty and the proletariat alike. All are equal in the Footgolf field. You just need to aim, kick, and sink the ball to score. This is a game that will test your resolve and demand you to go the extra mile. Bounce the ball off of the arena walls, blast past obstacles, move around hills and aim that ball into the hole with as few shots as possible. True masters of Footgolf are those who can sink their shots in one hit. You may take more but it will severely limit your overall cool fact. Challenge yourself and your friends, explore the synthesis of feet, and golf in this exciting new sport. Only on Addicting games.

name: Football.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Football.io is a free IOgame.

name: Forge of Empires
author: Addicting Games
description:
Please make sure your adblocker is disabled or you won't be able to play this game.

Forge of Empires is a truly epic MMO game. Do you think Empires are negotiated over biscuits and tea? Fool! The world around you was forged in the flames of time and against the cold iron of experience. All empires started as an idea which was brought forth into the world and made real by hard work, determination, and strategies of their founders. In Forge of Empires: the game, you will start as a small stone age settlement and slowly build up an empire throughout the ever-changing tides of history. Go from stone to bronze to steam to industrial to information and beyond! This game ain't like dusting crops or growing a garden, it is a strategic massively multiplayer online role-playing game where you must learn to manage your resources in order to grow your settlement and eventually dominate the future itself!

name: Forgotten Hill Disillusion: The Library
author: Addicting Games
description:
You hear them grumble, snicker, and taunt their vulgar jeers into the darkness. The Twins are searching for you, room by blackened room. It won't be long before they find you under the desk. You have the fire poker you found, maybe you could fight back? Maybe, but maybe escape makes more sense. You see a closed fire door that leads to an outer stairwell. On the other side of the room is an open door that leads into more darkness. The fire door may be locked, but you still have that skeleton key. The open door might be a dead-end or it might be another hall with more opportunities. No time to try both. Three choices, one chance, and no guarantees. The sound of the rain flowing through the eaves outside sounds like whispers and now you're seeing glimpses of the Twins flashlight as it creeps through the darkness.  'Glenda, come out come out' they sneer.  They're in the office adjacent: you're next. Gripping the fire poker you take a deep breath and close your eyes. All this trouble for a book, a stupid haunted book that you can't even read without going mad. You wonder about what you've seen tonight, how much of it was real? Will anyone believe you when you tell them? Will you get out to tell someone? A shock of thunder crashes through the darkened library.

Open your eyes and make your move.

name: Forgotten Hill: Surgery
author: Addicting Games
description: Forgotten Hill: Surgery is a free puzzle game. After being involved in some sort of accident, you wake up in a very creepy surgery clinic. Try to escape before they operate on you, because that's not gonna be pleasant.

name: Fortress Game
author: Addicting Games
description: It’s a fun game of throwing rocks and shoes at your neighbor. Special attacks include the Duck Throw and the Weiner Dog Toss. Fun, mean, and easy to play.

name: Four Leaf Clover
author: Addicting Games
description: It’s a virtual clover patch. Find a four leaf clover, and get virtual good luck!

name: Frantic Math
author: Addicting Games
description: Frantic Math is a free educational game. Math is not a simple escapist past time, it is a complicated set of rules and expectations. Some of those rules are complex and boring and some are so simple and taught to us so early that they become second nature. When you're adding up sums to single and double-digit numbers you barely even know you're doing math. It's just so natural and so easy. In Frantic Math, you'll be asked to take full control of your elementary math skills in order to add your way to the goal. Frantic Math is a game that confronts you with a solution and your job is to slide the various smaller numbers together in order to replicate that solution. You must think and move fast in this game since more numbers are added to the queue every few seconds and eventually you'll be drowned in an avalanche of numbers. This game is just all about adding up adjacent numbers towards a pre-determined solution. That is it. That is all that is required of you! This is a fun and fascinating game bereft of the needless complexities and obstacles in everyday life.

name: Free Rider 2
author: Addicting Games
description: In Free Rider 2, race on your own personally crafted 2D tracks, or find ones that other users have made for the ultimate challenge. With a heavy emphasis on physics, and hilarious wipeouts, you’re sure to faceplant more than a few times, especially if you load up some of the harder maps out there that users have created.

name: Free Rider 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Free Rider 3 is a free physics game. In Free Rider 3, you take a tilty bike ride through hand-drawn levels, collect stars and use power-ups FTW. Not good enough? Fine: Draw your own beastly level and trick it out! This game is sweet tilties.

name: Freecell Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Freecell Solitaire is a classic card puzzle. Solitaire is not just a game it is a way of life. You shuffle your deck and play the cards you're dealt. This is the story of your life, this is the story of everyone's life. How you will deal with a King or a Jack when what you really need is an Ace or a Deuce is one of the many determining factors in who you are and who you may yet become. If you are feeling stuck with diamonds and spades when what you really want are hearts and clubs, then you know what it is to live life and ply Freecell Solitaire. In Freecell Solitaire there are no right answers there are only optimal and sub-optimal moves. Where you decide to place your cards when you decide to place them, how you shuffle your cards: all of it is a reflection of who you are as a person. In this way, we can see how the game of Freecell Solitaire reflects who we are as people. Stack cards in alternating colors and increasing numbers or store them one at a time in your free cell discard piles. The choice is yours. Look for the patterns, make the right moves and cash out a winner. Just like in real life.

name: Freecell Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Freecell Solitaire is a free solitaire game. Solitaire is not only a fun card game, it is a way of life. Just go right ahead and shuffle the deck and play your cards. These cards and how you play them are the story of who you are, in fact, this is the story of who everyone is. Your story is told in how you deal with a Joker or a Duece when what you really need is a King or a Jack. These small choices truly are the determining factors in who you become. Feeling stuck with hearts and diamonds when what you really want are spades and clubs? Then you truly know what it is to live life and die by the Freecell. Welcome to the world of Freecell Solitaire. There isn't a right way or a wrong way, only better and worse plays. Place your cards, shuffle your deck: all of it is a mirror image of who you are in your heart. Freecell Solitaire reflects us as people. Stack cards in alternating colors and increasing numbers or store them one at a time in your free cell discard piles. The choice is yours. Look for the patterns, make the right moves, and cash out a winner. Just like in real life.

name: Fruit Crush Frenzy
author: Addicting Games
description: Fruit Crush Frenzy is a free match 3 game. This is a game about matching at least three and then extrapolating that as far as you can to match four, five, hey maybe even six. SIX! Fruit Crush Frenzy lets you make connections by drawing lines between adjacent blocks of frut. Match at least three to make them disappear but don't stop there! In this game you don't just match orthogonally you can also match diagonally and spread your pattern all over the map. If you want to get strategic then you can aim to include one of the black bomb tokens that will explode an entire column and line for you. This is a game that rewards strategy as well as celebrating the tactical supremacy of pattern matching and slip-sliding your finger across the board to blow fruit up. Tell your friends, tell your family, tell an enemy, tell em all, we don't care who knows about this game. If you want to challenge people then go ahead and challenge anyone you can find.

name: Fruit Skewer
author: Addicting Games
description: Fruit Skewer is a free mobile game. Go bananas with Fruit Skewer, the ultimate in fruit-themed match-three games that will have you skewering fruit like a pro! In this addictive game, your task is simple - align three or more pieces of fruit on your wooden skewer in order to clear them from the descending grid. But don't be fooled by the simplicity of the gameplay - as you progress through the levels, you'll encounter increasingly difficult challenges that will test your matching skills to the limit! While you must match at least three, you can technically fit as many pieces as will fit on your skewer. You can also Grab fruit that doesn't match and strategize your plays.

name: Full Stacks
author: Addicting Games
description: Full Stacks is a free puzzle game. This is a world of donuts. Donuts are delicious but they are also dangerous and they need to be stacked in a specific pattern in order to be of any real practical use. Full Stack is a game that allows you to stack all of the donuts you want in but you must do it in specific patterns. The patterns in this game are not 2 Dimensional, they do not go up and down and left and right, but they also have a depth to them, a third dimension that makes the game all the more challenging and all the more fulfilling. Ignore the colors and focus on the depth and the shape. Make sure that the stacks you're making do not go over or under the height allowance and that they fit all of the pegs perfectly. In this game, the pegs are your guideposts. The pegs exist so you know where everything is supposed to go, follow the pegs and drop the donuts on the pegs and you'll finish the game a true hero.

name: Fun in the Sun
author: Addicting Games
description: Fun in the Sun  is a free dressup game. Dress for seaside success! Change outfits until you've found the ultimate outfit. Don't forget the tanning butter!

name: Fun Volleyball
author: Addicting Games
description:
Fun Volleyball is a cute sports game. It may we winter now but it's always sunny somewhere. The world is full of beaches and this is only one of them. Join us in a fun and frantic clicking game where you must coach your team to victory by keeping the volleyball up in the air and then eventually over the neet and somewhere in the sand to score. This is a game that requires skill and concentration as well as being incredibly buff and able to operate well in stressful situations.  Volleyball is an age-old sport that requires an ability to judge distance as well as speed and timing. Will you spike the ball and take the lead or be crushed by your opponent's superior volleying skills? Only time and the leaderboard will tell.

This is a game which can be played one player against the computer or if you are really brave, it is a game that can be played one on one against a real-life opponent sitting right beside you. If you're ready to escape to a sunny beach somewhere in the middle of nowhere and defeat buff beach dudes who eat volleyball for breakfast, then perhaps you are ready for all of the excitement that Fun Volleyball brings to the table.

name: Funky Plane
author: Addicting Games
description: Fly on board Funky Air Flybus B230. Take to the skies, avoid the clouds, collect fun items! How many points can you score in 60 seconds?

name: Fury - The Tank Battle
author: Addicting Games
description: Fury - The Tank Battle! Be furious, battle tanks, use your abilities to survive and conquer your enemies! Oh yeh!

name: Galactic Colonization
author: Addicting Games
description: Galactic Colonization is a free strategy game. Dominate planets by invading them! Send your battle fleets to compete with a vicious AI in a war for ultimate control!

name: Galaxy Warriors
author: Addicting Games
description: Galaxy Warriors is an exhilarating space-themed vertical flight game. Join the fight against invaders as you fly across the starry sky. Shoot at other spaceships, aliens, and asteroids that are trying to stop you from getting to your destination. With everything you destroy, you’ll free coins that you must collect. With these coins, you can purchase upgrades. Upgrades include a defensive shield, stronger attacks for both front and side shooters, longer-lasting shooters and coin magnets. As you’re fighting against your enemy, avoid any debris and shots but fly towards boosts and coins. As you gain more coins and upgrades, you’ll be able to pass more and more waves beating out your own score every time. What are you waiting for? Join the fight to protect the galaxy in this online game.

name: Gameknot Chess Puzzle
author: Addicting Games
description: Gameknot Chess Puzzle is a free daily Chess puzzle. All chess puzzles aim to checkmate your virtual opponent no matter what moves they make (i.e., a forced mate) in the requested number of moves. Some chess puzzles are created from actual chess games played online, and some are purely composed chess problems, sometimes even with positions that cannot be reached in a real game of chess. All chess puzzles are automatically verified, so all solutions are guaranteed to be correct and complete.

name: Gangsta Bean
author: Addicting Games
description: Gangsta Bean is a free side-scrolling game. One Bad Bean is going to face down an army of evil food. Do you fight?

name: Gem Frenzy
author: Addicting Games
description:
Gem Frenzy is an Arcade, Roguelike game, inspired by Overcooked and Dig Dug where you must dig to find and sell precious gems.

Help Pancha become rich or suffer the consequences of late stage capitalism.

name: Gem Slide
author: Addicting Games
description: Gem Slide is a free gem game. This is a game about a grid of gems that are randomly assorted and laid out. Your job is to slide the gems left to right, right to left, up and down, and down and up. You must do whatever you can in order to make these gems line up in rows of three, but that is not all we want from you. In Gem Slide you'll be rewarded for being able to match not just three gems but four gems and in some cases five or more gems. But it also isn't just about lining up one kind of gem, in this game, there are multiple different types of gems, so, if you can line up three blue and 4 red at the same time then you are on fire. This is a game about spotting patterns, thinking ahead, making connections, and sliding your way to victory. If you like winning this game is for you! And if this game is for you then we encourage you to play it wherever you can, whenever you can. Play hard and see how far you can make it up the leaderboard.

name: GemCraft
author: Addicting Games
description: GemCraft is a free strategy game. Harness the awesome power of gems! Tower defense, yes. But a huge world; tons of levels to beat and many creeps to defeat!

name: Get 10 Plus
author: Addicting Games
description: Get 10 Plus is a free math game. Math is educational, math is fun, and now math is a game. Perhaps you have wondered exactly how many different ways there are to add up basic numbers to get to ten. Perhaps you think you're really good at adding up basic numbers to get to ten. Maybe you don't think it's hard, but we are here to tell you it is actually quite challenging and often in some cases it is also fun. Math puzzles are fun and educational. They also improve your mental math abilities which can be handy in everyday life. Have fun with these math puzzles. They are designed to be difficult, but fun. Now, math games are a great way to learn math by yourself. There are no tricks or gimmicks. For those of you who like numbers and patterns, this should be a piece of cake. And for those of you who don't like numbers and patterns, this could be a nightmare. The coolest thing about this game is the number ten. That is right, the number ten. See, check it out, you can do a lot with the number ten: it's the only number that works in a multiplication problem and in a division problem, and you can use the same number for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Crazy weird facts for a fun math game.

name: Get 10 Ultimate
author: Addicting Games
description:
Get 10 Ultimate is a free puzzle game. Welcome to the ultimate in getting 10. A puzzle game that will challenge you to add it up in order to break it down. Use both sides of your brain in order to make short-term tactical choices that will dovetail into long-term strategic choices. A gridded squares filled with tiles of numbers will appear.  By touching a selection of grouped numbers you actively combine that number with all adjacent numbers. The selected section all become one individual tile and the new tile will be one number higher than the previous section. Your goal is to build your way up to unlocking a tile with a value of 10. In order to accomplish this, you'll have to think about moves a few steps ahead of time, organize the existing tiles so that they all into place in such a way that you can exploit them after they have increased their value. You must always be aware that one bad move or a series of poorly thought-out choices will leave you unable to combine any tiles and thus end your game.

Challenge yourself by trying different grids and trying to get to 10 with fewer moves than in your previous games. Get10 is an adding game, a math game, and a puzzle game that will have you scratching your head and clicking your way through multi-colored levels of mind-bending fun.

name: Get Off My Lawn
author: Addicting Games
description: Get Off My Lawn is a free twoer defense game. My lawn may be small, but I will defend it to the death! My mower starts with deadly steel blades. And every upgrade makes me stronger! Keep creeps at bay while you nourish your green patch.

name: Get10
author: Addicting Games
description:
Get10 is a mathematical puzzle game. In Get10 you'll have to make short term tactical choices as well as long term strategic choices. A grid of numbered squares from 1-3 will appear and by touching a selection of grouped numbers you will combine that number with all adjacent numbers. The selected section all become one individual tile and the new tile will be one number higher than the previous section.

Your goal is to build your way up to unlocking a tile with a value of 10. In order to accomplish this, you'll have to think about moves a few steps ahead of time, organize the existing tiles so that they all into place in such a way that you can exploit them after they have increased their value. You must always be aware that one bad move or a series of poorly thought out choices will leave you unable to combine any tiles and thus end your game.

Challenge yourself by trying different grids and trying to get to 10 with fewer moves than in your previous games. Get10 is an adding game, a math game, and a puzzle game that will have you scratching your head and clicking your way through multi-colored levels of mind-bending fun.

name: Getaway Driver 3D
author: Addicting Games
description: Getaway Driver 3D is an epic car racing game where your objective is to drive away! This is an online game with 3D graphics where you play as the villain of the story. Someone just robbed a bank and hired you as their getaway driver. Don’t waste any time and get away as long as you can. Go on freeways, drive through the city, and drive on the sidewalks...anything you have to do to lose the cops. Be careful because this isn’t a regular police car after you. They’re not afraid to ram you in or block you off even if there are other cars around. Sometimes you have to play dirty to get ahead and in this case, you have to get on their playing field. This is a cool racing car game with different driving abilities that will help you live out your drift-car racing fantasies.

name: Giant Hamster Run
author: Addicting Games
description: You're a tiny hamster turned into a giant hamster. Suddenly, everything seems so small. Run along the city streets. Switch lanes, jump and slide to avoid obstacles such as roadblocks and police cars. Collect coins and cookies along the way. Use coins to purchase cool items, such as a skateboard, rocket pack and yes, a magic carpet!

name: Gifthunter2.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Gifthunter2.io is a free iogame. Ho ho ho and welcome to Giftmas, the yearly festival where gifts become sentient for one night a year and fight other sentient gifts for survival and possibly escape. In this game, you'll be armed with the same auto-repeater item as all of your gift friends. It is your responsibility to take cover as you hunt down other gifts and try to be the last gift standing. In this game, you'll be aided by the fact that the entire arena is filled with other boxes that look exactly like you. Al you have to do in order to blend in is just stop moving, Beware opposing players who might have noticed you running and then stopping. It is easy to get caught but its also easy to not get caught, it all depends on your vibe. Opposing players in this game are extremely sensitive to vibes. So, good luck with your giftmas battle royale. Maybe if you're lucky you will be able to take down the opposing boxes before they take you down.

name: Girl Dress Up Makeover
author: Addicting Games
description: Girl Dress Up Makeover is a free make up game. So many choices, so little time. From your eye shadow to your shoes, you decide what looks best. What does your ideal outfit look like?

name: Gladiator True Story
author: Addicting Games
description: Gladiator True Story is a free-fighting game.

name: Go Go Goblin
author: Addicting Games
description: Do goblins feel pain? Are they as aerodynamic as everyone claims? Time to test your goblin toss hypotheses, peeps. Let fly the little ogre, and help him go the distance with various and sundry powerups. Disco bouncing balls, dangerously dangerous rocket propulsion systems, and primitive flying squirrel wings all will help your green projectile move farther down field. Time to toss, folks!

name: Goblin Run
author: Addicting Games
description: Goblin Run is a free mobile platform game. You might never escape the jungle but that doesn't mean you should stop running. Ahead of you, there is nothing but the future. It is unwritten. It is a paradise of possibilities and you can only get there and make your dreams come true by running. Endlessly running in this goblin themed endless runner game.  there are coins to collect and the fun and adventure of jumping off and on of platforms. Use your tiny goblin muscles to jump over spikes, dodge pits, and traps, and collect as many coins as you can. As you run you can chow down on yummy roasts in order to activate your valued 'double-jump' power. Run your green goblin legs through this platform maze and unlock the secrets of. good time in this free, fun, plaatform game where you run till you die.

name: Gobtron
author: Addicting Games
description: Sling sticky snot strings at annoying humans. Combo shots for more destruction, yo! Spend your earned DNA to make your snot stickier, or add a Sonic Burp to your snotty tool box. Keep evolving to rule your world with snot!

name: Golf Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Grab your golf club, aim carefully, adjust your power and take the shot! Golf Mania is a casual multiplayer golf game that is all about precision, timing and quick thinking. Compete in real-time against up to 12 players on fun maps. Be the first to sink your ball into the hole, or find the smartest path through challenging golf courses full of obstacles and clever shortcuts. Invite and play with your friends or family in online matches. Choose your character skins and customize your golf ball to stand out from the crowd. Level up and unlock upgrades like shot distance and ball trajectory to improve your chances of winning.

name: Goose Idle
author: Addicting Games
description: Goose Idle is a free idle game.

name: Grand Grimoire Chronicles Episode 4
author: Addicting Games
description: Grand Grimoire Chronicles Episode 4 is a free escape game. There is a big dark house at the end of a long dark street. Somewhere inside is the answer to a mystery. People are talking about it 'who is Elizabeth' and 'what is her secret.' Everybody wants to know what the big dark secret just might be and it is up to you to follow your nose, collect the clues, put them together to solve the puzzle.  You'll figure it out if you spend enough time gathering the clues. There are so many clues and items in this escape room style dialog driven . Probably some of the best clues you'll ever read. But you gotta do something with them, you gotta take them and you gotta put them together and you gotta come up with a solution or its game over.  This is a mystery puzzle-style game that will put you to the test, the ultimate retro, 8-bit mystery game.  If you want to pass it and you want to be the hero you're gonna have to work hard cause it's not easy but it's fun. It's a good time.

name: Green
author: Addicting Games
description: Green is a free puzzle game. The color of money, the color of greed, the color of spinach, and the color of lime: Green is here, it is time to play. Some people say it isn't easy being green, they're actually wrong. It's quite easy to be green, but green as a game, a construct? That is where things get dicey, that is where they get complicated, that is where they get fun. Green is another game in a series of puzzle games from Bart Bonte. In this game, there isn't a specific series of puzzles that test your mental capacity. In these games, you don't even know what the puzzle is until you start clicking around. Every level is different and every level will drain you of your valuble energy as you try to figure out what the deal is and how to overcome it. This is a fun puzzle game for people who like to crack the case as well as click on through to the other side. If you think you're smart enough to win then prove it with Green, the game.

name: Greeny Gap
author: Addicting Games
description: The world is green and you're a quadrangle spaceship. Oh noes! Pilot through mazes that will take you upside down and roller coastering through a strange green world. And please, mind the gaps, or else there will be no certificate for you, young Greeny.

name: Greyhound Tycoon
author: Addicting Games
description: Greyhound Tycoon is a tycoon game centered around the business of greyhound racing. Pick a pooch; feed him right and give him lots of love and exercise. This online game simulation can get realistic though and you’ll have to take care of bills like in any typical business. You may need to take side-jobs like advertising pictures or working at a petting zoo just to fund your dream. You’ll also need to race your pup on weekends while placing bets. Pay attention to each dog statistics and don’t take risky chances. Things may be difficult in the beginning and you might have to take out a loan just to keep your business afloat. This online game is all about management. Just budget both your time and money to make get your dog to the top in this tycoon management game. Go on fun trips; visit off-track betting, borrow money from vicious thugs... your canine tycoon dream is finally a reality!

name: Guess the Word
author: Addicting Games
description: Challenge your vocabulary and problem-solving skills with Guess The Word! In this exciting word puzzle, guess a hidden five-letter word using color-coded hints—green for correct letters, yellow for misplaced ones, and grey for wrong letters. Refine your guesses and solve the puzzle! With a vast collection of words, this game sharpens your linguistic abilities while keeping you engaged. Whether you're a word game enthusiast or just looking for a fun brain workout, Guess The Word is the perfect choice. Play now to enhance your vocabulary, boost your pattern recognition, and enjoy hours of entertaining word-solving fun!

name: Gunball 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Your ball starts small, but it is powerful. Brutalize your enemies to earn skill points and money. Then make your ball more deadly. Attach money vacuums, laser cannons, and other weapons of ball destruction. Booyah! And do NOT forget to groove on the awesome music.

name: Gunny Bunny Double Plus
author: Addicting Games
description: This double-barreled bunny is armed to the teeth. Show them why you win with two guns instead of one.

name: Guns and Angel
author: Addicting Games
description: Angel brings the noise and the heat! Popping caps in plenty of monsters, and acquiring all the hot weaponry, yo!

name: Guns & Bottles
author: Addicting Games
description: "Guns and Bottles" is an exciting bottle-shooting game that challenges your accuracy and timing skills. Aim carefully to shoot the spinning bottles while your gun rotates, adding a unique twist to the challenge. Tap the screen to hit the bottles and score points. Hit three bottles in a row to earn bonus coins, but be cautious—hitting a red bottle will end the game! Gather coins to unlock powerful new guns and take your shooting skills to the next level. Get ready for a thrilling test of reflexes and precision with "Guns and Bottles"!

name: Halloween Bats
author: Addicting Games
description: Halloween Bats is a scary shooting game. Its that time of the year again. Halloween is here and it has brought a flock of bats to terrorize you. In Halloween Bats, you'll have to smash the bats before the bats can smash you. Each bat flies towards the screen and you must find them and stop them before they can reach your home base. Watch out for witches, zombie hands, spiders, and cats as they scurry across the screen. Each of these obstacles will try to stop you from completing your goal of destroying the bats. If you accidentally smash a cat, a spider, a witch, or a jack-o-lantern instead of the bats your turn will be over. So, be very careful. You will have to move fast but also be careful. The bats are sneaky and will try to trick you into accidentally hitting one of the forbidden obstacles. This is a game of skill, timing, and reflexes. Do you have what it takes to swat back the batty Halloween hordes? Find out as you smack bats and stack points. Hop on a broom and rid your way to the top of the leaderboard in this thrilling bat stomping casual game.

name: Halloween Connect
author: Addicting Games
description: Halloween Connect is a Halloween-themed matching game perfect for a relaxing game session. Enjoy this eerie-inspired game with backgrounds full of spooky and haunted forests that are infested with bats, ghosts, and Jack O’ Lanterns. This is a game for fans of matching tiles and everything Halloween. Match together tiles that picture monsters and other scary characters or items. There are witches’ hats, coffins, skulls, bats, red shot eyeballs, and spiders. From creepy to scary, there’s everything you love about Halloween. There are 10 levels of Halloween matching games for you to solve today. Once you’ve beaten every level, click on the high scores to see if you’re the best matching game player on AddictingGames.

name: Halloween Escape
author: Addicting Games
description: Halloween Escape is a free escape game. Did you need a reason to escape? This joint is full of ghosts and other spooky stuff. Bloody axes? No Like! Please to go home!

name: Halloween Escape Unmasked
author: Addicting Games
description: Last year was pretty scary, huh? This year, you have to uncover the truth behind all those ghosts and poltergeists. Use your insane escape skills to see what REALLY scared you last time!

name: Halloween Horror Massacre
author: Addicting Games
description: Halloween Horror Massacre is a scary-movie themed puzzle game that fans will enjoy. Your objective is to count down a creepy tree without bumping your head on a branch or before you run out of time. This is a casual puzzle game for fans of scary movies with creepy character skins and eerie music playing in the background. Your first free character is Freddy, the murderer that haunts nightmares. However, as you play along and earn points, you can unlock other monsters like Frankenstein, Jason, and Scream. Play until you unlock all of these killer characters. Then head over to the Leaderboards to see how you rank against other Halloween Horror Massacre players. Climb up the leaderboards or beat your own score in this spooky online game for scary-loving players.

name: Halloween Quest
author: Addicting Games
description: In a ghoulish mood? Match zombies and bats and ghosts to score. Well, that's your quest, so get busy!

name: Halloween Rush
author: Addicting Games
description: Two minutes. An infinite number of seemingly evil jack-o-lanterns. Unlimited ammo. Do your worst.

name: Halloween Tetris
author: Addicting Games
description: Halloween Tetris is a free Halloween game. This is Halloween and that means this is Tetris. Halloween Tetris is a game that has been played throughout the ages and around the world. You may have never played it but that is because it is a secret wrapped in a mystery. Halloween Tetris is very similar to the way normal Tetris is played but with one key difference: In Halloween Tetris, the Tetris blocks themselves are made out of neon voodoo skulls, ghost faces, and the brains of ghouls. The different ghoul faces are also color coordinated to the shapes that they are forced into, it's kind of cool and kind of terrifying. This is why it is Halloween Tetris and not just normal Tetris. It would honestly be weird if this was normal Tetris. In this version of Tetris, you are trying to survive as long as you possibly can and the board is bigger than normal. At first, this allows you to blast through the different puzzles extremely fast, however you eventually begin to realize the blocks are coming faster now, faster and faster. And now you are trapped with the ghost skulls falling and the unvanquished skulls beneath you.

name: Halloween Words
author: Addicting Games
description: Halloween Words is a Halloween-themed word game. Every level has a new-spooky inspired background that you can enjoy while you play. From pirates to Jack O’ Lanterns, there is everything Halloween-y with complimenting colors of orange and black. This is a word game for our dictionary loving players who happy to like education as well as Halloween. Exercise your mind by scanning through the available letters to put together English words. There are 10 levels for you to solve before the timer runs out! Put together as many words as you can find to earn points and to reach your goal. Once you’ve solved all 10 levels, head over to the high scores to see how you rank against other word game players.

name: Hambo
author: Addicting Games
description: Hambo and Bacon, back from Vietnam, are misunderstood. Bacon under arrest? Hambo to the rescue! Use your jungle fighting skills to free your brother in arms, my porcine pals!

name: Hammer 2 Reloaded
author: Addicting Games
description: No description available.

name: Handle
author: Addicting Games
description: Mix Wordle with cards and what do you get? Handle! Click through all the cards in a deck and figure out what hand the dealer is keeping from you!

name: Happy Farm
author: Addicting Games
description: Happy Farm is a puzzle game that is easy and fun to play! Click on 2 or more matching tiles that are connected either vertically or horizontally to make them disappear. The more matching tiles you connect, the better your score. This online game is a cute and colorful matching game that contains tiles with unique designs. There are 150 levels of this casual online game for you to play! As you unlock each level, you will also unlock boosts that will help advance your score. For instance, find an ax that you can use to remove a single tile that is blocking matching tiles. Use each boost wisely because you are only allotted a specific amount for each level. Find boosts amount the tiles as well like a rocket that can blow out a column or row. Submit your score to see where you rank against other players!

name: Happy Helloween
author: Addicting Games
description: Happy Halloween is a Halloween-themed cute and casual online game. The objective of this game is simple: catch the falling candies in your box without dropping a single one. It’s a weird and creepy night when suddenly Halloween candy starts falling from the sky. A small child dressed as a cute pumpkin while eerie music plays in the background runs back and forth in a frantic trying to catch all the Halloween candies. There are all kinds of lollipops that your character will enjoy as he rushes to grab them. You must help him out as you see the candies falling making sure he’s there before it hits the ground. While this has a Halloween theme, it’s not at all scary. If anything, it’s a cute and simple casual game for you to enjoy. Beat your own score every time you play as you climb up the leaderboards.

name: Hardest Maze on Earth
author: Addicting Games
description: Hardest Maze on Earth is a free puzzle game. You have tried all of the other puzzle games. They were good, some were even great, but none of them were the hardest maze on Earth. This is the hardest maze on Earth so by definition, it is also the best maze on Earth. This maze presents itself as a series of 2-D platform levels where you must deconstruct and master the patterns of floating triangles, swinging squares, and spinning circles. Move fast, move slow, dodge the obstacles and overcome the maze. You only get one chance so failure is not an option but it is an inevitability. You may die but you can always try and die again. It is a never-ending cycle of collaboration with the game itself. If you wanna make it to the top of the leaderboard you'll have to do it by trial, error, and hard work. This is a world of puzzles and pictures. If you think your puzzle muscles are up to the challenge then this is the game for you.

name: Hatfall
author: Addicting Games
description: HATFALL is a high-energy game of skill and hat-wearing born from Zero Punctuation, the hit online video series from The Escapist, created by the man behind ZP, Ben 'Yahtzee' Croshaw. When Yahtzee finds that his hat has gone missing theres only one option: collect as many hats as you possibly can. (Note: For best gameplay, be sure to update your browser to the latest version!)

name: Heart Break
author: Addicting Games
description:
Support the Developer!
Check out Studio Yarn at https://arataryan.itch.io/ to support the developer and try out their other games!

 

The townspeople of Heartsville  are broken in two! Join Hart Jr. in recovering the missing heart pieces, while at the same time teaching the culprits, the Bleeding Heart Gang, a hearty lesson.  But watch out - the gang is no joke! Bounce on their heads to inflict some cardiovascular damage! 

Play your heart out!

name: Hedgehog Launch
author: Addicting Games
description: Hedgehog Launch is a free launch game. Hedgehog + Rocket Pack = Money Maker! Collect coins in the sky with a prickly little dude, upgrade, and go for broke!

name: Hedgehog Launch 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Hedgehog is pretty good at the flying thing. But the stakes is higher now - time for a moonshot! Catapult yourself to awesome and useless powerups, like fancy goggles!

name: Helicopter Game
author: Addicting Games
description: Helicopter Game is a classic game of balance and timing. So, you think you can fly? Well, don't be so sure! It gets pretty hairy up there, once you're fighting gravity and dealing with an X and a Y axis you might just realize that flying is for the birds. Sharpen your retinas and crack your knuckles. Keep an eye on your speed, watch your altimeter, don't roll, don't overheat, avoid obstacles and try to keep your cool as you turbo thrust your way through a series f levels which get harder, faster, and more impossible to pass. If you thought a game like flappy bird was hard to play, you don't know what you're talking about. You literally have no idea. This is a chopper game designed to break you, to frustrate and intimidate. Only the strongest pilots with the most iron of wills and the hardiest hearts will bee able to take on these obstacle courses, navigate, and survive! How long will you be able to outplay the game itself Can you defeat it to survive longer than your friends? Will you spend hours of your time racking up a high score only to see all of your hard work dashed in half the time by someone a quarter of your age? Yes absolutely. Such is the curse of helicopter game. Instructions: Use your mouse to steer the chopper. Click the left mouse button to make it rise and try to tactically time the rate at which it falls in order to successfully navigate each stage.

name: Hell On Duty
author: Addicting Games
description: Hell is hot ... and hot means sweaty. Have you ever smelled a demon's armpit? Imagine a million skunk butts, but slightly less aromatic. These dirty demons need cleaned, and you're sending them to the showers in Hell on Duty. It doesn't matter if the water is holy, just bathe the beasts!

name: Hero Zero
author: Addicting Games
description: Build up your own superhero team!

name: Heroes of Glory
author: Addicting Games
description: It isn't glory that makes a hero its the quality of their character, its the strength of their convictions, the ability to stand defiant in the face of tyranny! The glory is just the cherry on top. In Heroes of Glory, you will recruit your own custom team of fighters, mages, archers, and all kinds of fantasy races and train them to defeat your enemies. You will vanquish evil and defend your homeland via PvP battles and a new way to approach arena battles. Heroes of Glory is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game which will allow you to customize your party, upgrade their skills and build an empire. You are the sacred warriors of your own nation-state. You must not only fight typical fantasy minions but the never-ending threats from the border.

name: Heroes of War
author: Addicting Games
description:
Whether you like WW2 strategy games or not this pvp online game will conquer your heart. Build your military base and attack other players. Try all types of World War 2 troops and tanks. Build your best squad to climb up the leaderboards.

FEATURES:

- World War 2 themed game

- More than 80 types of real WW2 troops

- PvP strategy games

- Easy to learn, hard to master

- Epic online ww2 warfare

- Fast and spectacular fights

Fight for honor and glory. Become the best commander!

name: Hex Wars
author: Addicting Games
description: Hex Wars is a free tank game. Welcome to the grid. the hex grid. A hex-based arena of grids, blocks, and tanks. You are but a cube tank that is trying to dominate the hex arena through violence, shooting, and sweet tactical maneuvering. Lead your tank to victory and decimate the opposition with judicious use of your turbo cannon, laser blaster, and iron will to survive. Because Hex Wars is an iogame, that means that you will be up against other players from around the world. A whole arena full of them. There are no teams in this game, there is just you, your blaster, and the inevitable conflict, the moment where you prove one way or another whether or not you're truly the gamer du jour or the gamer du jerk. So, slap into a hex grid in this simple but fun tank game.

name: Hexa-Tile Puzzles
author: Addicting Games
description: Hexa-Tile Puzzles is a free puzzle game.

name: Hex.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Hex.io is a free iogame. All the world is a hex grid and we are merely the bois who must click, build, and slowly develop a thriving kingdom of generators and walls. Such is existence as we know it. Ours is not to complain or to wonder why, our is simply to select the power generator to build the power generator and then surround it with a wall while we attempt to take over as much territory as possible. Hex Bois is a game of area majority and area influence. It is a game where you must flex your muscles by placing your hexes. In the game, you'll be creating hex powerplants to create an incrementally small number of points which you will then use to eventually buy a bunch more hex stuff. Will you buy another hex generator, a hex wall, a hex plant? Who is to say. The answers to such questions are hidden within your own mind and will only float to the surface in the heat of battle.

name: Hextank.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Hextank.io is a free IOGame.

name: Hidden Classroom
author: Addicting Games
description: Hidden Classroom is a hidden object game based on objects you find in school. Sometimes schools can get messy because students do not always return things to their place. With a big class and young students, it can get chaotic. Unfortunately, you got stuck with cleaning duty so you must put away all the items back in place. There are 10 levels to this hidden object game. There are classrooms from first grade to high school to clean up. You will find toys, notebooks, shoes, lamps, instruments, and utensils that need to be put back in their place. Find all the missing objects and complete all 10 levels of this online game. Each level is timed so you must search quickly. Once you have beaten all 10 levels, submit your score to see where you stand against other players.

name: Hidden Math Gems
author: Addicting Games
description: Hidden Math Gems is an educational game for learning students to play. Math does not have to be a bore! Use this online game to break up your math sessions with a good old-fashioned clicker game. The objective of the game is to help this archaeologist dig through various blocks to find treasures and gems. There rubies, emeralds, pearls, and other precious stones that are hiding through blocks. Certain blocks will be tougher to get through while others will be easy. Some blocks will not let you get through so you will have to figure another way down. Whatever you do, do not let the archaeologist hit the top of the game or you lose. Once you have played a fun session of Hidden Math Gems, practice your math by answering 5 math skills correctly to unlock the next game.

name: Hidden Objects: Super Thief
author: Addicting Games
description: Hidden Objects: Super Thief is a hidden objects game with adventure. It’s your lucky day! You get to be trained by the best thief in town. Except not everyone knows she’s the best of the best. Help her gain a reputation by stealing from various locations to earn more clients. Each client will provide you with a list of items that need to be stolen. It’s your job to keep track of the lists and click on all the hidden objects. Find the items as quickly as you can for bonus points. The better the score, the more likely the chance to gain 4 stars per location. As an unpaid intern, you have to work harder than anyone!

name: Hidden Princess
author: Addicting Games
description: Hidden Princess is a puzzle game based on fairytale images. A beautiful princess is frolicking through the forest with creatures, filled with curiosity, animals circle around her. In this magical forest, there are hidden objects that you must find in order to solve the level. There are 3 levels in total and they each have their own challenges. Find crowns, swords, bows, and flowers in this forest to win the game. Some objects are big and obvious while others are small or blend in well. Take advantage of the zoom feature to search every corner. This game is not timed but you do have a limit on turns. With every completed list, you gained more turns. If you run out of turns, you lose the level and have to start over.

name: High Fantasy Idle Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find High Fantasy Idle on Steam now!


High Fantasy Idle is an idle RPG with unique class-based gameplay and hundreds of achievements and secrets to find. Level up by farming, battling, and researching while buying items and perks, then rebirth to find newfound power! Embark on a journey of fantasy and mystery to unravel your destiny.

name: High Hills
author: Addicting Games
description: High Hills is a racing game. Move fast and move often. In High Hills, you're a 4x4 jeep trecking their way across the northwest. Hop in and slam on the accelerator as you navigate the hills and valleys of this sprawling racing game. Collect coins in order to buy upgrades for your offroader so you can fully optimize your ability to trek and explore. Tame the wild with the sheer will power of your steely nerved determination as you jump, swerve, and flip your way to victory. Earn extra points by flipping, spinning and jamming your way into the future. You may be stuck behind the wheel of a 4x4 but that doesn't mean you can't explore the world.

name: High School Cheerleader
author: Addicting Games
description: High School Cheerleader is a free dancing game. Want to make the squad? Show us what you've got! Give me an A! Give me a G! And take it on the road: now on iPhone and iPod Touch!

name: High School Tower Defense
author: Addicting Games
description: Marvin and the nerds have a cunning plan! They have stolen the precious and constructed an elaborate trap. Why? To eliminate their natural enemies, the jocks! Rearrange furniture in a devious manner to slow jock creeps. Then employ nerd tower powers, like Smelly Nerd and Love Nerd!

name: Highwayman
author: Addicting Games
description: Attack the drivers and steal all the gold they carry. Use the gold you steal to upgrade your abilities, purchase helpers, and keep going further and further. Be careful not to fight opponents that are stronger than you. Have fun looting!

name: Hollywood Rising Star
author: Addicting Games
description: You just got to LA with big plans to be a big star. Slasher films? Romantic comedies? Action movies? You will audition for every role you can think of. Dressing the part is the key to landing that role! Change your clothing, your hair and your makeup to suit the audition. (Green is good for zombie movies) Pay your agent for some pro tips. Nail the audition, win the role, and earn more cash to expand your costume wardrobe. Put your unique spin on a role and get more star power. Dress the part at the audition to win the role and become a Hollywood Rising Star!

name: Hollywood StyleMaker
author: Addicting Games
description: Hollywood Stylemaker is a free dressup game. The movie director is counting on you - can you play the part? Dress for each role, and impress the boss to level up!

name: Hot Dog Bush
author: Addicting Games
description: Hot Dog Bush is a free resource management game. After his precedency, George “Dubya” Bush moved on to his next great pursuit in life—selling hot dogs to hungry New Yorkers. Of course, having been president and all, that meant that business would not be slow, especially considering that old George Dubya has the tastiest dogs in all the east. In Hot Dog Bush, a fast-paced simulation/management game, you spend the days as our former president bringing hot dogs to the hungry mouths that so crave them. Drop the bun, grill the dog, slap some ketch-up on it, or other condiments, and then hand it out to a hungry patron of the dogs.

name: Huge Spider Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Huge Spider Solitaire is a card game but with two stacks of cards! If you love solitaire but want more of a challenge, try out the spider version. Maybe spiders aren’t your thing but do not fret! While there is a creepy name, this card game is similar to the game you love but with two decks and a few additional rules. Move around the cards to create a column with cards from King to Ace of the same suit. Complete this with all of the cards to win in this online game. Click on the deck when you run out of moves, and try to win as many games as possible. The game is not timed, but the faster you go the better your score!

name: Hungry Monster
author: Addicting Games
description: Hungry Monsters is a cute puzzle game where your objective is to feed a hungry monster! There is an adorable purple monster that is waiting to be fed in this fun matching game.  To feed the monster, there are several jewel-colored candies that you can tumble through to its mouth. Match 3 of the same colored candies to increase your score and to feed the hungry monster. However, if you want to increase your time, pay attention to what candies the purple monster is asking for and give him those as well. The purple bar next to the monster is your timer and once it runs out, the game ends. Click on the replay button to play around round in this cute matching game. select the leaderboard icon from the main menu to see if your best score landed on the leaderboard and to see where it stands against other puzzle players. Play again to rise up the leaderboards and feed the purple hungry monster in this online game.

name: Hunting Challenge
author: Addicting Games
description: Hunting Challenge is a free target practice game. Clay Pigeons are for the weak. in the real world, the toughest of the tough hunt real ducks. In Hunting Challenge, you will be locking loading and unleashing your buckshot into the skies of the great outdoors as you try to down birds. The birds move fast and fly at all kinds of weird crazy angles. You will need the speed, the accuracy, and the iron will of determined focus in order to bring down these crazy birds. As you blow through your ammo you're going to need to re-load. Don't worry we got you covered. If and when you run out of ammo just point your gun at the bottom of the screen and fire to load. Then lock load, and let go as you blast off into the wild blue yonder. take down as many birds as you can in this devastatingly simple and classic target-practice style game. This is a fascinating game of cat and mouse, bird and gun, and bullet and sky. It is up to you to use your trigger finger to put those bullets into the sky and get those dang birds.

name: Hunting Jack At Home
author: Addicting Games
description: Jack his taken his puppy friends and made a mess of your home. You'll need to track down each and every dog in order to get things back to normal. Do it quickly enough and your score will skyrocket. Fail... and well, at least you have a bunch of adorable dogs to play with? That sounds like a great day to us.

name: Hurdle Run
author: Addicting Games
description: Hurdle Run is a free avoider game. Some people have the audacity to end their running. We are here to tell you all about a world where you never have to end your trot. This is the world of endless runners. An endless runner game is a game that never ends so long as you maintain your ability to run. That sounds easy, doesn't it? You just run and keep collecting points. But the problem, in this case, is that there are obstacles. that is right, obstacles! You're going to have to jump over these randomly placed hurdles if you wish to keep running. The sky is the limit in this game if you are able to make it all the way all of the time. You will need to run, jump, run and keep going. Become the king and or queen of the leaderboard as you dodge hurdles and run as fast as you can for as long as you can. You'll show them all as long as you can keep your feet on the ground your head in the air and all the hurdles life throws your way behind you.

name: Hury.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Hury.io is a free iogame. Run don't walk to play this unique iogame where you play as a mamma bird who is leading her hatchlings to victory by stomping out the baby-bird competition. Build your flock and strut around the farmer's yard as you dodge enemies and their babies. Power-up your team with the occasional egg upgrades that will let you build your flock and demolish the competition. You can also send off a small portion of your flock to blitz your enemies when they least expect it. Convert the followers of the opposition to be birds of your own and build your own unholy army of vicious, feathered friends. As the game goes on the arena itself will begin shrinking. You need to be aware and stay away from the edges or you will be vaporized. Use your left mouse button to cause your bird to dash at high speed. This will require energy that you can gain by eating eggs. Take control of the yard and then take control of the sky.

name: I Dont Even Know
author: Addicting Games
description: I Dont Even Know is a free puzzle game. No, I serious this times! Be the one true answer for teh winnings! Or r u 'fraid?

name: i saw her across the world
author: Addicting Games
description: The love of your life is all the way on the other side of the planet, and you'll have to find her! Oh, and she's a ZOMBIE! Play the awesome sequel to stick-figure classic i saw her standing there!

name: I Saw Her Standing There
author: Addicting Games
description: I Saw Her Standing There is a free puzzle game. Its a classic love story about a boy and a girl  who is a zombie. Cage your undead girlfriend to keep her safe and avoid the other zombies, who only have one thing on their minds: Braaaains! Yours, specifically.

name: Ice Bucket
author: Addicting Games
description: Its back with new content! Position and angle are key to achieving maximum splatter.

name: Idle Crush Factory Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Idle Crush Factory on Steam now!

 

Idle Crush Factory is a physics-based incremental idle game where you crush shapes and build an automated factory that runs at the bottom of your screen while you browse or work. Earn cash, unlock upgrades, optimize your gears, and scale your factory in a satisfying progression loop. Wishlist now!

name: Idle Gumball Machine Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Idle Gumball Machine on Steam now!

Plinko-style INCREMENTAL game. Shoot gumballs at gears and buy upgrades to make bigger and bigger numbers until you break the game! Short, sweet, relaxing, and addictive!

name: Idle Tank
author: Addicting Games
description: Idle Tank is a free idle game. Idle games are sure to blow your mind like the blast of a tank shell! We're talking about the all-new, free-to-play, action-packed idle game taking the gaming world by storm: Idle Tank! In this game, you'll take command of a mighty tank charged with blasting your way through numbered barriers that stand in your path. Each obstacle has a different number, and you'll need to shoot it enough times to reduce that number to zero. It sounds easy, right? Think again! But fear not, gamer friends, because, in Idle Tank, you're constantly upgrading your tank to make it stronger and deadlier. Want to dodge incoming fire? Upgrade your tank's speed! Want to deal more damage with each shot? Upgrade your turret! The possibilities are endless, and the power is in your hands. All you have to do is point, click, and blast.  Let's not forget about the graphics, which are as explosive and minimal as the tanks themselves! With stunning flat retro animations and vivid, colorful explosions, you'll feel like you're in the middle of a battlefield, tapping, clicking, and idly blasting your way to victory. The best part of Idle Tank is that it's free to play! That's right; you can start playing without spending a single penny. Get ready to blast through blockades, upgrade your tank, and conquer the battlefield in Idle Tank, the most explosive idle game around.

name: IGTAP: an Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find IGTAP: an Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer on Steam now!


Cookie clicker meets Celeste: Complete short platforming sections for currency, then spend it on upgrading your income, buying clones that copy your best path, or improving your movement.

NOTE: It may appear as a grey screen upon initial load. Please let it sit for a few seconds, the game WILL load!

name: Imperia Online
author: Addicting Games
description: Life and death is a brutal game of cat and mouse in the medieval world of Imperia Online! From the comfort of your favorite gaming chair, you will be able to found a village, raise an empire and maybe even conquer the world! No atomic supermen needed, only your own tactics and strategy, the elegant but determined management of resources and the cold cunning needed to win major battles. In Imperia Online you are the emperor of a developing province. Struggling with resource problems, border squabbles, and neighbors who are thirsty for conquest. It's your job to unite your people, put them to work and use them to build a glorious new empire. An empire that can go toe to toe with any other empire on the planet, perhaps even an empire that can dominate the planet and reshape it in your own twisted image!

name: Imperial Hero II
author: Addicting Games
description:
TECHNICAL NOTE - THERE APPEARS TO BE AN ISSUE WITH LOGIN ON CHROME, WE ARE WORKING WITH THE DEVELOPER TO ADDRESS THIS, PLEASE USE FIREFOX OR EDGE IN THE MEANTIME. WE APOLOGIZE FOR THE INCONVENIENCE THIS HAS CAUSED.


Imperial Hero is a free-to-play MMO RPG with action-packed turn-based combat offering you an adventure you will keep coming back to. The game is designed and built from the ground up for mobile and offers the best features you expect of the role-playing genre:

 

• Character progression and development - lots of items, skills and spells to loot, learn and master.

• Turn-based battle system.

• Expansive world - handcrafted with hundreds of quests to complete.

• Deep crafting system - variety of item types and tiers.

• PvP features - guild versus guild battles, guild castles and castle sieges.

• Free-to-play.

name: Imperial Man
author: Addicting Games
description: Invading enemies have enslaved yer peeps and stole yer gold! Yer precious gold! This will not stand! Deploy your army to free the kingdom from bad peoples.

name: Imposter.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Imposter.io is a free IOGame. You gotta smash 'em all! Sometimes all that stands between you, victory, and the chasm filled with corpses is your ability to hold tight to your wooden plank or steel pole and strike hard against the enemy. And who is the enemy in this game? Everyone! They're all out to get you, and just like in real life you'll have to swing first, swing hardest, and smash your way through legions of haters, debilitators, and toxic posers who are pretending to be your friend. Imposter.io is a game with the same skin and theme of another popular deduction game, but Imposter.io eschews the mystery-solving aspect and gets right to the fun part: the smashing. In this game, you will be able to customize your look, choose out your bat, pick a name, and take to the arena with a zest for death that can only be rivaled by your lust for lashing! In this arena game, you'll have to outwit the other opponents if you wish to survive.

name: Indecision 08: End of Year
author: Addicting Games
description: It do be the end of the year though.

name: Infantry Covert Operatives 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Take turns trying to blow each other into pieces. Do you have the skill with a bazooka to win?

name: Infectonator 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Infectonator 2 is a free strategy game. The bad news: You're a zombie. The good news: You're a highly motivated zombie. Spread the infection around the globe, attacking cities large and small, from Shanghai to San Francisco, upgrading your disgusting disease along the way.

name: Infinite Escape
author: Addicting Games
description: Infinite Escape is a free mobile game.

name: Infinity Golf
author: Addicting Games
description: Infinity Golf is a free mobile golf game. Golf is a game of physics, a game of patience, and a game of strategy. Knowing how to bring all those separate skills together will serve you well in this life and the next. Infinity Golf is a platform-based gold game where you compete against the leaderboard to get as many holes in one as possible. You will launch the ball over rivers, rocks, mountains, crevasses, and other obstacles, trying to get get it in the hole with the lowest strokes possible.

name: Inklink.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
Inklink.io is a free drawing game. Have you ever wanted to draw stick figures competitively with friends or enemies from around the globe? Well, Inklink.io knows what you dream and has delivered you exactly what you want! Inklink.io is a game where you can draw with your friends. This is a real-time game where the other players scan see what you're drawing and make guesses as you go.  Whenever you guess correctly it becomes your turn to draw, the game is that simple and that fun.
