Challenge your friends or impress the legions of strangers who haunt internet game forums. With the number of users out there you'll never find yourself without a worthy opponenet. We think that you will love Inklink.io, it's charades for the creatively inclined. Can you guess the subject of the sketch before everybody else in the room? Then, when it's your turn to draw, use your mouse to sketch an image. This new and improved version of InkLink features:

  • More word subjects
  • Redesigned lobby makes it easier to find a game
  • More game rooms
  • No mid-game advertisements

Feeling sketchy? Play today!
NOTE: InkLink is an unsupervised multiplayer game.
We cannot monitor user-created content that might overstep the bounds of good taste!

name: Interactive Buddy
author: Addicting Games
description: Interactive Buddy is a freen game that allows you to interact with a real fake friend. Poke, prod, explode and customize your interactive buddy. This isn't so much a game as it is an activity. You will grind for cash and then use that cash to customize your buddy before finally torturing them with everything from hand grenades to laser beams. Every imaginable form of fun is available in interactive buddy, you just have to pay for it. At first, you'll have to poke and prod your buddy to make money, pick him up and throw him around the screen. It's fun, you'll become addicted. In. the bottom left-hand corner of the screen there is a counter which tells you how much money you have made. Keep your eye on it and when you get to over 60$ you'll be able to upgrade and customize the look of your buddy. There are also other menus that you can interact with. These menus let you buy weapons and other gadgets you can use to mess around with your buddy.

name: Iron Order 1919
author: Addicting Games
description:
Iron order 1919 is a free MMO game. Ah, yes 1919 – “The Great War” continues. Though one must wonder, can a war really be considered great? Perhaps that is a question for the philosophers, not you and me. We are the generals and foot soldiers on the ground, it is our blood sweat, and tears that grease the engines of empire. It is our sacrifice, our will, and ultimately our victories that will turn the tides of history. Europe has been trapped in a fierce fight over dominance and a temporary armistice is giving all nations a chance to revise their strategy. Under the Iron Order, countless inventions and technological advancements lead to Mechs roaming the battlefields. Mechanical warfare is slowly taking over while soldiers become mere bystanders when massive Titans (Massive Mechs) collect their bloody harvest. It is a time of monsters and a time of nightmares. Your worst dreams of machinery run amok have come true and they are bellowing a monotonous, mechanical war cry as they stomp across the sullen wastelands.

Iron Order is your chance to make a mark on battle-torn Europe. Enter an accelerated race driving technology to levels the early 20th century has never seen. In multiplayer matches with up to 26 players, you are asked to plan your strategy wisely and lead your nation to victory!

name: It's Merlin
author: Addicting Games
description: We like Rogue-likes around here especially when one of the most famous wizards of all time are involved. No, not Gandalf or Harry Potter. It's MERLIN! Defeat waves of enemies and choose your upgrade path as you go, every run will be different. Find the best upgrades you can and good luck with the magic!

name: It's Raining Monkeys
author: Addicting Games
description: Get ready for a wild adventure in It's Raining Monkeys! Step into a whimsical world where you wield an umbrella to bounce mischievous monkeys around and tackle mind-bending puzzles. With each clever move, you'll navigate through playful challenges, using your umbrella to swing and bounce your way to success. Can you outsmart the mischievous monkeys and conquer the puzzle-filled skies? Embrace the chaos, master the art of monkey manipulation, and let the rain of fun begin!

name: Jack O Copter
author: Addicting Games
description: Jack O Copter is a free avoider game. Get up out of the graveyard and into the sky. This is an avoider game where you are a happy-go-lucky member of the undead who is using their head mounted persional dron-o-copter to fly into the ether and beyond. You'll have to avoid swinging spiked hammers, swaying platforms, and all sorts of dangerous Halloween ghouls. You'll have to learn and master the physics of this game if you want to use a simple click in order to navigate your chosen undead monster. You can customize the type of monster you want to be and fly. As the levels progress and you get closer and closer to outer space, so to will the obstacles inbcrease. They will move faster and be closer together. As the game goes on you'll have to think 2-3 moves ahead to make sure you don't box yourself in and wind up back in  the graveyard. This is also an endless runner game meaning that you don't have a health bar or hit points. One life, one hit, one chance, that is all you get. You need to optimize your journey as far as you can as you collect the floating ghost candy to become the ultimate spook-o-copter.

name: Jelly Escape - Qky Games
author: Addicting Games
description: May your quest be fruitful.

name: Jelly Math Run
author: Addicting Games
description: Jelly Math Run is a math game combined with a puzzle game! This little jelly is looking for a portal to get back home. To help them out, click towards every block until every single one disappears. Once they do, the final one with transport the jelly back through a portal. There are 36 levels to this online game and plenty of math skills to practice. If you have mastered one skill already, you can change your skill mid-game or after the next level. There different skills to choose from like decimals, geometry, algebra, and multiplication. The math skills range from preschool to the eighth grade. You must answer 5 correctly in order to unlock the next level of the puzzle game. This is a great way to break up your studying time with a fun puzzle game to play.

name: Jelly Quest Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Jelly Quest Mania is a free-match 3 game. Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant colors and dazzling gems as you embark on an enchanting journey through a kaleidoscope of fun and excitement with the all-new "Jelly Quest Mania"! Brace yourself for a match-three jewel game that's so captivating it'll make your heart skip a beat! The rules in this jelly-filled, gem-blasting extravaganza are simple and straight to the point. Slide and swap different gems on a grid, and watch the magic unfold as you match three or more of these precious gems. With each match, the jewels disappear in a burst of glittering stardust, leaving you craving more! As you master the art of gem-swapping, be prepared to unleash the power of combos! Experience the adrenaline rush as one match triggers another and another, creating a spectacular chain reaction that'll leave you gasping in awe. Set your sights on specific patterns and watch in amazement as the gems vanish, leaving behind a sense of accomplishment like no other! The allure of creating intricate shapes amidst the colorful chaos will keep you engrossed for hours on end.

name: Jelly Row
author: Addicting Games
description: Jelly Row is a free match-three game with a startling and strategic twist. Imagine a world filled with row upon row of Jiggling jelly monsters. One-eyed, two-eyed, three-eyed, covered in spikes and slime: this is the reality of Jelly Row. In Jelly Row you only have control over one singular row which you can move from left to right. All around you the monsters are multiplying and you need to slide it from here to there in order to line up three in a row before they are able to fill up the screen. You have to move fast but you also have to make sure those moves matter. If you aren't able to line the Jelly Row up with one of the columns before the column itself fills up from top to bottom, then you're going to lose the ability to manipulate that particular column. It is tragic but it is also kind of fair. The Jelly Monsters just want to hang out with their friends. In fact, maybe you're the bad guy for pushing them around and trying to make them explode into nothingness. Have you ever thought of it like that? Well, you should have. We thought of it like that.

name: Jelly Trip
author: Addicting Games
description: Jelly Trip is a puzzle game based on the colorful and wondrous jellyfish of the sea. Travel deep into the sea to find a row of beautifully colored jellyfish that are eager to return with their family. Help them out by clicking and dragging a row horizontally to match together 3 or more of the same color. While this is a casual game, there is a timer meaning you must match the right amount of jellyfish before it runs out. There are 16 levels of this matching game for you to play! No tutorial is needed for this simple game. Just click and drag to create 3 or more groups of jellyfish. When you have solved all 16 levels, head over to the high scores board to see if you made it! Challenge your friends to beat your score on this puzzle game.

name: Jelly Up
author: Addicting Games
description: Jelly Up is a free avoider game. Welcome to the bottom, square. You are a momentum powered super square that is starting at the bottom and trying to get to the top. You're like a shark. You just can't stop. All you can do is move fast and jump at the right time. Level up from one platform together as you move faster and the platforms get shorter. Each platform may or may not have the crucial wall at the end. If it doesn't, your square will automatically bounce off the platform. In order to survive, you'll have to time your jumps and your glides just right to avoid jettisoning off of the edge at light speed. The higher you go fast you'll go. Your speed increases automatically and the platforms begin to shrink. If you wish to win and compete against the real gamers out there you'll have to sharpen your skills and get clicking in this fast-paced jelly based platform jumper.

name: Jellyfish Rescue
author: Addicting Games
description: Little mermaid, do what you do best: Blast the fierce denizens of the deep with your mermaid powers! The jellyfish will thank you.

name: Jewel Bubbles 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Bubbles 3 is a free puzzle game. Hey ho, let's go. Get three in a row and watch the jewels blow. This jewel Bubbles a fast-paced three in a row style game where you must puzzle your way through a never-ending barrage of colorful jewel bubbles. In order to make the, go away you'll need to swipe and swap them one at a time to dash them. As they blow up they also change the landscape of the board and more and more jewel bubbles will pop up. Unlock cool powers and Omni-bombs which allow you to take out all the rows, columns, and blocks you want. Jewel bubbles is a minimal game with a few simple moves and an endless amount of replays. Find the patterns, slide the jewels, save the day.

name: Jewel Christmas
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Christmas is a festive matching game for Christmas lovers! This is a Christmas-themed matching game where you can match gingerbreads, Christmas bulbs, Christmas trees, and stockings. There are four modes you can play: Infinity, Action, Escape, Downfall, and Blocker. Infinity is for never-ending matching fun for those who want a more carefree game. Action is for a time-limited round with goals to reach each level. In Escape, you must match bubbled decorations to advance to the next level. In  Downfall you must get the stars from the top to the bottom. Lastly, Blocker is destroying all the decorations in the blocks by matching them. Each mode has its own scoreboard with your best score. The games with levels get harder and harder as you match along in this easy online game.

name: Jewel Christmas Story
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Christmas Story is a free Christmas Game.

name: Jewel Classic
author: Addicting Games
description: There's nothing more classic than a match-3 game. Jewel Classic is no different. Match the jewels, meet the requirements, move on to the next level. How high a score can you manage? Swipe up, down, left, right, to line up those pesky jewels, are you up to the challenge?

name: Jewel Dash
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Dash is a free match 3 game. This is a puzzle game where you must create streaks of at least 3 jewels in a row. This is a simple yet addictive online game. The puzzle game is filled with tons of colorful jewels set against a muddy, cave background. Similar to other matching games, you must connect 3 of the same colored jewels, and do it fast! In this case, you are creating any shape of three with the jewels. There are multiple levels of this online game for you to play! You can find your score, timer, and level displayed on screen for you to see.  If you take too long, the game will automatically highlights jewels that you can rotate. Submit your score and see if you placed in today’s high scores!

name: Jewel Duel
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Duel is a unique fusion between a matching jewel game and a fighting game. In this online game, you can defeat giant snakes and gigantic insects while matching jewels. At the start of the game, you can choose your preference of language. Then you can choose to play as a Marwin the wizard, Isabela the assassin, or Caldur the warrior. Each character has their own weaknesses and strengths that must be considered before you make your final choice. Go to the map, and choose which journey you want to take by clicking on the available dots. Depending on what tiles you match, you will complete a certain action that will help you in fighting against the creatures. Use the coins you earn to purchase upgrades, weapons, and abilities that can help give you an advantage.

name: Jewel Genie
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Genie is a free mobile game.

name: Jewel Legend
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Legend is a free match-three game. Some legends are born, they come into this world with everything they need to be the superstar they become. But most legends are made, forged in the fires of discipline, hammered into shape by practice, and quenched in the healing waters of experience. You can be such a legend. You can step up to the plate and knock it out of the galaxy with our new match-three game: Jewel Legend. Jewel Legend demands concentration, pattern recognition, and a quick slip of the hand if one wants to win. In this fast-paced jewel game, you'll be tasked with matching three different jewels and unlocking new and exciting levels as you go. Make judicious use of power-ups, strategize the use of the different special abilities and you'll become the ultimate Jewel Legend. The rules are simple, line up at least three of a kind jewels, do it fast, and make the connections either horizontally or vertically but never diagonally. Try and line up trinities that will cause further jewels to line up after the initial boom and you got yourself combo train going! Jump on and wave goodbye to the normies. You're a legend now.

name: Jewel Magic Xmas
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Magic X-mas is a free clicker game. You're about to learn what the magic in x-mas is all about: jewels and matching three! Jewel Magic Xmas is a fast-movie holiday-themed match-three game and it is also filled with the reason for the season. Test your ability to recognize patterns and open yourself up to the world of combos' bonus points and extended blasts of match-three play. Whether you're matching jewels, bulbs, ornaments, candy canes, cookies, or glasses of eggnog, you can be sure that Jewel Magic X-mas is the game for you. So, whether you have decided to play this jewel matching game on your desktop computer or on your mobile device you can rest assured that you'll be able to point and click, or tap and swipe your way to the top of the heap in this exciting and fast-paced game of jewels, of magic, and of x-mas.

name: Jewel Shop
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Shop is a girl game where you’re the boss of your own jewelry shop. Play as a businesswoman who is manning her own shop that sells beautiful jewelry. There gold and silver rings, earrings, and necklaces that you are selling! Each customer has their own choice in jewelry and some of them are on a time-crunch. Sometimes you run out and must order more which can lead to an angry customer. Play quickly to fulfill each request before the customer gets upset and leaves. Earn a good enough for your score within the allotted time to advance to the next level. There are 10 levels of this cute time-management game for you to play! Once you have completed all 10 levels, submit your score and check to see if you’re in the high scoreboard.

name: Jewels Of The Jungle
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewels Of The Jungle is a free puzzle game. Memory is a fickle thing. What is the past but what we make of it with our weathered memories our tattered regrets, and our wistful wanderings? Some say there is no past and that all memories are but projections of expectations and self-serving anecdotes. We are here to challenge that notion. Of course, memory can be real and can be specific.  We believe it would be silly to believe otherwise and we intend to prove it with this fun and fascinating memory game. Consider the ability to blindly match different colored and differently shaped jewels as they are splayed out before you in an uneven grid. This game will present you with a series of tiles, turned away to protect whatever is on them. You need to peak and pull at the individual tiles in order to match two at a time and make the tiles disappear. You will do this until all of the tiles are gone and then a new set of tiles takes their place. You will flip and match those tiles and so on until there are no more tiles, no more past, no more memories! Bask in the almighty here and now as you defeat the past and leave your memories behind.

name: Julias Food Truck
author: Addicting Games
description: Julias Food Truck is a free management game.

name: Jump Bunny Jump
author: Addicting Games
description: Jump Bunny Jump is a free endless-runner game. Bunnies move fast. That is the one thing we know about them and the one thing we love about them. Our entire conception of bunnies is that they move along the ground, hopping fast but remaining tethered to the Earth. But that was the bunnies of old it is 2022 and bunnies have changed they have evolved. Bunnies can now rocket themselves into the sky and beyond the stratosphere. Join this bunny as they jump their way up through the ether and to the great beyond. Collect carrots and other treasures as you rocket past obstacles like platforms, spikes, and cannonballs. You can augment your jump by navigating towards the floating trampolines scattered throughout the various levels. This is an endless style game where you will chase the horizon for as long as you can stay alive. As you collect gold and other treasures you will be able to spend them on the various upgrades of your choice that will allow you to continue to try to grasp the stratosphere. This is a game for animal lovers and for jump lovers. Basically, anyone who likes to move, jump, fly, whatever.

name: Jump Changer
author: Addicting Games
description:
Jump Changer is a free physics game. Leap into action and brace for impact as you dash from one colorful platform to the next in our latest free-mobile game. In Jump Changer, you're a cube suspended in mid-air, with a path of colorful platforms below you. Your mission is to click or tap the correct colored square on the bottom of the screen to make your cube leap to the correspondingly colored platform. But beware, dear gamer-friends, and hesitation is your most formidable foe. If you pause to ponder, the platform beneath you will vanish into thin air, and your quest shall come to a swift and unforgiving end.

As the clock ticks away and pressure mounts: How long can you keep the cube bounding through the rainbow-bricked road? Jump Changer is an endless game that pushes you to the outer limits of your abilities, and it's an opportunity to showcase your lightning-fast reflexes to the world. Compete against friends, family, and foes to prove your prowess in the art of color matching. Bragging rights are up for grabs, and legendary status awaits those who conquer the leaderboard. Rise above the rest and scrawl your username into the hallowed halls of gaming glory on our sitewide leaderboard. 

In Jump Changer ss in real life, you forge a path to greatness with every click, tap, leap, and chromatic cue. Now you can seize the moment, navigate the labyrinth with lazer like precision, and achieve immortality! Embrace the challenge that awaits. The clock is ticking, and destiny beckons. 

Are you prepared to leap into action?

name: Jump Monkey
author: Addicting Games
description: Jump Monkey is a free avoider game.  Jump into fun with this fast-moving reflex game that pits you against your own hunger. You're a skinny monkey who is trying to plump up by chowing down on cheeseburgers, cherries, bananas, and other delicious snacks. The only problem is that all of them are above your head and you're gonna have to climb up and jump as fast as you can because there is no left, no, right, and no down. While the game seems simple it will become more and more complex as time goes on. You're going to want to figure out the special abilities provided to you by each of the different foods. Once you know what they all do you can exploit their abilities to the fullest extent of your powers. Jump Monkey is a game where all you have to do is tap or click in order to make your cute little monkey buddy move in time with the momentum of the game. So, jump into the jungle and quit monkeying around in this delicious new avoider game from Addicting Games.

name: Jump With Justin
author: Addicting Games
description: Jump with Justin is an endless jumping game where your goal is to get Justin up as high as you can! Justin is an eager beaver whose dream has always been to fly. Help Justin reach his lifelong goal by launching him up deep into the lively forest. Navigate his flight by avoiding obstacles while aiming him towards coins and boosts. Use your coins to buy upgrades like coin magnets, rockets, propellers, and balloons to help Justin get higher each time. To track your progress, check the upper tab to see your current and highest score along with your wealth. Head over to the leaderboard to see how you stack up against other players. Try to buy all the upgrades and play this online game repetitively beating your own beaver-launching score each time.

name: Jumping Color
author: Addicting Games
description: Jumping Color is a free clicker game.

name: JumpIt 2: Dockyard Run
author: Addicting Games
description: Why are you running? Does it matter? You know why you're jumping: because it's an awful long fall. And even stick figures can get squished.

name: Junkyard Rampage
author: Addicting Games
description: At least you're unlikely to damage anything of importance.

name: Junon.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Junon.io is a free iogame. Welcome to the void. Deep space. The eternal vacuum. The big black nothing. You're on your spaceship and you're trying to survive. You'll need to gather resources and craft them into more than the sum of their constituent parts. Survival is key. Survival is the goal of this game. You will need to stay alive and more than that, you will need to thrive. This is a survival game with a lot of strategies. It is a real-time game where you are trying to stay alive. This is an iogame based around surviving and thriving. this is a game that will teach you to gather, craft and thrive. make repairs, grow food, and generate oxygen if you want to stay alive. Take off into the gnarly obsidian void of space, the last frontier, the absolute end. Junon.io is a free iogame that will allow you to thrive.

name: Kamikaze Rush
author: Addicting Games
description: Kamikaze Rush is a free endless racing game. There is nothing like the rush of a kamikaze charge. Whether you're dodging heaving pyramids or sliding obelisks you'll love the high-speed challenge and never-ending courses of this endless racer game. An endless racer game is a game that never ends until you die. The levels just get faster and the obstacles are harder to overcome, but the longer you play the more choice you have. As you race through the game you'll see floating blue circles. Navigate towards and through these circles and you will score cash you can use to upgrade your ride. Get a new paint job, buy a slimmer model, and even manipulate the value of your score, it is all up to you. You can either customize your ride for fun or trick it out so that it is an optimized racing machine. Either way, the fun never ends in this fast-paced, futuristic, free for all. So, strap in and take off! Kamakazi Rush is a fast-paced game where you'll either win big or die fast. Your speed determines your outcome. Just move fast and avoid the rectangles as they throb in and out of the ground.

name: Karting.lol
author: Addicting Games
description: Karting.lol is a free racing game.

name: Keyboard Breaker
author: Addicting Games
description:
Keyboard Breaker is a typing game. Flex your fingers in this lightning-fast typing game which requires skill, precision, and speed. This is an old-school type em' up where all you gotta do to win is watch the screen and hit the keys. You won't be able to hunt and peck in this game because you're going to have to keep one eye on the screen. This is a typing game that doesn't concern itself with word scores, or letter scores, or punctuation or even words. No, all of that is simple, basic, for lesser games. This game just chooses two random letters and makes you bash on the keys until its time to choose two more random letters and smash away at them. Its hard work. It's tiring, but if you can tough it out then it's really satisfying to watch your score climb and make it to the top of the heap over on our site-wide leader board.

If you aren't fulfilled enough by typing your way up the leader board then maybe you'll like this game's unique two-player mode. Go head to head with a friend, literally, as the two of you use the same keyboard to smash out letters.

name: Keymash.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
Keymash.io: The Ultimate Typing Game for Speed and Skill

Level up your typing game with Keymash.io, a modern, fully customizable and massively multiplayer typing website designed by typing enthusiasts for the ultimate typing experience. Inspired by the beloved TypeRacer, Keymash.io sets itself apart with its exceptional customizability and ultra-smooth fluid typing interface. Jump right in to a modern global multiplayer typing game, engage with typists globally that challenge your speed and accuracy. Perfect for both pros to beginners, Keymash.io is not just a game - it's a community and a tool for honing your typing skills in a fun, interactive environment.

name: Khan Wars
author: Addicting Games
description: Enter into the merciless medieval age NOW and test your skills against some of the most experienced gamers in the world! Develop and fortify your own medieval city through new buildings and strategic structures. You can choose the path of steady economic growth, ruthless raids upon enemy objects, thoughtful trading, wise diplomacy and guild team play or any mixture of those that you find convenient.

name: Khan Westward Conquest
author: Addicting Games
description: In this pixel style card game you'll go through waves of enemies while following the heart of the cards!

name: Kick Master
author: Addicting Games
description: Kick Master is a free mobile soccer game. You shoot, you score, GOAL! Soccer is the most exciting sport in the world and it unites everyone for a few weeks a year at the world cup. Train your fingers to go all the way with this soccer shooter game that lets you make the shots, get the goals, and take the adoration that goes along with it. In this game, you're forever in a penalty kick situation. You can warm up with a few shots against an open net to let you figure out the physics of the game but once you get going you'll be up against a world-class goalie who is just as eager to stop your shots as you are to take them. Within the goal, there are targets that you are supposed to try and hit. You can still score points for getting it in the net but you'll get more points for hitting the target. This game lets you keep playing basically as long as you are successful. As soon as you miss three times its game over. So, you're gonna have to make every shot count.

name: Kick Ya Chop
author: Addicting Games
description: Kick Ya Chop is a funny clicker game with ninjas! There is a ninja in the woods named Ryu and there is nothing more he likes doing than chopping trees! What better way to practice his fighting skills than fighting against nature itself. Click right and left while avoiding branches to get the best possible score on this online game. As you earn better scores, unlock these cool characters named Chuck and Sam that are both ready to take down this tree. The faster you go the more time you will have. Monitor the bar at the top to make sure you are not running out of time. Go as fast as you can without making any errors. If you hit a branch, you lose. This is the kind of game you can play again and again though. Fight against yourself and try to beat your best score every time you play this online game.

name: Kids Farm Fun
author: Addicting Games
description: Kids Farm Fun is a free puzzle game. The kid's Farm Fun is here, it is free, it is fun, and it is custom made just for you! This is a puzzle game that offers farm-fun-themed jigsaw puzzles. Doing jigsaw puzzles for free on the internet can be fun, unlike in the real world where you are often stuck cleaning up the pieces after an evening of puzzling fun.  We are proud to have you here and now to sit down and play this online version of all the cool puzzles you remember from being a kid. Click on over for some new puzzles to solve. This online jigsaw puzzle offers a variety of farm-based fun puzzle-style games. There are beautiful landscapes, majestic animals, cool farm stuff, and pictures of daily farm life. Whatever the farm or animal-themed puzzle we can assure you that it'll be cool and fun to put together. So, sit down and don't worry about anything because we can assure you that you will enjoy putting together these lovely farm-themed puzzles. Use the option settings to help you solve the puzzle with more experience. However you want to play this Kids Farm Fun, it doesn’t matter as long as you are having fun!

name: Kirka.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Kirka.io is a free iogame. Imagine a world where a game like Minecraft had prebuilt levels that were populated with other players just like you from around the world. Imagine if each and every one of these other players were armed with a blade and two different firearms. Now imagine the only thought in their brain is 'destroy.' Kirka.io is a free iogame where you enter a Minecraft-style arena and are going toe to toe, and face to face in a deathmatch-style battle royale that never ends. There are a ton of weapons, nooks and crannies, and plenty of other cool Easter eggs in all of these levels as well as different play modes. Join a team or try it as a free for all. In Kirka.io whatever you want to do is up to you. Be a sniper, be sneaky, try and use stealth or take the safety off and go full auto in a spray and pray assault on everyone else. Kirka.io really lets you figure it all out in any way you want to. Kirka.io is an original FPS game that is set in a brick-bit world where only the strong will survive.

name: Kiss Bieber
author: Addicting Games
description: Kiss Bieber is a free kissing game. See how much Bieber-action you can manage without getting caught. The best kisses are stolen kisses!

name: Kissmat 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Get it on, everywhere. In the middle of class, out in public, just don't get caught. Can you sneak your kisses and be the winner?

name: Kitten Cannon
author: Addicting Games
description: Kitten Canon is a classic physics game. Fluffy has found his way into your cannon again, that dang cat just never listens and doesn't care! The only way you can teach it a lesson is by firing that cannon into a field of bombs, spikes, springs, and other awesome obstacles! From the mind of Dan Fleming comes a game that only Dan Fleming could invent: Kitten Canon!! This is a classic launch game with a solid physics engine that allows you to accurately predict where and how fast you can launch Fluffy. Fluffy is a naughty cat so don't worry too much about their well being, it really is Fluffy's own fault for being in the cannon in the first place. Now its your chance to teach Fluffy a lesson in this fun action puzzler!

name: Kitty Cats
author: Addicting Games

name: Kize.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Kize.io is a free iogame. Gather, craft, build and destroy. In Kize.io you are a riot cop who is out of control. Lost in the wild you'll be forced to gather different kinds of resources, craft them together, build yourself a base, venture out into the arena and take on other players from around the world who are doing the same thing that you are. It is a risky arena game of strategy nd luck. You'll have to think ahead but you'll also have to be quick on your toes because no matter how much you plan, no matter how smart you build you'll never be able to see every move from every opponent. Hunt the arena for weapon upgrades and try to find grenades, ammo, different kinds of guns and shelter. Use your ax to gather resources then retreat to a secluded part of the board to build your base. Hold off the opponents or confront them head-on and tear down their buildings. You will control the area, you will control the game! This is Kize.io a rapid and ruthless top-down 2D shooter survival style game. Are you ready for it?

name: Knife Rain
author: Addicting Games
description: Knife Rain is a free cute-shooter game. Knives were made for throwing and with 'Knife Rain' that is just what you'll do. In Knife Rain, you'll pass level after level to unlock different types of items to throw. Knives, wrenches, spatulas, it never ends. Each object becomes a deadly weapon in your hands and just another tool on your journey to becoming the ultimate Knife thrower. The top of the leaderboard is waiting for you, it's calling out, it wants you to make it, you need to appease the shouts and the whines of the leader board by aiming, firing, and being as accurate as you are fast. This is a cute-shooter style game that will require you to steady your aim, and fire with rock-solid precision at the targets square and true. Some of the targets are atomic cells, some are logs of wood, and some are even cartoon-style bombs but all of them have one thing in common: they are your enemy and they are spinning endlessly into oblivion. Only you have the power to chop them open with a few well-aimed shots of your knives.

name: Knives
author: Addicting Games
description: Knives is a free mobile-clicker game. With but the click of your mouse or the tap of your finger you can become a legendary knife throwing champion. Take aim at this high-stakes game of patience, precision, and clicking as you launch one knife after the other at the spinning target in the center of the screen. Each level the skill required to accurately hit each target will grow considerably.  There will be obstacles like other daggers and prizes like apples. You need to use your precision skills s an expert knife thrower in order to accurately split every apple and avoid every knife. The life of a professional dagger thrower is not an easy one. You must overcome all of your personal issues, matters of time, an focus yourself entirely on the art of throwing daggers. You seek not riches or fame or even glory. The simple satisfaction of your blade finding its intended target is enough to keep you going. take aim and throw yourself into a good time.

name: Kour.io

author: Addicting Games
description: Your car is on some wacked out planet. It’s KRAZY all right! As far as I can tell, there’s no way to wreck the car, you just put the pedal to the medal and let ‘er roar!

name: Krew.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Krew.io is a free iogame. Yarg, matey, and welcome to the open waters. The oceans of the world are a beautiful but cruel place. Their depths hold many secrets and if you make one wrong move you might wind up a victim of the bottomless fathoms. This is where Krew.io takes place. A dangerously fun game in a dangerously fun world. You are the captain of your own private pirate ship and are tasked with the noble job of keeping your crew alive as you explore the waters and decimate any other ships out there. This is a game of daring and tactical brilliance. Will you have what it takes to devastate your opponents or will you be made to alk the plank? This is a pirate game where only the scurviest of the scurvy dogs may survive, thrive, and dominate the high seas. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise, a pirates life is the life for you, you just need to bite down and swash buckle your way through it.

name: Lady Popular
author: Addicting Games
description: Customize your own supermodel and guide her through the glamorous world of fashion! Full of mini-games, pets, boyfriends, and duels! Welcome to the world of Fashion Duels! Are you born to be popular? Do you have an amazing fashion sense? Are you destined to live the life of a superstar? Then welcome to Fashion Arena! Start from creating your own lady and walk the path of Popularity! Build your own character and win numerous duels against others along the way.

name: Las Vegas Poker
author: Addicting Games
description: Step into the glitzy world of Las Vegas Poker, where the stakes are high, and the mood is sly. Dive into a virtual casino experience filled with colorful characters, questionable bluffing tactics, and the occasional poker face. Test your skills against these poker mastermind AI opponents that will have you hoping for a royal flush. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a novice at the tables, Las Vegas Poker promises all the excitement of a night in sin city from the comfort of your desk.

name: Las Vegas Roulette

description: Vegas, baby! Gamble away!

name: Lemonade World

Bwaah! Bwaah! Bwaaaaaah. Bwaaah, bwaah, bwaah!!!!

Translation: Grow trees and harvest ice. So you can sell more lemonade! Lemonade taste sooo good! It's my new favorite thing behind chickens and plungers!!!

name: Lets Bounce
author: Addicting Games
description: Lets bounce is a free mobile game.

name: Life In The Static
author: Addicting Games
description: Life in the static is a puzzle. It is a question waiting to be answered. It is a solution waiting to be discovered and a challenge begging to be dominated. Do you have the ingenuity, the stamina, and the resolve of a thousand exploding suns all waiting to be unchained and set free from the static? The static is not your friend and it will challenge your ability to solve its puzzling nature. The challenges will get harder and more complicated as time goes on. You will be forced to overcome floating platforms, sliding bridges, disappearing blocks, and all other kinds of obstacles. The static is a harsh mistress, one that takes all as prisoners. As you attempt to escape you may find yourself asking What is life? What is static? And what would be a life in the static? The static is everywhere, the static is everything. The static is your entire existence and you'll be stuck in it forever if you want. But maybe you can escape. Maybe you can gather your will and ttest it against the growing clouds of a dead grey void as it consumes everything around it, including you. Life in the static is an exciting platform puzzle adventure where players are forced to live out the existential nightmare of living within the static between worlds if they can't find the gumption to escape. Run, jump and even double-jump to escape your fate. The exit is always on the other side of the screen, behind a wall of obstacles.

name: Lifespan Candle
author: Addicting Games
description: Lifespan Candle is a free desktop game. This game is a platformer. This game is a puzzler. This game is a combination platformer-puzzler. You are a candle, and your wick is burning bright. On each level you must get the candle to the goal and burn it down. If you take too long, then your body will melt to nothing. You'll have to navigate melting, running, jumping, and dodging to complete each level. They are all puzzles, and none of them are easy but they're all fun.

name: Lightning Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Lightning Solitaire is a free solitaire game.  Welcome to the electrically charged and cosmically powered game of solitaire played out with playing cards. Energy is a complicated thing and it always has been but this game is pretty easy. This is a solitaire style card sorting game where you'll need to find and sort the colored and numbered cards into the appropriate patterns and columns. And we all remember how much lightning loves columns! Once you are able to make the draw deck disappear you'll know that you have conquered the game completely and saved charged upon its tingly energies. This is a mission that a true citizen of the world will take on in order to restore honor to the deep blue sky and the people beneath it. You have the chance to be a hero, a warrior, a bolt of fun. Seize the day and play some cards in Lightning Solitairem a fun, free solitaire game.

name: Lightybulb Round 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Click on things to interact, but also try to drag objects around... you never know what might happen. Levels may look similar, but you'll have to solve them in many different ways... math, deciphering codes, or even just good ol' process of elimination.

name: Like a Boss
author: Addicting Games
description: Like a Boss is a racing game. In Like A Boss you need to survive the zig-zag highways of the future for as long as you possibly can. All you have to do in this nerve-tingling racing game is click, hold, and let go. Of course, if you want to be an effective driver who is able to survive you'll have to know when to click, how long to hold, and only let go at the appropriate time. This is a simple mechanism but as the roads become more dangerous and difficult to navigate, it will become trickier and trickier to hold on. This is an endless style game where the levels don't end: you do. You're here to stay alive longer than any other player and climb your way to the top of the leaderboard using your reflexes and a little luck. Do you think you have what it takes to overcome the obstacles, slalom through the tightest corners and hold on long enough to become the leader of the pack? Will you rise above an prove that you have what it takes to put pedal to the metal and swish across the finish line like a boss? Well, here is your chance to prove it.

name: Line Color
author: Addicting Games
description: Line Color is a free clicker game that has several levels for you to solve. This is an online game with simple animation where you play as a square that is going down a path against an ocean-like background. Along this path, you’ll find interesting obstacles like swinging propellers and shifting blocks. Avoid these obstacles but if you do run into them, you’ll fail the level. Get through the path and to the finish line to pass the level. Play through the levels to win more coins and unlock character skins. You can unlock different colors for your character shape but you can also change the color of the path it leaves. This is a game that requires skill and thought. Don’t just run through the path because you must carefully plan out your escape to avoid hitting an obstacle. If you lose, don’t worry too much. You get the chance to pass the level again! Click on the leaderboard icon to see where you stand against other clicker game players.

name: Line Eraser
author: Addicting Games
description: Line Eraser is a free puzzle game. First you build the line then the line disappears. Such is the nature of all line based games. Like a sand castle built along the frothing, sandy beach all your lines will slowly melt into the great sea of electro-blocks as they fall. Like traditional Tetris-style polynominal games, you will be manipulating random shapes as they fall from the top of the screen. The difference in this game is that the playing space is huge, absolutely huge. It is easily double the size of the normal Tetris and by definition that means that this game will be double the fun. That is not marketing, that is not hype, that is just math. And math doesn't lie. Just like the leaderboard doesn't lie and hey if you're good enough at this game maybe you can make it to the top of the leaderboard, that sounds like fun .

name: Link It Up
author: Addicting Games
description: Link It Up is an exciting platform game. Life is a puzzle, it is a mystery. It is a journey from point A (birth) to point B (death.) Link It Up is also a game about going from point a to point b, and yes if you fail you just might fall into the neon spikes and die. But while you're here, while you're out there running around and moving dots and lines, you're not just alive: you're living. The pungent inevitability of entropy is always all around you, can you link up the dots in order to paint yourself out of deaths corner? Even for a minute, even for a second. You can run but you can't jump. You will need your puzzle skills in order to build bridges to the future and dominate. The leaderboard is yours for the taking if you have the strength to grasp it and hold on like you've never held before. Do it if you can.

name: Linsanity
author: Addicting Games
description: Every shot Lin makes is MONEY, baby! Maximize your points by grabbing powerups as they appear on the court. Lin has Lintense moves, an unstoppable Linstrument of basketball Linfluence. How does he do it? Linfra-red vision? Lintellectual Lindependence? Linner Linspiration?

name: Litemint.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Litemint.io is a free iogame. This is a game about strategy, a game about cards, a game about healing, and a game about deckbuilding. Many of us enjoy the casual fun inherent in sitting down with our friends and playing card games. Litemint flips the script by replacing your friends with robots who you have to play cards against. Play attack cards which will deplete them of their energy, and then play cards to heal yourself. It is a riveting game of strategy, attacking, defending, and healing. In between games you will have a currency you can use to buy more cards and build up your own custom deck that will work exactly the way you want it to. This is a laser themed, future-paced version of your favorite collectible card games. If you like building a deck an then playing that deck against your opponents, you'll love this game. It is a desktop version of a classic card game. Crazy? Maybe. Fun? Sometimes. But ultimately it is a rewarding challenge that you can play for free again and again until you've built the ultimate deck to destroy your robo-opponents. Jump into the arena and prove your worth, now!

name: Little War Game
author: Addicting Games
description:
Little War Game is a browser RTS game. In this retro-styled war and kingdom building game you'll build a base, raise an army and then send them out into the wilds to do your bidding. Choose from Knights, mages, catapults, and wolves then upgrade your army as the game goes on. Raid neighboring players for resources, conquer castles and lay waste to friends and strangers alike in this miniature version of a classic, old school war games.  This fun little 8-bit style game has it all! In fact, Little War Game also has some very extensive modding tools. You can make your own maps and custom game with the Little War Game map editor. Invite your friends into the fray and prove your superiority via battle. Fight for honor, fight for justice, acquire territory and move on.

Little War Game allows you to start your own custom rooms where you can invite friends, co-workers, family members, Tinder dates, your Uber driver, basically anyone you'd want to have a friendly nostalgic battle of the wits with. New maps are added on a regular basis and players who are logged in can get season skins like holiday lights and wreaths for their castles or cute costumes for their brutal warriors.

Come for the game, stay for the war, love the little: Little War Game!

name: Little Wizard
author: Addicting Games
description: Little Wizard is a free platform game.

name: Little Big Snake
author: Addicting Games
description:
Little Big Snake is the ultimate slither style game. You may be big but it'll take more than that to survive in the dewy world of Ambrosia! Little Big Snake is a slippery game of serpentine fun. On the jungle floor, deep beneath its leafy canopy, you are forced to defend yourself from a wide variety of potential threats using only your mouse and some hard-earned upgrades. In Little Big Snake you start off as a small, wormy looking serpent that has to eat, smash, and slither its way up the food chain. If you want to thrive and not just survive, you'll have to swallow nectar, kill Jujas --the jungles resident pest-- and eat all manner of disgusting insects. But beware! For Little Big Snake is a Massive Multiplayer Online game and that means you won't be the only snake looking to climb up the leader board.

The MMO aspect of Little Big Snake means that the jungle is an arena and you'll be pitted against other players who are hungry for the same evolution as you. If you want to win you'll have to be sneaky! Never attack an opposing snake head-on, this will certainly end in your death. The way you kill other snakes is by tricking them into smashing into you or surrounding them and strangling them to death within a swirling vortex of your own scaled body. Each opposing snake you kill will leave a trail of nectar which will help you grow. The larger you grow and the more enemies you kill, the higher your reward in coins. You can use your coins between levels to upgrade various aspects of your snake. Everything from your speed, agility, and even your creepy skin. Little Big Snake is an addictive snake game that pits you and your creepy crawler against an army of players from all over the world. If you think you're ready for the challenge then why not jump on in and sneak around? Welcome to the pit! Game Instructions: Use your mouse to control your snake. Avoid hitting other snakes head-on, this will kill you. Surround snakes and the creepy crawlers of the forest i

name: Lordz2.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Lordz2.io is the long awaited answer to the age old question: What is better than being a Lordz? Being a Lordz 2! This is the sequel to everyone's favorite io game of domination and decimation.  Name your tribe and start off in the middle of nowhere. Use your wits to mine for resources and build yourself a mighty castle, but beware! There are villains out there, opposing players who share the same open world like you! This is an iogame after all, and that means you'll be facing off against the sinister machinations of other gamers from around the world who want the same thing as you: total domination of the leader board. They'll do it the same way you would, by building a tower, defending it, upgrading their army and raiding until there is no one left. The only way to win Lordz2 is to outsmart the other opponents, out think them, and out maneuver them at every single turn. This is a fantasy game of violent attrition where there can truly be only one Lordz2.io and if you are smart enough, fast enough, blessed by the fates and lucky enough, that Lordz2.ioo might just be you!!!

name: Lost Island 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Lost Land 2 is a bubble shooter game that has several levels for you to play! Explore through these mysterious islands full of unknown creatures and eerie forest. Through the fog, you will find a bubble shooter game with multiple levels. Aim and shoot the cannon at the wandering snake as you stop it before it reaches the end. Aim bubbles of the color to create a 3 matching set which will cause the bubbles to disappear and shorten the devious snake. Be careful of obstacles in your way that will cause bubbles to bounce off and attach to the wrong part of the snake. If you need a different colored bubble, click on the cannon to see your options. Don’t take too long because the snake will continue to move along the path to try to defeat you in this online game. Finish all 20 levels in this fun bubble shooter game!

name: Lost Island 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Lost Island 3 is a bubble shooter game. Travel through this mysterious island that is home to an ominous bubble snake. Your objective is to keep the bubble snake from reaching its destination. To do this, use the bubble cannons to aim at shoot at the snake’s body. Create groups of 3 or more bubbles of the same color to make them disappear. There are obstacles that may prevent you from getting a clear shot so wait patiently but strike quickly when the coast is clear. When you split up the snake, it will slowly reconnect giving you a chance to aim at more parts of its bubbly body. There are 20 levels for you to play in this online game. Submit your score at the end of the game to see how well you did compare to other bubble shooter players. Play this game on mobile or your computer.

name: Lost Island Level Pack
author: Addicting Games
description: Lost Level Island Pack is a bubble shooter game with a jungle theme. Dare to walk into this lost island through the mysterious forest to find a snake made of bubbles. No matter what you cannot let this bubble snake escape into the ancient architecture. The objective of this game is to get rid of all the bubbles by matching them in groups of 3 or more. There are 20 levels to this online game. With each level, you get a different set of bubbles that you must destroy. There are obstacles in the way that will cause your bubbles to bounce off and miss their shot. Wait patiently for the bubble snake to slither by until you have a clear shot. Once the moment is right, do not hesitate to take your shot before the bubble snake reaches its goal. Submit your score at the end of the game to see how well you did compare to other players!

name: Love Chef
author: Addicting Games
description: Prepare a really romantic dinner - many options to charm your date. Can you find love through food?

name: Lucky Charms Mixed-Up!
author: Addicting Games
description: The Charms lost their colors! Help them by jumping through obstacles, but make sure you jump when the color matches.

name: Ludo Legend
author: Addicting Games
description: Ludo Legend is a free puzzle game.

name: Lurkers.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Lurkers.io is a free IOgame.

name: Mad Dash
author: Addicting Games
description: Mad Dash is a free puzzle platform game.  You are a minotaur trapped in one of the last mazes in the galaxy: a maze of levels. You'll have to jump and dash over treacherous obstacles and challenges to make it through this maze. Many of the platforms are too far apart for you to make it with a simple jump. That is why the mad dash was created. The mad dash happens when players need to jump over spikes or a crevasse that their normal jump wouldn't traverse.

name: Madburger 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Madburger 3 is a free management game. It's that Wild West tradition of making hamburgers and seeing how far you can throw them. Never tried it? Well, now's your chance.

name: Mafia Poker
author: Addicting Games
description: No description available.

name: Magic Divider
author: Addicting Games
description: Magic Divider is a free educational game.

name: Magic Pen
author: Addicting Games
description: Move the red ball to the flag. But how? Draw shapes, pin them down, push them - all with your Magic Pen!

name: Mahjong 3 Dimensions
author: Addicting Games
description: Mahjong 3 Dimensions is the 3D version of your favorite mahjong game. Instead of a flat layout of mahjong tiles, this online game lets you select blocks from different sides. Each layout is unique and can be turned around to find more matching possibilities. The blocks are decorated in caveman-themed icons! You will find slabs of meat, fire torches, arrowheads, and other items from archaic times. There are 24 levels of this fun puzzle game. Each level is timed so think quickly and find the matching pairs as fast as you can. If you run out of time, you lose and not be able to advance to the next level. When you finish all 24 puzzles, submit your score to see if you have made it to the top of the list.

name: Mahjong 3D Time
author: Addicting Games
description: Mahjong 3D Time is a puzzle game with a 3D twist!. While your average mahjong game is on a flat surface with traditional Chinese symbols, this game is a little bit different. This online game has  3-dimensional features to give you more of a challenge. Instead of Chinese symbols, this game uses cute icons with bold colors. You can find cubes with trees, hearts, flowers, and even stars. There are 50 levels of this game for you to tackle and solve! While this is a casual game, each level is timed and has its own pattern for you to conquer. Submit your score to see if you are one of the top players for this online game!

name: Mahjong Battle
author: Addicting Games
description: Mahjong Battle is a puzzle game where you play against a computer bot. Instead of playing peacefully on your own like other mahjong games, this online version requires you to play against an opponent. Play quickly but efficiently. To gain a better score, match open tiles with higher values. Your objective is to get the most points at the end of the game and to pass the level. To keep track of your score, you will find this and the level in the right-hand panel. There are 3 levels of this puzzle game for you to defeat. At the end of each game, submit your score to see if you were good enough to land on the top players’ list. If you lose the level, you will have to start all over again.

name: Mahjong Black and White
author: Addicting Games
description: Mahjong Black and White is a classic game of strategy, skill, and luck. In Mahjong: Black and White you'll be tasked with the goal of defeating an AI in the kind of brain-burning combat that they are most qualified to win. Make connections, foresee patterns, manage your hand, and slowly deplete the rows of tiles in order to claim ultimate victory. A true Mahjong player is able to balance situational tactics and ascertain the terrain of a game as well as think long term and employ a strategy which will help you collect tiles without painting yourself into a corner or handing victory to your opponent. There is a reason this game has been played by kings, generals, and arm-chair strategists for years: it is an elegant system which rewards planning and quick thinking. So, play now and work your way up the leaderboard. Just maybe you'll be able to leave your name among histories finest generals and greatest minds as the person who conquered Mahjong. Why not? It's worth a shot.

name: Mahjong Card Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Mahjong Card Solitaire is a combination of mahjong and solitaire! This online game is a unique take on the classic mahjong game. Instead of traditional mahjong tiles, this online game uses the standard solitaire card. Not only must you match the number but you need to also match the suit. You cannot match numbers only if they are of different suits. There are 10 levels of this mahjong game for you to solve! Each level is timed, so match all of the tiles to be able to unlock the next level. If you don’t make it on time, you will have to start over!  If you get stuck, look at your available options on the upper right panel. You can take a hint, shuffle, or undo the last move. Submit your final score to the leaderboards to see where you rank against other puzzle players.

name: Mahjong Classic Famobi
author: Addicting Games
description: Mahjong Classic is a free mahjong game.

name: Mahjong Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: It's a whole lotta mahjong!

name: Mahjong Wizard
author: Addicting Games
description: Match the tiles to win the game with the help of a wizard.

name: Mahjongg
author: Addicting Games
description: Mahjongg is a classic game of pattern recognition. Put your matching skills and strategic know-how to the test in this classic Chinese tile game. In Mahjongg, 144 tiles are placed face-up on the board, and it’s up to you to clear the board by removing pairs of matching tiles. While being easy to explain, and technically easy to play, Mahjongg isn’t quite a walk in the park. You only win if you clear the board. Run out of moves while there are still tiles to be played, and you lose.

name: Mahjongg Neon
author: Addicting Games
description: No description available.

name: Make Me Over
author: Addicting Games
description: Make Me Over is a free dressup game. Do you have taste? Dress your models and see if your outfits pass the test. Try not to clash!

name: Mana Blade
author: Addicting Games
description: Mana Blade is a 3D MMORPG in which you fight demons to protect the world. Pick a class, customize your character, and team up with friends to complete missions together.

name: Marbles Garden
author: Addicting Games
description: Marbles Garden is a free tower defense game.

name: Marilyn Monroe DressUp
author: Addicting Games
description: Oh, Marilyn. The same dress over and over. You're due for a makeover, girlfriend!

name: Mars Tomorrow
author: Addicting Games
description: The year is 2100 and our world is dead. The ravages of war, climate change, pollution, and neglect have all conspired to leave Earth a brittle and broken shell of its former self. But you have a vision. You can see farther than the end of your nose. You know that there is another way, another path: Mars. Assemble your team, build your rockets and blast off! Mars Tomorrow is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game where you are in charge of terraforming Mars. Will your team be the one to finally crack the code and colonize the red planet? You'll have to manage your resources, make strategic purchases and keep yourself guarded as you mine resources and take over territory on Earths bright red cousin. Hope you're not scared of heights because Mars is pretty high and you're gonna be over the moon when you play this game!

name: Match 3 Rabbits
author: Addicting Games
description: Match 3 Rabbits is a puzzle game that is full of cute rabbits! These bunnies need a little bit of help getting organized and getting out of these columns. Click and hold on the rabbit you want to grab as you try to match 3, horizontally or vertically, to help the rabbits disappear. Bunnies in cages cannot be grabbed but they can be matched. You are not obligated to grab the bunny on top and can reach your hand down to grab a different one below. Each level has a goal that you must reach which you can find in the lower righthand corner. You only get a certain amount of lives per each level as indicated by the carrots in the upper righthand panel. There are 10 levels for you to pass in this online game! Grab a bunny and get to matchin’!

name: Match 4
author: Addicting Games
description: Match 4 is a free mobile number game.

name: Match 3 Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Match Mania 3 is a fun and cute matching game that you can play from any device. Play on your computer or your mobile device, this game was made for them all. Pick up this casual game with colorful and bold blocks decorated with shapes like stars, diamonds, and pentagons. The cute yet simple animation makes for a fun matching game to play. Your objective is to create rows or columns of 3 or more blocks of the same color. Every game is timed so match the blocks quickly! Once you do a match, the blocks will disappear and you will get new blocks. For every game, your main competition should be yourself. Challenge yourself to beat your best score every time! As you become a better player, you will also rise up the leaderboards beating out all the other competition. What are you waiting for? Pick up this cute matching game and start playing!

name: Math And Snacks
author: Addicting Games
description: Math And Snacks is a free math game.

name: Math Commander
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Commander is a free educational game. Uh Oh, someone is trying to sink your battleship! Call the army, call the navy, call Rhiana, call whoever it takes to save the day and win the game. Math Commander is a game of skill and a game of guesses. You'll hide your fleet and then your AI opponent will take potshots at you as you try desperately to sink their ships first. Inbetween each volley you'll be tasked with answering math questions of your choice. You may choose the grade level and skill type as you go. This is a fun game for people who love math, love battles, and love ships! If you've ever dreamed of using letters and numbers in an effort to triangulate where an enemy might be hiding then this is absolutely the game for you. Get playing and have fun in this math-themed game of naval conquest.

name: Math Dash Ninja
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Dash Ninja is a free dash game. Remember that math is an ancient art which is also an ancient science. When the power of math is combined with the power of free games you get a true synthesis of fun and entertainment: we call it funtertainment. Math Dash Ninja is a math game where players are forced to answer math questions in order to activate their fun ninja friend as he runs, dodges, and jumps his way through an obstacle course filled with lasers, bombs, bottomless pits, spikes, and other cool but totally dangerous threats. Your ninja's ability to survive this run will be dependent upon your ability to correctly answer the math questions at the bottom of the screen. This game will both challenge your math skills as well as help you build them. Choose which grade level and skill type you'd like to work on and then enter the arena as a Ninja superstar who is ambitious and ready to take on the world. This game is a fun and exciting way to practice your ninja skills, your math skills, and your gaming skills. We are happy to provide this service to you.

name: Math Defender
author: Addicting Games
description:
Math Defender is a free math game.

Follow the pattern, remember the pattern, and repeat the pattern. The pattern is a dance you do to win and stay alive. Using your math skills is how you will save yourself by avoiding obstacles and staying on track until you make it to the end of the level and collect your points. This game requires deep concentration and a steadfast dedication to recognizing and following patterns. You will follow a set of blinking lights to navigate your spaceship through a field of space rocks and space-fighters. Repeat the pattern as it was played for you, take control of the ship and avoid incoming hostiles. Attention to detail and pattern recognition is absolutely paramount to victory. You cannot win if you do not follow along or click when you're supposed to then you run the risk of failure and failure in this game can mean only one thing: defeat! Defeat means no top score on the leader-board, it means no second chance, it means death. But don't worry this game is free, it is fun and you can play it over and over again until you get the hang of it.

name: Math Friends
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Friends is a free Math Game.

name: Math Hunter
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Hunter is an educational game mixed with an action matching game. Dragons have taken over the village and it is your job to capture them. However, you only capture them in matching groups. Use your finger or mouse to draw a line matching the same color and kind of dragon. The more you can match the better your score. You will see dragons of all different colors and shapes. Some are big and slow, and others small and fast. You will have lots of fun capturing the dragons as a break in between your math sessions. For the math portion, you can practice all kinds of math skills like counting, decimals, division, and even geometry! This is a great way to balance out both your gaming skills and your math skills! So check out this math game for your math skill needs.

name: Math Invasion
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Invasion is an educational game designed to help students practice their math skills without getting bored. Math homework can sometimes be tedious, but practice makes perfect. What better way to study than by making it a fun adventure. This online game encourages you to solve math problems quickly in order to stop an alien invasion. It is your job to protect your planet as big, green, and ugly aliens are coming towards your planet to take it over. Answer the math problem correctly to shoot them down. Answer them incorrectly, and the alien gets close to destroying your planet. Look to the upper-righthand corner to see how many aliens you must defeat, and how many lives you have left. Destroy all the aliens before losing all of your lives!

name: Math Monsters
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Monsters is a fun math game for you to play! This monster loves to eat junk food, and he is super hungry! Ted, Sandy, Bill, and Gary are the monsters available for you to play. They are hungry for candy, popsicles, and delicious cupcakes. However, people keep tossing shoes at them that are gross! Even monsters have standards! Avoid shoes as much as you can to level up and get the highest score possible. Once you play a level, it is time for math practice. Choose from various grades and subjects available for you to practice. Practice your geometry, decimals, multiplication, and fractions while enjoying a fun break in between. You can change your skill during the game if you already mastered the one you were practicing before.

name: Math Pop
author: Addicting Games
description:
Math Pop is a free math game.

This is a math game that is both fun and educational! Sharpen your math skills whilst enjoying a dangerous yet interesting matching game. This online game is all about the sweet and brightly colored candy pops which haunt the dreams of even the sweetest teeth out there. You are here to match upwards of three different candy pops. The three different candies must be adjacent either in a row, column, or group. They cannot be matched diagonally though. With every match-3 you will gain more time. Keep matching until there are no more and get the highest score you can every time you play. When you run out of time, you will get your final score. Then you will have to answer another set of math questions correctly to unlock another game session. This is a great way of breaking up your studying sessions without overwhelming yourself.

name: Math Rocket
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Rocket is a math game combined with a vertical flight game. Fly through space in this cute rocket ship that is trying to get as far away as it can. There are many obstacles in the way like satellites, meteor showers, and other debris in the vast sky. Hit something in outer space and you lose one life. Your objective is to reach as far as you can while also collecting stars along the way. On top of this fun vertical flight game, you get to practice your math skills. In between each gaming session, you will be asked to solve 5 math questions correctly. There are grades available from Preschool to the 8th grade, and different skills available for each grade. There are math skills as simple as addition and subtraction but also topics about geometry and algebra. Study in a way that makes learning fun with this math game!

name: Math Rush
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Rush is a free math game. This is a classic game of adding, subtracting, or whatever skill you want to practice.  Math is a complicated process by which we navigate the fascinating world of numbers. Numbers, how do they work? You may have asked yourself that question before and now is the time to answer it. In Math Rush, you are responsible for organizing and optimizing a warehouse. It is up to you to observe and categorize a variety of different gears into their matching boxes and then ship them off. Your score, your reputation, your very life itself hinges and hangs entirely on your ability to put things in the appropriate boxes and get those boxes to slide down the conveyor belt all while doing different math questions. As the game goes on you'll be organizing and sorting more than one box at a time, anywhere up to three or even four boxes sorting up to five different shapes with everything changing all of the time. This is a good game to learn and practice valuble math skills. Whether its picture of the shape on the box, the lane the box is in, or the speed of the parts as they roll out, you can be assured that the only constant in this game is changing, and speed, and the fact that you work in a factory because the screen is that of a factory and it never changes.

name: Math Slither
author: Addicting Games
description:
Math Slither is a free slither-style game. You've slithered, smashed, and hissed your way through all kinds of snake inspired games but this is another level of nake style fun. This isn't your grandmas slither, this is Math Slither. Take all of the slitherings around, avoiding other snakes, and gobbling up glowing spheres of energy that you love from other slither games and combine them all with math. All kinds of math! This is a mission-based version of Slither. But this isn't a fetch mission, a pick-up and deliver, protect, or destroy based mission. No, this is all about the equations.

At the top of your screen, you'll be given a simple equation. Your job is to figure out the answer and then slither around the map until you see the appropriate number and gobble it up. All the other rules of classic slither games apply. You can't bump into other snakes, you use up your energy as you boost and you need to replenish your energy and to grow. But, the important thing here, the thing we really don't want you to forget about is the math. Add math to your favorite style of iogame and now it's a whole new game. We did it and now you're playing it.

name: Math Smash: Animal Rescue
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Smash: Animal Rescue is a math game with a heroic adventure! These animals need a hero, and you are just the math whiz they need to save them. These dogs and cats have been naughty and climbed all the way to the top of these blocks. The blocks are falling down, and you must do your best to save them. Solve the math questions as quickly as you can to knock out some of the blocks before the animals fall off and hurt themselves! You will find the answer to your question among one of the blocks. Select one that is directly underneath the animal to help bring them down faster.  Earn coins along the way as you practice your math skills while also rescuing these adorable animals! There are various math skills you can select that range from preschool to the eighth grade. This math game offers decimals, addition, multiplication, geometry, and number properties.

name: Math Space Miner
author: Addicting Games
description: No description available.

name: Math Stacker
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Stacker is an action game combined with math! There is no need to choose between games and studying math. You can do both at the same time. Math Stacker lets you practice math skills in between fun sessions of a stacking game. With the stacking game, colorful blocks with funny facial expressions fall from the sky. When you see a group of 3 or more blocks with the same color, then click on them to make them disappear. Ideally, you want to prevent the blocks from stacking too high or you lose the game. The more blocks you match the better your score. After you play a session, you can solve some math skills to unlock the next game session. There are several skills to practice like fractions, multiplication, addition, division, and decimals. Answer 5 correctly to get to the next game!

name: Math Sweep
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Sweep is a free math game. Welcome to the dungeon, it's a fun new game. We got everything you want and hope you survive your stay. Load up on math skills and bring your friends, this game is the party that never ends. Math Sweep is a dungeon dive-style game where you go down into the depths of a dark dungeon and search room by room and corridor by corridor until you find treasure, keys, encounters, power-ups, and eventually a way out. Use long-term strategy and short-term tactics to wiggle your way through this dungeon, stay alive, slay the dragon, and save the girl. Math Sweep is a fun game where you will take on level after level of puzzling, mysterious dungeons filled with creepy crawlers. Your job is to hack and slash your way through the legions of villains and prevail on the other side of the game. Can you do it? Maybe. But it will take time and it will take skill, so, get ready to grind your way to the exit in this deliberately fun and over-the-top dungeon puzzle: Math Sweep.

name: Math VS Monsters
author: Addicting Games
description: Math VS Monsters is a free math game.

name: Maverick
author: Addicting Games
description: Think you're a maverick? This guy's been rocking it Western-style since the early 80s or something! Transport yourself through dangerous levels using only your fabulous six shooters! Bang Bang!

name: Max Dirt Bike
author: Addicting Games
description: Max Dirt Bike is the ultimate balance game. All you're going to need to remember if you wanna succeed in the fast-paced, highly competitive world of internet dirt biking is this: rev, charge, balance & brake. There isn't a hill you can't climb, a slope you can't overcome or a valley you won't dominate if you master the art of revving up, balancing on the brink, charging the hills and braking when the situation requires it. Max Dirt Bike is a smart physics action game that puts your dexterity and puzzle muscles to the test. If you want to end each level by fading into the darkness and disappearing to thee great leaderboard in the sky, then this is the. game you've been waiting for. The first, best, and most played dirt bike game with such a cool background!

name: Meal or No Meal?
author: Addicting Games
description: The classic game show, Meal or No Meal?

name: Medieval Castle Hidden Pieces
author: Addicting Games
description: Medieval Castle Hidden Pieces is a hidden object game for you to play!. This online game uses backgrounds of mysterious castles that have long been abandoned. You will find portraits, vases, jewelry, and other remains of these ancient castles. Instead of finding whole pieces like other hidden object games, this game presents an extra challenge by having you find broken pieces of an item.
