There are 10 levels of this hidden object game for you to conquer! There is no time to waste with the clock ticking! Find all the items within the allotted time and without making any mistakes. If you cannot complete it on time,  you will not advance to the next level.

name: Medieval Defense Z
author: Addicting Games
description: Unlock the King's powers to defeat hordes of zombies!

name: Meow Meow DressUp
author: Addicting Games
description: Cats are adorable. But they can be MORE adorable! Fortunately, these are much easier to dress than real-life kitties.

name: Merc Zone
author: Addicting Games
description: Merc Zone is a free iogame. Lock and load and lets go, solder. Merc Zone drops you into the heat of the action, the heart of the conflict, the real deal. You are an assassin, a vet, and a skilled operator but do you have what it takes to rally your different skills and turn them into victory at the hands of a dozen other players? Merc Zone is an arena fighting game where you'll be up against other players from around the world. Collect weapons, gain items, and learn how to crouch, snipe, and charge your way through ruthless opposition. All the world is an arena game and all of us are merely gamers, playing our way to the top of the hill as we fire, retreat, and hope to be the last one standing. You'll need skill, luck, and a lot of willpower if you want to overcome the opposition forces in this game. It is a true battle of the wills. Only the strongest will survive and if you play long enough and sharpen your skills enough you might just be the one to come out on top.

name: Mercurial Story
author: Addicting Games
description: Mercurial Story is a free physics platformer game. Mercurial is the name and physics in the game. In this puzzling world of upside-down platforms, wacky gravity, and spikey pits you'll be forced to test your skills, your luck, and your wits against the physics of the game itself. In this world, everything is changing all of the time and you can't be too sure of what side is up, what side is down, and who you even are as you run, jump, dodge, and flip the switches needed to fix the very gravity itself. Mercurial Story is a puzzle platform game where very laws of gravity themselves are always suspect and up for interrogation. Each level features bottomless pits, never-ending skies, and spikes everywhere that you'll have to successfully navigate if you want to make it to the end of the game. This game also tells a story so if you wanna see how it all turns out for your hero and fits together in the end then you're gonna have to sit down, sharpen your skills, and grit your teeth as you run, jump, dodge, and flip the switch on the very laws of nature themself! Welcome to Mercurial Story, it's a fun game: we hope you survive the experience.

name: Merge 2048
author: Addicting Games
description: Merge 2048 is an addictive puzzle game where you combine matching numbered blocks to reach higher values and aim for the elusive 2048 block. Play in Classic or Shape Mode, plan your moves to avoid filling the container, and use TNT blocks to clear space. With clean visuals, smooth controls, and score tracking, it’s perfect for quick sessions or long strategic runs—easy to pick up, hard to master.

name: Merge Combo
author: Addicting Games
description: Immerse yourself in this captivating merge puzzle game! Combine matching blocks to score points and trigger epic combos. The more blocks you merge, the bigger the numbers and combos grow! Test your strategy and aim for the highest score—how large a number can you create?

name: Merge Jewels
author: Addicting Games
description: Merge Jewels is a free puzzle game. In this strategic clicker game, you will be tasked with the fun job of seeking out and finding like jewels and then positioning them next to each other before merging them. You will be constantly merging all jewels and when you don't see the jewels onscreen that you would wish to merge, you will have the option to spend your time clicking on the mystery box on the side of the screen in order to open it and grab the mystery jewel to add to the spread in the play area. This is a timed game with a high score counter and if you want to make it to the top of the leaderboard you'll have to think fast and perhaps move even faster. Merge Jewels is a fun and addictive puzzle game where the speed at which you click is equal to the things which you might accomplish. Please be brave and click your way to victory as you merge disparate jewels towards victory in this fun and free puzzle clicker.

name: Merge Monsters
author: Addicting Games
description: Merge Monsters is a free mobile game.

name: Micro Tank Battle
author: Addicting Games
description: Tank Battle is a free action game where your objective is to destroy the other tank! This mobile game doesn’t give you a chance to breathe. Right away you need to come out shooting and using the environment to your advantage. As soon as the game starts, you’re suddenly in an enclosed space with only crates to hide behind. You have a limited amount of bullets that you can see in the upper tabs. You can find bullets, missiles, and other weapons through the crates as you’re fighting. Click on the trophy icon to drop down the leaderboards and see where you stand in this online cute shooter game. Don’t like playing alone? Invite your friend over to play against each other and see who has the most wins!

name: Minesweeper Classic
author: Addicting Games
description: Minesweeper Classic is a puzzle game that requires thought and strategy. This is the online version of the classic PC game. While everyone says they don’t really know how to play Minesweeper, the concept is fairly simple. The objective of the puzzle game is to find all 20 mines. Use the flag to mark all the suspicious blocks. Click on the blocks you think are free of mines though. The faster you find them, the better your score. However, if you accidentally click on a mine, you will automatically lose the entire game. However, you can always restart to play a new pattern. There are 4 levels of this online game for you to conquer. Submit your score at the end of the game to see where you rank against other minesweeper players.

name: Minesweeper Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Minesweeper Mania is a free puzzle game.

name: Mini-Golf
author: Addicting Games
description: Mini-Golf is a cute sports game based on miniature golf. Show up for your aim and shooting skills with this cute shooter game. This online game is designed with your basic golfing obstacles like a puddle of waters, hills, and sandpits. It’s a pretty and sunny day in this online game where you can go out and figure out how to shoot your golf ball. On top of getting your golf ball into the hole, you’ll see little gold stars along with the game that you’ll want to hit along the way for more points. Click on the shopping cart icon, to view other backgrounds and character skins for your ball. Use the stars you collected through the game to unlock each one. Click on the crown icon to view the leaderboards and see where you stand against other mini-golf players. There are several levels of this game for you to play until you beat them all. You only get three tries to get the ball in the hole and then you’ll be sent back to the beginning of the game. Don’t hesitate and use your aiming skills in this cute online mini-golf game.

name: Mini Putt
author: Addicting Games
description: Mini Putt is an exciting golf simulator! This is maximum golf in a mini-game! Mini Putt is the classic desktop version of everyone's favorite physics and spatial reasoning puzzler: Mini golf. You may be head honcho down on the greens, you may be the top putter at your local golf accessory store, but here on Addicting Games, you're just another player who has to prove themselves by swinging their way up the leaderboard. How many holes in one will you get? Can you outsmart the legendary windmills? Polish up your clicking finger and get ready to take on the whole internet at once with this insanely detailed and realistic approach to Americas favorite past time: Golf! Stay under par, regulate your every last muscle contraction and movement. Be in total control of your own mind, body, and soul and you just might be able to play a perfect game. Hop into a golf cart because you'll be motoring up the leader board in no time.

name: Mini Putt 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Mini Putt 3 is a free golf game. Sweetest Online Mini Golf there is! Whether alone or versus up to Four Friends, Mini Putt 3 will quickly become your favorite online Mini Putt Game!

name: Mini Shooters
author: Addicting Games
description: Mini Shooters is a free IOgame. Cute shooter games are one of the most popular game types online. Cute shooter games are all about surviving on the battlefield and fighting the enemy. Cute shooter games have become a major hit with players of all ages. With cute shooter games like Mini-Shooters, you can customize your own individual little character, from the weapons, and equipment to the way they look. All of the choices you make in your customizations will inevitably help you fight against enemies. You can also team up with other players online from around the world in order to complete missions and cream other teams. Cute shooter games are an excellent way to spend time with your online friends while sharpening your point-and-click skills like the true bad apple you really are. don't just pretend to be cool, with Mini Shooters you can actually be cool. We suggest it, we encourage it. This game will allow you to collect items as well as customize your character in almost any way you want. Nothing is not safe for work of course but it's all safe for fun.

name: Minipoly.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Minipoly.io is a free FPS game.

name: Missile Madness
author: Addicting Games
description: Missile Madness is a free clicker game. Woah, it's Missile Madness. Watch out we all love Missile Madness. When you absolutely need to take out an opposing city and all of the people in it, when you absolutely need to avoid their air force and devastate the population then you are suffering from madness. Missile Madness. This is a crazy fun game about all the cool stuff that happens in war and during the occupation. So, like just think about it. The bombers, the air force, the anti-aircraft guns. Just like all the cool stuff about the war that you love to love. And now you control it in order to just devastate the opposition. Take control and click your way to victory in this heavy-duty game of bombs and consequences. War is here and it is not pretty, it kind of sucks. Get on the right side and blast your way through the competition.

name: Mobsmash.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Are you sick of going it alone in arena after arena of MMO shooters? Ever want to try something new, something different, something where you're not alone against hundreds of players from around the world? Ever wanted to join a gang and make some waves? Then Mobsmash.io is the game for you. There is no individual gain without cooperative effort. While most MMO games focus on you the player as an individual and your struggles against opposing individuals, Mobsmash.io has a different approach. What if you weren't a man, but a leader. Around you were an army of followers who depended on you for guidance and survival? After all, left alone long enough, all any of us can really hope to do is die. There is community in numbers, there is aid in numbers and inevitably if you handle your resources properly, follow a strategy, and get lucky: there is power in numbers. And you'll need all the resources, strategy, luck and power you can get your hands on if you wanna win this one. Upgrade your mob to smash your opponents and develop strange new abilities. You can take over land, hunt for resources and build an entire civilization. But, so can your opponents. While you're hunting they're crafting. While you're crafting, they're attacking, while you're attacking, they're upgrading. While the action in Mobsmash.io starts off slow the conflict is as inevitable as it is brutal. Eventually, your legion of Elves is going to switch from killing raccoons to fighting Wizards or hunting deer to hunting Dwarves. Such is the story of nature, the story of life, and the story of death. Instructions: W,A,S,D: Move 1,2,3,4: Select Right Mouse Button: Gather Resource Left Mouse Button: Attack

name: Mobu Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Mobu on Steam now!

 

Mobile requires a controller!

Play as a monk wielding superpowers in this fast-paced arena shooter with roguelite elements. Survive waves of bouncy enemies raining from the skies as the challenge escalates. Buy upgrades and special abilities to create game-breaking builds and push back the chaos.

name: Monster Truck Soccer
author: Addicting Games
description: Monster Truck Shooter is a free sports game.

name: Moomoo.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
Moomoo.io is the ultimate in survive and thrive arena games. It also asks the ultimatae question, the one question we all live with and sturggle with: Are you playing to win or are you playing to get by? You'll find out pretty quick in this fast and fun arena style io game where your choices have consequences and those consequences are a matter of life or death. Do you want to chop down trees to get wood, do you want to smash errant rocks in order to aquire minerals? Are you going to forge weapons to take into the arena later, or build armor to protect yourself from the savage hordes? The choice is up to you but you better make it quick!  You'll be surrounded by dozens of other real life players. Not just non player characters but flesh and blood opponents who want the same thing as you, and you better believe they're optimizing their stats, sharpening their swords and looking for fresh faced newbs to decimate on their road to the top!

Just like in real life, the leaderboard does not lie. Youo can not charm your way up it, you can not lie yoour way up it, you can't be born number one and no one can give it to you. If you want to be number one you'll have to earn it. You'll have to prove your worth in battle against an army of faceless hordes just like you!

name: Mope.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Mope.io is a free arena, survival game. Welcome to the jungle where evolution rules all. Choose your animal and jump into the arena. Will you be a shrimp, a mouse, a gentle bird, or a squirrel? The choice is yours and once you make it you'll be forced to survive in a world gone mad. Mope.io is an arena game but it is also a survival and evolution game. Keep your character, strong and growing while you level up to become an even more powerful version of yourself. In this game even if you aren't the biggest brute on the bock you can team up with other smaller players in order to take swipes and bites at the tail of the big bullies. You'll be able to find hidey-hole, develop powers like poison, fly, and explore the secret biome that is beneath all of our feet. Mope.io is a game that has an instant and intuitive user interface which lets new players jump in and have fun right away but also offers deeper mechanics that reward long term players who have been around and learned more about the game. Mope.io has been around for a long time as a result of players like you learning, loving, and coming back again and again.

name: Mortgage Meltdown
author: Addicting Games
description: Mortgage Meltdown is a free tycoon game. When the housing market is in free fall, is there still an opportunity to make money? Of course! Buy properties, hold them, and sell for profit. Cuidado, my friend - this market is, um, volatile.

name: Moto-Psycho Madness
author: Addicting Games
description:
Moto-Psycho Madness is a free racing game. You like to move fast. We all like to move fast. Does it make you crazy? Does it make you a psycho? Well, it might if you like to move fast on a motorcycle. Moto-psycho madness is a sickness, it is madness spread through the smell of burnt rubber and spent diesel. Choose from four different motorbikes, gear up and roll out. Hit a ramp with your lights flashing and streak through deserts, jungles and city streets alike. The only treatment for moto-psycho madness is two wheels, a humming engine and the streak of smoke from your muffler as you rocket around downtown.

Moto-Psycho Madness is a game but it is not playing. It is a thrill ride that will launch you face-first into the visceral excitement of the high octane world of stunt racing, dirt bikes, high jumps and low levels of self-control. Let your thirst for adventure guide you to explore an open world thrill ride that will let you experience a radical change of pace. You'll blow a gasket in Moto-Psycho Madness: The hot new racing game from the makers of Desert Drift Royale.

name: Moto Rush
author: Addicting Games
description: Moto Rush is a free game. Motorcycles! Hoverboards! Monster trucks and bears! Get your tilty ride on in this monstrous game. Pull tricks, race in Timed or Challenge Mode, and see if you can survive the Ultimate Race!

name: Moto X3M
author: Addicting Games
description: Moto X3M is a free racing game. Do crazy tricks on some very goofy dirtbike tracks!

name: Motorcycle Tycoon
author: Addicting Games
description: Motorcycle Tycoon is a free racing game. Rule the moto world! Buy parts and hire mechanics; supervise their work to get your bikes built in time. Then hire riders and go to the track! Use your prize money to buy better parts and employees who don't lose their cool so fast. You know who I'm talking about.

name: Multi-Cave
author: Addicting Games
description: Multi-Cave is a free IOGame. Welcome to the cavernous depths of Multi-Cave. Multi-Cave is a free IOGame where you are going to be forced to grapple your way through the Earth and to the top of the leaderboards. Use your grappling hook to challenge very forces of gravity itself as you point, click, and launch your way through a series of labyrinth-style mazes that contain a variety of jewels that need to be collected in order to win. Invite your friends to compete and you'll be able to show them up via your skills with a grappling hook. You might think you know IOGames, and you might think you understand how races work but once you combine gravity, races, and mazes you'll find yourself pretty surprised at what comes next. Spoiler alert, it's fun. What comes next is fun. We try to pride ourselves on delivering fun, and here it comes.

name: Mushroom Farm Revolution
author: Addicting Games
description: Mushroom Farm Revolution is a free strategy game. Mushroom farming: sounds mellow. Just propogating the fungus, yo. But wait! Cute creeps want to stop my spores! Uncool! Take TD to the mycological extreme, dude!

name: My Sweet 16 Photoshoot
author: Addicting Games
description: Prom was great, but what's next? Make the cover of a magazine! Look your best...

name: MySims Agents
author: Addicting Games
description: Ready for a new MySims adventure? Prepare to battle Morcubus, the lord of the criminal underworld. Recruit other special agents to build your sleuthing dream team. Search for clues, hack computers, pick locks and solve devious puzzles. Adventure through ancient temples and ski chalets as you collect evidence and handy secret devices! Can you and your team outwit Morcubus?

name: Mystery Paradise
author: Addicting Games
description: Mystery Paradise is a puzzle game where you must match 3 or more of the same marbles. This is a game based on a tropical and mysterious paradise. Deep in this rainforest, you have found this unusual puzzle full of brightly colored marbles that you must match together. Make the colored tiles disappear by matching the marbles on top of them. Each level has its own challenges with different grids and different positioned colored backgrounds. There are 30 levels of this game for you to solve! This is a casual puzzle game but you still must beat the clock before you lose that level. If you lose, you can play it again until you solve it in time. When you beat all 30 levels of this online game, click on the high scores button from the main menu to see if your score was good enough to land there.

name: Naughty Summer Camp
author: Addicting Games
description: Naughty Summer Camp is a free escape game. Summer Camp Lesson #1: ignore the prepared schedule. This is camp, not school! Wreak havoc on your counselor. She won't remember you next summer, I'm sure...

name: Naughty Supermarket
author: Addicting Games
description: Naughty Supermarket is a free dating game. You're just a bag boy! Do you really think you can get that delightful, charming shopper to dump her boyfriend and fall for you? Only one way to find out...

name: Need Light
author: Addicting Games
description:
Need Light is a free mobile game. Prepare to embark on an electrifying adventure like no other! Introducing “Need Light” - a free mobile game that will ignite your imagination, challenge your reflexes, and spark joy in the hearts of players worldwide. Get ready to tap, drop, and plug your way to victory as you become the ultimate dangling electrical plug! In the whimsical world of Need Light, you find yourself in the shoes (or, should we say, prongs) of an intrepid electrical plug. Your mission is to tap your screen (or click that trusty mouse button on desktop) and skillfully navigate a swirling, ever-moving conveyor belt of sockets. Timing is everything, and it's up to you to drop down with pinpoint accuracy and plug yourself into those sockets as they stream by. Picture this: You're a plug; the world is your electrified oyster! With each successful connection, a surge of triumph courses through your virtual veins. You'll feel the joy of finding your place in the grand electrical symphony, completing circuits, and bringing power to the world. But beware, for the challenges you'll face along the way will test your reflexes and quick thinking. Can you adapt to the ever-increasing speed of the conveyor belt? Can you navigate the maze of moving sockets with finesse and precision?

Need Light is not just a game of skill and timing - it's a delightful experience that will brighten your day. Its vibrant, colorful visuals and playful animations create a world where mundane objects come to life, showcasing the magic that can be found in the simplest of things. Let the whimsy of the game's design and the lighthearted sound effects transport you to a realm where joy and laughter abound. This isn't just a game for the young. It's a game for the young at heart. Need Light is a mobile game that connects families, allowing parents and children to bond over shared moments of laughter and friendly competition. Who can achieve the highest score? Who can make the most dari

name: Nekra Psaria Part 2
author: Addicting Games
description: This weird puzzler might make you go insane! Escape an underground cell, only to find yourself in a spooky forest... and it just gets stranger from there.

name: Neoinvade
author: Addicting Games
description: Neoinvade is a free iogame. Tanks for coming to play this neon-colored game of arena warfare, tank battles, and endless fun. Neoninvade is a fun, free iogame where you play as a tank alone or on a team and your goal is to target, overcome, and out-gun your opponent.  Take aim at a good time and start blasting at the enemy. You'll be trying to tactically navigate yourself through an absurd arena where everything is out to get you and you can only succeed by the skin of your teeth. Use gumption, strategy, luck, and a little elbow-grease you might just be able to lead your team to victory. Whether you want to play as a general, a gunner, or as a hero this game gives you the chance you deserve. Capture the flag, devastate the enemy base, and blast your way straight to victory alone or as part of a team in this one of a kind, classic tank arena game.

name: Neon Daily Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Neon Daily Mahjong is 3 mahjong games in one! Tune in every day for a brand new puzzle to play. Every day is a different challenge. This is a daily game with 3 styles of mahjong games you can play: Mahjong Solitaire, Mahjong Connect, and Triple Mahjong. Mahjong Solitaire follows the more traditional form of mahjong. If you just want to play the classic game, this one is for you. If you want mahjong with a little twist, Mahjong Connect is a similar version but requires different rules for matching the tiles. If you want a real challenge, then check out Triple Mahjong which requires matching 3 open tiles in order to beat the game. Or play all 3 to challenge yourself and enter into our high scores list!

name: Neon Daily Sudoku
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Neon Sudoku is an online sudoku game that you can play from your phone or computer. Sudoku is always a great time killer for those of you who want to exercise your brain on a daily basis. You have 4 different modes to choose from Easy, Normal, Hard, and Expert. Play the game of the day at whatever pace you like. If you just want to unwind and not think that much or if you really want to challenge yourself, then there are different modes for you to choose from. If you need more puzzles, then click on the date and choose one from a different date.

name: Neon Hearts
author: Addicting Games
description: Neon Hearts is a card game that you can play at home! Play against your digital opponents in this online version of the classic game of Hearts. Not even these computerized opponents can beat you in a card game of Hearts. Submit your score to see where you land on the High Scores list!

name: Neon Mahjong 3D
author: Addicting Games
description: Mahjong 33D is a 3-dimensional version of the classic game of mahjong. Instead of flat tiles, you have 4 sides of the cubed pattern that you can match with each other. The blocks are set against a bright purple background to let the tiles stand out. There are two modes: timed and untimed. In the timed version, there are 40 levels for you to play! You have a short amount of time to complete the puzzle. If you don’t complete it, you lose the level and have to start over. The untimed version is the same but you can play more casually without the stress of a time limit. You still have to solve the game in order to advance to the next level though. Submit your score to see if you’re one of the high scorers of this game!

name: Neon Math
author: Addicting Games
description: Neon Math is a puzzle game that incorporates math with a sliding puzzle! For fans, of Neon Games you may recognize their signature use of neon colors set against dark backgrounds. This online game is no exception with bright green squares set against a navy blue background. Your objective in these math puzzle game is to slide all of the squares until they reach zero. In the beginning, this will be an easy concept but the game gets more difficult with every level. There will be multiple blocks to slide and you must figure which ones to slide and in which direction. There are 40 levels of this puzzle game for you to solve! Each game is timed so don’t hesitate to make a move.

name: Net Terminator
author: Addicting Games
description: Net Terminator is a free sniper game. This is a target shooting game that’s really hard to pass the first level on. I can’t imagine what the other levels will be. I couldn’t get anywhere. The only thing terminated was my self esteem.

name: Night Drivin
author: Addicting Games
description: Night Drivin is a free racing game. Some people are just passengers when it comes to life, but you? You're a driver. What do you do? You drive! And what better time to drive than at night when the sun is gone and the world is only lit by the pale light of the moon and your own razor-thin headlights. In Night Drivin' you will be taking to the streets to outrace your fast and furious friends. Life can get pretty dull and the grind of a 9-5 job can wear on almost any person --during the day. But the night time is the right time for those of you who crave the adrenalin rush that is inherent in street racing and activating your turbos as you outmaneuver your opponents. Life is a race, and if you don't know how to use your turbos and overtake everyone else then you'll be stuck spinning your wheels in obscurity as the rest of the world screams their way up the leaderboard, leaving you and all your daytime dreams in the dust.

name: Nightmare Runner
author: Addicting Games
description: Escape an endless nightmare haunted by monstrous creatures!

name: No-El
author: Addicting Games
description: No-El is a free escape game. Oh no it's time for another holiday and it's up to you to save that holiday. If you aren't able to finish your holiday-themed mission then there will not be a holiday for all of the good boys and girls of the world who have earned gifts through their behavior and general affect for the previous year. Anyway, No-El is a puzzle game where you must activate a variety of buttons in order to generate an escape door. It is a puzzle platform game in which you are armed with the ability to push a giant present on top of a button and also fire green lasers. The lasers have the tendency to stick to depress vertically aligned buttons as well as sticking to walls, thus allowing you to use them as a make-shift ledge for jumping up and out of the pit you're in. This is a puzzlingly fun game that is more fun the more puzzley it gets. If you've ever dreamed of being an elf or shooting green lasers then this is absolutely the best game possible for you.

name: Notebook Wars 2
author: Addicting Games
description: These hand-drawn airplanes should be no match for my...hand-drawn airplane. Oh snap! But dead enemies cough up gold, and gold buys better airplanes and badder guns. Lets get busy!

name: Noughts & Crosses
author: Addicting Games
description: Noughts & Crosses is the classic game that is unlocked with math questions! Play against our AI opponent as you both race to create a row. Strategy is definitely required for this kind of competitive game. For the newbies, the game is played on a 6-block grid. You are either the nought or the cross but crosses go first. The person (or robot) who plays first has the advantage. Create a row with your mark to win! Once you play a quick session, you will need to solve math questions to unlock another game. All the questions are multiple-choice. This math game has skills from preschool to the eighth grade. There are simple math skills like addition, counting, and subtraction. However, you will also find advanced math skills like decimals, multiplication, fractions, statistics, and even geometry!

name: Null Matter
author: Addicting Games
description: Null matter is a free puzzle game.

name: Number Crusher
author: Addicting Games
description: Number Crusher is an action game combined with math practice. Studying without breaks can be hard, that is why these math games were designed to give you some fun time. Help this demolition man get through all the blocks to finish the job. Breakthrough the blocks while collecting stars and gems. You must go as fast as you can to avoid getting your character pushed to the top of the screen. Once you played a game, answer math questions to practice the skills you need to work on. There are various math skills available to practice from preschool to the eighth grade. This is a great math game to help give you bursts of lessons with breaks in between.

name: Number Frenzy
author: Addicting Games
description: Number Frenzy is a free math game.

name: Number Sequencer
author: Addicting Games
description: Number Sequencer is a free puzzle game. Numbers work best when they go in sequence. Everybody knows this, we all agree that our favorite numbers exist in chronological or reverse chronological sequences. Number Sequence is a game that takes full advantage of this and optimizes the satisfaction of laying numbers out or rolling them back in a specific manner at specific points. Number Sequence is a puzzle game where you don't need to know math (ew) instead you need to know which came first, the 5 or the 6? Number Sequence forces you to place numbers one after the other in sequence in order to reach a pre-determined point. At first, this is easy but eventually, you don't even know exactly what those pre-determined points are or how the numbers in front of you all connect. That is where the puzzle aspect kicks in, that is where the thinking, the strategy, and all the fun stuff actually happens. We are happy to have you on the team, the team of sequencing numbers, the team of people who compete with each other by sequencing numbers, and ultimately the victor at the end of the game and the top of the leaderboard.

name: NumberMerge
author: Addicting Games
description: NumberMerge is a casual game that lets you eliminate numbers.  The goal is to combine larger numbers by clicking on adjacent numbers in the main game board, thereby eliminating them and combining new numbers twice as large.  When there are no more than two consecutive numbers on the board, the game ends. The overall style of the game is casual.  It features lively colors, complemented by a visual style full of beach elements, as well as background music and splashing water sound effects, creating a leisurely and immersive beach walk experience for players.  Sometimes catch a hot air balloon flying in the sky, there will be a surprise!  The gameplay is simple and fun, allowing players to enjoy a moment of relaxation in their busy lives.

name: Nyan Cat FLY!
author: Addicting Games
description: Nyan Cat FLY! is a free racing game. Ew gross, asparagus! You're a magic cat made out of Pop Tarts and rainbows, you wouldn't be caught dead eating asparagus and brussel sprouts. besides, you're a space-faring cat now. What is the point of taking to the final frontier if you're gonna be stuck eating the leafy green leftovers of Earth? Indulge in space-age cupcakes, slices of pie, and other delicious sweets. Avoid anything even remotely green or healthy as you fly at warp speed through the kittenly cosmos. You'll wanna keep your points up and the veggies down. Too many o the green things and you'll die --ew-- but you'll also wanna collect stars and other upgrades as they appear. You can do it Nyan Cat if you believe in yourself!

name: Oasis
author: Addicting Games
description: Oasis is a free platform game. Oasis is an adventure game that will let you walk through walls on your way to excitement untold. It is a platformer, it is a puzzle, it is a platformer puzzler. It is everything you have ever wanted in a free online video game. You run, jump, and slide through walls. There is literally nothing else to do in a game. This is a fun platform puzzler for those who love both platforms and puzzlers.

name: oceanbound.io
author: Addicting Games
description: oceanbound.io is a top-down online naval combat game where players command customizable ships in a vast, minimalist ocean world. Collect experience by destroying objects like crates, lilypads, and wrecks, then upgrade your ship’s individual components.

name: Odius Dot Fly
author: Addicting Games
description: Dot Fly is a free clicker game.

name: Oiligarchy
author: Addicting Games
description: Oiligraphy is a free strategic tycoon game where you run you use government resources to drill for oil. Play this interesting time-management game that relies on politics to be able to progress. Trash the environment, displace endangered animals, and take advantage of indigenous people. Do so by bribing politicians to pass legislation that benefits your business. You can also bribe the government of different regions to get rid of protestors or let you pollute their environment. This is a tycoon game that’s all about the profits and not about the people and animals you may hurt along the way. Don't feel rich enough? Then Drill, Baby, Drill!

name: Old School Hangman
author: Addicting Games
description: Old School Hangman is a free word game. We love Hangman, it is a classic game of bluffing and guessing. You must flex your ability to sus out a word based on only a few clues. If you can't do it then you will slowly manifest, piece by piece, like a corpse hanging from a noose.  Never has a trip to the gallows been more fun than with Old School Hang Man. You'll need to earn enough diamonds in order to buy a clue, but the clues themselves are increasingly vague. In the end, it will come down to the tried and true method of guessing vowels first then really common letters like R and T or like L or whatever. Only suckers guess X, Y, and z. Don't try and be cool or an edgelord by guessing these obscure barely used letters. You will not be impressing anyone. This is a game all about optimization. Just guess the vowels, use some critical thinking skills, use some deductive logic, take your time. It really isn't that hard but it is a cool challenge and honestly, it's fun. It must be fun. If it wasn't fun then people wouldn't have played the same game for like a billion years or whatever. OK, thanks for playing.

name: Operation: Desert Road
author: Addicting Games
description: Operation Desert Road is a free tank game. We all love tanks. Tanks are one of the nation's favorite past times. Whether you are driving a tank, making a tank, buying a tank, or selling a tank. We can all agree that tanks are cool. Yay tanks. In this game, you will be in control of a tank, a really cool tank, and you will be driving it towards an unknown objective in the distance. On your way, there will be other tanks, guys running around, and armor stations that will try to stop you. Your job is to smash them, to blast them, or to ignore them and just drive by. To be clear you can actually just drive right past them. But it is more fun to blast and or smash so why not do the fun things, even if it takes longer. Stop and smell the roses, blow up some bad guys it is all the same because all things are equal when you're sitting behind the controls of a tank.

name: Overlords New Mansion
author: Addicting Games
description: Overlords New Mansion is a platform puzzle game. Welcome to the Overlords New Mansion. This is a platforming game about the trials and tribulations of one lonely knight and his fairy friend making their way through the Overlords New Castle. This is a castle full of spikes, ramps, speeder platforms, and disappearing brick. As hard as it is to visit any drafty old castle, the life-threatening challenges in this game are a terrifying, death-defying assault on your senses and you'll only be able to survive with the guidance of your fairy friend and your own quick reflexes. Learn how to power jump by reading scrolls found throughout the castle. You can also learn several other tricks like how to view more of the screen than normal, power jump, and even super ttack. This is a challenging game full of obstaacles which will require you to live, die and repeat. Try to figure out the specific pattern it takes to overcome every new chaallenge. An exciting challenging game about taking on the world and leaving it behind you.

name: Paganini Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: What a complex solitaire game huh? These rules are all over the place. Completing these games will definitely give you a challenge unlike anything you've tried before.

name: Panda Tactical Sniper
author: Addicting Games
description: Keep this cute killer out of danger with your superior sniper abilities. You are an accessory to Bear Crimes!

name: Pandas Mahjong Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Pandas Mahjong Solitaire  is a free solitaire game. Panda loves it when you match tiles. And he gets bored when you dont! Play the flossiest mah jongg game around, my peoples. Charm the Panda!

name: Pandemic 2
author: Addicting Games
description:
PLEASE NOTE, YOU MUST HAVE AN ADDICTING GAMES ACCOUNT TO POST SCORES TO THE LEADERBOARD.

Pandemic 2 is a free game about the spread of a dangerous pandemic in the modern age. This is a strategy game about the danger and threat of an aggressive virus as it slowly spreads its way across the globe. By playing as the virus instead of as medics, researchers, or other members of the medical and scientific communities you will see the mechanisms by which a virus may spread. This is a casual game with simple mechanics that allow for deep meaningful choices on behalf of the player. As the game continues your objective will be to spread your virus as far, as wide, and as fat as you possibly can. As your virus evolves you'll gain experience points. With these experience points, you will be able to purchases upgrades. You can choose from a lit of different symptoms which all have their own ways of helping the virus spread. This is a casual time-management game so you’ll have to upgrade and then wait and see if your disease is progressing before your time limit. As time passes, you’ll gain evolution points which is what you can use to purchase upgrades.

name: Pang 2004
author: Addicting Games
description: You used to have to pay a quarter to play this game. Burst the bubbles as fast as you can, but don’t get hit or you’re dead. These are poisonous bubbles, I guess.

name: Papa's Cupcakeria
author: Addicting Games
description: Papa's Cupcakeria is a free management game. Ever wondered why they're called 'cupcakes'? Because 'breakfast' was already taken. Serve up sugar pies to your sweet-toothed customers in Papa's Cupcakeria and do it fast, before those sweet teeth are riddled with cavities.

name: Papa's Freezeria
author: Addicting Games
description: Papa's Freezeria is a free resource management game. Corner the soft serve market with epic desserts! Take orders from customers, mix up basic ingredients, and add toppings and sprinkles. Use your hard-earned cash to improve your menu and restaurant. Keep customers happy, and the money will keep pouring in. With sprinkles!

name: Paper Trampoline
author: Addicting Games
description:
Get ready to bounce your way to victory in Paper Trampoline!
In this sketched, paper world, your goal is simple: help the paperman get across each level by carefully placing trampolines in just the right spots. Sounds easy? Think again! As you progress, you'll face increasingly tricky obstacles, dangerous staplers and spike traps, and unique problems that challenge your problem-solving skills.

Are you ready to think outside the page and master the art of the perfect jump? Let the bouncing begin!

name: Paper Warfare
author: Addicting Games
description: Paper is the softest item in this game. Teh action is rock hard and intense, yo! Fly and blast; upgrades and destroi!

name: Paper Wars
author: Addicting Games
description: Paper Wars is a free tower defense game. When you are on the left page, you shoot right. On the right page, you shoot left. Get killed too soon? Get a second chance and partner with your ghost to finish the level. Select your upgrades and plunge back into intense robot and monster destruction fun time!

name: Parking Tight
author: Addicting Games
description: Parking Tight is a free puzzle game. In the modern world, the only thing that truly matters is space and time. Specifically, the space to park your cool vehicle and hopefully the time to do it. Sometimes in order to park properly things are going to get a little tight. Parking Tight is a spatial puzzle where you compete against a lack of space and irregularly shaped sectors in order to fit your multiple cars into the proper spaces. This is a puzzle game where there is only one specific answer for each level. In order to finish the level and move on you'll have to accurately park the cars. Finding the answer is hard and it may take a fair amount of trial and error. Timing is important because obviously being faster at something is basically the same as being better at it. So, we wish you the best of luck in this skill-based puzzle game where space is limited and time is always running out.

name: Parkour.lol
author: Addicting Games
description: Parkour.lol is a free racing game.

name: Pastry Racer
author: Addicting Games
description: Ready to hit the road? Pick a car and pilot your Pop-Tarts(r) toaster pastry to victory! Avoid hazards and grab food for speed!

name: Path Of Arrows
author: Addicting Games
description:
Path Of Arrows is a free desktop puzzle game. Path Of Arrows will transport you to a retro 8-bit wonderland, blending simplicity, strategy, and nostalgia into a captivating puzzle platformer experience that keeps you hooked for hours. Embark on an extraordinary journey through a monochromatic universe where cunning puzzles and death-defying platformer challenges await. In the grayscale realm of Path Of Arrows, you'll find yourself navigating treacherous terrains and overcoming seemingly insurmountable obstacles. Armed with only your trusty arrows and wits, you must harness the power of precision to conquer each level's intricate challenges.

In this monochrome odyssey, your strategic prowess is put to the ultimate test. Every move counts, and every arrow fired becomes a pivotal decision. To escape the clutches of perilous pits and cunning traps, you must fire your arrows at walls and leap onto them with unwavering precision. Each jump carries you closer to freedom but beware - the path is fraught with challenges that will push your skills to the limit. Path Of Arrows is a testament to the timeless allure of the 8-bit era, invoking a sense of nostalgia that will resonate with young and old players. The captivating simplicity of its black-and-white palette, combined with its retro-inspired graphics, transports you to a bygone era of gaming, where imagination and pixelated artistry reigned supreme. You'll be swept away by the charm of its classic aesthetics and indulge in the sheer joy of pixel-perfect platforming.

With each level conquered, a sense of accomplishment washes over you, fueling your desire to conquer the next perplexing puzzle that lies ahead. Step into the Path Of Arrows. Unlock the mysteries of its mesmerizing grayscale landscapes, conquer its peculiar puzzles, and immerse yourself in the joy of retro-inspired platforming. Embrace the simplicity, embrace the challenge, and let your arrows become your passport to greatness. Best of all,

name: Payroll Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Payroll on Steam now!

 

Mobile requires a controller!

The dice roguelike. Payroll is a compulsively replayable deckbuilder where you rotate dice to control luck, discover devastating combos, and trigger outrageous chain reactions to escape the loan shark.

 

Roll Dice. Rotate Your Fate. Escape the Loan Shark.

 

One forgotten parking ticket spiraled out of control.
Now a literal loan shark is after you—and he’s not taking excuses.

 

Your only hope?
A dangerous deal involving magical dice and a ticking clock.

 

🎲 CONTROL THE CHAOS

 

This isn’t a luck game—it’s about turning bad rolls into perfect plays.

 

Roll your dice, then rotate them to visible faces to shape the outcome. Dice land at angles, limiting your options. Positioning matters. Every rotation is a choice—and every choice can save or doom your run.

 

🧩 BUILD YOUR DICE, YOUR WAY

 

You don’t start powerful—you build power.
Customize your dice between rounds:
Add new faces
Create satisfying combos
Discover wild synergies
Turn scraps into momentum
Every upgrade changes how your dice behave, and every decision carries risk.

 

🦈 THE LOAN SHARK IS WATCHING

 

Clear your debts and the rules start to bend.
Special rounds introduce brutal twists:
Dice may lock up
Rotations can be restricted
Familiar strategies stop working
Adapt fast—or get eaten.

 

🔁 A TRUE ROGUELIKE FEEL

 

Every run starts fresh.
No safety nets. No guarantees. Just your choices and the dice.

 

Short, punchy runs make it dangerously easy to say: “Okay… one more.”

 

📺 RETRO PS1 AESTHETIC

name: Pencil Racer
author: Addicting Games
description: Draw it, Play it, Save it, Share it! Select awesome vehicles like ducks, tractors, tanks and pigs. Customize track behavior with stickiness and boost. Decorate your track with heavy-duty art tools!

name: Pencil Racer XL
author: Addicting Games
description: Draw it, Play it, Save it, Share it! More vehicles! New art shapes! Easier to draw, easier to share! The XL is for Excellence!

name: Penguinz
author: Addicting Games
description: Penguinz is a free shooter game. One brave penguin fights off swarms of murderous other penguins! And unlike real penguins, who are content to poke each others' eyes out with their nasty beaks, these Penguinz tote 9mms and pick axes. oh snap!

name: Perfect Piano
author: Addicting Games
description: Perfect Piano is a free typing game. Improve your typing skills and jam out to some dope piano beats in this desktop and mobile reflex base game. Perfect Piano is an easy to learn impossible to master reflex game where you must type out the notes as they fly by. The game is over if you miss even one note but the better you are the longer you will play and the higher your score will be. This game requires the perfect synthesis of hand-eye co-ordination and timing in order to perfectly tap your way through dozens of never-ending classic songs. twinkle twinkle little star is the song that starts the game and you'll be tap, tap, tapping right along as you slowly move your way up the leaderboard. Don't be discouraged by an early loss here or there, this is a game which will require focus and attention. Eventually, you will get better and take your place side by side with other musical legends in the Valhalla of our sitewide leaderboard system.

name: Pesten
author: Addicting Games
description: Pesten is a puzzle game that is the Dutch version of crazy eights. If you love playing cards and like one with a lot of rules, then this is the online game for you. Play against 3 computer bots who are out to take you for your money’s worth! Each game has 4 rounds and you are out to dominate each one or get the best out of 4. Don’t let these computer bots intimidate you! You are the best of the best! If you’re not one for plain ole’ solitaire and like more of a difficult game that Pesten is one that will entertain you. This is an online card game that is going to challenge your strategy.

name: Petz.lol
author: Addicting Games
description: Petz.lol is a free iogame. Sometimes it's just you, your fists, and an angry army of heckin' puppers who are heck-bent on devouring the living. If you want to survive you'll need more than just your wits. Collect various items, ammunition, and upgrades that will put you one notch above the rest. At first, you think you can take the pet-patrol on one at a time. But you'll quickly realize that it's never just one on one. As soon as you enter into battle the other pets will get wind and they begin to snipe at you, they begin to swirl around you and tear you apart. This is why you need to think ahead and move fast. Collect your weapons, take potshots at the pets from behind. Its never a fair fight anyway so why pretend. Get good with your weapons because you're not going to be able to punch your way out of this one. Stay frosty as you avoid any dead-end entanglements. And watch out for the catz.

name: Pharaoh Slots Casino
author: Addicting Games
description: Pharaoh Slots Casino is a free casino game. When in Rome you do as the Romans, when you are in Egypt you walk like an Egyptian, what is the connection? Slots! Everybody loves to play slots, the one-armed bandit, the game of chance that people love to lose at. In Pharaoh slots casino you play the role of someone on vacation in Las Vegas. You're trying to win by pulling the one arm and playing with a bunch of knobs and stuff on the game. Remember, slots are a game of chance so don't try to overthink your strategy here. There are no tactics and there are no real tricks and that is what slots so dang fun! You'll thrill to the adrenaline rush of pulling the lever and watching the windows roll over and turn into 3 matching pictures. That is how you get a jackpot and getting a jackpot is the whole point, its a lot of fun and many people swear by how cool it is. We agree that it is fun and think you should try it.

name: Phrasicle
author: Addicting Games
description:
Phrasicle is a daily word-chain puzzle game where you link connected words to form two-word phrases or compound words. Each row leads to a final mystery phrase — the “Phrasicle” — that you must solve at the end!

🎯 Objective

Fill in each row by finding five words that form a sequence of natural two-word phrases or compound words. Once all rows are complete, use the words you've found to solve the final Phrasicle clue.

🧩 How It Works

* -The first and last words in each row are already filled in.
* -The first letter of the next word in the chain is provided. Use clues if needed to reveal more letters.
* -Enter words into the blank spaces to form natural two-word phrases or compound words to complete the word chains. These can be phrases like chill out (“chill” + “out”) or board game (“board” + “game”) as well as compound words like sunflower (“sun” + “flower”) or paperclip (“paper” + “clip”) as seen in the example grid below.
* -You can use up to 10 clues total to reveal any 10 letters. Your tier depends on the number of clues you use so use them sparingly! If you use 0-3 clues = 🥇 Gold, 4-6 clues = 🥈 Silver, 7-10 clues = 🥉 Bronze
* If you reveal the grid you are automatically in the 🥉 bronze tier so don't give up!
* -The Phrasicle will be a common saying or turn of phrase. To solve the Phrasicle, use the words you've revealed in the grid to fill the blanks in the Phrasicle clue. For example, if your clue is "__ __ at a __" and you've revealed the words One, Step and Time in your grid, the Phrasicle could be "One Step at a Time". Submit the entire phrase in the text box to solve the Phrasicle and earn your stars!

🔍 Example Solved Grid:

name: Pick A Lock
author: Addicting Games
description: Pick A Lock is a casual online game where your objective is to pick that lock! We’re not ones to teach you how to do bad things but picking a lock can definitely have its advantages. This is an interesting brain teaser that keeps you on your toes. As soon as you hit start, the game starts fast and you barely have any time to think. Your goal is to stop the line as soon as it hits the circle. Not a moment before or after. With every level you pass, another dial turn is added in the next level. This is a precise game that might have you raging. However, once you've memorized the pattern, you’ll be able to unlock them like a champ. Check the leaderboards to see who is the faster lock picker on AddictingGames!

name: Pictile
author: Addicting Games
description: Pictile is a free puzzle game. Pictile is a super high-octane game of patterns, pictures, and pushing. Pictile will test your ability to recognize a pattern and then re-create it by pushing bricks around a grid. This is way easier than it sounds especially when you consider that it's all timed. Actually, it's not timed. There is a count down, so, it's even worse,. The game will count down as you push squares around and try to match the pattern in the upper left corner. There are different colored squares and they'll start off in chaotic disarray. Your job is to think two moves ahead, three moves ahead, maybe even four moves ahead as you struggle to re-create the pattern exactly as you see it. There is no score, there are no close calls, and you can fail. In this game there is no interpretation, there is no close enough. You either get it right or you get it wrong. Harsh but fair. Also a lot of fun. If you think you can stand the test, that you're better than the rest, or you just wanna chill out and push some squares then Pictile is the game for you.

name: Pictoid
author: Addicting Games
description: Pictoid is a free puzzle game. We hope you're prepared to enter a world of pictures, words, and the unholy synergy between the two. That synergy is you. That synergy occurs when you sit down, strap in, and decide that you will solve all of the puzzles laid out. And just what are these puzzles you might ask? well, we are glad you piped up and said something because Pictoid is one of our favorite new games and we're more than proud to talk about it and how it works. Pictoid is a word puzzle game with a unique twist. You must identify the secret picture by using the letters in the word, but the letters are limited and thus you can only truly use them one single time. Once you think you've figured out the big mystery behind the picture we simply ask that you enter your guess into the game. If you wind up being right, you get to go to the next puzzle. If you're wrong, then it's time to watch as a single life point is subtracted from your score.   Don't worry the genius brain that powers Pictoid will also keep track of your best scores so that you can try to beat it with each new round.

name: Pile Shapes
author: Addicting Games
description: Pile Shapes is a free puzzle game. As the shapes rain from the sky, it is your job to mold them into one unified shape and thus gain points. Life is a puzzle and every aspect of it is all about you finding the elements of existence that can fit together and become more than the sum of their parts. This cosmological concept is brilliantly demonstrated in this simple puzzle game. Your job will be to align the diverse spectrum of shapes into the darkened shape in the center of the screen. In this game, you are both a philosopher and a detective. You will be answering the question of the darkened shape by stuffing it full of the colorful pieces of bric-a-brac as the answer. If you consider yourself a fudge-fingered treat addict then you will be happy to know that your sweet tooth is sure to be tickled in this tantalizing game of space vs non-space, good vs less good, and blocks vs the void. This is a game for only the most powerful wizards of the puzzle form.

name: Pimp My Christmas Tree
author: Addicting Games
description: The words \"pimp\" and \"Christmas tree\" might not have been used together before, but deck the halls, baby. Add the trimmings just right and send it off as an e-card if you like.

name: Pinball Madness
author: Addicting Games
description: Pinball Madness is a free pinball game. If you consider yourself the kind of kid who plays a mean pinball then this is the online game for you! We all know what pinball is, we all love pinball, the concept behind this game is: what if we took the pinball machines of yore and digitized them and put them in our pocket. Do you think it's crazy? Well, maybe but it's also genius! Pinball Madness is a  fast flicking game of reflexes, physics, and the never-ending struggle of gravity: You can shoot that ball up 1,000 times and it will fall back down 1,000 times. The struggle is eternal like Sisyphus who forever rolls a boulder up a mountain only to have it roll back down and start all over. But much like Sisyphus rolling that boulder up and chasing it down forever until the end of time, it helps if you consider him happy, having fun, enjoying the struggle of pushing it up the mountain, the satisfaction of reaching the top, and the surprise of it rolling down. This is basically how Pinball Madness works as well, you must forever flip the flippers on the side of the screen in a vain attempt to keep the ball from falling into the bottomless pit. While the ball is bouncing around you are also trying to roll it over diamonds and stars in order to grasp bonus points.

name: Pinball Neon
author: Addicting Games
description: Pinball Neon is an arcade game with a scoreboard waiting to get your name down! There is nothing like playing the pinball machine at the arcade. Whether at the beach pier or your local miniature golf center, there seems to always be a pinball machine for you to play. It is a classic and never gets old. Pinball Neon is the online version of this game that will bring back those memories. This online game has bright colors, great animation, and easy-to-use controls. The goal of the game is to keep the ball in the pinball machine as long as possible. For each session, you only get a limited amount of lives. Play as long as you can for each round to get the best possible score.

name: Pinch Hitter 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Pinch Hitter 2 is a free sports game. Put your batting skills to the test with these baseball challenges, and work your way up all the way from the sandlot to the major leagues. Can you work your way up through the ranks of baseball wannabees all the way up to the major leagues? You start with the meager sandlot, and then work your way up through that, into the little leagues, and eventually you go straight into the major leagues. Each set of challenges for each league tasks you with completing objectives like getting two homeruns back to back and hit 10 balls without any strikes or outs. It can prove to be challenging, but as they say—timing is everything.

name: Pipe Rush
author: Addicting Games
description: Pipe Rush is a free mobile game.  You can't rush the pipe but the pipe can rush you. These are wise words from some of the elders of the Pipe Rush world. People who have played the pipe and won. You would be smart to listen to them. This is a game that will test your hand-eye reflexes and your ability to spot obstacles then quickly jump out of the way. You might just need that skill set in the real world. It is a good thing we are offering you the chance to test it out now. If you were to ever want to play this game in the real world it is on mobile and that is close enough to the real world now. In fact that is the real world now. Your reality has been warped.

name: Pirate Cards
author: Addicting Games
description: Pirate Cards is a free card game. Hello, mateys. Take a break from pillaging and sailing across the high seas and relax with this fun card-based strategy game. You'll have fun piloting your pirate around the map and trying to collect items and slay enemies hile activating canons and mines before you finally push your luck and die on the wrong end of a goblin blade. This is a card game that will require careful planning and strategic choices as well as on your feet tactical choice and every now and then, a little luck. Collect treasure in order to save up and buy upgrades later on and collect items and weapons in order to help you better fight the sea monsters and rival pirates you'll face within the game. This is a game of endurance, the longer you last the better you will do but inevitably you should also be aware: this is a game based around living and dying. You play until you die, then you pick yourself up and start over again.

name: Pirate Klondike
author: Addicting Games
description: Pirate Klondike is a free card game.

name: Pirate Shootout
author: Addicting Games
description: Pirate Shootout is a free sniper game. Beat the game and unlock Hard Mode! Take down pirates with your sniper rifle.

name: Pirates Of Islets
author: Addicting Games
description: Pirates Of Islets is a free shooting game based on the pirates of the sea! Hop on board and join Pirates Of Islets as they go on an adventure to find gold and potions. This a brightly colored online game full pirates, gold, ships, and so much more! Your character hops from wheel to wheel as you collect gold and other boosts. Be wary of any bombs or other dangerous objects that you must avoid else you lose the game. Crash through treasure chests and collect as much gold as you can. Use your gold to unlock helpful boosts, cool character skins, and backgrounds. Collect 40,000 coins to unlock all of the trophies that this online game has to offer. Get as far as you can each time, and then view your scores on the leaderboards. If you’re not where you want to be, then play again, unlock everything, and climb up the leaderboards!

name: Pixel Factory
author: Addicting Games
description: Pixel Factory is a puzzle game where your objective to memorize and draw the same pixel drawing. This is a good online game to help test your memory. First, you are shown a cute pixel drawing and given less than a minute to observe and memorize it. Then it is time to draw. Click on and use the pixel color in the righthand panel. Each block must be in the same exact place and the same color as the one you observed. There are 30-pixel drawings for you to replicate in this online game! Some of them are simple shapes with only one color and some of them are more complicated shapes with multiple colors. If you get stuck, click on the magnifying glass in the lower right-hand corner and you will be given time to view the drawing again. However, using the hint will eat at your score every time you use it. Once you have solved all 30 levels, submit your score! Then head over to the scoreboard to see if you rank up there with other high scorers!

name: Pixel Snake
author: Addicting Games
description: Pixel Snake is a free mobile game.

name: Pixelforces.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Pixelforces.io is a free arena battle game. Do you want your MTV? Are you willing to fight for it? Well, load up soldier because Pixelforces.io just might be your best opportunity to prove your worth. This is an arena battle game where pixelized players will use 5 different weapons to blast their way through the competition. Keep your trigger finger steady and your eyes peeled. Don't let anyone snipe you and always shoot first. This game starts you off with five fully loaded weapons. No need to search the map for ammo and discarded weapons. You'll be given everything you need and have the same opportunities as the other players. The weapons in the game are a rocket launcher, an Uzi, a Glock, a sniper rifle and a pump-action shotgun. Each weapon comes with its own advantages and disadvantages. For example, the grenade launcher is an instant kill. But it takes a few seconds to re-load and if you are too close to the target it will also kill you. In order to effectively use the grenade launcher, you need to choose your shots carefully. The Uzi does very little damage per shot but offers you the ability to spray a ton of bullets. This is good for cover fire and sprays and prays.

name: Pizza Division
author: Addicting Games
description: Pizza Division is a math game for those who love pizza. Pizza is the best food all around! Have you ever wanted to make a pizza? Well, this restaurant needs your help in cutting slices. It is always hard to get all those pieces equal. Help out this restaurant by cutting the pizza into the perfect amount of slices. Finish as many slices as you can in the allotted time. The customer is waiting so you need to be fast yet efficient! Once you finish a session of the pizzeria, it’s time for some math skills! Answer 5 questions correctly to unlock the next session. There are various math skills for you to choose from like addition, multiplication geometry, percentages, and many more!

name: Pizza Shop
author: Addicting Games
description: Pizza Shop is a girl game where you are a girl-in-charge who is running a pizza shop. This online game is a mix of tycoon, time-management, and matching! Play as the main character who is working hard to start their own business by opening a pizza shop. There are 14 levels for you to pass! After serving the customers and earning enough coins to advance to the next level, you must then shop for supplies.  Do this by playing a matching game where you must match together the ingredients you need.

name: Playground Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Playground Mahjong is a free Mahjong game. Welcome to the wonderful world of Mahjong is a classic strategy game that has been played for hundreds of years. Some of the strongest minds in history were players of Mahjong and it helped them sharpen their razor-sharp wits in order to take on other challenges, bigger challenges, challenges beyond the comprehension of the mortal man. Playground Mahjong is a version of Mahjong where players combine different tiles in order to create matches which thus makes the tiles disapear. In order to win you want to make all the tiles disappear as fast as you can. You can't match tiles that are locked in by other tiles so you'll have to focus your energy on the fringe tiles. You have a few special abilities that you can use in order to accomplish this goal, the game also has several different levels of difficulty. Playground Mahjong is a version of mahjong where the different tiles are all themed around the different things you can find in a playground like slides, swings, merry-go-rounds, and the jungle gym. Have fun playing mahjong.

name: Plumber Duck
author: Addicting Games
description: Align the pipes to flush those duckies out.

name: Plus 10
author: Addicting Games
description: Plus 10 is a free math and puzzle game. 10 is a pure and holy numerical unit. The base-ten system is something that has revolutionized the world and helped to standardize everything from counting on your fingers to counting on your toes. In plus 10 you will get to experience the thrill and excitement of basic addition as you try to connect disparate numbers floating in the haze and make them add up to ten. If you see a three and a seven then you better try and get them adjacent to each other because when you click on them they add up to ten. If you see a six and a four then you're going to have to move mountains to get them adjacent because when you click on those you'd best believe that's a ten. Plus Ten is a game that will have you scratching your head and picking your brain for a basic combination of numbers that add up to ten. Eight and two, yup that's a ten. Five and another five? Absolutely a ten. The combinations are endless and it's your job to coordinate the exact right drags and clicks in order to make all of these numbers line up, add up, and become ten.

name: Pocket Jump
author: Addicting Games
description: Pocket Jump is an online jumping game that requires fast reflexes. This little blue square with its cute little face is on a brave adventure. It’s your job to help it jump over these random spikes and get up as high as it can. The game is set against a bright yellow background that makes it easier to see when the spikes are coming. You must jump over the spikes so you can jump from it once you land on it. However, you cannot bump into it from any side. At the end of each game session, you’ll see your best score and most recent score. Try to beat your score every time as you rise up the leaderboards. Click on the shopping icon to use your blue diamonds to purchase cool character skins for you to play with. There’s no tutorial needed for this instant game. It’s available for both desktop and mobile devices. Just hit play and you’re already playing!

name: Poker Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Poker Solitaire is a free card game. This is the ultimate synthesis of your two favorite card games. Poker and Solitaire are classic games that have entertained generations of players for hundreds of years. People love Poker for the drafting and tableau building that is inherent in its mechanics. Other players enjoy the game for the sheer thrill of bluffing and seeing through your opponent's bluff. Now, take all of the drama of Poker and mix it with the strategy and puzzle of solitaire. VOILA! You have Poker Solitaire. A game in which players can have all of the card counting fun of Poker with all of the puzzling of solitaire. In this game, you eliminate cards not by ordering them by suit, value, or reverse value, but rather by combining them to create poker hands. Each hand that you play is worth a certain amount of points. You score more points by going for more complex hands than a simple two pairs but in doing so you run the risk of defeating yourself or deflating your score by constantly having to discard cards. It is also a great way to learn and remember poker hands and the odds of cards being dealt. So, whether you're a poker player or a solitaire person this is a game that you will love.

name: Polyart
author: Addicting Games
description: Polyart is a free puzzle game. Beauty truly is in the eye of the beholder, but what if your eye was sliced, shredded, and shattered beyond all recognition? How then would you be able to parse the beauty all around us? Polyart is a game that poses the question and provides the answer. In Polyart you will untangle the mystery of a series of polyart puzzles which have been fractured, divided, shattered into a million-piece puzzle with no this and no that. Do you have the skills required to untangle this mess? Slide the fragments here and there, too and fro, back and forth in order to view the fractals from the correct angle and see the full picture. This is a game about trial and error and instinct. Hone your ability to unravel a mystery and slide these beautiful pictures into view using nothing more than the tips of your fingers and the full breadth and depth of your brain. Polyart is a game that will challenge you on levels that you didn't even know were possible. Enjoy this game alone or challenge a friend to beat your record.

name: Pool: 8-Ball Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Pool: 8-Ball Mania is a free pool game. If you're smart then you know you should never play pool with somebody named after a city. Luckily, in our cool little pool game, you won't have to worry about anything like that because we offer you the world's finest artificial intelligence as your opponent. In this cool, free, mobile pool game you will be able to take on either a close friend sitting with you or an AI that is programmed to give you one heck of a game. This is a game all about physics, geometry, and a little bit of hustle. Pool is an age-old game that separates the wheat from the chaff and allows you to compete in a skill-based game that is as exciting as it is quiet. If you find yourself yearning for a friendly game of pool with a healthy competition then this the game for you. Get ready to have a real mania over pool in this cracking good app.

name: Pool Billiard
author: Addicting Games
description: Pool Billard is a sports game based on a good old fashioned game of pool! This online game is designed to show you the top of the pool table so that you can easily see all of the available balls, routes, and holes. The pool table and balls are decorated and colored just like your basic pool game in your recreational room. This is a solo version so you are not playing against a bot nor a live opponent. You and physics are your only opponents in this game! Your objective is to pocket all of the colored balls first from ideally from low to high. Lastly, you must pocket the black ball to get the best possible points. If you love pool, then check out this online version of the sports game.

name: Pool Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Pool Mania is a free pool game.

name: Pool Shooter
author: Addicting Games
description: Play Pool Shooter on Addicting Games! Match and pop colorful bubbles in this fast-paced, addictive shooter game that challenges your aim and strategy.

name: Portrait Of An Obsession
author: Addicting Games
description: Portrait Of An Obsession is a free escape room game. We are all obsessed and we are all trapped. All of us are prisoners of illusion in a world filled with the clues needed to unravel our lives and find our way to the truth. Portrait of aN obsession is a free desktop game that allows you the user to live out your wildest dreams as you try to unravel the secret of the house on the hill. Beware of the ghosts and ghouls that might pop up and even a murderer or two who is hiding in the shadows. There are a number of puzzles and riddles which you must collect the clues to solve and find your way out. it is a fun escape room and we're sure you'll love playing it as much as we loved publishing it.

name: Potty Racers
author: Addicting Games
description: Potty Racers is a free launch game. They called him crazy. When he said he was going to be the first stick man to enter the porta potty racing and free jumping competition, they laughed. He was never trained, he was too old, he was being delusional. But this summer, he shows them all. Potty Racers is the inspirational story of one stick man who dared to dream, who dared to take a chance, to take a leap of faith --in a porta potty --off of a cliff. But, it's not just any porta-potty, it is a specialized racing porta-potty designed to move fast, get air, and make the distance. Take control of the stick man ss you charge down the hill and fly off the cliff you will gain money, money that you can use to upgrade your wheels or add an engine, add wings, add a parachute, add fuel, upgrade the fuel. Whatever kind of turbo-boosted upgrade you need is at the touch of your fingers.

name: Potty Racers 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Potty Racers 2 is a free launch game. A new island is now unlocked for your potty racing pleasure! Upgrade to Number 2! Explore exciting new lands with your powerful new porta-potty. Pootacular tricks, crapulous upgrades: it's a brown world after all!

name: Potty Racers 3.4
author: Addicting Games
description:
Potty Racers 3.4 is a free launch game.

Translation: Upgrade your raw porta potty all the way to an interstellar spacecraft. Which, by the way, still smells awful. And did you check out that awesome plunger?!

name: Pounce.sh
author: Addicting Games
description: Pounce.sh is a free iogame.

name: Power Mahjong: The Tower
author: Addicting Games
description: Play Mahjong like you've never played before. Match two mahjong tiles together and make your way through endless levels of the tower. How far can You go?

name: Presidential Candidate or EveryJoe?
author: Addicting Games
description: Think you can tell the difference between a real candidate and an everyjoe? You only have 3 seconds to decide so make it fast! Don't forget to show off your score to all your friends!

name: Presidential Knockout
author: Addicting Games
description: It’s Bush versus Kerry in a bare knuckle boxing match on the lawn of the White House. It’s been a long time since that election, but apparently there are still some issues between the two.

name: Press To Push
author: Addicting Games
description: Press To Push is a free puzzle game. The world is one big interlocking mechanism and it needs you to press the right buttons, push the right blocks and connect it all together. In this puzzling game of cause and effect, you'll be in charge of making all the right moves to keep it all together. Every button you press and every block you push will bring you one step closer to connecting everything and solving the ultimate mystery of life, the game, and everything in-between. Get various blocks from point A to point B with but a click of your fingers and a tap of your mouse. As the levels go on the puzzles become harder and harder. The number of buttons and blocks you need to press and connect will become increasingly complex and you'll need to pay attention to figure out the order everything needs to be pressed, pushed, dropped, and overturned. Press To Push is a fun puzzle game for fun puzzle people who love fun!

name: Prison Escape
author: Addicting Games
description: Prison Escape is a free sniper game. Head shots are the best way to take down these prisoners, which are all apparently identical twins. What female demon-spawn bore this group of psychos?

name: Protect The Ragdoll
author: Addicting Games
