description: Project Ragdoll is a free mobile game.

name: Proton V Electron
author: Addicting Games
description: Proton V Electron is a free clicker and avoider game. As you may or may not know: opposites attract. This is a game that will put your knowledge of protons, electrons, opposites, attraction, and how all of that stuff works together --or doesn't-- to the ultimate test. This is Proton V Electron, the epic, ages-old tale of protons, electrons, and what it takes to bring them together. In this case, it will require you to use your reflexes and a keen eye in order to make sure that protons only smash into electrons, and electrons only smash into protons. that is it. The game will challenge you by randomly going back and forth between protons and electrons. It will challenge you by having the protons and electrons fire from the top and the bottom of the screen at different and random times. It will challenge you by having the centrifuge in the middle of the screen switch directions and speeds at random intervals. All of these different obstacles must be overcome if you wish to become the true champion of Proton V Electron.

name: Provinces of Belgium
author: Addicting Games
description: Provinces of Belgium is a geography game that teaches you about the provinces of Belgium. There are not a lot of places that still have a monarchy but Belgium is one of them. If you are thinking of visiting this beautiful country to get a glimpse of their royalty then you should probably get to know the area. There are 11 provinces in Belgium and with the help of this map game, you will memorize them in no time. Do you know where East Flanders, Liege, and Luxembourg are? If not, then do not sweat it. You will learn these 3 provinces and the others with this geography game. This online game is designed to teach you as you go while being fun and easy to understand. Just click on the country, and the game will let you know if you got it right or wrong. Along the way, you will learn where the provinces are. With education, repetition is key and this map game can be played, over and over again, until you are an expert.

name: Pung.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Pung.io is a free IOGame. Pung is the arena, Pung is the fight, Pung is the weapon, and Pung is the game: the ultimate game. Welcome to the world of Pung.io where you will be forced to take on an arena full of real live players from around the world. It is punch or be punched in this game of ultra-violence and alpha competition. Pung.io will allow you to choose and customize your very own avatar, name it, and then jump into an arena filled with obstacles, enemies, weapons, and the opportunity to become the champion of them all. SSo, arm yourself, steady yourself, and prepare to enter a world of unmitigated punching, running, blocking, and winning. You can win all the time if you want but it will require that you sharpen your elbows and get punching. This is like the running of the bulls except with punches. This is the running of the punches and only you will have what it takes to throw the punches that will catch your opponents off guard enough to land a hit. You need to land hits and drop players if you wanna do the Rocky dance at the top of the leader board.

name: Punk-O-Matic
author: Addicting Games
description: If you can't be bothered to learn three chords but you want to make your own punk music, this is the game for you. Like having real punks in your garage without the BO.

name: Put Bacon
author: Addicting Games
description: Put Bacon is a free mobile game. Is it gravity or is it bacon? we'll never know for sure. In Put Bacon, you are tasked with slapping bacon into a cup. it requires timing and patience, it requires a sense of gravity and the ability to calculate distances. Wait carefully as each slice of bacon is dangled above the frying pan then tap to release it tap it again when it hits the frying pan. You're trying to launch the bacon through the sky and into the cup waiting on the other side of the screen. Put Bacon is a minimalistic clicker game where you are trying to get as many slices of bacon as possible into the cup. Don't worry about the grease, don't worry about anything else. All that matters is that you are trying to get the bacon in the cup. So drop it, slap it, and cross your fingers. This is the dawning of a new you, this is the bacon revolution.

name: Puzzle Sliding
author: Addicting Games
description: Puzzle Sliding is a free puzzle game.

name: pvpz.io
author: Addicting Games
description: PVPZ.io is a free iogame.

name: Pyramid Klondike
author: Addicting Games
description: Pyramid Klondike is an online card game. This online game is themed with the ancient artifacts of Egypt. The cards are decorated in mummies, and the background contains images of the majestic pyramids. There are 5 levels in this online game that you can play. Solitaire is not the only card game you can play solo. Klondike is another fun card game you can play by yourself. If you have never played before, your objective is to add two cards to 13. This is another card game to add to your favorites that you can play to pass the time. Once you have played all 5 levels, submit your score to see where you rank against other card players. Play again to challenge yourself and beat your own score.

name: Quick Math
author: Addicting Games
description: Quick Math is a free math game. Fast math is the only math worth doing. Anyone can punch numbers into a calculator, count on their fingers, or scribble equations on index cards. It is the truth brain-geniuses that have the ability to fast math in their heads wherever and whenever they want. Don't let the simplicity of the equations fool you. When you are faced with a timer counting down you will quickly realize that even the simplest math equations can become an unbearable challenge if the timing isn't right. What is X? Who is Y? Will you be able to solve all of the equations before time runs out and the world has ended? This is a question that real scientists ask themselves every day in math-related emergencies. In this game, we give you the opportunity to challenge yourself and practice for the day when it won't just be a game. Get fast, do math, and answer hard in Quick Math. A free game for true gamers only.

name: QWERTY Warrior
author: Addicting Games
description: Spell to kill. If you can spell their name, they die. Typing doesn’t kill people, People kill people with typing skills.

name: Rabbit Run
author: Addicting Games
description: Rabbit Run is a free mobile game.

name: Rabbit Zombie Defense
author: Addicting Games
description: Oh no! A virus outbreak turned all your rabbit friends into zombies. You're our last line of defense. Shoot power-ups to change weapons. Be careful and conserve your ammo. Remember to use the points earned to upgrade the weapons in the shop, and defend the base at all costs!

name: Race Right
author: Addicting Games
description: Race Right is a free racing game. there are a lot of ways to race. You can do it in cars, on motorcycles, with jets, and yes even using speedboats. Race Right is all about using your skills to race the right way and bring victory home. Just point, click, drift, and slide your way into victory as you avoid obstacles, arena walls, and all sorts of other annoying things. This is a physics-based gravity puzzler where your job is to navigate a speeding boat through a series of levels which become increasingly difficult as the game goes on. Do you have what it takes to make it to the end and become the race master? Prove it in this game of fast turns and blisteringly fast straightaways. Dominate the leaderboard and devastate your friends in this epic racing game of skill, patience, and pure speed. In some games, you light off nitrous in order to power up. This game is all nitro all the time, you just have to figure out how to get on top of it and stay ahead of the momentum in order to properly control your roll and blast your way past the finish line.

name: Racehorse Tycoon
author: Addicting Games
description: Racehorse Tycoon is a free racing game. Buy a horse, hire trainers and jockeys, and start your steeplechase career. A season of races, and you can bet against your own horse!

name: Raft Wars
author: Addicting Games
description: Help Simon defend his treasure from pirates in this raft wars game. Simon made the discovery of diamonds while playing in the sand one day. His story hit the news and now pirates from all around the world want to fight this little guy for his loot! With the help of his baby brother and dog, Simon is set on defending his rightfully earned treasure. This aim and shoot game is misleadingly easy looking but can be difficult to play. First, select the angle by moving your mouse. Then select the strength by moving your mouse up and down. Your goal is to knock out each of your opponents using tennis balls or other items that you’ve acquired. Every time you take a turn, they’ll make their aim in response. You must get rid of the pirates before they get rid of Simon and his little brother. Once you’ve beaten the first set of pirates, you can move up to each level which will feature other enemies like Vikings! After each level, you can use your cash to purchase upgrades. Upgrades can get you better tools and rafts to help you defend your treasure in this sea warfare game.

name: Rafting Adventures
author: Addicting Games
description:
Rafting Adventures is a free avoider game. Rafting is an adventure made more fun by being an endless runner-style game. Yes, endless runners are fun but they're also a challenge for those of us who are used to games with definitive beginning middle, and an end.  The object of the game is to paddle as far as you can and as fast as you can without hitting a rock and thus dying. This risk-reward proposition is a big part of what makes endless runners so heckin' cool. They can be really fun, really addictive, and really frustrating. Rafting Adventures is an avoider and endless runner game where your only goal is to collect rubber duckies and stay alive. It is a sub-genre of platformers where you have to avoid obstacles and collect duckies without getting killed. There's also no time limit, so you're free to take as long as you want while collecting rubber duckies to boost your score. That's what makes this kind of game so hard — there is no time limit or health system, so when you die you die. There are no second chances and no one is coming to save you. It makes you truly feel the pressure because it's so easy to make mistakes.
Rafting Adventures is a game that, as the name suggests, turns rafting into an adventure. An endless adventure of avoidance and collecting things.  You play a rafter who is  dodging your way through a hostile environment. The object of the game is to raft along for as long as possible collecting ducks without dying. As you raft through the game, it becomes more difficult but also more rewarding. Show us what you got!

name: Railway Valley
author: Addicting Games
description: Railway Valley is a free tycoon game. Railway Valley places you in the shoes of a railway manager, perhaps the most thankless job in the world. It’s up to you to build train tracks from one location to another, ensuring that all the trains can make in there in one piece. but if there are any obstacles in the way, those have to be cleared out first, and if there are multiple trains coming from multiple locations, you’ll need train tracks to connect everything together, and you’ll need control when the switches will swap between tracks to allow all the trains to run smoothly.

name: Rainblox
author: Addicting Games
description: Rainblox is a free match-three game.

name: Rally Point 3
author: Addicting Games
description:
Rally Point 3 is a free racing game.

Vroom vroom goes the race car. This is a super-fast, first-person style race game where players are going to be going head to head with AI racers or challenging their own best time in the time trials. This is a super-fast racing game that will allow you to unlock new cars, new tracks, and campaign your way to a fun and eventful end. For people who like nothing more than to hop behind the wheel of a suped-up automobile and race themselves with no end in sight. Sometimes in life --just like in this game-- your only real opponent is you. If you feel cool because you set an all-time record for beating a race, imagine how great you'd feel if you then also beat your own time, and then just kept doing that until there was no more time left. You are so fast that you outran the very concept of time. It could happen, we have seen it happen. More and more people are talking about it.

name: Randass.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Randass.io is a free iogame.

name: Randomancer
author: Addicting Games
description: In this action lane defense game your units are your dice! Roll the dice onto the battle field to place your units.

name: Rapid Math
author: Addicting Games
description: Rapid Math is a math game for you to test both your math and speed skills. As soon as you see the counter go down, you must do the math as quickly as possible.  Your score is determined by how many you get correct, and how many problems you finish by the end of the timer. If you do not earn enough points, you will not be able to advance to the next level. However, you can always replay the level again! There are 30 levels of this online game for you to beat! The game will start off easy with additional and subtraction. Each level will become more difficult with more complex math problems. If you are good at math, then here is the time to show off your skills. Submit your score to see if you are one of the Rapid Math high scorers!

name: RAVEN-STAR
author: Addicting Games
description:
A tiny Game Boy Color game about finding a place where you belong.

You are a raven born without wings. Cast out of your village, you must find a way to return home. Run and jump around The Ravine on your journey to find the legendary Wishing Star.

name: Record Shop Tycoon
author: Addicting Games
description: Record Shop Tycoon is a free tycoon game. What is a record? Well, it doesn't matter, if it makes you money. Build up your record store empire by purchasing the music genres that customers love and expanding to every neighborhood in the city.

name: Red Escape
author: Addicting Games
description: Escape from three rooms using logic and the tools you find, solve puzzles use passwords, find hidden clues to escape.

name: Red Remover
author: Addicting Games
description: Red Remover is a free puzzle game where your objective is to remove the red blocks. Enjoy this fun brain teaser game with its cute and simple animation. The red blocks are miserable and they just want to go away. Your job is to do this while leaving the green and happy blocks on the screen. Lose a green block, and you lose that level! This is a creative puzzle game where you have to think of various ways to keep the green blocks safe. Some of them may be in danger are about to roll off the screen but you can use other blocks to safeguard them. There are 40 levels to solve in this funny puzzle game along with more locked levels.

name: Red Snake 3D
author: Addicting Games
description: Red Snake 3D is a free avoider game. The Red Snake is in a race and the red Snake intends to win. Dodge barricades and walls as you slither through an ice white world of gleaming indifference. Control the red snake and slink through challenging levels at top speed. You need to become unburdened as you move towards the finish line in each level because even though you'll be focused on staying alive the whole time your ultimate end goal is to make it to the finish line. This is a fast-paced game of slithering, sneaking, slipping and sliding your way through icebergs and other obstacles. It is a game of reflexes, a game of will, a game of determination, and ultimately a fun, free racing game. Try it and you're sure to enjoy it. In Red Snake, you might be the snake and the venom might be real but ultimately if you want to make it to the top of the leaderboard you're gonna have to bring your own bite. So, bear those fangs and get those ribs moving in this fun, fast, and furious racing game.

name: Redemption Slots Machine
author: Addicting Games
description: Redemption Slot machine is a free casino game. Welcome to the world of one armed bandits, slots, and the jingle-jangle of coins that tie them all together. While Redemption Slot Machine is a casino slot game, it is also so much more. For example, one great thing about this game is that you don’t have to worry about losing all your money. Casinos can be a lot of fun but it’s no picnic when you lose your hard-earned cash. But don't orry partner, this is a fun and casual online game in the style of real casino slots games. This slot machine is decorated with funny images of cowboys and cowgirls, and horses and stuff. Nothing is funnier than winning a game by getting 3 bandits in a row! Play until you win the jackpot with this fun online casino game. It will satisfy your hunger for winning.

name: Regions of Czech Republic
author: Addicting Games
description: Regions of the Czech Republic is an educational map game that will touch up your knowledge of the Czech Republic. Whether you need to study this for school or just want to show off your geography knowledge, Regions of the Czech Republic is a fun and quick game that will brush up your skills. Ever wondered where Prague is or how big it is? Well now is your chance to learn about the beautiful regions of the Czech Republic. There are 14 regions for you to identify. Since this is an educational game, even if you get it wrong, the game will give you a quick hint telling you where it actually is. At the end of the game, you’ll receive your score and the time it took you to get you there. Beat both your score and time by playing again and remembering the hints the game gave you before. Practice makes perfect!

name: Regions of Denmark
author: Addicting Games
description: Regions of Denmark is an easy map game for you to memorize. Denmark is known as the happiest country in the world. As a country with no hills, that is easy to believe since you never have to ride your bike uphill. Whether you are interested in the geography of Denmark or you simply have to test to study for, this is the map game for you. There are only 5 regions of Denmark that you will have memorized in no time. Do you know where Syddanmark is? If you don’t, then don’t worry! This game is all about repetition and it will teach you the regions in no time. Play it as often as you need to in order to drill into your head the beautiful regions of Denmark.

name: Relaxr
author: Addicting Games
description: Relaxr is a chill game for chill people. Hey man, chill out. It's ok. Breath. Relax, just take a second. Look around. Look at the colors, look at the flares and the smoke. That's pretty cool, that's pretty chill. Drag your mouse around the screen, play with the controls on the right-hand side of the screen. See, you can make it look as cool as you want. Relaxr is chill like that. Relaxr is a game that understands sometimes you don't want to mow down an army of zombies, collect gold coins, chase other players or race for the finish line. Relaxr knows that sometimes you just wanna relax, look at some cool colors, some weird pattern, take a picture and share it with your friends. If you think you're done with games for a bit, maybe you just wanna chill out, look and some colors, think about your feelings or the future or whatever. That is cool. You're cool. Relaxr is cool. Relaxr gets it. Relaxr is here for it.

name: Relmz.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Relmz.io is a fantasy role-playing game. Welcome to a realm where only the strong survive. This is the wide world of Relmz.io A fantasy RPG where you will compete against other players from around the world in order to sly the vile Goop monsters, level up your character, learn magic, gain some cool new weapons and then take on other players. It is a big world, and it is a scary world. You won't find many allies here just shopkeepers, wise old men, and the occasional NPC who wants to stab you in the back. This is Relmz.io and it is a dangerous place to be if you yourself are not a dangerous person. Customize your character from the color of their skin to the style of their hair. Choose any gender you want, add a beard and even a cool custom costume. In Relmz.io you can be whoever you want to be as long as who you want to be wants to be slaying Goop monsters.

name: Retro Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Retro Mahjong is an elegant Mahjong style game in a classic 8-bit animation style. Nostalgia is back and it just might be the wave of the future. Whether you like things from the 70's, 80's or thousands of years ago, we're pretty certain that this version of Mahjong is perfect for particular tastes. It is nothing short of revolutionary to take a game that is hundreds of years old, and thought of as a classic -like Mahjong- and then combine it with a vintage aesthetic like the green-hued pixel bit animation of the late 1980s. The combination is magical. Now you can match pixelated lightning bolts, 8-bit bombs, and a variety of 80's gaming tropes as you play through classic game mechanics which have been tested and approved for hundreds of years by dozens of generations. Mahjong is truly a timeless game and by adding its mechanics to a beloved retro art theme, we hope to deliver it countless new generations. So, sit down and prepare to enjoy a game that your ancient ancestors played in an art style that your parents loved!

name: Return to Halloween Escape
author: Addicting Games
description: Return to Halloween Escape is a free escape game. Trapped in the Halloween house again? It's even more haunted than last time. Escape or join the ghouls in the house!

name: Reversi Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Reversi Mania is a free strategy game. This is not Othello and this is not Bang. This is Reversi and it is an old game that may just blow your mind. Reversi is an ancient strategy game where two opposing forces take to the board to determine who is the more strategic, who can think tactically, and who is the mightiest of them all. This is an arena for your mind and in this game, the winner takes all. Reversi is a strategic game that rewards skill, intelligence, planning, and pattern recognition. There is no luck, there are no dice, you do not customize your weapon. In this game, you are the weapon, and your only path to victory is to make smart choices that will devastate your opponent. This is a simple game played in black and white. There are no ties, no points, and no bonus rounds. This is a game of winners and losers so be sure you are former or you will surely be the latter. Reversi is an ancient game but believe us when we say it never gets old.

name: Reversi Neon
author: Addicting Games
description: Reversi is a free strategy game.

name: Rhino Rush Stampede
author: Addicting Games
description: Rhino Rush Stampede is a free endless runner game. This game is a ballistic, horns to the wall, side-scrolling, endless runner escape where you are the rhino who runs and scores. Get ready to smash, splash, and overcome where you collect, smash, and overcome. the world is full of obstacles and you as a rhino must smash them to steal all the gold you can. This is the noblest of all pursuits and it is one we think you'll enjoy, we know we enjoy it. So step up, strap in, and charge it through endless levels of different challenges, obstacles, and a  fast-paced endless runner style game where you need to survive for as long as you can. As a humble rhino, you'll try and roll your way to victory by smashing many obstacles in this fun, free racing game. This is a game all about durability and survival. The winners will be those who are able to smash, jump, and avoid the pitfalls, to stay on track toward a glorious rhino future. The game only gets faster and harder the longer you play, so, don't expect any reprieve from the suffering until after you die. Such is existence in a jungle world where smashing is the only escape and there is no end.

name: Richup.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Richup.io is a free IOGame. Shake, rattle, and roll the dice in this ultimate strategy game of buying, selling, acquiring, rolling, moving, and having a good time. This is a highly strategic real estate game where players will learn to have fun while wheeling, dealing, buying, and selling in the high-stakes world of real-estate. Play against other players from around the world and make them pay rent in this epic game of life and death. Take over the various different railways and resources which players may need in order to move on with their life. You can do it, we believe in you. When you pass go in this game you will receive two hundred dollars. We urge you to re-invest that money into some real estate, charge rent, use that money to buy more real estate, and bankrupt all your friends. Just like in real life. Only the strong will survive in this game of luck, money, and fun. Do you think you have what it takes? You'd better hope so! Because there is no sympathy.

name: Ricochet Kills 2
author: Addicting Games
description: The ultimate trick shot is back! Aim carefully and make each bullet count. When you're finished, make your own sweet ricochet levels, baby!

name: Ride The Bus
author: Addicting Games
description: Ride the Bus is a card game where your objective is to have enough tokens to ride the bus. This is a cute twist on your basic card game. You are riding the bus and you need tokens to get to your destination. Your goal is to win more bus tokens so you do not get kicked off the bus. If you lose your tokens, you have to get off the bus. Play against three AI players who decided to bet their bus tokens in a card game. However, their computerized brains cannot compete against your human ones! To win the card game, try to earn 31 points by adding all the cards in your hands of the same suit. The highest number wins every game.

name: Right Color
author: Addicting Games
description: Right Color is a free clicker game.

name: Rihanna Dress Up
author: Addicting Games
description: Poor Rihanna - she's going to catch a horrible cold, all wet like that. If she won't come in out of the rain, let's at least get her into something warm and snuggly, shall we?

name: Rise Above
author: Addicting Games
description: Rise Above is a free-avoider game.  You're a chicken in this endless avoided game where objects like spikes, balls, hexes, squares, and sticks fall from the sky and must be blocked, deflected, and pushed away by your shield. This is a game where you play until you die. If you want to make it to the top of the leaderboard, you'll have to be as defensive as possible. This is a game with no way to speed up, slow down, or move your chicken. The only way to survive is by protecting them with the shield. Endless avoider games are a great way to practice patience and strategy as you block, push, and protect. Keep your chicken safe in this free, fun, avoided game.

name: Risky Way
author: Addicting Games
description: Risky Way is a free instant game. The highways of the future are risky and if you want to survive you'll need to be smarter than all of them combined. All you have to do in this nerve-tingling racing game is click, hold, and let go. Of course, if you want to be an effective driver who is able to survive you'll have to know when to click, how long to hold, and only let go at the appropriate time. This is a simple mechanism but as the roads become more dangerous and difficult to navigate, it will become trickier and trickier to hold on. This is an endless style game where the levels don't end: you do. You're here to stay alive longer than any other player and climb your way to the top of the leaderboard using your reflexes and a little luck. Do you think you have what it takes to overcome the obstacles, slalom through the tightest corners, and hold on long enough to become the leader of the pack? Will you rise above and prove that you have what it takes to put the pedal to the metal and swish across the finish line like a boss? Well, here is your chance to prove it.

name: River Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description:
River Solitaire is a free solitaire game.

River Solitaire is a unique version of multi-handed solitaire! This online game is a unique take on the classic solitaire game. Instead of traditional rows and columns, this online game uses various hands of different cards. Not only must you match the number but you need to also match the suit. You cannot match numbers only if they are of different suits. There are 10 levels of this mahjong game for you to solve! Each level is timed, so match all of the tiles to be able to unlock the next level. If you don’t make it on time, you will have to start over! If you get stuck, look at your available options on the upper right panel. You can take a hint, shuffle, or undo the last move. Submit your final score to the leader-boards to see where you rank against other puzzle players.

name: Road Fury
author: Addicting Games
description: Roady Fury is a fast and furious race and wreck game. You have a laser blaster with a never ending supply of blasts. Use it wisely to destroy the  slow moving, boring, and frankly annoying people who are clogging up the highway. Doesn't it make you mad to be stuck in traffic? Doesn't it anger that these slow moving cars are just forever in the way? Aren't you just furious? Well, are you furious enough to turn your laser blaseronto auto and go nuts on the highway? Just zoom through the lanes of traffic, taking out the trucks, tankers, and SUV's as they slowly chug along. It's an intense ride through the hot desert. Collect cash from the cars as they explode and use it to power up! Long term your whole mission is to blast these people into oblivion and geet rich doing it --just like in real life. So, get started now!

name: Robo Racing
author: Addicting Games
description: Robo Racing is a free racing game. Blow the competition away.

name: Rocket Hopper
author: Addicting Games
description:
• Rocket Hopper is a super-simple, ultra-fun physics-based rocket navigation challenge.
• Beat the game by safely landing on the finish pad or crossing the finish line.
• Avoid lightning barriers, and try not to crash into anything...

• License Disclosures

name: Rocket Panda: Flying Cookie Quest
author: Addicting Games
description:
Bwaaah, bwaah, bwaah!!!! Bwah?

Translation: Flying chickens and cows, two of my favorite things!!!! But what is a rocket Panda?

name: Roll Rush Extreme
author: Addicting Games
description: Roll Rush Extreme is a free action game where you navigate a rolling ball down a tunnel. From the POV of the rolling ball, run through a tunnel as you start going faster and faster. Travel down a bright green tunnel with 3D animation as you use the arrow keys to tilt right or left. Avoid holes but collect coins to increase your score as you journey down this turbulent path. The game picks up the pace as you pass certain hurdles making the action game more challenging. As you are playing the game, you can view your speed on the left side and your current score on the right side. At the end of each game session, a display will show your best score and the most recent score. Play, again and again, until you beat your best score and rise up the leaderboards. Click on High Scores to see where you stand against other action game players in this online game.

name: Rollin Candy
author: Addicting Games
description: If you like Cut the Rope, you'll like this one! Rotate objects to pick up gold stars with your tasty peppermint candy.

name: Roly Santa Claus
author: Addicting Games
description: Help Santa get back to his sack of toys! His big ol' bag is needed to deliver the toys to kiddos!

name: Roman Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description:
Roman Mahjong is a free mahjong game.

Ancient Rome was a vast wasteland of conquered countries, territories and cultures. All who fell to the swords and sandals of the their unholy emperor. The lineage of their power reaches back through ancient times and some might say that the empire never ended. The background of this online game is designed with the historical architecture of the Roman world. The tiles have beautiful Roman designs with bold colors like red, green, purple, and orange. If you make an error or get stuck, you have the option to shuffle, undo, and take a hint. With each level, you get 3 of each. However, either option will lower your overall score. There are multiple levels of this online game for you to play and win! Each level has its own pattern and challenge as the game becomes more difficult. On top of differing patterns, each level is timed so you must solve each puzzle as quickly as possible. Don’t be deterred, though! Play through all the levels with the best score possible to land on our list of High Scores!

name: Rotate and Roll
author: Addicting Games
description: All about the gravity, folks! Get your happy little ball to the big bubble, but don't fall, and don't hit the spikey dudes. Many levels, many, many levels. And a level editor? Aw snap!

name: Royal Bride Dress Up
author: Addicting Games
description: Royal Bride Dress Up is a free dress up game.

name: Royaledudes.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Royaledudes.io is a free iogame.

name: Running Circle
author: Addicting Games
description: Running Circle is an online clicker game that you can play from your phone or computer. This is a simple online game with clean animation in just two colors. This game may not have fancy graphics but it sure will keep you busy for hours. Just because it is easy on the eyes, though, does not mean it is an easy-to-beat game. This online game requires fast reflexes to get the best possible score. Your objective is to avoid running into a white line. Seems too simple, right? While you are trying to avoid one white wall, another one will appear as the white ball keeps quickly spinning around the circle. This is the type of game to play again and again. Play to defeat your own best score as well as to rise up the scoreboards.

name: Running Jack
author: Addicting Games
description: Running Jack is a free endless runner game with a funny twist. Jack is a professional bagpipe player and he uses this to help him float through the air. Help him escape this unusual situation he’s trapped in with flying missiles and lasers. All Jack has his are his bagpipes but help him collect gold coins through the game. Collect spins that you can use at the end of the game to gain goodies. Use the gold coins to buy boosts like life, speed, and shield. You will also find weapons like rockets and tennis guns. There are also shoes to make you jump better and hats to collect more coins. Unlock everything and get the highest score on the leaderboard. Click on the quests to see what you need to to do complete all of them. Running Jack is on a mission and your job is to help him travel as far as he can each time.

name: Rush Matrix
author: Addicting Games
description: Rush Matrix is a free clicker game. It turns out all the tech-nerds were right! We are living in a matrix, a Rush Matrix that is! Thrill to the sci-fi puzzle adventure that is 'Rush Matrix' as you move, smash and increase your score in increasingly clever and heart pounding ways. You'll have to think fast and react even faster as you slink your way through a bubble puzzle of increasingly complex and puzzling races. Each level goes on as long as you're alive and the only way to win is to grind, Climb, and devastate the competition. This is a game about speed and agility. You need to dodge, avoid, and pick up the items you like. This is a game of skill for true champions of the genre. You can prove yourself to the competition by out playing them in this slinky game of rushing through a matrix.

name: RUST & ROPE
author: Addicting Games
description:
The floor is literally lava, and the only way out is UP.

Take control of an agile Scrap Spider in Rust & Rope, a lightning-fast vertical grappling game where hesitation means melting. Armed with a high-tension grapple hook, you must swing, zip, and climb your way through a crumbling, infinitely generating industrial shaft while a deadly tide of magma chases you from below.

Master the physics of the swing, dodge treacherous ice walls that kill your momentum, and collect scrap coins to upgrade your bot into an unstoppable climbing machine.

Features:

* Precision Grappling Physics: Aim, shoot, and pull yourself through the air. String together mid-air grapples to build massive speed and outrun the rising heat.
* Dynamic Environments: Navigate through shifting biomes. Stick safely to the metal chunks, but beware the ice sections where you will helplessly slide down!
* The Power Ten Upgrades: Spend your hard-earned coins in the shop to permanently upgrade your stats. Increase your zip speed, magnet range, coin multipliers, or buy revives to save a doomed run.
* Game-Changing Powerups: Smash into powerups to activate a protective Shield or ignite your Overdrive Rocket thrusters to blast upward in a state of pure invincibility.
* Fierce Daily Competition: Compete against players worldwide on the Daily Leaderboard to win massive coin payouts and exclusive revive tokens.
* Chase the World Record: Leave your mark on the game. The highest score ever achieved by anyone is physically immortalized as a Golden Flag high up in the level for all other players to see—until someone climbs high enough to break it!

How high can you climb before the heat catches up?

name: Safari Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Safari Mahjong is a free mahjong game.

name: Samurai Rampage
author: Addicting Games
description: Samurai Rampage is a free platform game. Known for their patience, their virtue, and their steadfast dedication to discipline and order, one must ask what could truly make a samurai rage? We promise you that you will find out in our new game 'Samurai Rampage.' In Samurai Rampage you will become a furious fighter who is hell-bent on slaying an army of the evil undead. Demons have risen and they are not happy! Sharpen your sword and store up your rage for a lightning-fast run through a never-ending dojo in this point and click, tap or you'll miss it assault on bad guys and boredom. The little demons' faces are groaning and growling to get your attention, each more wicked and evil than the last. You'll have to strike first and strike hard if you want to defeat the grizzly army of grinning gremlins. Build up your rage-o-meter in order to properly strike them down. Do not falter and do not fail for your mission is of utmost importance. If you were to fall then who would stand against the demons of the deep?

name: Sand Ball
author: Addicting Games
description: Sand Ball is a free puzzle game.

name: Sandstrike.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
Sandstrike.io is a free IOgame. Are you ready for a mind-bending, reality-shattering adventure in the desert? We’re talking about the one and only sandstrike.io, the FPS game that will have you on the edge of your seat, blasting your way to glory! In this game, you'll find yourself in a desert arena, surrounded by other players who are all vying for the ultimate prize - survival. But don't let the arid landscape fool you,  friends. This is a game of high stakes, where every shot counts, and every move could mean the difference between victory and defeat.

As you navigate the desert terrain, you'll need to keep your wits about you, anticipating the movements of your enemies and using all your skills to take them out before they take you out. With every kill you make, you'll earn points to unlock new weapons and abilities. From pistols and rifles to grenade launchers and flamethrowers, you'll have a range of devastating tools at your disposal, and it's up to you to use them wisely. But it's not just about firepower. In sandstrike.io, strategy is just as important as marksmanship. You'll need to work with your teammates, using communication and coordination to outmaneuver your opponents and seize control of the battlefield. With each victory, you'll gain more experience and become even more deadly until you're a force to be reckoned with in the desert arena. 

The action in sandstrike.io is absolutely mind-bending. With retro graphics and immersive gameplay, you'll feel like you're right there in the desert, firing on your enemies and dodging their attacks. Whether alone or with friends, you'll be hooked from the very first shot, and you'll keep coming back for more. So, what are you waiting for, gamer-friends? Jump into sandstrike.io today and get ready to unleash your inner warrior. With its intense action, strategic gameplay, and mind-bending graphics, sandstrike.io is a must-play for any gamer who loves first-person shooters. So lock and load, my f

name: Santa Goes Digital
author: Addicting Games
description:
Support the Developer!
Check out one of the developer's at https://geminisharon.itch.io/ to support the developer and try out their other games!

 

The digitalization doesn’t stop at Santa's Workshop. In fact, this year, all wish lists have been submitted digitally for the first time. Unfortunately, Santa has only little experience with the digital world.

Give him a hand and help him evaluate this year's submissions.

name: Santa Run
author: Addicting Games
description: Santa Run is an endless runner game where Santa Claus is the main character. Santa’s running behind on schedule and he needs to get these toys to all the good boys and girls. Help Santa Claus run across from building to building as he avoids dangerous obstacles like icicles and towers. Do not fall in between buildings or else Santa will get hurt and Christmas will be over! Santa also needs to hop over chimneys to drop off the presents so make sure not to miss a single one. At the end of each game session, you’ll see your most recent score and your best one. Play again to beat your previous score and to rise up the leaderboards. Click on the leaderboards icon in the lower right-hand corner to see where you stand with other Santa runners in this online game.

name: Santa's Quest
author: Addicting Games
description: Santa's Quest is a free puzzle game. Christmas can be a real puzzle and never has that been more obvious than right now when Santa himself is lost behind a sliding block puzzle. You need to intervene if you want all the good boys and girls of the world to get their presents this year. Santa is an extremely busy person who has a lot on his mind: presents, routes, who has been good, who has been bad, time-zones, flight paths. The man can't be concerned with the challenging but fun sliding block puzzle present in this game. Which is where you have to come in. Tap, click, slide, and unravel this mixed-up world as you help Santa walk his way from his sleigh to the houses laid square and true. This is an exciting and fast-paced puzzle game where you'll be challenged to slide blocks and open up a path to the chimneys. It is not time but you'll probably want to get it done pretty fast because time is of the essence.

name: Sarah Palin DressUp
author: Addicting Games
description: Hockey mom? Caribou killer? It's all up to you. Redress Sarah for VP success!

name: Savages
author: Addicting Games
description: Mookah lakah heekee, you know you wanna lei me. Pass the poi mahallo. Shoot the arrow, man!

name: Save the Witness
author: Addicting Games
description: One witness, many enemies. Keep your witness alive long enough to testify. And try to keep the collateral damage to a minimum, you gun-happy sniper, you!

name: Scary Mathventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Scary Mathventure is an educational game that incorporates puzzles and math practice. Sometimes studying can burn you out so it is good to take breaks here and there. This online game lets you play a level and then requires you to solve 5 math problems before unlocking the next level. There are 30 levels of Scary Mathventure for you to play. You can choose math skills that vary from preschool to 8th grade. There is addition, algebra, decimals, and fractions for you to study. The online game itself is a puzzle game where you must figure out how to remove each bomb in the picture with a limited amount of ghosts and paths. Each level comes with its own challenges like needing to grab keys in order to unlock certain doors. Do not hesitate to play this fun math game!

name: School of Dragons
author: Addicting Games
description: Raise and train your own dragons as you soar through the skies, go on legendary quests, and explore Berk with Hiccup, Astrid and the rest of the How to Train Your Dragon heroes.

name: Schoolbreak.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Schoolbreak.io is a free IOGame. School is order but life is chaos. It is inevitable that you as a child will find a way to add chaos to the order of school. Your enemy is the dreaded teacher. The teacher will always try to stop you and try to hold you down while screaming historical dates, simple mathematical equations, and lessons about grammar. But you will not listen. You will not learn their rules and their facts. You are your own person and you will party, wreak havoc and destroy the institutions upon which society itself has been built. You will do this because chaos is fun and it makes for a fun game. Schoolbreak.io is a fun game that takes the battle between order and chaos to its ultimate end. Here is the big twist that you did not see coming. In this game, you can actually choose to play as either the child, the student, an agent of chaos. Or you can choose to play as the dreaded teacher: the arbiter of order, the disciplinarian. This dichotomy is what makes the game endlessly re-playable and will allow you as a gamer to maximize your fun. Enjoy this game.

name: Scorched
author: Addicting Games
description: Either these guys have really thick skin, or those bullets do only slightly more damage than firecrackers. Blast away your opponent in this parody of Tanks.

name: Scorpion Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Scorpion Solitaire is a card game based on the concept of solitaire. Solitaire is fun to play but sometimes you want more of a challenge. This online game has similar rules to solitaire but with more cards out on the board to make things more challenging. To add more of an obstacle, each game is timed so you must react quickly. There are 3 levels for you to select depending on your skill level. Create all 4 decks to win the game. If you run out of the moves the game will automatically let you know and end the game for you.

name: Seagull Story
author: Addicting Games
description: Happy monkey? Almost! The seagulls are ruining his little island. Seek your revenge!

name: Searide.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Searide.io is a free iogame. Welcome to the sea, you are in for a dark and stormy ride. We hope you survive or at least have fun. Searide.io is an exciting iogame in the vein of Agario but with a few new mechanics that make it more exciting. First of all, you won't die if you are attacked by a larger opponent. In this game, you have a health bar that you can choose to heal or not. This allows you to take a few shots and also means that you can't expect to just run into someone smaller than you and wipe them out. You're gonna need to do a little bit more work. You can also customize which sea animal you want to be and collect power-ups to help you grow, smash open loot crates for a special ability. Please be sure to avoid the various stationary sea monsters in this game that sit quietly and wait for you to get too close. They can only do harm. Meanwhile, there are power-downs out there which look almost exactly like the power-ups. Don't be fooled into picking those up as they will only slow you down. Use your boost to get in and out of trouble and try to stay alive in this sea-themed arena spectacular.

name: Secret Santa
author: Addicting Games
description:
Support the Developer!
Check out Liquidream at https://liquidream.itch.io/secret-santa to support the developer and try out their other games!

 

"In today's world of modern home security, Santa's job of delivering presents gets tougher every year!"

Your Mission:
  - To deliver all of the presents without making too much noise

name: Shadow Drifter
author: Addicting Games
description: The darkness is your friend and Gunbots are not, duh! Guide the Drifty Bot along the shadows and block the lights any way you can. Escape is at your hand!

name: Shadow Snake 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Snakes! You already know the Snake Laws. Eat to grow. Avoid black creatures who rob your health. And do not bite your own tail! Slither to success by gobbling bits of sunlight. Will you rank as a Python, or a mere Worm?

name: Shakes & Fidget
author: Addicting Games
description: Shakes and Fidget is a free browser-based and totally ironic MMORPG. If you love all of the excitement of creating a character, going on quests, side quests, fetch quests, then fighting bosses for more loot and experience points, you are going to love Shakes and Fidget - in an ironic way, of course. Shakes and Fidget plays with all of your favorite fantasy and MMORPG game tropes and mechanics and then re-imagines them with an ironic twist. It is an exciting new take on MMORPG's and it is something that you'll definitely want to try out. Choose your race, class, gender, and then customize your character before setting off into the hinterlands to find quests. Each quest will require careful considerations about diplomacy, tactics, economic choices and of course character development.

name: Shanghai Dynasty
author: Addicting Games
description: Shanghai Dynasty is a free mahjong game. Welcome to the Shanghai Dynasty. This is a new game but it's also in many ways a classic game of pattern recognition. Put your matching skills and strategic know-how to the test in this classic tiled game of symbols and elimination. In Mahjongg, 144 tiles are placed face-up on the board, and it’s up to you to clear the board by removing pairs of matching tiles. While being easy to explain, and technically easy to play, Mahjongg is far more challenging than you could possibly believe, this is why it lasted for thousands of years. It has a deep strategy and a cool aesthetic.  You only win if you clear the board. Run out of moves while there are still tiles to be played, and you lose. we think you can do it, take a quick trip to Shanghai and enjoy the exotic locales.

name: Shanghai Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Shanghai Mahjong is a free mahjong game. Woah, its a mahjong  game. Woah, take our hand and we'll make it we swear, woah: Shanghai Mahjong.  Shanghai Mahjongmight very well be like no other Mahjong game you've ever played. In many Mahjong games what you do is click on matching tiles in order to make them disappear as you slowly work your way through tiles on the edges of the board to get to the juicy center and make everything disappear. Shanghai Mahjong is extremely similar to that but in this game, you get to choose what pattern you want the tiles to be arranged in and the arrangements are pretty cool tbh. There are some cool time limits, the ability to re-shuffule, and maybe even hints as to where to look. And that is what Shanghai Mahjong is and why it is cooler than everything else. So, while you think you know Mahjong you don't know Shanghai Mahjong. You know basic Mahjong for normies. This is the real deal and we officially triple dog dare you to play it and not love it.

name: Shapes Of Things
author: Addicting Games
description: Shapes is a free puzzle game.

name: Shards
author: Addicting Games
description: Shards is a fun paddle game where your objective is to break all of the colored blocks. This is a bright online game that uses 3D animation with transparent color. Choose from there levels of speed: slow, normal, and fast. This vertical game can be played on both mobile and desktop devices. With each game, you get 3 lives to beat each level and advance to the next one. There are multiple levels with varying difficulty for you to defeat. Once you’ve beaten all the levels, look to the leaderboard to see where you rank against other players on this online game.

name: Sheep 13
author: Addicting Games
description: Sheep 13 is a free IOgame.

name: Shell Challenge
author: Addicting Games
description: Shell Challenge is a free matching game.

name: Shell Shockers
author: Addicting Games
description: Shellshockers.io is an egg-ceptionally good time. Whoever said that war never changes doesn't know what they are talking about and probably never played Shellshockers.io See, Shellshockers.io is war game much like we've seen before: first person, arena, variety of items, upgrades, and weapons. But friend, here is the twist: You're an egg! That's right, your character that goes through the game and is firghting for life or death is straight up aan egg! Unbelievable! The art is amazing of course, the animation is smooth, and you'll have a variety of different items, weapons, and upgrades which you can use to augment your already egg-given abilities and take on players from around the world! Since this is an io game you'll basically be playing agaisnt real flesh and blood people, not AI and not non player characters. This means your strategy and your tactics are going to have to be  top notch because believe us when we say that your opponenets will be bringing it! The leaderboard is thee final tally for who matters and who doesn't. Shellshockers.io gives you the ability to prove yourself to dozens and dozens of eggs around the world. So, don't get too scrambled as you play this thematic war game.

name: Shifting Jelly
author: Addicting Games
description: Shifting Jelly is a free endless runner game. There is almost no running in this game. This game is basically a game of sliding but that sliding is technically endless. Well, it is endless as long as you are good at what you do. See, in this game, there are no second chances, there are no hit points, and there are no do-overs. You will only ever get to the end and score the highest possible score if you are good enough to morph your block of jelly to fit through the various doors. As you slide, endlessly, you will come face to face with a bunch of portals, and doorways. Your job is to morph your jelly as fast as you can in order to pass it through the doors. It requires timing, patience, and a keen eye for spacial recognition. This is a game that will test the limits of your limits. Are you as smart as you think you are? We sure hope so. Remember, life is a slideway and you gotta slide it until you die.

name: Ships 3D IO
author: Addicting Games
description:
Ships 3D is an IO game, multiplayer sailing ship simulator. The game is played in 'first person' where you control the sailor and move around the ship; interacting with the helm, sails and cannons. Sink enemy ships and shoot other players to score points.

Features:

There are two modes; Trader mode and Team mode. In Trader mode take items to the trader to earn large amounts of points. In Team mode, attempt to capture islands to earn points for your team.

Other game features include clans, friends lists, muskets, unlockable cannon balls, ships and skins, as well as, mountains, goblin NPCs, weekly rolling wall of fame and top clan listings.

Invite friends directly into your ship in Trader mode for endless fun.

name: Shooterz.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Shooterz.io is a first-person shooter-style iogame. This is war and the only way home is in a body bag or riding high on the top of the leader board. In shooterz.io you win by killing and lose by dying. It's simple, it's deadly, it's fun. Choose different weapons and learn to crouch, jump and hide. In this game, you won't be firing off rounds against a mindless AI opponent. Oh no sir, In this world you'll be head to head with hundreds of other players from around the world. If you think you're good --and I mean really good-- then why don't you prove it by being the most trigger happy killer in the arena and on the leader board? You can prove yourself over and over again in the world of online combat as you take out enemies one by one and two by two. So, go head to head, toe to toe, eye to eye, and trigger to trigger in this thrilling adventure of a game.

name: Shopping Street
author: Addicting Games
description: Shopping Street is a free tycoon game. Feeling greedy? Start a business! Slow shoppers with benches and newstands; save clams to purchase new stores. Can you expand your strip mall empire across the country?

name: Shotgun Princess II
author: Addicting Games
description: Our Shotgun Princess is trapped again! This time, she's in a Goblin's prison. Why are these goblins so aggro? Use your escaping skills to bust out!

name: Shotgun vs Zombies
author: Addicting Games
description: One shotgun, 1 million zombies. I like those odds. There's zombies literally falling from the sky and only you, brandishing the world's baddest ballistics, can stop them. Upgrade your shotgun to its most shotgunniest by equipping rockets, grenades, and a bunch of other totally unnecessary -- and totally awesome -- weaponry.

name: Shotwars.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Shotwars.io is a shooting game. This is an arena fighter where all players spawn armed to the teeth and must seek out more weapons, more ammo, and finally blow each other away. It takes much skill to survive in the world of Shotwars.io where you'll be taking potshots at each other with all kinds of shotguns, AK47's, and bazookas. This is a game about aim and a game about survival. You'll be fighting toe to toe and face to face with other players from around the world in real-time. It is as thrilling as it is bizarre. Lock, load, and let's go.

name: Sift Heads Assault 2
author: Addicting Games
description: The sequel to Sift Heads Assault with more rivals and new bloody challenges.

name: Sift Renegade 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Third game in the Sift Renegade series. Kiro revisits his past back when his lost brother Keinji was still alive. Includes gruesome special skills and decapitating figurative heads. Upgrade and acquire new weapons to help you.

name: Sift Renegade 3: Expansion
author: Addicting Games
description: Sift Renegade 3: Expansion is a free stick game. Back to the past.

name: Ski King
author: Addicting Games
description: Ski-King is a free racing game. Winter is coming and you know what that means: skiing. Some people hate snow, some people love snow, some people live their whole lives without ever seeing or touching snow and some don't have an opinion on snow one way or another. This is a game for the people who love winter sports, and endless racing. Imagine if you will an algorithmically generated downhill map of obstacles, ramps, trees, rocks, and flags that must be obeyed. A game where you only ever get faster and build up points to show off to your friends. Ski-King is an endless racer-style game where the screen is flipped and instead of forward, you're heading down, towards the player. It is an interesting twist on the endless racer genre and it offers up a few obstacles and opportunities for players of all skill levels. In this game, you'll have to pay attention to the flags to know which direction to turn in true slalom style. Avoid trees, rocks, the flags themselves, and cliffs as you hurtle downhill towards victory. Last longer than any of your friends and be the king of the hill.

name: Ski Runner
author: Addicting Games
description: Ski Runner is a free avoider game. What, downhill skiing isn't enough for you? OK, eat the pills for major points. Just don't let the hallucinations distract you. Ten levels of mind-bending alpine action await. Strap in, baby!

name: Skillfite.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Skillfite.io is an io game that combines MMORPG, throwing you into live multiplayer showdowns against 100 players. Develop skills, craft gear, and team up or battle for loot. Train 5 skills, gather 17 different resources, and forge 20+ weapons and armor in this Gatarn Games-backed thrill with weekly updates. Prepare for gaming excitement!

name: Slacking School
author: Addicting Games
description: Slacking School is a free puzzle game that has several mini-games for you to quickly complete. School can be a bore especially when your teacher is talking about things that don’t interest you. That’s why you have to come up with fun and creative things to keep yourself entertained. Unfortunately, you have a strict teacher that likes to come around and check on you to make sure you’re taking notes. When the teacher is gone, click on one of the various mini-games and try to complete it before the teacher returns. There's a stacking game, an action game, and even a coloring game for you to select. This online game is set on a timer so try to complete all the games prior to that. The teacher’s time is random and may not give you enough time to finish all the mini-games. If the teacher catches you, you lose that level! Paint your nails and shoot paper balls in this funny and random online game.

name: Slaughterhouse Escape Deluxe
author: Addicting Games
description: Little Pig is about to be bacon! Help him avoid certain (but delicious) death on the slaughterhouse floor: Use power-ups, collect golden apples, and customize Little Pig to make his very short life a happy one. You're his last hope if he's going to escape the slaughterhouse!

name: Slay the GoblinZ Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Slay the GoblinZ on Steam now!

 

Slay the GoblinZ [Alpha] is a dark fantasy incremental RPG where you take on a job to exterminate goblins. Craft unique weapons, master deadly skills, and put an end to the Goblin Forefather.

name: Slay with Santa
author: Addicting Games
description: Where does Santa get all them pretty presents? Here is the secret: his special Santa blaster turns nasty, bile vomiting beasties into desirable consumer goods! Neat trick, huh? Get your holiday blast-o-rama off to a hot start with Santa. Slay Bells Ring a Ding Ding, Baby!

name: Slayerz.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Slayerz.io is a free iogame. Alright, Jarhead. This is the first day of the rest of your life. You're gonna need a rifle, a side-arm, your helmet, a little luck, and a lot of grit if you're going to make it in this man's war. Slayerz.io is a free IOGame that gets right to the heart of conflict. All the politics and the red-tape is gone, in Slayerz.io there is only you and your will to survive in a cutthroat battle to the death against other players and enemies from around the world. You might think you know IOGames and you might think you know FPS games but you don't know them like this, you don't know the heart and the soul of violent combat until you play Slayerz.io. The world of slayerz.io is a gritty shoot or be shot, live and let die style of arena massacre. This is a game for the hardest of the hardcore, gamers who have slaughtered their way through the rest and are ready to compete with the best. This is an iogame, so, the competition you face will not be AI bots wandering around in a haze, but rather, real live humans wandering around in a haze. In this game, you can customize your avatar, choose your weapon, sharpen your skills and jump into the arena to prove your worth, test your meddle, and become the ultimate slayer.  Slaerz.io is an online first-person shooter in the popular .io genre of gaming. Defeat your opponents; collect coins; buy cosmetics and gun skins; become number one on the leaderboard.

name: Slay.one
author: Addicting Games
description: A fast-paced, indie, 2D, multiplayer, top-down shooter

name: Slices
author: Addicting Games
description:
Dive into the delightful challenge of Slices, a captivating puzzle arcade game where your objective is to assemble as many complete watermelons as possible. With each slice, strategize your moves to create neat piles and maximize your score in this addictive fruit-fueled adventure.

Test your skills and reflexes as you slice through juicy watermelons, aiming for perfection in each arrangement. With no levels to hold you back, the thrill of beating your own high score drives the gameplay, offering endless replayability and satisfaction.

name: Slide Fit
author: Addicting Games
description: Slide Fit is a free puzzle game.

name: Slime Love
author: Addicting Games
description:
Slime Love is an adorable clicker game based on love! These star-crossed lovers just want to be together but one is stuck in an unusual puzzle room. Your objective is to figure out how to grab the love key and then hop on out of the area into the portal that will appear. There are obstacles that you may need to hop over as your character goes left and right after it hits the wall or other thing. There are 30 levels in this fun puzzle game that are waiting to be solved by you. Sometimes there are then one love keys that you need to grab in order to open the special portal that will take you back to your love. If you get yourself killed in the name of love, don’t worry! You can replay the level as many times as you need to figure out the best way to get to your goal. Play this online game about a slime in love that wants to return to his beloved. After you pass each level, the next one will be more difficult than the last.

.

name: Slime Rage
author: Addicting Games
description: Don't make this slime angry! It might just split into multiple parts and wreak more havok! Seriously, how does slime manage to get everywhere and anywhere? Like, we octopi not liquid enough? Anyway, help this slime escape and exact its revenge, satisfy its rage!

name: Slingshot VS Monsters
author: Addicting Games
description: Slingshot VS Monsters is a free physics-action game. The monsters are already here and the only one who can stop them is you and your trusty slingshot. This is a game not unlike the ages-old tale of David and Goliath. As a monstrous horde of invading evil is descending upon your humble town the only weapon that can stop them is a slingshot that wields colored balls. You will have to master the science and art of physics if you want to take down these baddies. Gravity can be your friend if you have the gumption and the will it takes to carve graceful firing lines through its oppressive pull. In this game, you'll have to make sure to use a like-colored ball to take down like-colored monsters. Yellow balls for yellow monsters, red balls for red monsters, and so on. If you fire the wrong colored ball at one of the monsters then it'll simply bounce off and have no effect. There is but one exception to this sacred rule: the black ball. The black ball is wild, it is chaotic. A black ball has the ability to vanquish any monster. Use them wisely when they pop up and pay attention to when the monsters themselves change colors because when they turn metallic grey they become momentarily unstoppable.

name: Slush.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Slush.io is a free online race and io game. Welcome to the great big race in the sky where you can make your very own custom courses and go nuts. This is a platform based racing game where you can create your very own custom race tracks by simply drawing a few lines. You can also pick from an assortment of pre-made powerups like ramps, turbo-chargers, springs, spikes, lava, a bunch of stuff like that. It's all exactly like the kind of stuff you'd expect to see in a racing game except you're the one making it. Once you've created your own track, give it a name and then invite some of your real-life or online friends into the game to challenge them. The best part of Slush.io isn't just that you race against boring old bots or other players from around the world, no, in this game you can challenge one of your friends to a race and show them what its really all about. Settle your Facebook arguments, twitter beef, and DM drama with a quick head to head in this vicious and addictive race game.

name: Smart Cupcake Stand
author: Addicting Games
description: Smart Cupcake Stand is a time-management game that incorporates math practice. Working in a cupcake shop can be tough, especially when each customer wants a custom order. On top of these unique orders, these customers have little patience and you must create the cupcake as quickly as you can! Once you’re done playing a round of the game, you will be served math questions that you must answer correctly in order to unlock another session. There are various math skills you can choose from like fractions, multiplication, geometry, and even statistics. This is a unique type of educational game that helps break up studying with a fun game!

name: Smartle
author: Addicting Games
description:
Smartle is a daily word puzzle game where you rearrange letters to create horizontal 5-letter words. Train your brain, improve your vocabulary and solve a new word puzzle every day.

The game is easy to understand but can become surprisingly challenging as you search for the correct word. Some puzzles can be solved quickly, while others require careful thinking and pattern recognition.

Smartle includes multiple game modes:

*

Daily Mode - solve one unique puzzle every day

*

Sprint Mode - race against the clock and solve puzzles as fast as possible

*

Archive Mode - play daily puzzles from previous days anytime you want

Whether you want a relaxing brain teaser or a fast-paced word challenge, Smartle is designed for players who enjoy word games, logic puzzles and casual brain training.

name: Smarty Bubbles
author: Addicting Games
description: Smarty Bubbles is an addictive bubble shooting game. In Smarty Bubbles you are in control of a colorful canon that fires orbs of different colored ammo. It is your mission to match colors in groups of three or more and get combos to disappear the variety of colors from the map. The longer you wait to make your shot the more likely the wall of colors is to slowly creep towards you. You'll have to think fast and aim true but also think about where you're landing the bubbles. Remember, a well-placed shot can knock off massive chunks of the rainbow wall if you place the shots perfectly by banking them off of the wall. Strike at a hidden artery of the wall and bring the whole thing down for bonus points. You are the commander in charge of this game and it is your mission to maximize your points by optimizing each of your shots to achieve the ultimate in damage. This is war and you are the last general in the rainbow army.

name: Snail Bob 2
author: Addicting Games
description: A dangerous forest stands between Snail Bob and his Grandpa's birthday party! Figure out how to get him there safely.

name: Snake Condo
author: Addicting Games
description: Snake Condo is a snake-themed avoider game. Become a blip that beeps their way to the top in this challenging but fulfilling avoider game. The interface is simple, all you have to do is click to the left or click to the right. This will guide your cube. The goal of the game is to collect the most yellow cubes and let them flow behind you like the tail of a long, pixelated snake. Your score will be based upon how long you're able to stay alive and staying alive will be no easy feat. In this game, there are dozens of obstacles, everything from rocks to cubes to rival snakes. The journey before you is long and perilous but you can do it. You can win, you can show them all. While you're slithering you'll see the stalks of carrots sticking out of the ground. It is in your best interest to seek these carrots out and collect them. While the carrots do not have an effect on your score or any abilities you may have within the game itself, you. can use them to purchase luxury goods. In between games you can use the carrots as a currency that will let you buy hats, glasses, custom paint scheme and all sorts of other cool items. It is worth collecting to see what is available.

name: Snake Go!
author: Addicting Games
description: Snakes can't stop, and they won't stop, they have to go, right now! Maneuver the snake through the various obstacles. Each level adds a new challenge, and each path needed will be different. Can you complete each and every level?

name: Snake Rush
author: Addicting Games
description: Snake Rush is a free mobile, avoider game. Get your pointing fingers ready and prepare to slither your way through level after level of obstacles. In this snakey fun game, you'll be forced to guide your snake-friend through a maze made up of dangerous shapes. If you were to guide the snake into one of these obstacles it would be certain death. Your job is to regulate the speed, direction, and overall velocity of the snake and make sure it never smashes or crashes into the walls all around it. If you are able to accomplish this feat you'll make it to the end of the level. Your score will be based on your speed and not your accuracy because even one mistake would mean certain doom for you and your snake. This is a fast and fun mobile game for people who appreciate free, fast, and fun mobile games. So, try it an tell a friend.

name: Snakes and Circles
author: Addicting Games
description: Snakes and Circles is a free-avoider game. You are a snake made out of an infinite series of glowing orbs. Your only goal in life is to feast upon circles of light that are the same color as you, it sounds easy but as you slither through life you will encounter horizontal beams of light which will alter your very being. As you pass through the horizontal beams of light you will take on their color. In doing so this means that you will change colors and thus be forced to consume the glowing circles of that new color. You will have to change course mid-slither in order to survive for if you were to accidentally lose track of your own hue then you might eat the wrong color and die. Boom. Game over and no points. So, pay attention. Snakes and Circles is a fun and fast-paced game of avoiding, chasing, colors and fun. It is an endless racer-style game that only ends when you die and you only die when you screw up, so, don't screw up.

name: Sneaky Sniper
author: Addicting Games
description: Sneaky Sniper is a free stick game. Tip toe through these missions, you guys.

name: Sniper Assassin 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Sniper Assassin 2 is a free shooting game. It is also  the sequel to your favorite online shooter game, Sniper Assassin. Sniper Assassin 2 continues with Shawn’s story as both an agent for the government and a paid assassin. Unfortunately, someone figured out his identity and his wife was killed as a result. Angry and grieving, now he’s out to look for his wife’s killer and there’s no stopping him. On top of doing the government’s dirty work, he still takes petty missions from average citizens looking to get rid of annoying neighbors or wanting justice from unpunished criminals. Whatever the reason, it doesn’t really matter to Shawn. As long he’s getting paid the big bucks, it doesn’t matter who he has to take out. In this online game, you play as Shawn, a cold-blooded assassin with a rifle and a scope. This shooter game is simple, take out your targets but don’t harm any civilians or you’ll lose the mission.

name: Sniper Assassin 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Sniper Assassin 3 is a free sniper game. Put your skills to the test in this game puzzle game, and help elite sniper Shawn Davidson get the revenge he so desperately wants in this third installment of the Sniper Assassin series. Much like the previous games, in Sniper Assassin 3, you’re embarking on a series of missions, all of which with a specific target (or targets) that you must discover and take care of. The trick is discovering how to complete each mission. Make the wrong move, and it’s over.

name: Sniper Assassin 5: Final Mission
author: Addicting Games
description: Sniper Assassin 5: Final Mission is a free sniper game. It’s been a rough few months for old Shawn, but the end is finally in sight in this puzzle/action game. Shawn’s in deep at this point, and it’s up to you to help see him through this ordeal. In this final chapter of the Sniper Assassin saga, you’re chasing down the man responsible for everything in a series of puzzle-based sniper scenarios. Will he pay for what he’s done, or will he only be making a fool out of poor old Shawn?

name: Sniper Team
author: Addicting Games
description: Sniper Team is a puzzling, first person shooting game. Gather your squad and defend the objective against your enemies in this first-person action game. In Sniper Team, it’s up to you and your three squad mates to defend the objective from being destroyed. You’re fixed in a specific location, and you can’t move. But that’s why there are four of you. Enemies will come from multiple directions, and you’ll have to switch between the members of your squad to take care of all the enemies. Defeat them all, and you move on to the next mission for an even more challenging scenario. Be on the lookout for more difficult enemies, as well as supply drops that can give you a cash boost. Defeating enemies also grants you experience and money. The experience levels you up, unlocking new items that you can buy for your squad members.

name: Snow Queen 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Snow Queen 3 is a unique matching game that requires strategic thinking! The Snow Queen is back in the third installment of this matching series. She has once again frozen everything and the elves are trapped! It is up to you to match together the stones to free different elements in order to break the spell. While other matching games require senseless matching, this online game has goals that you must reach to pass each level. For instance, in the first level, you must set free all the pieces of a butterfly in order to win that level. Watch the timer because if you run out of time, you lose the level. There are 25 levels of this adventurous matching game for you to solve in order to defeat the snow queen!

name: Snow Queen 5
author: Addicting Games
description: Snow Queen 5 is a free jewel game. The Snow Queen is here, she is back, and she is looking for revenge. It will be up to you to generate the energy and the power needed in order to devestate the queen herself. You'll have to mine the energy by matching your way through the jewel mines. All you have to do is swap, swipe, and drag the rows or columns of the jewels in order to line up at least three of like colors. Can you do it? We think you can, in fact we know you can. Another thing we know is that once you get started you're going to love it. Games like these are a lot of fun and after all the Snow Queen wouldn't keep coming back if she wasn't having fun herself. So, anyway, get swiping! This is the ultimate free match 3 games. Whether you want to match the jewels, ornaments, spheres, or all sorts of other glittering bulbs. Just get three in a row and you'll be on your way to victory. Most importantly you'll be able to appease the dreaded Snow Queen. Some say the snow queen is nice, some say she is not really so nice. In our opinion, she is honestly fine but she is very picky and like other monarchs, she didn't exactly work for her position so there is a certain amount of entitlement.
