The Snow Queen also doesn't know much about the match 3 industry.

name: Snow Rally
author: Addicting Games
description: Snow Rally is a free racing game. Move fast and move often. In Snow Rally, you're a 4x4 jeep trecking their way across the northwest. Hop in and slam on the accelerator as you navigate the hills and valleys of this sprawling racing game. Collect coins in order to buy upgrades for your offroader so you can fully optimize your ability to trek and explore. Tame the wild with the sheer will power of your steely nerved determination as you jump, swerve, and flip your way to victory. Earn extra points by flipping, spinning and jamming your way into the future. You may be stuck behind the wheel of a 4x4 but that doesn't mean you can't explore the world.

name: Soakamon
author: Addicting Games
description: Master the pee balloon. It’s the only way to win. Soak your jaunty opponent until he goes home crying to his mommy.

name: Soccer Kicks
author: Addicting Games
description: Soccer Kicks is a sports game where your objective is to hit the target inside of the net. This is an easy soccer game with cute and bright animation. The game is fitted to be played on a smartphone but you can also play it on your computer. It’s not enough just to get the ball in the net, you have to hit a target that may or may not be moving. On top of hitting an unpredictable target, sometimes you have to avoid a determined goalie. Look out for stars that you can earn by hitting the target. Miss 3 times and you’re out! At the end of each game session, you’ll see your most recent and best score. Play, again and again, to beat your own score every time. The more you play this online sports game, the better you’ll get.

name: Soccer Pro
author: Addicting Games
description: Play as a soccer superstar. Avoid incoming opponents. They'll try to tackle you into submission. How many goals can you score?

name: Soldier Attack 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Shoot, shoot, and shoot some more.

name: Soldiers Fury
author: Addicting Games
description: Soldiers Fury is a free shooter game. In this game, you will help a lowly soldier of fortune become a soldier of fury and maybe if you're lucky, a soldier of fame. Soldier Fury is an endless shooter game where you will wade through dozens of enemies and just never stop shooting. That is all you do.  Pick up different weapons, pick up health packs, collect upgrades, cool stuff like that. It is actually a lot of fun and you're gonna like it. So, lock and load and let's go because this is a game of kings, a game of queens, and a game of shooters. If you have the grit, the gunpowder, and the guts maybe you'll be able to turn some of that soldier's fury into some soldier's fortune. If not you might wind up blown to bits at the boots of your enemies. Either way, you'll probably have a lot of fun getting there and know that we are beside you every step of the way in spirit.

name: Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Solitaire is a free solitaire game. Over a hundred years ago, this classic computer game was played with a deck of cards. No kidding. Back then, it was unusual to play a game by yourself.

name: Solitaire Grande
author: Addicting Games
description: Solitaire Grande is a free card game.

name: Solitaire Legend
author: Addicting Games
description: Become a legend in the single-player card game world.

name: Solitaire Master Logic
author: Addicting Games
description: Solitaire Master is a free card game.

name: Solitaire TriPeaks Garden
author: Addicting Games
description: Solitaire TriPeaks Garden is a free Solitaire game. Welcome to the most romantic garden in the world. As the t-shirts say 'Gardens are for lovers.' Indeed. And we hope you love card games as much as you love your significant other, especially solitaire card games! That is what Solitaire Tri-Peaks Gardens is, a solitaire card game. It is in the genre of solitaire card games where you the player must use simple pattern recognition in order to make a pile of cards disappear. In this case, the pile of cards will be drawn one by one. If you do not see the card that you need, please, feel free to click through the deck until you do. But beware! This game is timed, it is scored, and for every card, you draw that you don't need you're really just pushing yourself farther and farther away from a high score. A high score can be shared with your friends and used to challenge them. So, put down that baguette and take off your beret. It is time to surrender to temptation and play Solitaire Tripeaks Garden.

name: Solitaire Tripeaks Harvest
author: Addicting Games
description: Solitaire Tripeaks Harvest is a free card game. Most solitaire games have some random theme pasted on, but not Solitaire Tripeaks Harvest. This version of Solitaire Tripeaks Harvest is old school and it doesn't pull any punches. This is a game that gets right to the point and just lets you have a little fun slowly organizing different sets of cars. Solitaire Tripeaks Harvest is a card sorting and organizing game where you will be sorting and organizing cards in numerical order, ordered by suit, and ordered by color. It is up to you to figure out how to do it and then hunker on down and make it happen. Did you know that after you shuffle a deck of 52 cards the chances of it being the same shuffle as another deck of the same cards are so astronomically small that it basically never happens? Isn't that crazy? We think it's crazy and we also think it's cool. That is why solitaire is cool. If you think solitaire is cool or even if you don't then we think you should play this game.

name: Sp1der Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Spider Solitaire is a free card game.

name: Space
author: Addicting Games
description:
Command your spaceship as you blaze across the cosmos, strategically capturing territory by enclosing it with your energy trail. Outmaneuver rivals by cutting across their trails, vaporizing them in spectacular collisions. Stay vigilant, outside your own territory you are vulnerable to others crossing your own trail. Expand your territory and dominate the galaxy in this thrilling game of strategy, speed, and cosmic survival.

Mechanics

Objective

Capture 100% of the map as quickly as you can, killing as many enemies as possible.

Capture Territory Fly outside your territory and fly back in to capture territory. You are safe within your own territory and vulnerable outside of it.

Boost

Collect gas to fill your boost meter. You can boost on demand as long as there is gas in your tank.

Kill Enemies

Hit an enemy trail to kill them. If your trail is hit by another player or by yourself, you die.

name: Space Friends Shooter
author: Addicting Games
description: Space Friends Shooter is a space-themed avoider game. In space, no one can hear you avoid. The whole galaxy is full of space junk. The universe is one great big dumpster and if you wanna get anywhere you're going to have to blast your way through it. Choose the color of your UFO, then pick whether or not you identify as a dog or a cat. Then hop into your craft and let's go! You'll have to avoid astronauts, asteroids, planets, suns, satellites, space stations and abandoned space ships as you fly through the dumpster fire that is our universe. Collect ammunition as the game speeds up and use the spae-bar to blast errant trash out of the sky. There are also health power-ups and shield upgrades which you can claim in order to try and stay alive. The farther you get the harder it gets. More trash moving at faster speeds, thus, the game is amazingly realistic. Whatever your strategy is you can prove yourself in the great beyond by avoiding, blasting, and staying alive.

name: Space Pilot
author: Addicting Games
description: Less space than you'd like.

name: Space Rocket
author: Addicting Games
description: Space Rocket is a free mobile game. Welcome to the final frontier. A world where gravity is a distant memory and the only real rule is speed and the immortal science of reflexes. In this game, you'll take to the stars and beyond while you dodge satellites, avoid asteroids and keep your distance from the alien baddies. In space, no one can hear you win, so, you'll have to announce your victories by screaming into the void or signing up for an account and rocketing up our very own leaderboard. This is a fast-action game where all you have to do is swipe, swoosh, dash, and dodge if you want to make it to the top of the world and beyond. Space Rocket is a fast and furious game that requires a quick hand and a steady eye. If you truly want to succeed in this game you'll have to hunker down and let it go! Space is chaos, a never-ending void that is just waiting to be explored and conquered. As the premeire Space Rocket, it is your job to do the scouting and find a place to land and live.

name: Spank the Monkey
author: Addicting Games
description: Keep your pants on and see how fast you can send this monkey sailing. Will this plastic little critter reach the upper atmosphere?

name: Spear Stickman

description: Don't get wrecked.

description: Speed Dating is a free dating simulator. Do you compliment the hair or ask their sign? Or do you mention your favorite sport? Kurt Cobain or Mozart?? QUICK! ANSWER!! Oh no, too late; FAIL. Better answer right next time!

name: Speed Rush
author: Addicting Games
description: Speed Rush is a free racing game.

name: Speedboats.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Speedboats.io is a shooter game. Rev your engine, load your weapon and lets rock and roll. In Speedboats.io you may be on a boat but the vibe is anything but chill, no sir, in this game its kill or be killed as you speed through columns, avoid rocks, and try to keep yourself afloat just long enough to get in some kill shots. Speedboats.io is a wet and wild ride with endless ammo and an aesthetic boat that should help you blast boredom. In Speedboats.io you'll wanna run and gun because the other players are just as fast and just as deadly as you. There is no time to snipe and get the perfect shot. If you stay still too long you're liable to get hit by a more savvy player. You're gonna have to think like a shark, always moving, and always winning. If you want to be the perfect killing machine you'll have to marry your tactics to your aim. The reticule in this game is untethered from the boat itself, thus you can spray and pray any number of targets as you're going the other way. If someone gets on your six then just turn around and blast em.

name: Spike Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Spike Solitaire is a card game with a detective theme! There is nothing like a theme to spruce up a solitaire game. The detective in this game is searching for some clues, while you are searching for the cards you will need. The cards and backgrounds are shrouded in the mystery theme but the objective of this online card game remains the same. There are 3 levels in this solitaire game, and each one is timed. You must solve each game before the timer runs out! Once you have solved all 3 levels, your final score will be automatically submitted. Check the scoreboard to see if you are one of the top card players!

name: Spin N Win
author: Addicting Games
description: Spin N Win is an online casino game that has several modes to play! You don’t have to empty out your pockets for this online game, it’s all in good fun. There are several mini-games to play within sessions of spinning the wheel. Find games like wack a’ mole, slots, scratchers, and even hangman! The main goal of this game is to spin the wheel and hope lady luck is on your side. If you have an unlucky day, just try a different mode to play a different round. There are three game modes for you to choose from Quick Cash, Marathon, and Fortune. Select Quick Cash for a quick spin of the wheel and some in-between games. Marathon is a game of 50 spins. While Fortune is dependent on the least amount of spins to earn a specific goal. No money is needed for this simple casino game that has loads of options for you to choose from.

name: Spitball Warrior
author: Addicting Games
description: At last, spitball without that awful paper aftertaste! Paste your many frenemies to your heart's content. At least, until you get plastered.

name: Spite Cannon
author: Addicting Games
description: Spite Cannon is a free shooter game. It seems these blocks don't like being shot with a cannon. Tough nuts! Blast away, reducing blocks to dust, and buying awesome upgrades along the way!

name: Splat Em
author: Addicting Games
description: There are many celebrities here to hit with a variety of materials. Pick Osama, GW Bush, Brittany Spears and more, and throw cake, pies, or poop at them.

name: Split Ball
author: Addicting Games
description: Split Ball is a free puzzle game. Everything is splitting in two, the world, this game, and even you. In this game, you take control of the binary and split the world like so many hairs in a pedantic argument. as the balls spin and bounce carefree through the level your job is to break up their fun by building a wall and blocking them all off. You need to hit a certain percentage of filling the board before you're able to move on. As the game goes on the amount you're supposed to fill in gets higher. but don't worry, you'll never fail because as the game goes on you get better and better. This is a game of reflexes, strategy, and the tactics that hold it all together. Split Ball is a classic game that you may have heard whispered about in hushed voices as people tell tales of their trials and triumphs. It is a fun game, an old game, and inevitably a fulfilling game.

name: Spooky Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Spooky Mahjong is a mahjong game created with horror-themed tiles. If you are into creepy stories and scary movies, then you will love this puzzle game. Instead of matching traditional tiles, match tiles with images of monsters. There are ghosts, bats, mummies, devils, and witches on the tiles to match. The tiles are set against eerie background images of cemeteries, abandoned houses, pirate ships, and more. There are 30 levels of this online game for you to play! Each level is timed, and you must complete it on time to advance to the next level. With every game, you will find different patterns that will present their own challenge. If you get stuck, the game will automatically give you hints by highlighting available tiles. If you run out of moves, the game will automatically shuffle to help you out. Submit your high score to see your username at the top of the list!

name: Sports Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Sports Mahjong is a free Mahjong game. Finally a game of mahjong for jocks! If you've always been more of a sports head and less of a strategy-type person then we think we've found a game for you: Sports Mahjong! Take a look at all of these cool mahjong tiles all based on Olympic sports like archery, the javelin, weightlifting, and whatever. All that stuff, all the stuff you've heard about on T.V or had to do in gym class, it's all here, and now it's in mahjong form. Mahjong is a classic strategy game that has been around for hundreds of years. It is something that comes standard on most PC's ad can be found in most retirement homes. It is a fun and fulfilling game of tactics and pattern recognition.

name: Spot The Difference Daily
author: Addicting Games
description: Spot the Difference Daily is a puzzle game where you must spot the differences between two images. No, we’re not pranking you as Jim does with Dwight! There are 10 differences between the two images you are seeing. Some of the differences may be obvious, but others won’t be easy to catch. Check every nook and cranny before throwing in the towel, and taking a hint. Your score is determined by the amount of time you take to solve the puzzle. The faster you solve it, the better your score. Wrong guesses and hints add time to your score. Play quickly and become one of the top players of this online puzzle game. Tune in every day for a new puzzle to solve! You can join Shockwave Unlimited, our sister site if you want to play more puzzle games.

name: Sprockets Jump
author: Addicting Games
description: Sprockets is a free mobile game. In Sprocket just like in real life you are but a node trying to blip and bloop your way out from the chaos. As the world spins around you you'll have to think fast and move faster, make tactical decisions that keep you moving so you can get to the outer ring. In Sprocket, you are trying to make your way from the center of the screen to the outer rim of a forever spiraling vortex. All you need to do in order to accomplish this is click. That is it. You just simply click once at the right time and in the right space and your bleep will bloop themselves over the edge of the spinning platform you currently occupy. The problem is that the platforms are constantly spinning and you're trying to land on a platform that is also constantly spinning. All you have to accomplish your task is your sense of timing and reflexes. This game offers you no power-ups and no upgrades. You have no stats to toggle and no way to cheat. It's just you and the vortex spinning to infinity.

name: Squadd.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Squadd.io is a free iogame. Welcome to the cube arena, it is a dangerous, edgy world where only the dangerous survive. If you want to take on the world then this is the game for you because you get to customize your character, name them, arm them, and then set them loose in a world full of bots, bombs, laser-guided rockets, and real-live opponents. That is right. In this game you won't just be taking on bots programmed by some nerd, you'll be going toe to toe with the rest of the world. Other people just like you are sitting on their computer and they're playing, learning, iterating their strategy, and taking aim at everything you do. You may be smarter than one of them but are you better than all of them? Do you dare take on the entire world? Well, in Squadd.io you can, you will, and you might end up regretting it to be honest. This is a fun game with tons of upgrades, items, and abilities. Ping your friends and make it personal with a squad of your own.

name: Squeezer
author: Addicting Games
description: Squeezer is a free clicker game where you get to play as a creepy eyeball that is traveling up a maze-like path. This is a simple online game with simple animation that changes with every session. The neon-colored background changes from purple to blue to green and other fun colors. Each time you play as a black little eyeball that you will help navigate through dangerous obstacles. However, the dangers you encounter vary from spinning spiked circles to two simple lines. Be careful not to touch any part of the obstacle or else you lose that game session. Whatever the obstacle, each one you pass earns you a point. Click on the “leaders” icon to see where you rank against other Squeezer players. Play, again and again, to beat your own score and to rise up the scoreboards. This is an easy online game that you can play from your computer or mobile device for hours and hours. No tutorial needed for this clicker game. Just start clicking away!

name: Squirrel Hunt
author: Addicting Games
description: To some folk, squirrels are pets. Remove the pests from the premises, please!

name: Stabfish2.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Stabfish2.io is a free iogame.

name: Stack Colors
author: Addicting Games
description: Stack Colors is a free mobile game. Warm-up those legs and get ready to stack them colors in this endless runner-style avoider game. In this game, you'll be forced to run as fast as you can through an obstacle course full of differently colored blocks. Your mission is to collect as many blocks as possible while also avoiding the differently colored blocks that are scattered around the field of play. In order to do this, you'll have to move fast and think even faster. Avoid the pillars for they will certainly spell doom. Your only hope at winning enough coin to upgrade your runner is to pay attention and move as fast as you can. This is a game of quick reflexes and the ability to see two moves ahead. Will you defeat the never-ending platform of doom or will you die like all the rest?

name: Star Trek Academy Trainer
author: Addicting Games
description: Explore the universe by becoming a cadet in Starfleet. Take a variety of aptitude tests, to help determine your rank and suggested career path!  Don't forget to see the Star Trek movie in theaters, 05.08.09!

name: Starving Artist
author: Addicting Games
description:
Starving Artist is a unique and free puzzle game. Get ready to add your name to the ranks of legendary artists with Starving Artist. In this new and completely unique game, you'll be trying to create and sell your own original art within the games market. You're trying to earn money to keep your paint supply levels filled up. The game will provide you with the front page of a newspaper that tells you about all of the world events of the day. You'll need to decipher the clues and figure out what colors, shapes, and patterns you need to use in order to really capture the zeitgeist and make the big bucks.

Pay careful and close attention to the headlines themselves and the words used. Do they mention colors, shapes, feelings? Can you replicate what they are talking about using the colors you have? If you can and you manage to please the games Artificial Intelligence then you can sell your paintings for a mint. If not you'll be at the back of the breadline like the starving artist you are. It'sd a free market and only the best of the best will rise to the top. If you believe that, oh, boy have we got a game to sell you
! It's Starving Artist, a great new fun game for people who like puzzles, creativity, and unique game play experiences.

name: States of Austria
author: Addicting Games
description: States of Austria is a geography game that will help increase your knowledge of Austria! Whether you are a geography nerd or if you are completely lacking in the geography department, then check out this educational game. There are only 8 states of Austria that you need to memorize to win in this online game. Find states of Austria like Karten, Tirol, Steiermark, and others. Play until you get each one right without any errors proving you are the map expert! This online game teaches you as you go because it is all about education. Even if you get the answer wrong, it will show you the name of the state you did select. Additionally, it will show you the right answer if you get it wrong 3 times. With this educational game, you can play it over and over again until you completely nail it keeping all 100 of your points.

name: States of Brazil
author: Addicting Games
description: States of Brazil is an educational game about the states of Brazil. The key to learning geography is repetition, and this online game does just that. Play this map game over and over again until you memorize every state in Brazil. Tocantins, Acre, and Santa Catarina are just 3 of the 27 beautiful states of Brazil that you must identify. There are many reasons why anyone would want to learn about Brazil’s geography. Maybe you want to visit the country or maybe you need to study for a geography test. Maybe you just like having a vast knowledge of geography! Whatever the reason, do not hesitate to play this fun quiz game about the states of brazil. Play Geography has a vast series of map games to help expand your knowledge.

name: States of Mexico
author: Addicting Games
description: States of Mexico is a free geography game. Welcome to Mexico, a beautiful country is known for its vibrant culture and cool flag. Mexico, like other countries, has broken its total territory up into small states. Do you think you could name those states if you were randomly asked to point them out on a map? Well, you better hope so because that is what this game is all about. In this fun and exciting quiz-style game, you will have the opportunity to go south of the border and visit Mexico one state at a time as you sharpen your knowledge and learn all about the big beautiful world all around you. Mexico is a fun country full of great people and if you can't name a state then this is the game for you, or, if you think you are the expert on Mexico then step on up and show us what you got.

name: Stealing the Diamond
author: Addicting Games
description: How do you steal the world's biggest jewel? With the world's biggest stones, obviously! Not only does Henry Stickman have them, he gets kicked in them over and over again in Stealing the Diamond. Failure has never been so fun.

name: Stick Hero
author: Addicting Games
description: Become the white knight of a fair maiden's dreams or dawn the silky black. pajamas of a ninja assassin. In Stick Hero, the choice is yours! Not only will you be able to choose between a variety of stock heroes like ninjas, knights, tanks, soldiers, mechs, aliens --and more-- you'll have to customize a side-scrolling platform adventure for each of them. Finally! an adventure in which you are in full control! Devise obstacles, and traps, choose from an army of minions. Toggle heir stats, and actions and set them loose in a dungeon, in a jungle, in a forbidden forest or any location you can imagine! Then, save the game and share it with your unsuspecting friends. Do you have what it takes to trick those you care about and know best into losing at a game of your own devising? Will they be able to outsmart, outplay, and out think you? Will your army of robots, demons, and other mischevious minions be enough to hold the hero at bay? Find out in Stick Hero! The game you design, you build, and you control!

name: Stick Running
author: Addicting Games
description: Try to stick your landing.

name: Stick War
author: Addicting Games
description: Stick War is a free desktop strategy game.   This is the ultimate base defense game online. Prove that you are the greatest Stick King in the land by defeating all of your stick opponents. In this real time strategy game, defend the statue of your king while simultaneously trying to destroy the statue of your enemy. Build miners to harvest gold, and then use that gold to purchase units. Those units will be your front-line defense against the enemy, and your means of destroying the statue. Progress through multiple levels, unlocking additional units along the way, until proving to the stick world that you are the one true Stick King.

name: Stick War 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Turn-based stick-figure warfare for the ages!

name: Sticklets
author: Addicting Games
description: Sticklets is a puzzle game where you must help your characters to get to the portal at the end of each level. This is an online game that tests your cognitive skills. Help the sticklets get through various obstacles like cliffs, mountains, holes, and other dangers. You have the option to use different strategies to get to each challenge. You can use dynamite, build a ladder, build a bridge, float down with an umbrella, or drill through rock. Which tool should you use to get to the next step? On top of figuring out which tool you use, test your math skills to be able to get to the next step of this online game. This puzzle game offers math skills from preschool to the 8th grade. There is counting, addition, algebra, and geometry! Get through all 24 levels of this platform game and beat them all!

name: Stickman Biker
author: Addicting Games
description: Stickman Biker is a free balance game. Welcome sticks, stickettes, and stox of all ages. We are here to humbly present to you what is without a doubt the ultimate stick-balance game. Now, remember, if you're gonna succeed in the fast-paced, highly competitive world of Stickman Biking then: rev, charge, balance & brake your way to victory.  There isn't a hill you can't climb, a slope you can't overcome or a valley you won't dominate if you master the art of revving up, balancing on the brink, charging the hills and braking when the situation requires it. Stickman Dirt Bike is a smart physics action game that puts your dexterity and puzzle muscles to the test. If you truly want to end each level by fading into the darkness and disappearing to thee great leader-board in the sky, then this is the game you've been waiting for. The first, best, and most played stickman racing game too have ever hit the net.

name: Stickman Madness 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Stickman Madness 3 is a free towwwer defense game. Swarming stickmen come to ruin your picnic! Shoot them all! Beware - the longer you live, the stronger your enemy becomes. Don't forget your upgrades!

name: Stickman Slaughter
author: Addicting Games
description: Stickman Slaughter is a free stick game.

name: Stickman Swing
author: Addicting Games
description: Stickman Swing is a free puzzle game where you must act fast to swing the stickman past the finish line. If you thought stickman games were a thing of the past, then you’re terribly wrong. Play this modernized version of stickman games with a mobile-friendly screen. Your goal is to help this stickman swing and bounce his way to the finish line. This is a pinball-style game where you use the surroundings to toss around the stickman character until you beat the level. There are bars that he can bounce off and use to his advantage. Then there are circles that become swings when you click on the screen. Pass all the levels and unlock cool character skins like a ninja costume and superhero outfit. Hurry and play this fun and free puzzle game!

name: Sticky Balls
author: Addicting Games
description: Sticky Balls is a  free clicker and match 3 game. The balls are here and it's either stick or be sticky in Sticky Balls, a fast-paced puzzle game. Multiple colored balls are falling and as they fall they automatically connect with other like-colored balls in the test tube of doom. your goal is to click on the largest groupings of the like-colored balls in order to make them disappear and gain points. More balls are going to fall and if too many fall then they'll fill the test tube and end the level. Click strategically if you want the balls to disappear in a specific order and thus reveal even more balls. The game is designed to make you click fast and click often as you try to combine balls and make everything disappear for the ultimate optimization of your points. You'll love Sticky Balls, a game that people love to play and play to win. If you like matching, distractions, and balls then you will absolutely love playing this free puzzle game.

name: Storm the House 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Storm the House 2 is a free tower defense game. Those pesky stickfigures are at it again! Defend your castle from the ravages of their pokey sticks. Hire additional gunmen and upgrade your weapons.

name: Street Ball Star
author: Addicting Games
description: Street Ball Star is a free basketball game. Get ready to live out your hoop dreams in this fantastic physics simulator. This is a basketball game that is set on the streets, not a fancy basketball court, but maybe if you ball hard enough, sharpen your short throws and keep your eye on the ball you'll make it to the big leagues. Street Ball Star is a physics game that tests your ability to aim a ball from the floor of the court to the rim of the basket. You'll have to learn the physics of the world as your grapple with gravity trying to pull the ball away from the net. This game doesn't just test your skills but it helps you work on them as you play. You'll be able to hone your instincts as your shoot for glory in this thrilling basketball simulator. One of our personal favorite sports games and possibly one of the best out there. Many people are saying it, you're hearing it more and more: Street Ball Star is a game for heroes on the court and beyond the keyboard.

name: Street Pursuit
author: Addicting Games
description: Street Pursuit is a free racing game. In this racing game, you'll have to be quick, nimble, and out-think the cops as you twist and turn your way through a suburban maze of hedges, walls, houses, and barricades set up to stop you in your tracks. Try to collect as much cash as you can in order to unlock better cars and new levels. Beware the police cars that freckle the landscape and will try to smash into you and take you down. Each hit from a cop won't slow you down too much but it will remove some money from your stash and that is the whole point f this game! You can collect power-ups like shields which let you smash cop cars without any issue. You can collect a snowflake that freezes all the cops in lace or you can hit an explosive device that blows up all the opposing vehicles ad turns them into money for you to collect. This game is for the quick of heart and the fast of wheel. Do not let the man get you down as you avoid their barricades and dodge their attacks. This is not a game of smash em' up because whenever you smash you lose cash. Be quick, be nimble, and get rich in this fast-paced game.

name: Stretch Sums
author: Addicting Games
description: Stretch Sums is a free puzzle game. A crucial skill in life is the ability to make it stretch. Whether we're talking about your paycheck, your body, or your best little white lies, stretching them to their limit is as important as it is fun. In Stretch Sums, you'll be tasked with the noble challenge of taking a few tiles worth of numbers and stretching them in the four cardinal directions to cover the distance between predetermined values. Woah! Sounds like a lot of fun. Math isn't just a lot of fun it is also a tool that can be used to interpret and explain a lot of natural phenomena. Why not partake in the joy of pure math with a game where you find yourself literally in the center of an equation as it blossoms out in all directions. Stretch Sums is a game for people who love math and love winning. If you think you might be that kind of person or if you know someone who is, then hey why not play this game. There is literally no reason not to.

name: Student Driver
author: Addicting Games
description: The rubber hits the road on this obstacle filled physics challenger. You'll need to use all your wits in order to make it through each of these challenging levels. Just when you think you've got it figured out, there's a curveball for you. Not much different from real driving, minus the funky balancing.

name: Stunt Dirt Bike
author: Addicting Games
description: Stunt Bike Driver is a racing game. Put your dirt bike skills to the test by making it through each short obstacle course as quickly as possible and without wiping out in this 2D game. These trials of skill will certainly put your dirt bike or ATV skills to the test. In theory, it’s simple—make it from one side of the screen to the other, but this is certainly something that’s easier said than done. What kind of obstacle course would it be if there were no obstacles, and there are obstacles-a-plenty. And as the old tortoise taught us, sometimes to win a race, it’s better to go slow than fast, especially when going fast will send you tumbling over an obstacle and onto your head. ree.

name: Stylish Girl
author: Addicting Games
description: Stylish Girl is a free dress up game. Some dudes are shallow. But cute! So it's OK to dress to impress, right? Sure. See if you can keep Prince Charming motivated by choosing the PERFECT outfit for each occasion!

name: Sum Stacks
author: Addicting Games
description: Sum Stacks is a free math-puzzle game. All the world is math and we are but mathematicians trying to figure out the algorithms, additions, and subtractions that make up existence. In Sum Stacks, you will use your unholy knowledge of arithmetic in order to add it up, subtract it down, and cut your way through level after level. In this game, you will be given a sum and some tablets. Your job is to use the tablets to subtract or add to a series of numbers in order to achieve the foregone sum. While simple addition and subtraction are technically easy this game takes them to places you'd never expect. In Sum Stacks you'll find yourself doing the kind of math you've never dreamed was possible. This is a game for people with a quick wit and a keen sense of value. Test your skills against the never-ending barrage of numbered tiles that demand you take them and apply them to an ever-increasing chain of un-related sums just waiting to be achieved.

name: Sumjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Sumjong is a mahjong game that uses numbers and symbols! Instead of looking for matching tiles, this game requires you to create math equations. What better way to practice your math skills than in this fun online game. Simply click on the free tiles to create a math equation in the right-hand panel. Take advantage of mixed tiles that you can use to either represent any number or any symbol. There are 10 levels of this math game for you to practice your math skills! You can create either addition or subtraction equations. Submit your score at the end of the game to see your final score and ranking. If you are one of the top players, find yourself at the top of the list!

name: Summer Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Enjoy the summer heat with a relaxing game of mahjong. But without the sun reflecting off the tiles and blinding your eyes. Clear the tiles by matching them.

name: Sumo Up
author: Addicting Games
description: Help the the sumo kid jump high up in the sky by placing a jumping platform under him. Jump super high to unlock the other sumo dudes!

name: Sunburn
author: Addicting Games
description: Char broil these tourists to a crisp. Your job is to make sure that SPF isn't a word in our vocabulary. How many sunbathers can you fry?

name: Sunsave - Incremental/Roguelite Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Sunsave - Incremental/Roguelite on Steam now!


Sunsave is a relaxing incremental game with a vaporwave and minimalist vibe. Destroy meteors, collect resources, and evolve the Sun with upgrades that unlock new mechanics!

name: Super Candy Jewels
author: Addicting Games
description: Super Candy Jewels is a free puzzle game. All of the candy in the world can be yours if you have the tenacity and the temerity to tap, drag, slide and match your way to victory. Super Candy Jewels is a game that will allow you to taste the sweet, sweet, taste of success or the bitter sting of failure as you slide and drag your way through a never-ending series of levels filled with sweet treats and tricky layouts. in this game, you'll be challenged to find the sacred trinity hidden within adjacent rows and columns of candy. This is a game of quick swipes and thoughtful tactics. You might not know what your next move will bring and you might be thinking three swipes ahead. This is a game for everyone, the kind of game that can be played, and replayed for hours on end as you try to achieve the highest score in the shortest time frame. Where is your mind, where are your friends, why is this such a fun game if it's so challenging? there is just something about obstacles that makes us the better versions of ourselves.

name: Super Dress Up
author: Addicting Games
description: This girl has some nice silky lingerie for you to have her try on. Will you slip her into something more comfortable, or dress her for a night out?

name: Super Frog
author: Addicting Games
description: Super Frog is a free desktop game. With only three lives per level, you must collect all the fruit, dodge the birds, and smash the bugs, and make it all the way to the end without losing your heart. This is a typical platformer game with incredible 8-bit graphics and incredible level design. Run, jump, double jump, and smash your way to the heart of fun in this fast-paced, nostalgic, and fun platformer game where collection is the name of the game and you only win when you finish. The fruits are all over the place and they get harder and harder to reach. Sometimes you might have to take some lumps on your way to the fruit. That is OK, it is all worked in to the mechanics of the game.

name: Super Math Buffet
author: Addicting Games
description: Super Math Buffet is a math game with a funny twist! If you are into gross games and need to study your math skills then this game is the one for you! Feed your characters tons of foods like pizza, cake, pasta, and stacks of pancakes. Your goal is to fill him up until he throws up! Believe it or not, the more times you make him vomit, the better you are doing in this game. This game incorporates math skills for you to solve. Get it wrong, and you miss out on some tasty food for your character. Fill him up until it looks like he can’t hold any more food. Look to the barf-o-meter in the right-hand panel to see how you are doing. If you are ready to play a different math skill, click on the menu to change it up. Math doesn’t have to be boring with this funny yet educational game.

name: Super Orb Collector
author: Addicting Games
description: Super Orb Collector is a free puzzle game. Gravity is your enemy, space is your enemy, the walls are your enemy. In Super Orb Collector, your enemies are everywhere, they are all around you and they don't like being disturbed. In order to collect the orbs from each level and make it to the extraction point you'll have to sneak by swinging platforms, spinning rotors, avoid endless pits, and time it all perfectly. These orbs are valuable so they will be well defended. You must be of pure heart and iron will if you wish to overcome the obstacles before you and succeed in stealing the glowing spheres of destiny. Super Orb Collector is a maze style puzzle game where you must find your way through the traps and winding passages way in order to pick up your prize and deliver it to the door at the end of the level. Super orb Collector is a game that will test the limits of your reflexes as you dodge danger, avoid attacks, and sneak your way to victory. This is a game that rewards stealth over strength so strap on your critical thinking caps and get deductive in Super Orb Collector.

name: Super Shuriken
author: Addicting Games
description: Super Shuriken is a free Math Game. Math is an ancient science that has helped us explore and understand reality for centuries. Ninja's are centuries-old martial-artists who practice ninjitsu. When you combine the martial artistry of ninja's with the legendary science of math you unleash an unstoppable force. In Super Shuriken you will play the role of a cartoon ninja who is solving mathematical equations as fast as they can in order to fire off their razor-sharp shuriken. The faster and more accurate your answers the more true your aim will be and thus your score will rise ever higher. You can use this game to sharpen your existing mathematical skills or learn new ones. Choose whichever skill-set you wish to work on and the different grade levels associated with them. You can choose from grades K-8 and within each grade, there are different skill types you can choose to challenge yourself. By combining math and ninjas, Super Shuriken makes learning and practicing the fundamentals of arithmetic an exercise in fun for the whole family.

name: Super Stacker 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Super Stacker 2 is a free stacking game. Super Stacker 2 is the sequel to the classic puzzle game, Super Stacker. The objective of the game is simple: stack the shapes you’ve been given without them falling over for 10 seconds. Some of them may be a no-brainer but with others, you’ll have to channel your inner architect skills. The shapes come in all forms like triangles, squares, and even circles. This is a casual online game but it can require a lot of thought. Can you keep your quivering mass of jelly blocks standing for 10 seconds? Oh, really? Super Stacker 2 thinks you cant so prove it wrong! Join in playing this casual game with 40 levels of varying difficulty.

name: Super Wicked Awesome
author: Addicting Games
description: Platform through time, fighting vikings with shotguns and generally getting your blood nuts satisfied with a whole bunch of hilarious adventurism. Sold!

name: Super Worm 3D
author: Addicting Games
description:
Level Mode:

Collect 25 apples to progress to the next level, or try to get a high score in endless mode

Endless Mode:

Avoid spikes and other obstacles and get the highest score possible

name: Supercar Road Trip
author: Addicting Games
description: Supercar Road Trip is a free racing game. Get in your turbo-charged supercar and burn some rubber, bro.

name: Supercar Road Trip 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Supercar Road Trip 2 is a free racing game. Put your foot on the gas and blow the competition off the road.

name: Superstar Football
author: Addicting Games
description: Superstar Footballis a free sports game. You want a football game? We deliver! Build a team from scratch; buy better players as you start winning. Use Star Power to make your team play its best! Check out new features like extra fields, new plays and weather!

name: Supremacy 1914
author: Addicting Games
description: Europe is on the brink of collapse. Petty squabbles over resources, borders, and alliances have driven the world to war! And what a war it is, indeed the war to end all wars, in Supremacy 1914, you will act out the drama, intrigue, action, betrayal, treason, and inhuman horror of the first world war. Manage a European country, keep your economy strong and your resources on point and then build up a mighty army to devastate your neighbors! Upgrade your various units including infantry, generals, armor, and the air force as you blast your way through nation after nation who dare stand in your way! The world of Supremacy 1914 is cut throat but also encourages treaties with opposing players. You can negotiate deals with non AI countries in order to accomplish your mutual goals.

name: Suroi
author: Addicting Games
description:
Suroi is an open source 2D battle royale inspired by the defunct surviv.io. In Suroi, you'll spawn on an island, with nothing to your name. Break crates and other obstacles to get loot. Don't stand around for long, because a zone of deadly gas is always closing in! Your objective is to kill all the other players and be the last left alive. Complete it, and you'll be rewarded with a juicy chicken dinner! There are a wide variety of weapons to choose from, as well as several game modes in regular rotation. Invite friends and play together in duos or squads.

Stay survivin'!

name: Swap Sums
author: Addicting Games
description: Swap Sums is a free math game. This game is all about zero. Zero is the only pure value in the world. It is not bigger than any other number and it is not smaller than any other number: it simply is. Pure zero as a goal may seem less than exciting but ultimately it is perfect grounds for a challenging and interesting game. In Swap Sums, you will be using your wits to apply tiles of different positive and negative values to a series of tokens with positive and negative values. Your goal is to puzzle out the order in which those tokens can be played and where they can be played to reach pure zero. The ultimate in neutrality. This is a game for puzzle masters and math masters alike. Because in the end, all puzzles are really just math, you're really just coming up with an algorithm to determine the best way to toggle resources, manipulate shapes and values and fit them in or take them out of an existing set of information. It is fun, it is so fun. You'll love it. You'll love making your way to zero. We all have to go back to zero, we've built it up to far now.

name: Sweet Candy Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Sweet Candy Mania is a cute shooter game. This candy dispenser is full of all of your favorite candies and you cannot help but empty it completely out! There are various candies to choose from like chocolate, mint, lemon, and raspberry flavors.  Each level has its own goals with limited moves. For instance, you may need to get rid of all the raspberry candies on one level. Complete all the objectives of each level to earn all three stars. There are 50 levels of this bubble shooter game for you to unlock. Play through each level with this cute shooter game to remove all of the candies from the candy machine.

name: Synth Invaders
author: Addicting Games
description:
Synth Invaders is a retro-inspired shooter heavily influenced by arcade classics like Galaga and Space Invaders. It is designed to preserve the nostalgic feel of original coin-op games while adding a third dimension to the experience. In the true spirit of the arcade, your primary objective is simple: survive the onslaught and achieve the highest score possible.

 

Game Features

Diverse Arsenal: Choose from 5 different weapon types, each with unique strengths and weaknesses tailored to different playstyles.

Scaling Difficulty: The challenge intensifies with every victory. After each boss defeat, enemies become progressively more powerful, and new enemy types emerge to test your reflexes.

Dynamic Visuals: Experience a shifting atmosphere as the environment evolves based on your progress.

name: Tactical Squad
author: Addicting Games
description: Line up the shot and pull the trigger!

name: Tactical Weapons Pack
author: Addicting Games
description: Tactical Weapons Pack is a shooting game. In Tactical Weapons Pack you choose between three exciting modes of play as well as multiple classes in order to blast your way to the top of the leaderboard. Choose your weapons carefully and take aim because this is a tactical shooting game that rewards quick thinking and a precise trigger finger. You can choose between a tower defense style game where you must stop drones from making it to your finish line, an all-out shoot em' up where you have thirty seconds to take down as many drones as possible and a sniper-style mission where your aim will be put to the ultimate test. Level up your class of hero and unlock new weapons to help blast your way through the competition and land dead center in first place.

name: Tactical Weapons Pack 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Tactical Weapon Pack 2 is a tower defense game. You thrilled to the available weapons in Tactical Weapons Pack 1, you were wowed by the graphics, physics, and realness of the original but Hunny, you ain't seen nothing yet. Tactical Weapons Pack 2 is a step up in every possible way. New items, upgraded weapons, and new modes of play that will literally blow you away. This isn't your momma's Tactical Weapons Pack, this is Tactical Weapons Pack 2. Get blasting with any one of the multiple weapons available. Choose from the available modes of play and impress your friends with your ability to spray and pray, no scope headshot drones, or drop a rocket on an opposing robot. It is the ultimate test of your skills and a great way to practice your aim with a ton of collectible and upgradable weapons. If you think you're ready for the nest level of drone fighting then this is the game for you.

name: Takeover
author: Addicting Games
description: Takeover is a free strategy game. Train swordsmen, archers, knights, and other units to capture towns and castles. Bring glory and peace to the empire.

name: Taming.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Taming.io is a free IOgame. You must catch them all, you must train them all, and you must send them out into the wilds to battle and become the ultimate tamer. You are a taming master. A person who ventures out into the world finds powerful young creatures, trains them, and then uses them in deadly battles to determine the victor. It is a strategic game of searching, finding, taming, training, and using. A game that you will be playing in real-time against other tamers from around the world. Your skills will not just be put to the test by some random AI, no, you'll be challenging real live people with the same smarts, experience, and ambitions as you. This is a fun strategy game where you will be finding, upgrading, and customizing your various beasts. It is very similar to Pokemon but it's not Pokemon it's totally its own thing, its a different thing and it's actually really fun.  So, get clicking and have fun in this super fun game of taming, training, battling, and more! We're proud to present Taming.io to you and hope you will enjoy playing this fun, free IOGame.

name: Tank Battle
author: Addicting Games
description: Two tanks emerge on the battlefield. Collect ammo crates and power-ups. Navigate your way to the enemy tank. Fire away! Can you outsmart the other tank?

name: Tank Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: When tilty trucks fail, bring in some heavy armor. With a cannon! Drive your tilty truck through dangerous landscapes to deliver the deadly cargo. Obstacles? Kablammo!

name: Tank Wars
author: Addicting Games
description: Tank Wars is a free tank game. Prove that you are the superior tank pilot in Tank Wars! It’s tank vs. tank, and only one can leave the arena in one piece. The other tank will be in significantly fewer pieces—because you blew them to smithereens. In this simple battle of the tanks, choose to play against your friend, or against the AI, and then it’s just a matter of sending landing enough hits on your opponent before they can do the same to you!

name: Tanked.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Tanked.io is a free tank game.

name: Tankroyale.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Tankroyale.io is a free IOGame.

name: Tanks
author: Addicting Games
description: Tanks is the best game out there. Prove that you and you alone are the best tank pilot by blowing your opposition to smithereens. Play against AI opponents of varying difficulty, or challenge your friends to a duel, a duel of Tanks. Take turn launching hunks of explosive metal into the air, and then smile as then come crashing down on your opponent, obliterating terrain or the enemy tank itself. But you’ll have to make sure you have the angle just right, or the only thing you’ll be feeling—rather than a sense of victory—is embarrassment. Succeed, though, and you’ll not only get a nice sense of accomplishment for angling those attacks just right, you’ll also earn money! Spend it on upgrading your tank, or buying additional items. Keep being victorious, and you’ll be the greatest tank in all the land.

name: Tanks Battlefield
author: Addicting Games
description: Tanks Battlefield is a free online tank game. Welcome to a far-flung battle in the middle of nowhere. You and your team must overcome overwhelming odds in order to blast through the mechanized opposition and take down their stronghold. Each level will see you in charge of your own tank working alongside other operators in order to target and take-out a specified amount of enemy tanks before you are able to open fire on their base. Always keep an eye on your health, and ammo levels. You only have a few rounds before you need to re-charge your ammo. Meanwhile, there is no way to regain spent health. Be careful, be aggressive, be a winner. In order to target your enemies base, you'll first need to decimate a specific number of tanks. The amount of tanks changes each level and even after you have taken out the armor division, more and more enemies will keep spawning until you're able to take out the headquarters. Stay strong, stay frosty, and never let the enemy overwhelm you. Make tactical use of your allied tanks and allow them to cover home base or use them to flank your enemies. This is not a war of attrition, it is mission-based. Be the first to finish the mission and you will succeed.

name: Tap Speed
author: Addicting Games
description: Tap Speed is a free racing game.

name: Tap The Rat
author: Addicting Games
description: Tap the rat is a free online puzzle game. the rats are everywhere. The rats have invaded and only your pretty kitty can stop them. Smash the rats a fat as you can and don't them overwhelm you. Thee snarling little gnat are trying to spread disease and teal your precious cheese in this adorable, fast-paced game of action, intrigue, and the inevitably of hierarchy. People own cats, and cats own the mice. Smash, mah smash your way through a never-ending level and protect the cheese. If you think being a cat just mean lying around, soaking up the sun, flicking your tail and licking your paws: THINK AGAIN! In this exciting and free mobile game, you'll be put to work as you smash rats, protect the cheese and save the day!

name: Target Coaster
author: Addicting Games
description: Target Coaster is a free shooting game that is unique as it is fun to play! Shooter games tend to be violent, gory, and action-packed. However, this is a different kind of shooter game where you have to think outside of the box. The game displays a curvy path with arrows floating through it against a pastel red background. Pay attention to the curvature of the path as this will help you angle the arrow to shoot out the white letters that you’ll find across the game. You have limitless arrows but don’t spend too much time thinking about how to do this. Each level only gives you a certain amount of time before you fail. Doing well in the game? Click on the scoreboard icon in the lefthand column to see where you rank against other players. Pass every level and gain more points to rise up the leaderboard to be number one!

name: Tatesjourney.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Tatesjourney.io is a free IOgame.

name: Territory War
author: Addicting Games
description: Territory War is a free strategy game of attrition. War... war changes basically all of the time. It used to be fought with sticks and stones, and then we discovered flint rock and made bows and arrows. At some point someone discovered gunpowder. The weapons got bigger, louder, faster, eventually, we split the atom and now robots do all the fighting for us, yay! So, yeah. War changes constantly. It's basically a never-ending flux. Sometimes we fight over religion or resources, or philosophy, but mostly its territory. And that is what this war is about: Territory. This is truly a territory war. You'll be in charge of an entire legion of stick troops throughout the ages. All of them with various types of shields, weapons, and whatever. Upgrade your units, your items, and your various battlements. Encroach upon your opponent's territory until there is nothing left for them to fight for! Conqueror be conquered! Dominate with extreme prejudice or bow down to the iron heel of those who would have you on your knees. Its a tale as old as time. Huh, maybe war doesn't change? Someone should write that down.

name: Terror of Mongolia
author: Addicting Games
description: You have a bow and you're on horseback, the question is... how much of an army can you take down before they get to you?

name: Terrorist Hunt
author: Addicting Games
description: Terrorist Hunt is a free shooter game. Oooh, terrorists. NO LIKE. I especially hate their squatty posture and blue coveralls. Kapow! Pow!

name: Tetrads.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Tetrads.io is a free iogame. The tetrads are coming the tetrads are here, it is your job to take care of the tetradic threat. Tetrads is a retro-blip animation polynomial game. Strap in for a minimalistic ride where you are but a cube in a world of shapes. You'll want to survive, and that means you'll have to finds other shapes and absorb them to stay alive and find other smaller shapes. Every battle will cost you the sum of your blocks and the opposing players blocks when you destroy them so choose your opponents carefully and always pick on someone smaller. As you play through the game because you will  be attacked by players bigger than you. Outsmart them and make judicious use of your 'boost' power by pressing the left mouse button So you can speed away from a potential attack, or get the jump on a potential victim. The boost has its own power bar which will quickly run out as you use it and then will slowly re-charge at half the speed.

name: The A-Maze Game
author: Addicting Games
description: Maze is a free puzzle game. The real maze is real-life. It is all around you at all times and you are forever lost. Is this the right way? Is that the right choice? Have you found a way out or just another dead end? In real life, you may never know but in Maze the answer is clear. Find yourself out of a  series of puzzling mazes in this exciting maze game that gives you only a small peek at your surroundings and asks you to make a simple choice: left or right, up or down. That is it. But once you make enough of these choices and you make them fast enough you'll find your way traversing the maze, making it to the end, and out the other side. Victory is yours, but was it fast enough? Most people find their way out but barely any of them do it in time. If you want to be a winner, a real winner, then you have to optimize every choice and make it out the exit as fast as you can. Maze is a game that will take you on a trip.

name: The Archers
author: Addicting Games
description: The Archers is a free shooting game that you can play with your buddy! Play as a cool archer dress in an awesome costume that helps conceal your identity. Dynamic music pumps you up as you compete outside in a bare and natural setting. You and your opponent stand on boulders that will vary in height creating a challenge with every turn. This is a two-player game so invite your best friend or your sibling to join in on the fun. Your objective is not to kill your opponent but rather to show off your amazing skills. Hit the apple on the top of your opponent’s head and avoid killing them. In fact, if you do hit them, you don’t get any points and you lose your turn. If you keep hitting the apple, you get the chance to hit it again until you miss it. Don’t have a friend over right now? Don’t worry! Select training and choose between timed or untimed training so that you become the best archer out there!

name: The Black Knight
author: Addicting Games
description: The Black Knight is a free platformer game. Inside birds there are coins--who knew? Smash them and grab the money, along with the peasants and shops. Can you grab enough gold to appease the king?

name: The Bubble Dress Up
author: Addicting Games
description: In the '70s, to do drag was a lifestyle commitment. Now, click and drag different clothes onto the model to your heart's content without giving your parents a heart attack.

name: The Classroom 3
author: Addicting Games
description: The Classroom 3 is a free escape room game. Grade's aren't your strong point. But that doesn't matter with the geek in the class. Are you crafty enough to sneak around the teacher and get the answers off the geek's test?

name: The Gambit
author: Addicting Games
description: Dive into the chessboard chaos of The Gambit! Play as animated chess pieces in this puzzle game where brains beat brawn. Solve tricky puzzles, outwit opponents, and navigate the board strategically. With vibrant visuals and brain-teasing challenges, it's a fast-paced, playful quest for chess mastery. Will you checkmate your way to victory and be the ultimate chess maestro? The pieces are set, the game is on – let the Gambit begin!

name: The Grand Grimoire Chronicles - Episode 2
author: Addicting Games
description:
Nothing seemed off about the hotel at first but now Dev was starting to wonder if the rumors were true. Too many coincidences, too many unexplained events, and now he was lost on what he thinks is the third floor even though the elevator said 5th floor. Meanwhile, where was that elevator exactly? It seems like each hallway of the hotel shifted after he walked down it. At first, the numbers were all prefixed with 5, now with 3. That just doesn't add up. There was also the stillness of the place. It was noon, he should be able to hear voices in the rooms, or see other people in the hall but ever since he got to the fifth --or was it third-- floor, everything had been quiet, too quiet. Pausing to look out the window, Dev realized that the sky had become nothing more but a thick grey fog. It was too foggy in fact to see anything more than a few feet away from the window. 'I give up on this one, I really do,' Dev muttered aloud to himself.

'Don't give up, Dev! You're doing fine.' Stunned, Dev turns toward the sound of the voice. A beautiful woman in a vintage green cocktail dress was holding a champagne glass and smiling at him. 'You just need to relax, you've been cooped up here all night.'  Dev shook his head 'I'm sorry but, do I know you?' The woman's smile disappears into a snarl 'How typical, you know, I thought you were different.'  Confused, Dev tries to explain 'Look, lady, I don't know how you know my name, I'm just trying to find my way out of here.' The woman shakes her head  'You know, they were right about you. They were all right about you. You're just like the others and you're gonna wind up just like the others.' Before Dev can respond the woman splashes her champagne in his face 'hey, now...' Dev flinches in shock. Wiping the champagne from his face he realizes that the woman is gone but where she stood is a soaking wet ax in the middle of the hallway standing straight up, balanced perfectly on its head. 'Now what the ...' before Dev can finis

name: The Impossible Quiz
author: Addicting Games
description: The Impossible Quiz is a classic brain teaser that will confuse you until your head hurts. This is the same puzzle game you may remember from your childhood. It’s still around and still as perplexing as ever. This is an online game that is full of twists and jokes that will get you frustrated but also make you laugh. Try to solve the entire quiz as quickly as you can. Can you solve it in a day? You can do it on your own or invite your friends to help you solve this crazy brain teaser.

name: The Jigsaw Puzzle
author: Addicting Games
description: Play The Jigsaw Puzzle on Addicting Games! Enjoy relaxing, brain-boosting fun as you piece together beautiful images in this classic online puzzle game.

name: The Last Ninja
author: Addicting Games
description: The ultimate warrior, one might say.

name: The Last Stand
author: Addicting Games
description: The Last Stand is a free zombie shooter game. Make a stand before zombies bite into the meatier part of your skull. Use the daylight hours wisely, and prepare for the hordes who come again at night. Can you make this stand, or will you fall?

name: The Last Stand 2
author: Addicting Games
description: The Last Stand 2 is a free tower defense game. Survive each night by eliminating zombies. When daylight comes, look for supplies and survivors. How long can you hold out?

name: The Mafia Poker
author: Addicting Games
description: Mafia Poker is a free card game.

name: The Palace Hotel
author: Addicting Games
description: The Palace Hotel is a hidden object game that takes place in a mysterious hotel. Something odd is going on here at the Palace Hotel, and you are just the detective needed to find out what is happening. Belongings of the guest have gone missing and they may be hidden among odd places around the hotel’s property. Vases, purses, hats, and even jewelry have all gone missing! Use your magnifying glass to find all the items on the list. There are 10 levels in this hidden object game for you to solve. Each level is timed so you must search quickly in order to unlock the next level. Submit your score at the end of the game to see your rank, and to see if you are one of the top players.

name: The Path
author: Addicting Games
description: The path is a free puzzle game. Which way glowing orb? There is only one path, there is only one way, and there is only one sequence of events that will unlock that path. Your job is to toggle the obstacles, move the objects, and clear the way for a series of orbs so that they can make it all the way from point a to point b. This is a puzzle game where there is only one answer and one solution to every level. You can't fake it, you can't fluke it, and you can't fathom any alternatives to the one true path. The path is the way to victory and your job isn't just to walk it but to forge it. This is a game that will test your knowledge of cause and effect, physics, timing, and obstacles. The Path is a game that will allow you to live out your dreams of finding your way through a maze without a minotaur. While the levels aren't timed we would obviously think a lot more of you if you could get them done in a certain amount of time. The lower the better. And don't make any mistakes! If you screw up just once it's game over.

name: The Prince Edward
author: Addicting Games
description: The one and only!

name: The Tower Defense
author: Addicting Games
description: Tower Defence is a free Tower Defence game. We all love towers, we all love defending things. Now with the new game  'Tower Defence' you can put your love of defense and towers together and defend a tower. How does one defend a tower? With a series of smaller towers that are armed with archers, magicians, orbs, lasers, and all sorts of black magick or catapult-based weaponry. The invasion is on and you have limited resources to buy and build yourself a series of small towers in order to defend the larger tower. You can choose what kind of tower and whether or not you want to upgrade it, sell it for pennies on the dollar, or replace it with a tower that does something completely different. All of the different towers have different strengths and weaknesses. Some deal heavy damage but take a long time to reload, some have a long-range but deal very little damage. Some are auto-fire but have a very limited range. It is a puzzle with no outcome. Except for the one you give it.

name: The Travel Puzzle
author: Addicting Games
description: The Travel Puzzle is a free puzzle game.

name: The Vampire Quiz
author: Addicting Games
description: Do you prefer sophisticated bloodsuckers, or rowdy party wolves? Take our extremely scientific quiz to identify your inner beast!

name: The Worlds Easyest Game
author: Addicting Games
description: The Worlds Easyest Game is a funny and easy online quiz game that’s sure to make you laugh! Come and relive your childhood with this classic silly game that really is just as easy as it seems. This quiz-style game is great to waste time and just have some layback entertainment. You’ll also enjoy the upbeat music and colorful layout. This is one quiz you don’t have to sweat about failing.

name: The Worlds Hardest Game
author: Addicting Games
description: The Worlds Hardest Game is sincerely the worlds hardest game. Strategize, execute, and overcome! In these action puzzlers, you'll be in charge of steering your green square through level after level or blue dots and red zones. Your goal is really quite simple: avoid the blue dots and navigate yourself from one red zone to another. That is it, that is all that is expected of you, sounds simple does it not? Well, it's not. It's actually hard. In fact, some have said this is the worlds hardest game --and it is. You'll have to match your dexterity to your ability to solve puzzles as you traverse these levels. Avoiding blue balls is a lot easier than it sounds. You'll see, you'll all see.

name: They Took Her!
author: Addicting Games
description: The town is full of zombies, and the bomb goes off in a minute. Good thing everyone is safe in the shelter, right? Everybody except your daughter! Oh to the Noes! Sixty seconds to find a weapon, solve the clues, and rescue yer kiddo!

name: Thing-Thing 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Thing-Thing 3 is a free platform-shooter game. Thing-Thing is back, with more furious action than ever!

name: Thug Racer
author: Addicting Games
description: This is the coastline flying by at 80 miles an hour. This is fly hunnies in the backseat and chumps in the trunk. This isn't just racing, this is Thug Racing! A fast, furious, and nostalgic racing game with a vaporwave feel and an eighties throwback look. In Thug Racer, you'll only have your mouse to dodge cops, other cars, palm trees, and the various other obstacles that the California coast throws at you. Watch out for palm trees and other drivers as you navigate down the highway and put up with the non-stop chatter and annoyance of your passenger and co-pilot who will give you tips, advice and endless lectures about your failures as a driver if you let him down. So, sit down, strap in put the pedal to the metal and blast off into the thug life with this fun paced 16-bit race game.

name: Tic Tack Toe
author: Addicting Games
description: Tic Tac Toe is a free puzzle game. Just like in real life all it takes to win is three in a row. That is it. just line up your exes and your ohs and let's see what you got. This is a game about out-thinking your opponent and maybe even becoming your opponent after you defeat them in the sacred grid of ceremonial magic. If you truly believe in your heart and soul that you have what it takes to align your X's in such a way that you are able to trick your opponent into giving up the upper hand then we believe this is the game for you. All we ask is that you sit down, crack your knuckles, sharpen your flicking finger and prepare to enter a world of excitement, a world of adventure, a world of X's, and a world of O's. Tic Tac Toe is a generations-old drama that everyone knows how to play but nobody knows how to master.

name: Time 4 More Cat
author: Addicting Games
description: This cat has a gift: when she stops moving, time stops. But she still needs to go home. Eat tacos, fries, pie and more tasties while avoiding humans and machines. Grab orbs for useful powerups, like a force field to protect your kitty self. Seven play modes turn this game into a cat-happy way of life, peeps!

name: Time Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description:
Welcome to Time Mahjong, a captivating twist on the classic tile-matching game infused with a time-themed challenge. Dive into a world of intricate mahjong puzzles, where every move counts against the ticking clock.

Embark on a journey through beautifully designed levels, each presenting unique tile arrangements and strategic challenges. Race against time to match pairs of tiles and clear the board before the clock runs out.

name: Tiny Cars
author: Addicting Games
description: Tiny Cars is a free racing game. Don't let the name fool you, Tiny Cars is certainly one big game. In this tiny racing game, you'll have to be quick, nimble, and out-think your opponenets as you twist and turn your way through a desktop maze of floppy disks, erasers, paper clips, and pencils set up to stop you in your tracks. Try to collect as many stars as you can in order to capture the best score. Beware the competitors cars that freckle the landscape and will try to smash into you and take you down. Each hit from a cop won't slow you down too much but it will remove stars from your stash and that is the whole point of this game! This game is for the quick of heart and the fast of wheel. Do not let the man get you down as you avoid their barricades and dodge their attacks. This is not a game of smash em' up because whenever you smash you lose cash. Be quick, be nimble, and get rich in this fast-paced game.

name: Tiny Tank Patrol
author: Addicting Games
description: Tiny Tank Patrol is a free tank game. Just because these tanks are tiny doesn't mean the fun has to be! That is right, in Tiny Tank Patrol you'll be in command of an entire squad of your own devising. In this game you'll take on small missions to build up your money, your forces, and your experiences. The idea is that you will develop the experience needed and the resources required to constantly upgrade your tanks until they are an indomitable force of pure hate. This is the time of your life when you should be out building tanks and taking on enemies as you devastate the competition and become an all powerful tank-styled warlord. The time is running out and soon you won't be much more than a memory. So, before that all happens, before everything goes wrong, you can have fun in this fascinating tank warfare game. Play as long as you can, show the world what you really have, show them all you can be, and take the world down with you as you raid camps, explode through armor, upgrade your shields and increase the lethality of your shells. This is a big game in a little package and you'll always cherish your memories playing it.

name: Tinytanks.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Tinytanks.io is a free IOgame. The tank war is finally here and it is really tiny. Tinytanks.io is a fast, top-down shooter game that puts you in charge of your own tank. Your job is simple: stay alive, devastate the competition, and control the map. Sounds easy but it's not, this will require you to have a keen sense of aim to blast the competition with a huge collection of upgradeable weapons. You will also need to have lightning-fast reflexes in order to take potshots at your opponents and dodge any incoming blasts. There is no luck in this game. It is all tactical ability and strategic thinking. So, sharpen your trigger finger and get ready to blast your way through map after map of minimalistic little arenas filled with blood-thirsty enemies from around the world. This is an iogame which means that your opponents won't simply be robots programmed to hunt and destroy. In this game, other players from around the world will be locked in and sitting behind the controls of the little tanks. They'll have just as much skill, experience, and ambition as you and that is what will make them dangerous: The human element.

name: tochki.online
author: Addicting Games
description: A remake of the famous game slain.io. A multiplayer online game in which you fight monsters and play with other players. Improve your character's characteristics and defeat everyone.

name: Tom's Adventure
author: Addicting Games
description: Embark on an epic pixelated quest in Tom's Adventure Alien Invasion, a thrilling browser game that pits you against alien foes in a retro-style platformer. As Tom, your mission is to navigate through challenging levels, facing off against a variety of quirky alien enemies along the way. Jump and dodge your way to victory in this action-packed adventure filled with nostalgic pixel art and dynamic gameplay.

name: Tony Rigatoni's Pasta Passion
author: Addicting Games
description: Tony Rigatoni's Pasta Passion is a drawing puzzle game. In it, Mr. Tony Rigatoni is patiently waiting for a scrumptious plate of pasta! Your job is to drag a spaghetti noodle past other customers and the wait staff into Tony’s mouth. Along the way, there are meatballs for you to collect by drawing your noodle through them to add more flavor to Tony's meal. Be careful though, because if you draw the noodle too fast, you'll break it!

name: Top shootout: The Pirate Ship
author: Addicting Games
description: An old pirate ship full of golden treasures and beautiful hostages sails in the Caribbean Sea. Load your cannon to defeat all pirates and get the best score!

name: Top Shootout: The Saloon
author: Addicting Games
description: Shoot down the baddies as fast as you can ... but don't hit the townsfolks (it's frowned upon).

name: Top Speed
author: Addicting Games
description: Top Speed is an action game where you race through traffic! There’s no traffic cop around and you’re in a rush to get to your destination.
