Weave in and out of traffic without hitting other cars. Some cars stay in their lanes but some of them will switch without signaling. The nerve! Earn and collect coins as you get further and further with each play. Use the coins to unlock all the character skins for your car so that you can choose from many options. The car game will speed up as you zoom through traffic and it becomes difficult to avoid bad drivers. Drive as far as you can each time to earn cash and get a better chance of landing on the leaderboards. Do not stress if you don’t get too far at first. This is the kind of online game to play over and over again to beat your own score. You are your own competition in this fun action game!

name: Toss the Turtle
author: Addicting Games
description: Toss the Turtle is a free physics game. When we say 'toss,' we actually mean 'blast out of a cannon.' Which is a great place to start. Shoot your flying turtle to keep him in the air; do a little turtle steering to go farther. And don't forget to upgrade with those sweet, sweet guns!

name: Totemia Cursed Marbles
author: Addicting Games
description: Totemia Cursed marbles is a free marble-shooter game. The curse is real and you are our last hope. Stop the marbles before they stack up and bring us down. Totemia Cursed Marbles is a shooter game where players defend the entrance to their tribes' shrine from the unwelcome advance of rainbow colored spherical invaders. You can save the day by making sure that you line up the color of the marble you fire with at least two like colored marbles in the line. Practice ytour timing and your accuracey. Take out marbles strategically or fire off a volley of hail Mary's. This cute-shooter game lets you make the choice what kind of player you will be, but however, you play the game make sure you play to win. Pay attention to the marbles in the line, sometimes you will see bonus marbles, power-ups, and other kinds of special marbles that will allow you to optimize your chances of survival. Defend your base and keep the entrance safe or these marbled invaders will roll all over you, your friends, your family, the tribe, and everything you hold dear. Load up and let's go with Totemia Cursed Marbles. A true gamers game.

name: Tower Bloxx
author: Addicting Games
description: Tower Bloxx is a free stacking game. Who knew that building an entire city could be so easy? Stack up blocks to make the highest skyscrapers possible and give the umbrella peeps a home.

name: Tower of Hanoi
author: Addicting Games
description: Move the tower to the rightmost rod. One disk can be moved at a time from the most top of each tower, and cannot be placed on the smaller disk.

name: Tower Trouble
author: Addicting Games
description: Tower Trouble is a free avoider game. Tower Trouble is an endless runner style game where you aren't just running you're flying, and you're striving for a better life somewhere higher in the sky. Flap your wings and set your sights high in this epic avoider game where you will be dodging spikes, avoiding flame, ducking lasers, and side-stepping cannonballs. You will find out how far you can go and it may surprise you. In this game, all you have to rely on is your ability to fly and your reflexes. There are no upgrades you can buy, no coins to collect, there is nothing you can do but survive. Your life is your prize, the distance you run is your only accomplishment. This is a simple and straight forward endless runner game where you will avoid from the first second of play until your very last. Do you think you have what it takes to become the ultimate firefly? Prove it in Tower Trouble, the ultimate endless runner game.

name: Towers of London Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Card games are a dime a dozen, but how many of them take you to 'jolly ol' England?' Only Towers of London Solitaire can do that! Well... not really, it doesn't buy you plane tickets or a put you up in a nice hotel. But it can provide hours of card game fun!

name: Towertide
author: Addicting Games
description: Survive endless waves of enemies while building and upgrading your towers in this diep.io inspired tower defense!

name: Towerz.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Towerz.io is a free IO game. This is the radical, high flying world of Towerz.io. An IO game where you must be precise and act fast if you want to win. This is a game that will test your reflexes and your precision as you click through an endless series of falling blocks in order to stack them the most accurately. In this multi-player twist on a classic reflex game, you will be playing in real-time against opponents from around the world. This game is now a race who can go the highest, the furthest, the fastest. You can do it, you can defeat the other players but it won't be easy. You'll have to think hard and move fast if you want to win. This is a 2-d gaame of stacking, speed, and clicking. You have what it takes now show us all.

name: Toy Factory
author: Addicting Games
description: Toy Factory is a fun puzzle game where you need to help the toys escape! This is a cute puzzle game where there are a variety of toys looking to be freed! There are bunnies, aliens, rubber ducks, and teddy bears that want to get out of this stuffy toy store. Match 3 or more of the blocks to help the desperate toys come down to be able to get out of there. There are 45 levels of this game waiting to be solved by you! This is a colorfully decorated game with cheerful music playing in the background. The blocks are adorned with bold colors and images of unicorns, rockets, spaceships, and other fun characters. You can find your level and current score along the top of the game. From the main menu, select the High Scores to see where you stand against other Toy Factory players. Play until you’re at the top of the list!

name: TRACE
author: Addicting Games
description: Trace is a free escape room game. The evidence is there; all you have to do is find it. In Trace, you will scour every aspect of every room in this abandoned chateau. It is your mission to unlock what happened by finding clues, collecting items, and unlocking the secrets of this island abode. Only you can really know what really happened. And you'll know if you point, click, collect, and pay attention.

name: Traffic Controller
author: Addicting Games
description: Traffic Control is a free mobile game.

name: Traffic Racer 3D
author: Addicting Games
description: Traffic Racer 3D is a free racing game. We all love traffic. We all love to race. We all love the third dimension. Now, for the first time ever a game unlike any other brings together traffic, racing, and all three dimensions. That's right: Traffic Racer 3D is here! Boldly go where no other player has gone before in this fast-paced racing game where you can take on a live opponent or go head to head with the computer. Dodge oncoming traffic and weave your way into the history books with this super realistic, night time-based traffic racing game. Customize your car, unlock faster and more furious rides, invite a friend, and fire off the nitrous in Traffic Racer 3D. You may think you can drive, you may think you can race, but can you traffic race in the third dimension? Only time and this game will tell. Now, rev up, roll up, and throttle the competition in this fun and addicting racing game.

name: Traitors.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Traitors.io is a free survival style iogame. The art in this game is minimal and aesthetic. Itis a game where survival is paramount and tactics are key. pay attention to the instructions because this is a complex game with aa lot of fun and interesting choices as well as a whole world of different strategies which can be employed. This is a fun game which is also a multi-player because it is an iogame. This means that you'll be going up against real-life players as you navigate a large, open-world arena with dozens of different choices to make and strategies you can employ.

name: Treasure of Cutlass Reef
author: Addicting Games
description: Treasure of Cutlass Reef is a free strategy game. Feeling Piratey? Send the King's fleet to the briney deep and steal their gold. Then upgrade your ship and plunder with impunity!

name: Trench Runner
author: Addicting Games
description:
Trench Runner is a first-person, endless runner game. The future is here. The future is now. The future is trench warfare at 300 miles an hour. Are you fast enough? Are you smart enough? Do you have what it takes to defy an empire, destroy their auto-cannons, dodge their electro walls, blast their bosses and take down their space station? If you like first-person shooters, endless racers, sci-fi, or avoider games than this game is just for you. 3-D graphics and a procedurally generated trench background make every play of this amazing sci-fi adventure more stunning and engrossing than the last. Re-live your favorite tunnel chase assault scenes and be the hero you've always wanted to be in Trench Runner!

This is an endless racer game where you are armed with quad laser cannons and a mystical vibe that lets you know when danger is approaching. Follow your instincts and heed the warnings of the flashing yield signs. Navigate towards one of the three power-ups which randomly become available. Shields will protect you from laser bombs, electro-walls, and the turbo canons along the canyon walls, but watch out! Because even with full shields you are still vulnerable to running into walls if you aren't careful. You can also activate the 'Slow Down' feature which will momentarily slow down all gameplay which will better allow you to dodge walls and target enemies. Finally, there is the 'Wall Breaker' upgrade which automatically destroys all visible walls so you can focus on blasting one of the many bosses you will face.

name: Trench War
author: Addicting Games
description: Trench War is a free mobile war game. Our world is at trench war, now and forever. In Trench Wars you won't just choose a side you'll run it. Trench Wars is not a simple game for simple people but rather an epic and intense game of global conflict that will ensare the lives of countless thousands. Choose your side, stake out a place on the map and then build your army, summon your units, direct your soldiers, engage the enemy, hunker down in a bunker or get up and charge your way into history. Trench Wars is a game which rewards strategy and slowly bidding your time as well as lightning fast attacks and blitzes into the enemies encampments. In battle, you might need to use tactical logic to ascertain the most optimal form of combat be it snipers, machine gunners, riflemen, or a bombing run but long term this game will be won by generals who know how to plan, pivot and push forward. The more time you invest in learning the nuance of Trench Wars the more you are likely to get out of it.

name: Tri-Towers Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Three towers, and they all must fall. Remove the cards to clear them all.

name: Triangle Way
author: Addicting Games
description: Triangle Way is a free endless runner game. Get out of the square way and get into the triangle way. Which way is the triangle way you might be asking? Down! Fall forever through the neon-lit grids of eternal and endless running. Triangle way is a fast-paced and futuristic endless runner style game where you will race, dodge, and triumph in a series of endless runner style competitions. Take control of your mightly triangle and angle it through the many mazes and around the walls of the grid and try to stay alive. You'll have to dodge all sorts of obstacles and keep your nose clean as you charge, dodge, race, and zoom your way to victory. Life is a fast-moving obstacle course that never ends until you die and so is this game. So, hop on board and get to know the controls as you put your pedal to the metal.

name: Tripeaks Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Tripeaks Solitaire is a free solitaire game. Most solitaire games have some random theme pasted on, but not Tripeaks Solitaire. This version of Tripeaks Solitaire is old school and it doesn't pull any punches. This is a game that gets right to the point and just lets you have a little fun slowly organizing different sets of cars. Tripeaks Solitaire is a card sorting and organizing game where you will be sorting and organizing cards in numerical order, ordered by suit, and ordered by color. It is up to you to figure out how to do it and then hunker on down and make it happen. Did you know that after you shuffle a deck of 52 cards the chances of it being the same shuffle as another deck of the same cards are so astronomically small that it basically never happens? Isn't that crazy? We think it's crazy and we also think it's cool. That is why solitaire is cool. If you think solitaire is cool or even if you don't then we think you should play this game.

name: Triple Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Temple Mahjong is a free Mahjong game.

name: Triset.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Triset.io is a free IOgame. This is a game of domination, spacial reasoning, reflexes, and tactical advantages. This is a 3D version of your favorite Tetris-style game but with an aggresive twist! in this game you are competing with an opposing player to dominate a small enclosure with your polynominal pieces. This is a colorful and unique puzzle-war game and it is designed to be a competitive challenge that you can brag about to your friends or devastate them with your skills in a one on one game. Play through as many levels as you possibly can, proceed through new levels, new challenges, and new players as you quickly and accurately optimize the placement of your pieces.  Unlike the original game, in this game, your goal is to fill up all the whole board with polynominals that slowly become a small city. This is an explosive and fun advanced version of the classic Tetris game that is more challenging for the best casual game players. Once you’ve beaten the game, submit your score to see how well you rank against other puzzle players. Play again until you beat your own score or you’re at the top of the rankings!

name: Tropical Tennis
author: Addicting Games
description: Tropical Tennis is a free sports game. Welcome to a truly international game: tennis. Tennis is a game that was designed for kings and queens to play in order to non-violently decide the fate of nations. It has been played by movie stars, elite members of society, and the glitterati from all walks of life. In Tropical Tennis, you may feel like you're on vacation but will need to truly work it. This game will have the opportunity to prove your mettle and test your worth against a lightning-fast AI-controlled tennis bot. This tennis bot has been developed and trained to devastate the competition. Remember, the tennis bot will not go easy on you. You must be on your toes and only bring your best game. Tennis has long been used to separate the wheat from the chaff as it will be used now to separate the weak from the strong. Is your finger fast enough to devastate the tennis bots AI? Can you swipe and slash and take your place at the side of the monarchs of history and step up to the challenge? Or will you be trodden under foot, your life and ambitions crushed as you clumsily swing and miss? Only Tropical Tennis will know for sure.

name: Trump Run
author: Addicting Games
description: It's more of a hop...

name: Tuggowar.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Tuggowar is a free card game. Tuggowar is the most epic 1v1 deck-building game. This strategy game has a simple and innovative concept. Each match has a unique set of cards to choose from. Build an epic combo deck or attack, disrupt, and counter the Enemy. Incredible vector art with tons of cool basic and unlockable card. This is the perfect game for people who love 1v1 and strategy games and want their creativity, skill, and strategy to shine without being bullied or beaten by random decks. The cool thing about this game is that every player has the same deck and the same access to the same cards. This is a great place to start if you've never played a deckbuilder. Great campaign for first-timers and veterans alike.

name: Turkey Liberation Front Escape
author: Addicting Games
description: The tables are turned, Mr. Thanksgiving! Maybe just once, our noble friend the Turkey can spend the holiday with his own family. Gobble gobble gobble!

name: Turret Tumblers
author: Addicting Games
description:
Protect your back in this online multiplayer twin-stick shooter game with a twist!

As a good recycling robot, your job is to collect as much scrap metal as possible, even it means recycling the other robots. They are not going to make this easy though!

Turrets are easy to replace, but your hull is not. Protect your back with your turrets, while you bounce or curve your shots to reach your enemy's back. When you eventually succeed at salvaging the other robots, use their precious metal to make your hull even stronger. How long can you survive?

name: Turret Turmoil
author: Addicting Games
description: Turret Turmoil is a free tower defense game. Defend, upgrade, and devastate the opposition. Turret Turmoil is a tower defense game where you are forced to face down and overcome never-ending waves of infantry, tanks, bombers, jet fighters, and worse. With every target, you annihilate you will be able to collect a modest bounty. Save this cash up and use it to upgrade your operations. You can buy walls, a stronger more powerful cannon, rockets, land-mines, and even re-charge your failing health. This is a never-ending battle of attrition. Your back is against the wall and you're all alone against an unwavering army of tanks,  infantry, and bombers. All they have to do is take your tower down and all you have to do is stop them. Sounds simple, doesn't it? Click into a world of tactics, upgrades, and strategy.  You can't let the bad guys win, not a little, not just once: never. You will fight upgrade, and stand your ground even as the enemy encroaches. The battle lines have been drawn and you're on the right side. Hold them off, hold them down, and devastate!

name: Twist Maze
author: Addicting Games
description: Twist Maze is a free mobile game.

name: Two Stunt Rivals
author: Addicting Games
description: Two Stunt Rivals is a free racing game. Stunt rivals is a fast and free racing game that pits you against the deadliest competition around someone you know. In this game, you won't be racing against artificially intelligent robots or against an arena full of other players from around the world. No, in this game you will be racing against a friend or family member who is sitting right alongside of you. Let the trash-talking, engine revving, and racing b begin! in this game, it's not just about making it around a course, oh no, in this game you are going to be competing against the clock to pull off as many different jumps and stunts as you possibly can. The time is ticking and you have to prove your value by stunting, jumping, and flip-flopping your way onto the great big leader board in the sky. If you want to defeat your friend next to you, then you're going to have to stretch your fingers and get em clicking. This is not a game for the faint of heart or the weak of will. This is a game for people who play to win and win to live.

name: Twordle
author: Addicting Games
description: You've guessed one word before, but how about two? That's right this is Twordle. You're looking to guess two 5 letter words by finding letters from other 5 letter words. It's like word-ception!

name: Typeracer
author: Addicting Games
description: TypeRacer - the global typing competition. A classic browser game since 2008! Race opponents from all over the world against the ultimate typing battle! Matchmake around your skill level, customize your race car and more. Perfect for all ages learning to type! This game combines the excitement of global competition with the fundamentals of typing. After your first race, you will obtain a skill level and matchmake with opponents around your level to keep your races fun and balanced.

name: Typing Fighter
author: Addicting Games
description: Typing Fighter is a free typing game. Life is a never-ending campaign of battles Some of those battles are before us and some of those battles are behind us. But every battle leads to a new now. We at Addicting Games are here to tell you that some of those battles can be made of words and it can be up to you to connect the letters to make words that will change your life. Change it so much, that perhaps you will be at the top of the leaderboard. In Typing Fighter you will use the tips of your fingers or the taps of your mouse in order to click on and connect a series of letters in order to form words. The words will become punches, kicks, and blocks.  Each level is also timed, which means you will be in a rush to punch out as many words as you can as fast as you can. It is a challenging game for smart people who like to think hard, think fast, and think often. If that sounds like you then please by all means play this game, enjoy this game, and try to beat our high score.

name: Tyran.io
author: Addicting Games
description:
Tyran.io is a free iogame.

Welcome to the terrifying world of Tyran.io. A world where humans compete for weapons, items, and upgrades so they can unlock dinosaur eggs to grow themselves a dino-partner they can use to take on other opponents. That's right, in this arena free for all, not only will you be going toe to toe with other human competitors from around the world, but you'll be fighting ace to face with a collection of Scary dinosaurs that you can ride. Strategize which weapons and upgrades you think might work best with your dino of choice and then hop on and gallop around taking enemies. It is an extreme game of extreme face to face battles that go from awesome to epic when you introduce dino riding to the equation. Do not let the cute animations fool you, this game might look adorable but when you get right down to the nuts and bolts it is absolutely terrifying. Mount the dino of your choice and stomp your way to victory in this fully engaging game of combat and conquest.

name: Ultimate Noughts & Crosses
author: Addicting Games
description: Dive into strategic battles with friends or challenge a cunning AI in Ultimate Noughts and Crosses! With local and AI modes, conquer grids and claim victory in this modern twist on the classic game.

name: Ultra Mech Fights
author: Addicting Games
description: Die, robot.

name: ULTRATAP Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find ULTRATAP on Steam now!

ULTRATAP is an incremental game about a penguin who has chosen to go off into the mountains. On your journey defeat monsters and bosses, grow stronger and enjoy the process. Buy upgrades, complete quests and equip powerful items.

name: UN Weapons Inspector
author: Addicting Games
description: Try to find the weapons of mass destruction! Guess what? Youre HORRIBLE at it!

name: Unfair Mazes
author: Addicting Games
description: Unfair Mazes is an IO puzzle game that you can play by yourself or with multiple people. Invite your friends to play this crazy puzzle game where you have to go through a ridiculous maze. Your objective is to reach the circle on the opposite end that is the same color as your character point. Flip the lines and paths to create your own path to your goal. Always look 3 steps ahead of you as you might end up in a slot that cannot be advanced or you may bump into another player and get stuck. While you’re doing all this, a bot or other player is also trying to get to their mark before you do. On top of figuring this unfair puzzle game, you have to beat your opponent as well. Play against a bot or select the multiplayer option to play against a live opponent. Join this IO game and invite your friends to see who can reach the end first!

name: Unlock Block
author: Addicting Games
description: Unlock Block is a free puzzle game. This is the high-stakes world of sliding puzzles where players try their hand at unlocking a series of increasingly difficult block-based puzzles. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to slide the villainous pink blocks out of the way of your hero blue block. It sounds easy but it will require the ability to think ahead, think backward, think sideways, and finally think upside down. Sliding puzzles are an ancient form of entertainment and are important in understanding spatial awareness. None of the blocks are of the same size, but all of them are laid out in either horizontal rows or vertical columns. You will need to figure out what needs to be moved where and when if you wish to open up the entrance of the cell in this amazingly fun block puzzle style game. If you like sliding puzzles you will like this game. How fast can you make it to the forty-fifth level? You must play to find out for yourself.

name: Urine Trouble
author: Addicting Games
description: Feeling full of yourself? Unleash your golden stooge stream on unsuspecting targets. Move fast, because baby bladders aint so big, knuckleheads.

name: Vampire Physics
author: Addicting Games
description: Vampire Physics is a free physics game. Spread the vampire curse with gravity! Solve physics problems to send your bloodsucking hero off to infect more puny mortals. Watch out for garlic!

There are 5 levels for you to play and you want to win them all! Play against the 5 best AI players in town. They are experts in poker and will not go easy on you. That is okay with you because you are here to win everything! If you have a great poker face, you can bluff your way to the winning pot! However, it best to know the game for higher chances of winning. At the end of each session, submit your score to see if you land on the high scores list.

name: Viking Queen Defense
author: Addicting Games
description: Viking Queen Request is a strategy game where you must battle to protect your home base! In this online game, play as the Viking queen who is being attacked by her enemies. Luckily, you are supported by a strong army of Vikings. This is an online game that incorporates your knowledge of math. Answer the math problems correctly to gain gold and defeat your enemies. Use the gold to obtain more soldiers to help you defend your castle against other Vikings. There are 10 levels of this math game for you to solve! You have the option to practice math skills from preschool to the 8th grade. No need to stick to one skill either. You can change skills during gameplay. On top of being educational, this online game is loads of fun!

name: VIP Slot Machine

name: Viscous Ventures
author: Addicting Games
description: Viscous Ventures is a free platform game. Brace yourself, gamer friend,  because "Viscous Venters" is a fluid and dynamic platformer here to redefine the genre and elevate your online gaming experience to squishy new heights. Get ready to dive into a world where fun knows no bounds and where your gaming skills are truly put to the test. Your journey in "Viscous Ventures" revolves around mastering the art of growing and shrinking. Need to squeeze through a tiny gap? Shrink down! Facing a colossal obstacle? Grow into a formidable rectangle! Adapt and conquer as you navigate a 2D maze of intricate challenges to test your creativity, agility, and strategy. Throughout your journey, you'll encounter a cast of quirky and formidable foes who will stop at nothing to impede your progress. With simple but challenging AI and increasingly complicated levels, you'll need all your wit and skills to emerge victorious. So, let's get wet as you embark on a gaming adventure that will challenge your mind, dazzle your senses, and provide endless hours of entertainment. Are you ready to shape your destiny? The world of "Viscous Ventures" awaits!

name: Void Miner - Asteroids Roguelite Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Void Miner - Asteroids Roguelite on Steam now!

 

Blast. Collect. Upgrade. Repeat. Void Miner is a retro-inspired roguelite asteroid shooter where you pilot a space ship and manage an automated tower to destroy endless fields of chaos. Dodge, blast, and harvest your way through waves of asteroids in a fast-paced loop of destruction and progression. Find the full game on Steam!

description: Start this game with six different weapons? Now we're talking! Give the Argons a taste of hot space lead. Cowboy Up!

name: Wacky Dungeons
author: Addicting Games
description: Wacky Dungeons is a free clicker game. Welcome to the dungeon, the wacky dungeon. This is an incremental clicker-style game where you'll be following the patterns and clicking through a variety of levels in order to make it to the end of the dungeon and your escape. This game will test your tactical ability, your ability to strategize, and your clicker finger as you smash various dungeon baddies as you struggle onward towards redemption. Wacky Dungeon is as dangerous as any other game but is also a little light-hearted. Don't expect a grimdark dive into the void with this game. This is a world of fun and laughter even though it's also a dangerous slog through a bevy of baddies. Collect treasure, upgrade your items and make it to the top of the pops in this epic dungeon dive that only requires you to point, click, and let 'er rip.

name: Wallpaper Connect
author: Addicting Games
description: Wallpaper Connect is a puzzle game where you must match all the tiles to win the game. This online game is set against a generic living room background along with fun music to cheer you along. The game is based on various vintage colors and patterns of wallpaper on tiles that you must match. If you get stuck, each game offers you a limited amount of hints and shuffle to help you solve that level. Use them only when you really need them. You must complete each level in a limited amount of time as well so do not take too long. There are several levels of this game that you can complete. With each level, you can expect a bigger challenge with more tiles being added. When you finish this online game, your score will automatically be submitted to the scoreboards. Go to the main menu and select High Scores to see where you rank against other puzzle players. Play through the levels again to see if you can get a better score.

name: Warbrokers.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Warbrokers is a first-person shooter game. All the world is a war, and we are merely soldiers. In Warbroker.io you are a highly trained former military on a team of Jarheads looking to rip it up. Load up on guns and play with your friends in this huge online arena shoot 'em up style game. You can play classic version or arena style where it is simply kill or be killed. Scope out the area from the air and then land, gather up your weapons and start hunting. There are multiple different maps from high rises, to a small town, an airport, and even a rocket launch site. Keep your eyes open for weapons, helmets, body armor, and smoke grenades. Some levels even feature automobiles you can commandeer, drive and run down any opposing agents. Lookout for snipers and be ready to fire at a moments notice, aim for the body and you'll guarantee a hit. Try to outlive the other guys and watch your avatar rocket up the leaderboard.

name: Warlords: Call to Arms
author: Addicting Games
description: Warlords: Call to Arms is a free tower defense. Wage a war of territorial control in this real time strategy game. Pick your faction, select your units, and then commence your campaign of territorial domination. Each mission you complete successfully will give you gold that you can use to upgrade your units or buy additional ones. From there, it’s just a matter of gradually capturing different parts of the map until you have it all. Heed the call to arms and be the Warlord you were destined to be.

name: Warz.lol
author: Addicting Games
description: Warz.lol is a free iogame.

name: Whizz Words Deluxe
author: Addicting Games
description: Whizz Words is a free word game. To play, either select each letter with your mouse, or type them into the keyboard directly. Once you hit enter (or select the enter button), you’ll gain score based on the word’s length, but if the word’s not in the direction, then you gain nothing. There are two game modes—classic and quick. Classic has you playing 6 rounds, 2 minutes each, and you choose your score between each one. Quick is just one round that’s 3 minutes long.

name: Whizz Wordz
author: Addicting Games
description: Whizz Wordz is a free word game. Calling all SmartyPants! Make words with random letters for a few minutes. Then eliminate a category, like '4-letter words.' Then make more words. Hard, Hard, and Harder!

name: Wild Flower Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Wild Flowers Solitaire is a delightfully decorated solitaire game based on flowers. This is a basic online solitaire game set against a garden-themed image for a relaxing gaming session. Some of the cards are also decorated in brightly colored flowers. Select Help to review the solitaire rules if you are a new player or just want to review this game’s rules. Each session is timed so the quicker you solve the game, the better your score. Play, again and again, and challenge yourself to beat your own best score. Rise up the leaderboards and prove yourself to be one of the best solitaire game players on AddictingGames.

name: Wild West Shootout
author: Addicting Games
description: You're the Sheriff, go hunt down the bandits one by one! Challenge each bandit to a duel, where the winner will the one with the quickest hands in the Wild West.

name: WIZ
author: Addicting Games
description: Wiz is a free puzzle-platform game. Rogues are unpredictable, fighters are one-note, bards are always ruining parties, and paladins are too preachy. But Wizards! Wizards are the way to go. Wizards are fun, and Wiz is the funnest wizard of them all. Join Wiz in his game -- Wiz-- where he tries to unlock the secrets of the universe and move obstacles out of his way in order to get back home. Where his heart is. Because he left his heart there. Wiz is one of the pest puzzle style platform games you can play for free on your desktop right now. Use your fingers to swipe the various bricks out of the way and then charge your way toward the exit. It is a fun and fast game that can be played by anyone with a willingness to embrace the magic and majesty of Wiz, the wizard who loves to solve puzzles, move forward and exist entirely in two dimensions.

name: Wizard Jewels
author: Addicting Games
description: Wizard Jewels is a puzzle game made for wizards! It doesn’t matter what house you’re from, you’ll enjoy this magical-based matching game. This isn’t your basic matching game. It’s 3 games in one with 3 different ways to match the jewels. Additionally, one of your objectives is to make the backgrounds completely disappear. To do this, you match the jewels and the backgrounds will go POOF! Once you’ve done this, you have to use your magic to get a key to its destination. There are 50 levels waiting for you to cast your spell! Click on the play button, and get to playing this unique matching game that will give you more of a challenge.

name: Word Blitz
author: Addicting Games
description: Word Blitz is a free word game. in the sky, below you, and all around you are a torrential downpour of letters. The letters are coming at you from all angles, it is a jumbled mess. You need to step up and take control of the twisted and chaotic mess of letters. you need to use your finger to connect the letters and form words. We have it on pretty good authority that if you were to connect the letter you might be able to spell some words and those words would be worth points and those points unlock future levels and those levels report to a leaderboard system and that leaderboard system is how you show off your accomplishments to other players from all over the world. Word Blitz is a game that will keep you guessing, clicking, and looking for the next combo of letters that may just unlock the next level. Remember, once you can see the words in your own mind's eye you will be able to see them everywhere in the world. All around you are words, words build worlds, and now it is your time to shine and connect the dots for hours of word nerd style fun.

name: Word Detector
author: Addicting Games
description: Word Detector is a free word search game. So, you think you can spell? Well, we dare you to try and prove it. Some word games are a stodgy affair rife with trivia and pedantic rules about grammar. Word Detector is a speed game where you are given a series of letters and scored on your ability to connect each letter to the other letters and form as many words as you possibly can in as short an amount of time as you possibly can. The game will start off easy with a common letter which can be arranged into a variety of irregularly used words but as the time ticks away you're going to be forced to really scratch your noggin as you try and make 3 words out of Y,A,C, and L. Try it. It's a lot harder than you think and it is also a lot more satisfying when you actually pull it off. Word Detector is a fabulous ride through the crazy world of spelling, grammar, words, and all the magic that comes from them.

name: Word Hunt
author: Addicting Games
description: Word Hunt is a free word game. Words might very well be the fundamental building blocks of language as we know it. There are all kinds of words and their meanings, spellings, and definitions are a tangled web of logic and coincidence that stretch back from the end of this sentence to the very first time primitive man uttered 'ugg' at the site of a fire. As justified and as ancient as words are they can also be a puzzle. Words in and of themselves can be an abstract game that involves stacking, patterns, and an understanding of their context within a matrix of words. In Word Hunt, your job is to find the words listed to the right of the game screen and do it as fast as possible. The screen will be filled with an assembly of letters and somewhere hidden in those letters are the words that you seek. Finding them as fast as possible is the true test of a player but there is no shame in taking your time. This is a game of chance and a game of skill. It will stretch your vocabulary and it will push the boundaries of knowledge itself.

name: Word-Scapes
author: Addicting Games
description: Word-Scapes is a free word game. Crosswords is a classic word game where players combine words and overlap each other in order to complete a puzzle. It is an age-old game that has finally been upgraded. In Word-Scapes, you'll be tasked with filling out a grid of crossing words. The trick here is that you'll also have a selection of letters at the bottom of the screen. In order to fill out the grid, you must first connect the letters to form words. The formed words will automatically appear in the grid as long as you correctly identify and link the letters. The added challenge of finding letters in a soup of chaos makes this game all the more fun.

name: Word Squares
author: Addicting Games
description: Word Squares is a free puzzle game. The pictures tell you everything you need to know, you just need to figure it out. Word Squares is a puzzle game that puts you in the hot seat. As the timer ticks down you'll have to decipher the message, unscramble the letters and find the word. In Word Squares, the word is king, the word is the goal, and the word is fun. This is a unique puzzle game that confronts you with four pictures that hint at what the word might be. You have a limited amount of time to find the theme, see the pattern, put it all together, and unlock the level. This game takes crosswords to the next level and lets you stretch your investigative muscles. If you consider yourself a word nerd or a letter slinger, then this is the kind of game that you'll want to use to challenge your friends or devastate your enemies. Compete to place the highest on our leaderboard and prove that you are the ultimate word-knowing person. Some people just say words, but true Word nerds can pull them out of the ether and use them to score big.

name: Word Trail
author: Addicting Games
description: Word Trail is a free word puzzle game. Life is a series of trails. Some of them are before us and some of them are behind us. But all of them lead to a new reality. We are here to tell you that some of those trails can be made of words and it can be up to you to connect the letters to make words that will change your life. Change it so much, that perhaps you will be at the top of the leaderboard. In Word Trail you will use the tips of your fingers or the taps of your mouse in order to click on and connect a series of letters in order to form words. The length of the words will determine their value in points. Each level is also timed, which means you will be in a rush to find as many words as you can as fast as you can. It is a challenging game for smart people who like to think hard, think fast, and think often. If that sounds like you then please by all means play this game, enjoy this game, and try to beat our high score.

name: Word Vacation
author: Addicting Games
description: Word Vacation is a free word game.

name: Wordl Unlimited
author: Addicting Games
description: Wordle Unlimited is a free word game. Words are the basis of reality, and reality is where many of us spend most of our time but time can take a while. We thought we'd help you out while you're whiling away that time and toss you a free unlimited word game! World Unlimited is a free word game that begs of your attention and takes only your time in return. World Unlimited is a game for people who like the challenge of figuring out words with no hints but don't like the barrier to fun that other games impose upon play. If you don't want your vocabulary to curdle and need a fresh hurdle to keep your brain fertile then why not try Wordl Unlimited? We think that this type of word puzzle is exactly the kind of game that people need right now and that is why we're making it free to play on desktop with unlimited chances to play in a day. We here at Addicting Games love words and we're happy to share this game which is both addicting and word-based with our many fans who appreciate word games and want the freedom to play it an unlimited amount of times in a day for free forever.

name: Words
author: Addicting Games
description: Words is a puzzle game where you can show off your knowledge of words. Are you a book nerd or just have a love for the English language? Check out this fun and simple online game where you put together words for points. This word game is set like a boardgame against natural and colorful backgrounds. There are 45 levels and over a hundred words for you to unscramble. Each level has its own challenge that you can find by looking in the lefthand column. You will need to cover the blue blocks, reach a specific score, and reach a specific amount of words to get to the next level. You have to do this all in a limited amount of moves. If you get stuck, you can use the shuffle button or reset button. After you’ve completed all 45 levels, your score will automatically be submitted. Click on the High Scores button to see if you made it the top of the list!

name: World of Karts
author: Addicting Games
description: World of karts is a free iogame. Sit down, buckle up, hit the gas, and let's go. World of Karts is a free racing and arena battle game where you become a cute cartoony animal style person and get behind the wheel of a bright go-kart. You can either choose to play the racing version of the game or you can go and play the battle version of the game. The racing version of the game is a straight forward racing game where you will compete with other players from around the world. In this racing game, you will also have access to randomized weapons which you can use to smash your opposing players and take command of the raceway. When you are playing the battle version of the game, it is a whole new court where you don't have to worry about racing or first place. In this version of the game you just avoid getting hit while you collect weapons to take out other players. Both versions of the game are fun and will give you a never-ending set of options for play.

name: World Trivia 2018
author: Addicting Games
description: World Trivia 2018 is a quiz game based on trivia from around the world. Select your country of choice, and answer trivia questions from that region. Use the image depicted along with the available letters to spell out the topic of the picture. Click on the letters to add them to the screen, and click on them again if you need to remove them. Complete each level with sufficient time to earn enough stars and unlock the next level. You can use stars to unlock hints to help you out with more difficult subjects. There are 28 levels for you to unlock and solve! The faster you answer, the better your score. If you run out of time, you lose that level and have to start over. Submit your score to see if you are one of the best trivia players on AddictingGames.com!

name: World Wars
author: Addicting Games
description: World Wars is a free online strategy game. Channel your Inner Napoleon! Battle 1 to 7 opposing armies; wage war and strategize your way to Victory! World wars is a classic strategy game that will pit you against a cunning AI that is heck-bent on your destruction. If you think you're ready to get tactical or strategize your way out of a bad situation then this is ultimately the game for you. World Wars is a classic game that will teach you the ins and the outs of map-based combat, the rules of attrition, and what it's like to be at the mercy of the dice. In this game, you can build an empire or raize one to the ground. It is all up to you and the choices you make, so prepare yourself for a world of pain or a world of victory.

name: Worlds Hardest Game 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Worlds Hardest Game 2 is a free trivia game. Oh, you think you're so smart. Well, Harder 2 is 50 levels of brain-crushing pain. How long can you withstand the awesome power of angry blue circles?

name: X-Type
author: Addicting Games
description: Hey, starfighter, you know what to do... Fire up the thrusters and blast the heck out of anything that zooms your way.

name: Rally Point
author: Addicting Games
description: Rally Point is a free racing game. The best racing games get to the point, the rally point. In Rally Point you can start with one of two different cars which you will use to blast through a variety of different tracks. Earn cash to buy upgrades and unlock new cars, upgrades, and other cool touch-ups that make the game uniquely you. This is a high-quality, high-octane racer that lets you live out your wildest dreams. Race at night, through mud, on city streets, in a new car, a classic car, or a futuristic racer that you personally customize. The choice is yours and you make it with every race you win, every race you fail, and every time you turbo-charge your way to a finish flag somewhere high in the sky. You can do it. you can show them all with this game. so, sit down, strap in, and get going. Rally Point is a racing game that you will tell your grandchildren about. Rally Point is the coolest game out there and is totally one that you will be happy to play.

name: Yatzee

description: Yatzee is a free board game.

author: Addicting Games
description: Yoga Run is a free avoider game.

name: Yorg.io 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Yorg.io 3 is a unique multiplayer tower defense game set during a zombie apocalypse. This is the third installment of the popular series, Yorg.io. Yorg.io 3 takes a simplistic approach with its animation with a top-view playing field. The zombies only attack at night so take the day to load up on supplies while building both your defensive towers. You can kill zombies with cannons or arrows or use walls to make it difficult for them to get to your home base. On top of killing zombies, you need supplies like crystals, stones, and lumbar to create towers. Use your upgrade options to enhance your current towers making them more efficient. You also have the option to play solo or join a multiplayer session where you can compete against other players during a live session. As you gain coins, you can unlock other cool playing fields and levels. Join in and see what all the fuss is about in this tower defense IO game.

name: Yukon Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Yukon Solitaire is a free solitaire game.  Welcome to the wonderful world of puzzling your way through a card-based game of sorting and organizing. As you may know, as everyone knows, solitaire is not just a game of cards it is a game of life. It is also a game of cards (technically) but is mostly it is about life. Your life. The deck is shuffled and you play the cards you're dealt. This is the story of your life, this is the story of everyone's life. How you will deal with a King or a Jack when what you really need is an Ace or a Deuce is one of the many determining factors in who you are and who you may yet become. If you are feeling stuck with diamonds and spades when what you really want are hearts and clubs, then you know what it is to live life and play Yukon Solitaire. In Yukon Solitaire there are no right answers there are only optimal and sub-optimal moves. Where you decide to place your cards when you decide to place them, how you shuffle your cards: all of it is a reflection of who you are as a person.

name: Zapper.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Zapper.io is a free slither-style iogame. Zapper is the free iogame for people who want to get zapped, zap others, and basically just extrapolate upon the concept of zapping in a variety of ways. For instance, you play as a long electric glow bug and in this hyper-static form, you have two play modes: one where you must avoid all other players as you eat and grow or the far more deadlier option: To kill all opponents. In the avoider mode, you'll be traveling along the circuits and lines of currents which cover the arena like a giant spider-web trying to gather as much energy as possible to grow as big as you possibly can. In the arena version, everything stays the same except instead of dying when you touch an opponent you'll destroy them. Unless they destroy you first. There is an assortment of different skins you can buy in this game which will allow you to spend your hard-earned tokens on something cool like aesthetics. You can also unlock cool achievements which are affected by your size, kills, and point value. Its a lot of fun!

name: Zombeat-io
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombeat.io is a simple rock, paper, scissor-style arena game. The zombies have risen and sides are taken. The undead have all fallen into three different factions and each faction is a different color. You'll spawn as a randomly colored zombie and it is your job to hunt down and eradicate all zombies of the color below yours. In case your zombie faction is outnumbered or you are in a tight spot, don't worry. You can easily change factions by seeking out and finding a potion. These potions will allow you to change color from red to green to blue and back again. This way you'll never be at the mercy of an enemy if you don't want to. As you destroy opposing zombies your character will grow. Start off as a cute and spry child zombie and lowly kill your way up the ranks from teen to middle age, all the way until you're. shambling mass of flesh and earth fused together. A giant waking behemoth.

name: Zombie Arena
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombie Arena is a free zombie game. They're coming to get you, man. Listen for the air raid siren because once it goes off you won't have much time to scour the perimeter and find your weapons and staying alive. In the zombie arena winning means living and living means dishing out a lot of death. Zombie Arena is an arena game where you start off with nothing but a flashlight, a knife, and a chainsaw and then have to collect weapons like a grenade launcher, an AK, and a Samurai sword in order to cut down and destroy the encroaching zombie hordes.  Take full advantage of the mini-map in the lower left-hand corner and go ham on these here zombies. All they have is their superior numbers but you can cut that down easily with judicious use of your variety of weapons. Outrun them, sneak up on them, or just run headfirst into a mob of sluggish and evil zombies. Do not go quietly into that zombie arena, you must rage, rage, rage againse the decrepyt, brain eaters of the world.

name: Zombie Balloon Heads
author: Addicting Games
description: Stick figures fight zombies too! Fill zombie skulls with ink until they explodes. Find more ink, make a bigger gun, and keep on keeping on!

name: Zombie Balloon Heads 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Fiends, zombies and enemies of a stickly kind are here to ruin your day. No chance! Blast their hollow heads until they fill up with ink, and watch their skulls explode. Delightful! Travel through history and time, meeting and destroying lotsa zombies. Inky hilarity ensues!

name: Zombie Balloon Heads Halloween
author: Addicting Games
description: Design yourself a hilarious costume and start inking down your many enemies! Zombies, witches, goblins, exploding pumpkins...the Ink Must Flow. And there is one fat guy in a tree who is pretty annoying. Ink him out!

name: Zombie Cops of London
author: Addicting Games
description: When a government 'super cop' experiment goes horrifically wrong it's down to a budding scientist to save the world.. or at least his girlfriend!

name: Zombie Demolisher
author: Addicting Games
description: There's more to killing zombies than just machetes and shotguns and chainsaws... Try a wrecking ball for a change!

name: Zombie Invasion
author: Addicting Games
description: Survive the zombies hordes as long as you can! Prevent them from crossing the bridge! Each zombie that escapes damages your energy. Be careful not to hit the runaway survivals. Defeat them all!

name: Zombie Killer
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombie Killer is a free zombie game. The zombies are here, the apocalypse has happened, and you are left to survive against an army of undead monsters who are bent on finding you and taking you with them. Luckily, you're smart, you're wiley, and you're armed, so don't worry: you're not going out like that! Grab some weapons, upgrade your base, smash some zombies, and beat back the hordes of the evil monsters as they encroach on your own personal liberty. In this game, you'll have 1 phase of fighting where you run around the field and try to pick up a bunch of weapons and gold. In the other phase, you'll take that money that you earned and use it to upgrade your ammo, your weapons, your avatar, and your base. Determine what you think you'll need, buy it up, and then try it out against the zombies as they rage-rush towards you! do you have the ability to dodge, smash, target, and persevere against the undead? Do you think you are smarter than a dead man? In this game, you'll get the chance to prove it.

name: Zombie Love Story
author: Addicting Games
description: Help zombies find true love in this fun puzzler!

name: Zombie Massacre
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombie Massacre is a zombie fighting a game set in the wild wild west. If it wasn’t tough already to be a cowboy, now you have to slaughter zombies while protecting the frightened and defenseless townspeople. Use your available weapons to kill as many zombies as possible. As you pass each stage, you’ll earn points and unlock weapons that you can purchase and then upgrade. You can also unlock support like medkits, ammo, and other supplies that can help you in this action game. During gameplay, you’ll find green boxes that hold new items that you can use. On your dashboard, click on the sheriff to view all the achievements that you have completed or are in progress. As you gain more achievements, you’ll also rise up in ranks. On top of keeping yourself safe, protect the townspeople and the wagon. If you protect the right person, they may reward you with supplies and coins.

name: Zombie Math
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombie Math is an educational game that mixes killing zombies with math! The zombie apocalypse has hit the nation and you must do everything possible to protect yourself and others. There are still humans running for their lives and you are helping in the fight against the undead. The only way to defeat them is to solve the math questions correctly. Make studying fun with this time-sensitive math game as you solve puzzles and destroy zombies. Get the option to practice a variety of skills from preschool to eighth grade. There is addition, multiplication, decimals, and algebra that you can choose from.

name: Zombie Road
author: Addicting Games
description:
Zombie Road is a free endless driving game. The zombie apocalypse is here and you can't win. The only smart move is to hit the road and get out of town. Smash your way through hordes of shambling undead as they clog up the highways and try to stop anyone from escaping. But beware! You won't just be fighting off the zombies, you'll be fighting for space on the open road with your own fellow humans. That is right, this is the apocalypse and there are no sides. Your fellow citizens are just as anxious to get out of town as you and they're just as braindead and vicious as the zombies.

Watch out for fellow drivers as they cut you off or deliberately chare into you, your only hope for survival is to outmaneuver them and build up your score by smashing through the zombies. Do you think you have what it takes to kill em' all and dominate the leaderboard? Now is your chance to prove your worth. Hit the road in this all original racing gorefest.  Dodge cars and trash zombies as you strive for a better life somewhere on the outskirts of society. Zombie Road is a free racing and avoider game that puts you in the driver seat, behind the wheel, and against the zombie horde.

name: Zombie Shooter 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombie Shooter 2 is a free physics game. What are the best kind of bullets to kill zombies? The kind that hit them in the brain! Zombie Shooter 2 will have you popping z-heads with zee lead. Meet this puzzle-shooter at high noon in Undead Man's Gulch.

name: Zombie Situation
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombie Situation is a free tower defense game. Is your neighborhood overrun with zombies? Again? Move from your living room to the street, hook up with some friends and face down the undead apocalypse with a buttload of increasingly fantastic firearms.

name: Zombie Tower Defense: Uprise
author: Addicting Games
description: Listen up, soldier! There's only one thing standing between a zombie horde and your brains: a whole lot of guns and ammo, which is pretty much the best thing to be standing between a zombie horde and your brains. Upgrade chainguns, buzzsaws, cannons, flamethrowers and other crazy weapons, like the CorpX zombie exploder, to wipe out undead armies and gruesome bosses across five different maps.

name: Zombie Train
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombie Train is a free zombie game. Hop aboard the Zombie Train and survive for as long as you can in this 2D, side-scrolling action game. You’re stuck on the Zombie Train, and the only thing to do is stop the zombies before they’re able to stop you. Fortunately, there’s a wide array of items to help you do the job, and the zombies conveniently drop money to help you afford all those items. You’ll get a brief break to collect yourself as the train moves from one station to the next, but ultimately, it’s all zombies all the time.

name: Zombie Typocalypse
author: Addicting Games
description: Why do these Zombies keep attacking the Earth? And why do you have such bad aim? Good thing the Zombies are blathering on about stupid things - you should use that, and your supreme typing skills, to target 'em! Type those Zombies to Death!

name: Zombie World 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Strip the skin off their skulls with one simple shot. Are you quick enough to blast off their limbs and head before they go down for good?

name: Zombies Ahead
author: Addicting Games
description: One thing is for certain, the zombies are gonna keep on coming. Lock and load!

name: Zombies vs Halloween
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombies vs Halloween is a fun and exciting zombie game where you’re the only cowboy in town willing to fight off the living undead. It’s already a lawless land out here in the west but suddenly there’s a zombie apocalypse. Unfortunately for the zombies, they’re up against one of the toughest cowboys in town who isn’t willing to let them take over. For every level, you have a goal of either gaining supplies, killing zombies, or saving other humans. Protect yourself but also save any damsels or gentlemen in distress by killing the zombies before they get to them. After you’ve earned enough coins, head over to the shop to either buy a new weapon or upgrade current ones. You can also purchase support that will have healing kits and other useful items. Don’t miss out on this action zombie game set in the wild wild west!

name: Zombies Vs Penguins
author: Addicting Games
description: Use precision shots to eliminate the walking dead with limited ammunition. Everything you ever learned about penguins is useless in this game. However, there are delicious sushi treats that you can grab while battling zombies. Anchovy rolls! Snow Crab sashimi! nom nom nom

name: Zombies vs Penguins 2
author: Addicting Games
description: The penguin is back, and boy, does he still hate zombies! Many zombies stand still and take their headshots like (dead) men, but some wimpy zombies hide under rocks and behind exploding barrels of fuel (hint!). Do what needs doing, penguin.

name: Zombo Buster
author: Addicting Games
description: What's a landlord's worst nightmare? Zombies. Everyone knows that zombies make horrible tenants. Keep the zombies out of your buildings at all costs - your property values depend on it!

name: Zombocalypse
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombocalypse is a free zombie game. Its you vs. a horde of hungry, hungry zombies. Your goal: Make strategic use of limited ammo and health to stay alive (and unlock more powerful weapons). Tip: Call in an airstrike when things get too bitey.

name: Zombotron 2: Time Machine
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombotron 2: Time Machine is a free platform game. Time travel is totally possible. All you have to do is play Zombotron 2: Time Machine and 10 hours from now, you'll wonder where your day went. Explore a zombified planet to find fuel for your spaceship, but beware: Who knows what evil lurks deep in the heart of this alien world? (Well, actually, we know. It's zombies.)

name: Zombusterz.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombusterz is a free iogame. Sometimes it's just you, your fists, and an angry army of undead punks who are heck-bent on devouring the living. If you want to survive you'll need more than just your wits. Collect various items, ammunition, and upgrades that will put you one notch above the rest. At first, you think you can take the zombies on one at a time. But you'll quickly realize that it's never just one on one. As soon as you enter into fisticuffs the other zombies will get wind and they begin to horde you, they begin to swirl around you and tear you apart. This is why you need to think ahead and move fast. Collect your weapons, take potshots at the zombies from behind. Its never a fair fight anyway so why pretend. Get could with your weapons because you're not going to be able to punch your way out of this one. Stay frosty as you avoid any dead-end entanglements. And watch out for big zombies. The zombies who have grown large by feasting on living flesh. Do not engage with the giants unless you're armed to the teeth and ready to rock and roll.

name: ZOMGies
author: Addicting Games
description: Why are the zombies in your pajamas? Run barefoot through the streets, blasting the undead as you go. Remember, it's ok to hate zombies. Hate them and shoot them.

name: ZOMGies2
author: Addicting Games
description: Them zombies are back, but you have better options and you are wearing shoes! Get in a vehicle to mow zombies in stylish comfort. Grab pizzas, Chinese take out and zombie antidotes to keep up ur strangth.

name: Zoo Trivia
author: Addicting Games
description: No description available.

name: Zumba Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Zumba mania is a free bubble shooter game. Enter into this daring jungle world filled with orbs and Zumba. This is a game where a helpful frog will show you the way. Through the waterfall, you will find a group of bubbles that you need to destroy! This game is fairly easy, just aim and shoot at matching bubbles. As you shoot the bubbles, more bubbles will be added to the bunch and it will begin moving around. Whatever you do, do not let the bubbles pass the portal at the end of the level. As you keep playing, you will sometimes find power-ups like bombs that will let you blast the group no matter what color they are. Blast as many bubbles as you can for the best score possible! Play the game over and over by challenging yourself and beating your best score every time. Click on the scores icon to drop down the list of the high scorers of this bubble shooter game. Will you make the list?

name: ZZZ Snake
author: Addicting Games
description: ZZZ Snake is a cute action game that you can play on your computer or mobile device! Play as a cute and silly snake that wiggles back and forth either up or down the screen. Depending on what’s easier for you, select either Go Up or Go Down to navigate your snake character. Search for blocks that are the same color as your snake to increase your score. As you’re playing, the snake will change colors so be prepared and do not hit any blocks that do not match the color of the snake at that time. Your score is dependent on the numbers each block contains. Click on the trophy icon to drop down the leaderboards and see how you’re doing against your other friends. Play again to rise up the leaderboards and beat your own personal best score. This online game may seem easy but you will see it can get difficult to navigate in between all the blocks as your snake changes colors.

Survive the enemy onslaught, destroy their ships and get the warp barge home – or be destroyed! Instructions to play are in the tutorial at the start of the game and a controls graphic shows you how to get the most out of your ships.

Age of Ascent: Arrival is a mini-game preview of our early release, due out soon. Illyriad Games Ltd. is a small UK-based indie dev team with a focus on MMO’s and co-ops with direct play and deep strategy.

name: AI가 만든 UI를 체험해 보세요! ( Enjoy the AI-generated game UI! )
author: DMeloper
description:
◆ 화면 우측 하단의 음소거 버튼을 해제하면 효과음과 함께 즐기실 수 있습니다. ◆

◆ 화면 우측 하단 전체화면으로 더 몰입감있게 플레이하실 수 있습니다. ◆

이 프로젝트는 AI로 실제 적용 가능한 게임 UI를 만들 수 있는지 탐구하기 위해 제작되었습니다.

[ 단축키 안내 ]
'F' 키 : AI 요소들을 찾아볼 수 있습니다.
'V' 키 : 메뉴창을 모바일-PC 디자인으로 변경할 수 있습니다.

[사용된 AI서비스 목록]
- 미드저니
   : 맨 처음 이미지를 생성할 때 사용되었습니다.
- 스테이블디퓨전
   : 생성한 이미지를 변형할 때 사용되었습니다.
제작 과정은 제 유튜브 채널에서 확인하실 수 있습니다. https://youtu.be/Ffxtq93qqU8?si=KzSTVki1wpxXHvOC

This project was born out of curiosity about how cool AI could make game UIs.

[ Keyboard shortcuts ].
'F' : Browse the AI elements.
'V' : Change the menu windows to a mobile-PC design.

[List of AI services used].
- Midjourney
was used to generate the first image.

- StableDiffusion
was used to deform the generated image.

In addition, the UI configuration was created by referring to the asset Cartoon GUI Pack.
You can watch the creation process on my YouTube channel.https://youtu.be/Ffxtq93qqU8?si=KzSTVki1wpxXHvOC

author: ProdigiousMike
description: Explore the alien video game store! Toggle between 10 cameras with the "c" key, or use a numbered key 0-9. Alternatively, and for mobile users, you can use the on-screen GUI for camera & sound control. My contributions include: Shaders: The alien box on the counter uses a custom-scripted shader that dynamically moves, glows, & changes opacity. Lighting: Neon lights decorate the walls & shelves, brightening the scene & attracting attention to various wares. Animation: Upon entering the store, you are greeted by the cashier, who waves & bows, while alien customers wander & examine different games. VFX: Make a wish! Peek out the window to see shooting stars, but watch your head, as steam may come out of pipes & vents. Cameras: The scene contains 10 views to appreciate the entire scene. Post-processing: Colorful, bright, vibrant filter. Audio: Muzak blares from the speakers as machines droll & aliens communicate in squeaky speech. name: Annihilator
author: blackdiamondgamedev
description:
​Annihilator, is a game where you are trapped in a planet called T131 and you have to kill all the Zyrus Robots and ESCAPE!

Story​ - (It was year 2099 in Earth) You and your team were going in a spaceship to T131 planet for research work when suddenly a meteorite hits your spaceship. The meteorite creates a big hole in the spaceship. You were the only one wearing the spacesuit so you survive but your team gets lost in the space forever! You're some teammates land on the planet but the Zyrus Robots kill them! . You wake up and find yourself in a planet, when you see your spacesuit GPS, you find out you are in T131 planet. You find out that this planet is conquered and ruled by Zyrus robots. Disclaimer - Zyrus Robots are robots who have many leaders. They are strong and almost like robots. They're found in Kepler planet.
You just have a plasma gun. You have to kill them all and survive!

The user can vary the aspect ratio of the blades and blade pitch angle as well as the wind speed and direction. The turbine has a simple generator model that outputs power proportional to aerodynamic torque and rotation rate. The brightness of the light is proportional to the power generated. How much green energy can you make?  www.aerodynamicobjects.com

name: Astro

description:
Astro is an endless runner where you travel through the Milky Way Galaxy, seeking to get the highest score possible while evading all obstacles in your way. As you advance through different planets and achieve higher scores, you will encounter more hurdles to avoid while maintaining your fuel for your jetpack. This game is purely a passion project, and actually my first game so any criticism or advice is greatly appreciated.                                                       
                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                           The controls are simple, with A and D used to go left and right, and space being used to use your jetpack!

Since this game is on a browser, the quality overall isn't up to par with the actual application version, so if you would like the better and official Astro it'll be here at my itch.io page: https://rodriler.itch.io/astro. Just scroll a little down, click download, and unzip/extract the files. With that, you'll have the official version of Astro!                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                       
Check out Astro on simmer.io: https://simmer.io/@rodriler/astro

Normally to pause you would press Escape, but the browser kind of interferes with key, so I also allowed Tab to be used to pause or unpause for the browser version.

I used some assets, so they'll be below:

name: Ball Sprinter 3D: City Adventure
author: Alex4791
description:
Note: This game does not seem to be exported properly in WebGL format. I will look into this error as soon as possible. Hope to make this work online soon!

Welcome to an exploration of a forward moving ball object in a road filled with squared and rectangular objects all in the way! Navigate your journey through cities, glaciers, forests and more better seen than said. Collect pick ups of varying points to increase your high score. Discover ways to control and master the endless forward running speed by timing the left and right movements to your convenience at play. Certain white objects or other speed bump lookalikes help reduce an outburst of uncontrollable fastness. Every rate of speed affects the game's progress indefinitely. Avoid brown colored obstacles at all costs! A single collision and the game is done for. The adventure holding its own provides different ways to be overcome. Look out for special openings and tactics to your ever evolving advantage!

name: BasketBallTraining
author: N_Ryz
description:
A simple game of hitting a basketball hoop.

Control.
You can adjust the angle of the ball with the up and down arrows. The power of the throw is controlled by holding the space bar. If you release the space bar, the ball will fly towards the target.

Victory conditions.
You are competing with a computer controlled opponent. Your task is to throw more balls into the basket than your opponent in ten attempts. If you find it too easy or, on the contrary, too hard, you can raise / lower your opponent's level after every 10 throws.

Hint: you almost always hit the hoop if the throwing power is between 401-419 and the ball is aimed at the inner rectangle of the basketball backboard.

author: Zhiu_1234
description:
This game is based on the CWC Live prototype 4, but it has some extras:

- Basic movement (space = jump. vertical movement for speed control, horizontal movement for camera control)
- Three unique power-ups: Shockwave jump, auto-aim bullets and power tackle
- Normal, aggressive and boss enemies
- Each boss has an additional ability: spawning additional enemies, firing homing missiles at player, or agile jumps
- The game counts the waves and at wave 4, 6 and 10, boss enemies will spawn
- Postprocessing effects
- Cheat button "R" will reset the player back to the platform
Try to finish all waves and be victorious (without using "R"). Have fun! :)

name: Beatdown Breakdown Boomtastic
author: johnnyjacques
description:
Originally created for a game jam by a team of 4, “Beatdown Breakdown Boomtastic” is a 2.5D experience that combines classic beat-em-up gameplay with rhythm game mechanics. All graphics were created from scratch, 2D images were animated using Unity's skeletal animation. 3D assets were made using ProBuilder. There are slight audio issues in the webGL build, you can also download the game here :

https://davidflyr.itch.io/beatdown-breakdown-boomtastic

Summary :

Hit those beats HARD! You've been hired as a security guard at a concert, and it's your job to protect the DJ from unruly fans rushing the stage to drag him away. Finish the song to win; fail to protect the DJ and you'll get booed offstage.

Power up your punches by lining them up with the beat of the DJ's music. You help him, he helps you back-- stronger together!

Controls:

Keyboard: "WASD" to move, "Space" to jump, "Left-click" to attack, "Esc" to quit.
Controller: D-pad/L-stick to move, "A" to attack, "B" to jump.

author: game_able
description: Bee Alive est un jeu vidéo développé pour la première fois par Anh-Thi, Lorie et Thérèse qui propose un premier niveau  dans le genre "infinite runner". Dans ce niveau , le joueur incarne le rôle d'une abeille perdue en ville, luttant pour éviter les nuages de pesticides et de polluants mortels. Le but ultime est de survivre aussi longtemps que possible. Avec des graphismes captivants et une musique immersive, Bee Alive offre une expérience de jeu palpitante où les réflexes rapides et la prise de décision rapide sont essentiels pour franchir les obstacles et atteindre des niveaux  score élevés. Préparez-vous à un défi sans fin dans le monde urbain dangereux de Bee Alive.

name: Beer Run
author: iAmChrisBro
description:
Beer Run is an Indie game created to steal beers from supermarkets. Three guys with a plan to steal more beer after running out, they go into multiple grocery stores to rob beer. Security guards are the enemy while the characters intend to rob from a store. As you progress throughout the game, each level gets harder by improving their security system. Multiple security guards in certain levels that make it tough to steal without being caught. As you collect more beers the character starts to slow down from all the weight being carried, creating another challenge besides evading the security. 

Features include - 
Limited carrying supply
Slowed down speed when carrying beers.
Can drop beers to gain speed.
3-star reward system
Story
3 different characters

description:
‘Twas a nice summer’s day at the castle, until it was visited by the devastating, rock breathing, Stone Dragon. But not to worry! This castle has a Dragon Blaster. The only problem is, the power charger is outside the walls!!
Can you save the castle by charging the Blaster while dodging the on-slaughter of rocks?

[Instructions]
Tap the button to Jump.

name: Blackjack
author: LZimm7
description:
Everyone loves blackjack, the classic luck/strategy casino game., and whether you're a seasoned pro or a blackjack newbie, this immersive online blackjack experience serves as a free training ground to gamble without any real risk.

A leaderboard for the highest amount of money earned by players is included in the main menu. Keep in mind that the leaderboard only accounts for money that you had when you cashed out, not your peak amount of money, so try to time your cash-out effectively. 

6 Decks are used in this game, and they are reshuffled about halfway through the shoe.

Please leave any feedback in the comments.

House Rules:

Blackjack pays 3-2: This is standard, but still needs to be specified.

Dealer must stand any 17: This is standard but still needs to be specified.

Insurance is unavailable: Insurance is a weird thing in blackjack, when to use insurance is widely debated and even unknown to many. Many people never use insurance, so I decided not to include it.

Splitting is not allowed: The application of a split is rare, as the player is unlikely to be dealt a pair. If a player is dealt a pair, it is still rare that they would split any cards besides aces or eights. On top of its sparse application, splitting is an unnecessary advantage given to the player. This game moves very quickly, and when the player loses, they can simply just play again, so I found that the dealer needed another slight advantage, which I achieved by not including splitting.
