name: BlendIn
author: kakarrot97
description:
General Description

The player is assigned a color that initially matches the platform it starts on. There will be different color shifters and different color platforms on the way. When a player walks/jumps through a color shifter, the character’s color changes to that specific color enabling it to “blend in”. The player needs to avoid mismatching its character’s color to the platform's color while steering clear of other obstacles and making it to the endpoint to move on to the next level.

Goal

The goal is to match the player's color with the platform (and at the same time avoid other obstacles) and reach the endpoint. Mechanics (How to play) Player moves: Keyboard keys ‘A/Left’ and ‘D/Right’ to move left and right; ‘W/Spacebar’ to jump. Color change: Change character color when it walks/jumps through a color shifter. Color match: Match the character color to the platform. If it matches, the game continues; else the player loses.

Inspiration

Platformer: Mario, Vector, Mr. Jump Color Change/Match: Color Ball Run, Color Switch

name: Bus Simulator
author: CH_HASSAAN
description:
In School Bus Simulator, you take on the role of a school bus driver with the important task of picking up students and getting them safely to school. Your goal is to find children at three different bus stops, stop the bus at each station, and pick them up to win the game. Pay attention to your surroundings and be cautious of collisions along the way.

Controls:

Movement: Use your Arrow keys or W A S D to drive the bus.
Stop & Pick Up: Press Space to stop the bus and pick up students at each bus stop.

How to Play:

Pick Up Students: Locate the bus stops and stop the bus at each station (floor). Press Space to pick up the children waiting at each stop.
Complete the Route: Successfully pick up all students from the three bus stops and deliver them to school to win the game.
Avoid Collisions: Be careful while driving to avoid collisions with obstacles and other vehicles.

name: Captain Antonia and the Pillars of Albatross
author: CrypticAlbatross
description:
My (CrypticAlbatross) submission to the LEGO "Build Your Own Game" contest.

The Pillar Islands of Albatross are slowly crumbling into the sea as earthquakes and maelstroms rattle the world. To reverse the tide of destruction and save the people of Albatross, the explorer Captain Antonia must recover technological relics of a bygone civilization.

Gameplay features.
•	The game uses procedural generation for much of its content. From the menu you can always restart a level with a different seed. Unless you use the same seed number, every playthrough is different, some more challenging than others!
•	You can switch between four different cameras: far, near, first-person, and cinematic.
•	Five levels: prologue, the Voxelwood Forest, the Cubic Caldera, the Fractal Canyon, and Scholar's Island.

Other details:
•	I created the music using Reaper digital audio workstation.
•	I created all LEGO models using the LEGO editor asset on Unity.

It is a Unity-based game where players can play soccer by driving cars.
Almost all game mechanics and all assets are created by me.
The game currently includes a single-player mode with AI-controlled cars, offering various match setups such as 1v1, 2v2 (with an AI teammate), or uneven matches like 2v1 and 1v2.
The creation of the game is documented in a YouTube video series, where you can see almost the entire process of building the game from scratch.
Through the video series, I prepare game models, textures, scripts, and the integration of sound and music, as well as the implementation of single-player capabilities.
I am planning to create a multiplayer mode in the future.
For now, have fun playing against AI players.

name: Christmas Cruizer 1.0
author: Dhananjay2981
description:
Welcome to the wonderful world of our Christmas-themed car game! In this 
game, the driver of a car is on a mission to collect a fixed number of gifts and 
deliver them to their designated destinations, all while navigating through 
challenging terrains filled with obstacles. 
As the player journey through the winter wonderland, he will encounter 
adorable snowmen and mischievous devils, both of which will try to impede his 
progress. The snowmen will appear in his path, and if he hits them, his car's 
health will decrease. Meanwhile, the devils will follow the player, causing 
damage to your vehicle. 
With each level, the challenge intensifies, but so do the rewards. The player will 
discover health boxes along the way that replenishes his health, helping him to 
overcome the obstacles that lie ahead. 
As the player explores the enchanting winter landscape, he will encounter 
breath-taking scenes of snow-covered mountains, picturesque towns, and 
forests. The game's soundtrack is filled with festive holiday tunes that will 
transport the player to a world of holiday cheer.

name: Clean The Cleaners
author: thewazaa
description:
History
To clean is your life.

You have a heavy Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD) that doesn't let you feel well with the world if your house is not clean and something is out of order.

So, when you had to leave your house for a business trip and had to leave your family alone at home, you contacted a cleaning agency to make sure that your house would be clean when you came back.

And you left.

And you came back.

And the cleaning agency was not what it seemed. At your back, you found your family, your wife, your child, your dog, killed and sliced.

And the house was a mess, filled in blood, with everything in complete disorder.

And it is this disorder, not the death of your family, that requires revenge.

Controls
Movement: Left stick, WASD keys, arrow keys
Rotation: Right stick, Mouse
Jump: North button, space key
Action: East button, Alt key (avoid to use it if you run the game in the web browser), E key
Run: Left trigger, shift key
Shoot: Right trigger: left button
Outside this game, avoid drinking bleach to regain your health. IT DOES NOT WORK

name: CMYK Match
author: JMGomezCobo
description:
🎮 About the game:
Dive into the vibrant world of CMYK Match, where your task is to master the art of color blending using the CMYK color model. Test your skills by matching colors with precision, and race against the clock to achieve the highest score!

🎯 What's the main goal? 
The main goal of CMYK Match is to match the randomly generated target color using sliders representing the cyan, magenta, yellow, and black (key) channels. The closer your color is to the target, the more points you score.

🧩 How to play:
• Adjust Sliders: Use the cyan, magenta, yellow, and black sliders to mix and match the current color with the target color. 
• Input Fields: You can also type specific values in the input fields for precise adjustments. 
• Check Match: Press the spacebar or click the on-screen button to check if your color matches the target. The closer the match, the more points you earn!

💡 A few tips:
• Precision Matters: The closer your color is to the target, the more points you score. Fine-tune your adjustments for better accuracy.  
• Speed Counts: You earn more points for quicker matches. Balance speed and precision to maximize your score. 
• Increasing Challenge: The game starts with a forgiving tolerance but gets more challenging as you progress through the rounds.

Test your color-matching prowess and strive for the perfect match in CMYK Match! Can you achieve the ultimate high score and master the art of CMYK color blending?

Corvus Corax (or "The Corvus Corax Mystery" is a gothic style puzzle platforming game, where you must use key-binds, and expend your own health in order to manipulate the ground and solve the level.

The game follows the character: "crow" in their mental health Journey, as they fight against their own brain and save themself from the dark spiral of inky black, which lies in their heart. As the story progresses Crow gains more color in their life, as they start to see the world through a brighter lens, they start to reach the end of the dampened and dark tunnel that is their soul.

name: Crazy Farm
author: Darkzarich
description:
Controls:
Move - Left\Right Arrows or A\D keys 
Change Food - Up/Down Arrows or W\S keys
Throw food - Left Mouse Button or Left Ctrl

Feed the animals the food they love to gain score! If you feed an animal the food it doesn't like you will loose the score. Bumping into any animal results in death so be careful!

Tip:

Horses like carrots
Dogs like bones
Cows like ... pears!

Assets were taken from the course "Junior Programmer Pathway - Unit 2". I felt bad for leave it at the state it was by the end of Unit 2 so decided to add some more functionality to make it something more or less finished

Enjoy!

name: Crystal Radio
author: Keexi
description:
A short rogue-like that changes based on the music you have playing. Now testing controller support. The majority of controls should be functional. The bumpers shoot and dodge, the triggers switch weapons (for now), and the DPad controls the music player. Up to play, down, to pause, hold down to stop, right for next song and left for previous. Controller input on WebGL apps is very spotty, but at least Xbox controllers have been confirmed to work.

name: CWC Game Jam 2021 - Ben-Hur-Ry Up!
author: Zhiu_1234
description:
TLDR:
W: Boost (has cooldown)
SPACE: Combat trick against green cubes (has cooldown)
MOUSE: Camera
A+D: Move sideways (the chariot moves forward on its own)
Please read carefully, as the MVP project doesn't hold your hand when it comes to accessibility.
You are Ben, one of the brave chariot racers and you want to be the first one finishing two laps without dying. Dying?! Oh yes,... This race is not for the meek. You can tackle and boost your way to glory! Use the "w" key to get a small boost and hit that "space" button to get a super force field to attack the enemies. The enemies are those green thingies riding the chariots, by the way...
Oh yeah, and because your engine-horses are so super smart, they will drive the chariot for you automatically. So lean back and kick those opponents out of the race. You have full 360° view with your mouse so keep it wisely to keep track of both what's happening in front of you and behind you. If you wish, you can override the auto-pilot and use "A" and "D" to steer.
This game jam was fun, but also super intense. I tried to squeeze in as much free time as I could, while still having my 9-to-5 job and the everyday chaos happening around me. At least I could dig up around 10-12 hours and invested it in learning some stuff about racing car AI and fighting against physics.

This is a little personal project I've been working on for some months. On January 2021 i began to learn unity and C# from scratch, and this is the progress so far.

Can you defend your ground by clicking on the evil monsters? Massive waves of enemies just waiting to get on the other side, and only YOU are there to stop them.


Currently there are 3 levels with only one boss, but each level is unique because it offers a new type of enemy. See them all ;))

There is already implemented different enemy behavior, different attack skills, critical chance, acid damage, magic resist and armor values are different for each enemy, fire damage over time, slowing (used by the Wiz skill) and many more is already written.

This project is in development, so I've added the core functionality, but in the future I plan to add more enemies (they are already present), bosses (also hidden), characters and their new abilities.
All 2d and audio resources were taken from itch.io, and I thank the authors for the permission to use them in my project. This is my first project and I'm very happy to introduce it.
Please feel free to test and comment.

name: Energycell
author: matbout
description:
Un chasseur de prime s’écrase sur une planète qui lui est inconnue. Sans autre option, il décide d’aller chasser la seule personne qui a sa tête à prix: le scientifique fou Zakhar. Il va devoir sillonner une dimension peu connue pour atteindre son objectif. Devant ce défi, allez-vous vaincre le docteur Zakhar et permettre à Bob de se sortir de ce pétrin ou allez-vous échouer misérablement et devenir un autre cobaye pour les expériences malsaines de Zakhar?

Contrôles
- Clavier et Souris
--- Bouger : WASD
--- Sauter : Espace
--- Viser : Souris
 (Débloqués plus tard dans le jeu)
--- Tirer : Clic Gauche
--- Changer de dimension : Shift
-Manette
--- Bouger : Stick Gauche ou Croix Directionnelle
--- Sauter : A
--- Viser : Stick Droit
 (Débloqués plus tard dans le jeu)
--- Tirer : Gachette Droite
--- Changer de dimension : Gachette Gauche

Jeu réalisé dans le cadre du Projet de développement de jeux vidéo au Cégep de Sainte-Foy.

Auteurs :
- Mathieu Boutet
- Jérémy Faucher
- Dave Ouellet
- Mickael Chabot
- Samuel Ménard
- Rebecca Brassard

On mobile, go to: https://hub.link/maDiwdr

Atlantis is an abandoned aquatic park in Mexico City, which has become half forbidden half a spot to visit. Artists go there to make graffiti, street art, as well as music videos, and more! name: FabYutNori
author: greenstorm2669
description:
Traditional Korean Wood Game is now released and visible on https://play.unity.com/mg/other/webgl-builds-382488. In the latest update, the last bug has been fixed, and a new rule has been added. Now, you can hold Yut results when it's 4 or 5, and those results can be combined as you wish. Yut Nori, also known as Yunnori, is a traditional Korean board game that is particularly popular during the Korean Lunar New Year. The game involves a board, usually made of cloth or wood, and is played with four wooden sticks, called yut sticks, which serve as dice. Each side of the sticks has a different value, dictating the movement of the players' pieces on the board.

The objective of Yut Nori is to move all of one's pieces, or "mal," around the board and back to the starting point. The game can be played by two to four players or teams, and it encourages strategic thinking and cooperation, especially in team play. The unique aspect of Yut Nori is the possibility of getting extra turns or movements based on the outcome of the stick throws, making the game unpredictable and exciting.

Yut Nori is not only a game of luck but also of strategy, as players decide the best way to move their pieces in response to the throws, and how to best utilize the special moves allowed by certain combinations of the yut sticks. It's a game that brings families and friends together, fostering a sense of community and celebration during festive occasions.

7 Feb 2024 Major update to integrate the use of a rule that was communicated to me only at the end of January - the rule of making all throws when a 4 or a 5 is rolled and storing them to choose the most strategic combination later. Indeed, beyond creating a dropdown list and subsequent choice buttons, the computer was not able to click on them and wait for updates. Now, with the addition of a few variables and timers, it can click the last created button when necessary. As for the strategy, I have my ideas, but it will require more development.

name: Feed the Dogs 29.2.24
author: rmcc1983
description:
This started as a junior programmer pathway tutorial but I have built on it!

Read the story & instructions. Choose your character.  Choose your difficulty level to change starting lives, amounts of food, spawn start delay, spawn interval, powerup duration and what visual assistance you have - tooltips will help you decide. Enter your name to personalise displays. Move using WASD, arrow keys or the D-pad or left stick of a gamepad.  Feed the border collies bones using 8 (PS4 square), German Shepherds steaks using 9 (PS4 cross), and St Bernards cookies using 0 (PS4 circle).  German Shepherds need 1 piece of food, Collies need 2, St Bernards need 3...unless you miss too many dogs, in which case each subsequent dog will require an extra piece of food.  Keep missing, and eventually the dogs will require yet another piece.  Collect the star powerup to temporarily get sandwiches which they can all eat, and it only takes one to feed them (throw using backspace or PS4 triangle). Collect the shield powerup to be temporarily safe from dogs crashing into you. Collect hearts for extra lives. Mouse over the dogs, food etc in game for tooltips (and enjoy the custom mouse pointer)!  Pause using P (or PS4 R1), quit using escape.  The more dogs you feed, the faster they run! Don't let the dogs hit you, and don't feed them the wrong food - you will lose lives! Survive 2 minutes to win.

Gamepads are supported (I have tested with PS4 controller on WebGL) and the WebGL game can be played on mobile devices as I have added touch controls (including a virtual keyboard).



If you would like to complete my feedback form, please go to https://forms.office.com/r/ATTPTGmjPN?origin=lprLink



I am trying to learn, so constructive feedback very welcome. Please be kind!

description:
My final project for the Creative Core Unity course. It features and showcases many of the things I learned during the course.
Although this project took me a long time to create, there are still things I wish I could've done better and things that I could've implemented to enrich the user experience.
However, I'm glad it's done!

WebGL has a bug at the start of the game that prevents you from looking around. Simply start the game then exit fullscreen and then fullscreen again and click the mouse to remove the cursor!

The project is called 'Enter The Portal' and it's a 3D platformer. There are two levels with one bonus level where I tweaked the camera angle to give the user a different perspective.
Simply guide the character through the portal to progress to the next level.
I wanted to make fun-looking levels for the user to explore and feel at ease with.

I did make a third level but the scope and vision of it changed as it became too big!

name: Forgotten Dungeon 2
author: Unity Play
description:
Forgotten Dungeon 2 is an addictive hack-and-slash action RPG.
Slay skeletons, zombies, and other monsters as you explore dungeons.
You will gain experience for each kill, and sometimes, enemies will drop items.
When you level up, you can upgrade your strength, dexterity, intelligence, vitality, and spells.
Increase your attack/damage and defense by equipping yourself with better weapons and armor.

Choose between a sorcerer, archer, and warrior in this Diablo style RPG adventure game. Build experience and level up by defeating enemies.
Equip your character with items that are found, won in battle, or purchased from various vendors. There are a ton of different items to choose from in this game.

When you level up, the player has a choice of certain skills and attributes to improve and expand upon with their earned experience points.
Items and weapons collected which are not equipped can be sold at the shop for gold. Attacks can be melee based or magic based. Click on the target enemy to battle. 

Your magical skills can be selected from the left of the screen. Using these decreases the mana levels but deliver extra attack damage.
You can go back to town at any time by clicking the town button beside the skills button, and returning through the portal brings you back to where you left off.

Special attack types can target weakness areas of enemies, so choosing when to use the proper magical attacks is important.
The equipment you have selected actually shows up on the your character in the game.
Strength increases damage. Dexterity increases attack speed and dodge chance. Intelligence increases magic speed, magic damage, and mana max. Vitality increases life max.

name: FrankenLight
author: Pericky
description: Help Victor Frankenstein learn the secrets of life and death: In the novel "Frankenstein", Mary Shelley often symbolizes light as a symbol of knowledge. As light can shed light on darkness enabling us to see and understand more of our surroundings/world, knowledge also helps us understand the world and the unexplored/unknown darkness. Unfortunately, too much light can also blind, making one ignorant of their surroundings. In Walton and Victor's case, they had too much knowledge and failed to see the consequences and were ignorant of what their actions could do. Therefore the main idea of my game is to use scrolls/knowledge/light for good like helping you advance in the game, but be careful of not getting too ambitious and try to get too many scrolls because you may become ignorant of your surroundings and fall to your death. Use a and d to move left and right, space to jump. Let the scrolls guide you through the dark unknown and find the secrets of life and death. Good Luck!

name: Game Of G (Pre-Release)
author: StaggeringlyPurple
description: [IMPORTANT: If your mouse sensitivity is too high or you don't know how to play the game, press P. Also please don't press close or the game crashes.]                                                                                       This is a pre-release tutorial of my Unity survival game. Hopefully the full game will be available on Steam or itch.io sometime soon, but for now, this is all that I'm releasing. It is just a quick and simple walkthrough that explains the basic mechanics of the game. Also, there is a free play level, where you can run around and do stuff. In that scene, you can practice aiming your bow and arrow, and work on your building. This was a lot more difficult than I anticipated, but I'm overall pretty satisfied with the way it came out. I used Blender for the 3D modeling and Visual Studio for the scripting. I would love to hear your feedback as long as you keep the comments friendly and appropriate. I hope you enjoy!😃(Also please don’t judge my lousy art)

name: Glub
author: Unity Play
description:
1. English
2. French

----- 1. English -----

End-of-studies project on Unity (3WAcademy 2021, session 09, during the health crisis).

Completion time: 1.5 months.

This project is designed for Cross Platform: you can play it on mobile, WebGL or PC.

This game is a Casual and Arcade game for 7 year olds. The player controls Glub who has to hit cubes to get stars.

The movements are done in 2D on a finite dimension board. The view is in 3D, centered on Glub and the camera follows the position of the character.

Cubes fall from the sky at random positions and at regular intervals. They roll away from the board. Collecting cubes earns points.

A level lasts 30 seconds. An alarm clock that extends the time drops 5 seconds before the end of the countdown; collecting it moves to the next level and the timer restarts.

Failure rules: when Glub leaves the board or when the countdown is at 0.

A number of levels have been created offering various challenges.

Best score is saved.

The user inputs are real time, i.e. you can for example play on a touch terminal and switch to keyboard-mouse or joystick control without interruption. The mobile control is inspired by Sky made by That Game Company.

The project is subject to Responsive Design: on mobile in particular, the game supports portrait or landscape orientations, which influences the gameplay (portrait: 1 finger and move, landscape: 2 fingers and move and rotate camera) and the display of data on the screen (position of elements, dimensions ...).

Bonuses to be collected according to the score levels obtained are planned, but it is not realized at this time. I focused on the core of the game.

On the development side, this Unity project includes the Universal Render Pipeline, the new InputSystem, Singletons, ScriptableObjects and Unity Events. All scripts have a custom display by EditorScripting (I had to recreate the FlexBox CSS behavior).

The UI animations still have some bugs and I'm not satisfied by the architecture

The whole project design was heavily inspired by Hearthestone.

name: Hell Scape
author: Unity Play
description:
Te propongo un trato para salir del Infierno con tu alma intacta.
En el Infierno hay cuatro calabozos con diversas habitaciones y en cada habitación vive uno de mis demonios.  Ellos se alimentan de oro o del alma de algún incauto que pase frente a ellos.
En cada calabozo deberás alimentar a todos los demonios y salir por donde llegaste. Si superas los cuatro calabozos, te dejaré salir del Infierno con tu alma intacta.
Al inicio de cada calabozo te daré suficientes monedas de oro para alimentar a todos sus habitantes al menos una vez. Pero si te quedas sin oro, el siguiente demonio devorará tu alma y te quedarás en el Infierno para siempre.
¿Qué decides? ¿Quieres salvar tu alma?

name: Hotels Inc. - Prototype
author: Clara_Krieg
description:
Snapping is currently really wonky.

Minimum Goal: 

To build a hotel manager/tycoon game, where you start with a plot of land and build a hotel on it. You will hire employees to run the main aspects of the hotel (i.e. cleaning, reception, cooking, etc.) which will cost money. Once the hotel is built and employees hired, you will open for business and begin to attract guests, which will increase your revenue. You lose if your funds reaches a negetive value.

Long-term Goal:

Allow you to build a multiple level hotel with a rating system that increases guest flow.
Give the player more lots to purchase to have multiple hotels at once.
Allow the player to sell a hotel to gain lump sum amount, as well as add loans to get you more features up front, but at a cost.
Add in marketing campaigns that cost per day, but bring in more guests based on hotel ratings.

ตัวเกมเล่นได้เลยทันที ไม่ต้องโหลดลงเครื่อง ฉะนั้นหายห่วงเรื่องความปลอดภัยหรือไวรัสได้เลย

พร้อมแล้วก็กลายร่างไปเป็นแม่หอยกันได้เลย!
ที่ลิ้งค์นี้ >>>  



---
Game Created for Tawatnewt Fans! By Tawatnewt!!

Hey! We've got a game for you to try. It's called HoyFrenzy V1.0 (by Tawatnewt).

This is a game I created myself, and it's about a mother pearl oyster searching for her babies while also foraging for food along the way to stave off hunger.

This is just the prototype version, and it won’t take long to play (~3 minutes). Once the mother pearl oyster is full, she transforms into her complete form! There's only one level for now, but in future versions, I'll be adding more types of food, enemies, obstacles, and improved gameplay features. I guarantee it’ll be even more fun!

The game is playable directly—no download required. So you don't have to worry about security or viruses.

Each Hydra has its unique color and personality.  When the game starts ships are quickly and randomly sailing across the scene, the players repeatedly press designated keyboard keys assigned to their Hydra in order to eat the ships.  Players earn one point for each ship eaten,  but watch out, players can lose 5 points if they eat a toxic ship and gain 5 bonus points if they eat a gold ship. The player with the highest score wins the game.

Dear reader, 
My name is Docter Elizabeth Eams and I need your help. If you are reading this something must have gone terribly wrong. I have been working for almost 13 years on an alien that I call Frailien, But the truth of the matter is that I do not know who I can trust among my colleagues since Fralien is capable of a great deal. As a contingency plan, I have a build-in connection between me and Fralien.  For if or when Fralien is controlled without the secret code that I haven't shared with anyone. If this message is released that means that Fralien has killed and destroyed against its own will. You are the chosen one. It is not sure how you will find my lab and surroundings but be prepared for the worst...  
I need you to collect documents so we can figure out how to stop Frailien.

author: SFBTom
description:
Arriving on the shores of a mysterious island, you discover ruins of a once-mighty tower. But can it still be climbed? Perhaps, if the island lends you its power... 

~~~

CONTROLS: WASD or arrow keys to move, mouse to look around

~~~

I built this game over the last 2 weeks or so, in spare evenings, and I'm really happy with how it turned out! I put together a tool to auto-build Lego models from ProBuilder mesh shapes, so that I didn't have to hand place every brick in Unity or stud.io. I also tinkered around with giving the minifig character more of a stop-motion look, by forcing their animations to a lower framerate than the game.

I hope you enjoy the maze, it should be a fairly short game, though I'm not exactly sure - I know the routes already when testing!

For the Lego Ideas 'Build your own game' contest, Lego Ideas username SFBTom

O Jogo do Peixinho Dourado é um jogo divertido e educativo para todas as idades.

O objetivo é desenvolver o raciocínio lógico e a matemática de uma forma discreta e lúdica.

Veja as regras:

1. São 15 peixinhos, sendo 1 dourado e 14 verdes.

2. Dois jogadores se alternam para retirar os peixinhos verdes, podendo retirar 1, 2 ou 3 peixinhos por vez.

3. O jogador que ficar com o peixinho dourado perde o jogo.

Será que você consegue encontrar a melhor estratégia para vencer? Experimente e descubra! 🐟

Bom jogo.
Fernando F.

name: John Conway's Game Of Life
author: AfroDog
description:
John Conway, a British Mathematician, created the Game of Life in 1970. It is a zero-player game simulating cellular multiplication.

This project was interesting to code and presented the challenge of neighbor awareness on a 2D grid.

The rules are as follows:
1. If a cell has less than two neighbors, it dies by underpopulation.
2. If a cell has exactly two or three neighbors, it survives to the next generation.
3. If a cell has more than three neighbors, it dies by overpopulation.
4. If an empty tile has three live neighbors, a new cell is born.

name: June 2022 Update -> Spacebot Concept - Prototype 2
author: CreativeTherapyCo
description:
June 15 Update: Now you can shoot and defeat enemies,  get hurt if hit by enemy fire and fail or complete the first mission. 

About this project: We created Spacebot during buddy jam and are looking to get early feedback on this prototype as we continue development. Read on for more details and to get a sense of the vision for this game.

### Description

Spacebot was sent to the Nu Solar System for one simple job: to harvest oxygen. But how can she do that when the human colonies there need her help? Free 1000 human colonies and help them survive, using diplomacy or hostile warfare.

### Gameplay

Free captured human colonies, defend them from attack, and manage their resources! Your goal is to get to 1000 human colonies and (hopefully) keep them as healthy and happy as possible.

### Theme

Spacebot meets the 1000 theme because his goal is to save 1000 human colonies.

### Controls

Left Stick (gamepad), WASD/arrow keys, stick (joystick), primary 2D axis (xr controller)
Aim and Fire / Interact with button: Right Trigger (gamepad), left button (mouse), Top (touch screen), Trigger (Joystick), prime action (xr controller), space (keyboard)



### Credits

Kathleen (@Leena42) - Artist / Sound design / Unity developer

@milosst686 - Artist

A lot of LEGO fans have grown up with classic Castle and have spent hundreds of hours playing with knights and soldiers, pitting every faction against each other in glorious battles.

I certainly was one of them!

In this game you can select a character between 5 choices (Forestmen, Black Knights, Crusaders, Black Falcons and a generic soldier) and play your way through a maze of towers, in order to collect all the shields and win the game.

I hope you enjoy playing this game as much as I did creating it!

- Press the TAB key to pause the game, access the controls, or take a screenshot.
- All models were created with Bricklink Studio 2.0.
- There is only one level, currently, but I will gradually add more levels.

name: La Mora - A journey in time
author: allangaunt
description:
Welcome to this Unity Showcase Demo of "La Mora - A journey in time"

Time is Broken. This should be the Golden age of Mankind. Someone, something, has changed our history, and left us picking up the pieces. You are part of a group tasked with repairing the damage... However, something went wrong. You can't remember your mission and the machine that brought you here is broken. Your only clues are vague memories, along with a name; La Mora. You have to piece together your mission, your memory, and your wits, before time as we know it, is gone for good!

Enjoy your tiny journey in time!

- Allan and the La Mora Team

[Controls]

[WASD] - Move
[MOUSE] - Turn Camera
[E] - Action Button
[SPACE] - Jump / Climb Ladders
[TAB] - Open Inventory / Quest Log
[ESC] - Pause Menu

LEGO Ideas username: Speckhofer Enterprises

In this racing game, you can choose one out of twelve different racing cars and try to overtake the AI-controlled opponents! The track is located in a landscape with hills, mountains and ... sheep!

I built the LEGO models in BrickLink Studio. After importing them into the Unity LEGO Microgame, I implemented the controls and car physics, including air resistance, rolling resistance and lateral friction forces. In order to increase performance, I created my own material resembling LEGO 2x2 tiles for the road. The blue and red items (which give you a speed boost or slow you down) as well as the sheep were created using Behaviour Bricks.

Controls:
WASD - control car
Mouse - rotate camera
R - reset car

Download the game: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RdphcrvvWYZOAjTx7M0B2xVEwV4aVJbX/view?usp=sharing

description:
サッカー日本代表vsサウジアラビアテレビ放送・ライブ配信・ライブ放送・放送・生放送・生中継 2024年10月10日

Live►►🔴➡️ https://worldsportshd.com/jp-soccer/

Live►►🔴➡️ https://worldsportshd.com/jp-soccer/

🔴https://worldsportshd.com/jp-soccer/


【10月10日】サッカー日本代表 vs サウジアラビア代表 ｜テレビ放送・ネット配信サッカー日本代表が、2024年10月10日（木）にサウジアラビア代表と対戦する。

　会場はサウジアラビア・ジッタの「キング・アブドゥッラー・スポーツシティ」で、キックオフ時間は2024年10月10日（木）27時00分（11日3時00分）の予定となっている（日本時間）。

　サウジアラビア代表対日本代表の試合は、ネット「DAZN（ダゾーン）」／「ABEMA de DAZN」で独占生配信される。

　地上波テレビでの放送はないが、Android TV™機能やスマートテレビ対応の機種などで「DAZNアプリ」をインストールすると、テレビでも視聴可能となる。日本代表は、10月10日（木）に行われる『FIFAワールドカップ26アジア最終予選（3次予選）』（キング・アブドゥッラー・スポーツシティ／サウジアラビア）にてサウジアラビア代表と試合を行う。

　8大会連続8度目のW杯出場を目指す日本代表は、アジア2次予選で朝鮮民主主義人民共和国、シリア代表、ミャンマー代表と同組のグループBに入り、6戦全勝の首位で突破すると、最終予選ではオーストラリア代表、サウジアラビア代表、バーレーン代表、中国代表、インドネシア代表と同組のグループCに入った。

　9月の最終予選2試合では、初戦のホーム中国代表戦で7－0、第2節のバーレーン代表戦では5－0と、合計12得点無失点と圧倒的な強さを示し、2連勝を飾った。しかし、第3節の対戦相手であるサウジアラビア代表は、日本代表、オーストラリア代表に次ぐ3番手（ポット3）としてグループCに入ってきたチームだ。ここ最近、サウジアラビア代表は結果が伴っていないが、警戒すべき相手であることは間違いない。

　なお、日本代表は過去に最終予選でサウジアラビア代表とアウェイで2度対戦しているが、2017年、2021年とともに0－1で敗戦。厳しい戦いを強いられてきた歴史がある。ただ、最後の対戦は2022年2月1日に行われた前回のW杯アジア最終予選で、日本代表はホームで、南野拓実、伊東純也がゴールを決めて、2－0と勝利した。サッカー男子日本代表vsサウジアラビア代表丨日本時間何時から？日程・試合開始時間／FIFAワールドカップ2026アジア最終予選
10月の国際マッチウィークでFIFAワールドカップ26アジア最終予選に出場するサッカー男子日本代表・SAMURAI BLUEは、第3節のアウェイ戦でサウジアラビア代表と激突する。ここでは、同試合の放送予定について日本時間で紹介しよう。10月の国際マッチウィークで、FIFAワールドカップ26アジア最終予選に出場するサッカー男子日本代表・SAMURAI BLUEは、第3節のアウェイ戦でサウジアラビア代表と激突する。

この試合は相手チーム国の第2の都市であるジッダにあるスタジアムにおいて、現地時間10月10日の夜にキックオフされる。日本と現地の時差は、−6時間であることから、日本時間では日が変わった11日の明け方より試合が始まることとなる。

グループCに同居する両チームは、9月の第2節までを終えた時点で日本が1位（2勝0敗）、サウジアラビアが2位（1勝1敗）と、ワールドカップ出場権を獲得できる上位2チームに入っている。このため、どちらのチームもグループ内の難敵を倒して勝点を積み上げ、上位をキープしたいところである。

ここでは、アジア最終予選のサウジアラビア対日本の試合について、放送予定を日本時間で紹介しよう。

対戦カード：サウジアラビア vs 日本
会場：King Abdullah Sports City Stadium（サウジアラビア・ジッダ）
日時（日本時間）：10月11日（金）03:00 KO
※日本と現地の時差は −6時間

name: Look out! Crazy drivers.

description:
Challenge a friend with a race to the end of the road, but keep an eye out for the crazy drivers!

Here is my spin on the first prototype project from the Create with Code series! I added camera switching, a bunch of stacked obstacles, some oncoming cars that can steer left and right to make it harder to dodge, and lastly local multiplayer for that competitive goodness!

Hope you enjoy it!


The Controls:
    Player 1:
	WASD - To drive forward, backwards, steer left and right.
	Left control or E - To toggle the camera to the driver seat.
    Player 2:
	Arrow keys - To drive forward, backwards, steer left and right.
	Right control - To toggle the camera to the driver seat.

Primitive objects used, are from the Create with Code series - https://learn.unity.com/tutorial/set-up-your-first-project-in-unity?uv=2020.3&courseId=5cf96c41edbc2a2ca6e8810f&projectId=5caccdfbedbc2a3cef0efe63

name: Mass Driving!
author: Clara_Krieg
description:
How good a driver are you? Find out!

In all "Endless" difficulties, max speed increases incrementally up to 10 times, with the final level being when you reach a score of 2560+. Making it harder the longer you're in the game.

Changelog April 3, 2020

Added 10 Normal Mode levels and 10 Hard Mode levels for a total of 23 levels (including the 3 Endless Mode difficulties)
Added a "Controls" menu
Added a "Level Select" for the non-endless modes
Added a "Pause" menu to escape to the Main Menu or exit the game
Added a text at the bottom right of the screen to indicate your current level in Normal and Hard Modes

"Game Over" screen now allows you to choose to restart the current level or quit to main menu
On Normal and Hard Mode levels there is a screen in between each level to give you a rest between levels
Each level in Normal and Hard Modes increases the distance to the goal (which is currently invisible [plans to change that in future hopefully]) and increases the speed.
Hard Mode has a 50% base speed increase over Normal Mode on top of the 1st person only.

Changelog April 2, 2020

Adjusted the rain to be less white, and thinner so it looks more realistic.
Added some ambiance
> Rain sounds
> Engine sounds for both player and NPC vehicles
> Some relaxing music for the drive!

Changelog April 1,2020

Added image to: Main Menu and both Difficulty menus, so it's not blinding white.
Added a "Night Mode" (i.e. "Expert Mode")
Added rain to the endless modes
Adjusted car lighting to be way less intense and more realistic
Increased fog density in "Hard Mode" so the cars become visible closer.

Updated "did't" to "didn't" on Game Over screen. ;)

Endless Night Mode:
Incredibly dark.
Headlights are auto on, and can't be toggled.
Fog is very dense, making cars become visible fairly close to player.
Increase base speed by 50% compared to other modes.

Controls:
Auto forward movement
"A" and "D" move left and right
"F" to toggle Headlights (disabled in "Night Time Mode")
"C" togg

name: Mayan Doom
author: tomasmacias
description:
Procedural LEGO Platformer

A 3d platformer where level are procedural generated with increasing difficulty as it level up. It's my first "serious" game in Unity so I hope you enjoyed it. Please leave me any feedback on the comments :)

Synopsis

A recently discovered mayan temple has reveal that the actual End of the World will occur in December 2022 and not in 2012 as interpreted before. Luckily, this temple also shows that the old mayan gods (probably aliens) hided a secret high-tech weapon to be deployed at the time. But only if humanity proofs to be worthy in a series of randomly generated set of platforms, which will test both dexterity and cunning.

Why procedural?

- It makes the game more durable as you can replay it many times and it has, theoretically, infinite levels (Actually not, because of graphics and performance problems at very high levels)

- It enhance to learn how to play and get skills to avoid any unforeseen situation, rather than memorizing the timing of the level with repetition.

- It makes testing more funny (egoist thought of developer)

- The algorithm creates very interesting levels and situations that I, as essentially programmer, could not find out so easily. 

WebGL Performance

The game was developed on Windows Platform and it has much much better performance there. I tried to optimized it a little bit for WebGL but got out of time. I think I should remove some objects since the temple is very heavy for WebGL and also all the vegetation. If you have any tips please leave a comment.

You should be able to play some levels and get the concept of the game: like a demo. But I recommend you to get the Windows version if you have enjoyed it. (https://thebretonnian.itch.io/mayan-doom)

One workaround is to play with the  free look camera to make a kind of 2.5D View or placed it as cenital view in order to reduce the amount of objects in the Screen. Also reduce the look sensibility may help.

name: ML-Breakout
author: maraudingpangolin2
description:
This game was developed using Unity and ML-Agents and uses reinforcement learning to train a neural network on how the game should be played.   First, a clone of the Atari Breakout game was developed in unity.  Then the ML-Agent was trained to move the paddle left or right while being provided observations about the ball, paddle, and blocks.  The Agent was given rewards for hitting the ball with the paddle, breaking bricks, and a penalty for losing the ball.  By allowing the ML-Agent to train for increasing amounts of time, the Agent will learn what actions maximize the rewards and minimize the penalties, effectively learning to play the game.

In addition to developing the required game and a trained agent, we decided to expand the project to offer a multiple levels, a leaderboard, multiple trained models, and deployment of the game using WebGL to Unity Play.  This game demonstrates the learning behavior by offering three different levels of model training: 

     - Beginner - the ML Agent was trained for 7 minutes.
     - Intermediate - the ML Agent was trained for 11 minutes.
     - Advanced - the ML Agent was trained for 44 minutes.

This project was developed by Jonathan Reuter (reuterjo@oregonstate.edu), and Joel Strong (stronjoe@oregonstate.edu / www.jdstrongpdx.com) as part of their Capstone course at Oregon State University.  We used a GitHub repository with CI/CD and workflows found at: https://github.com/ReuterJo/ML-Breakout

Double-Jump = Spacebar x2 (pro-tip: you can jump extra times after colliding with cans or crates)

Stomp = Down Arrow Key 
Restart Game = Enter

name: MyPong Game v1.0 (Mimicking Atari's Pong Game)
author: masadamsahid
description:
How to Play:

This is a multi player game.

To move the left paddle press "W" key for up and "S" key for down. 
To move the right paddle press "🔼" key for up and "🔽" key for down.

===============================================

Pong is a table tennis-themed arcade video game featuring simple two-dimensional graphics, manufactured by Atari and originally released in 1972. It was one of the earliest arcade video games and created by Allan Alcorn as a training exercise assigned to him by Atari co-founder Nolan Bushnell. Bushnell based the game's concept on an electronic ping-pong game included in the Magnavox Odyssey, the first home video game console. In response, Magnavox later sued Atari for patent infringement. Bushnell and Atari co-founder Ted Dabney were surprised by the quality of Alcorn's work and decided to manufacture the game.

Pong was the first commercially successful video game, and it helped to establish the video game industry along with the Magnavox Odyssey. Soon after its release, several companies began producing games that closely mimicked its gameplay. Eventually, Atari's competitors released new types of video games that deviated from Pong's original format to varying degrees, and this, in turn, led Atari to encourage its staff to move beyond Pong and produce more innovative games themselves.

Atari released several sequels to Pong that built upon the original's gameplay by adding new features. During the 1975 Christmas season, Atari released a home version of Pong exclusively through Sears retail stores. The home version was also a commercial success and led to numerous clones. The game was remade on numerous home and portable platforms following its release. Pong is part of the permanent collection of the Smithsonian Institution in Washington, D.C., due to its cultural impact.

Source : Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pong)

name: NEO-TETRIS (Modernizing A Classic) (Mae by : Saif Ali Khan (Solo))
author: Xaif
description: NEO-TETRIS is a game I made for Create with Code Game Jam. As per theme (Modernizing a Classic) I decided to modernize Tetris with hyper casual feel. As the name suggests the game takes inspiration from neon /sci-fi assets. A lot of creators have made Tetris in unity before so programming wasn't a very big challenge. I thoroughly enjoyed the whole game jamming process. First I wrote down my idea, then divided it into sub-tasks. After division I prioritized them. First came basic functionality like creation of grid, making prefabs and then spawning. After these tasks I worked on some post processing to get the feel in game so that I would enjoy creating it more. After then I worked on basic UI and tried to polish it a little by optimizing code and adding sounds. I used Neon sphere's asset for level design. Used Camera Shake by watching videos of Brackey's. Also used Sci-fi sound effects assets from Asset store.

In a vast, inhospitable alien world, you are the expendable. Cloned from DNA for a single purpose: to test the most devastating, over-the-top, and downright absurd weaponry known to the galaxy. Welcome to NIMRODS, the ultimate survival roguelite shooter where the guns you craft are the legacy you leave.

Beyond Survival
Experience the innovative roguelite where your previous gun builds aren't just memories—they're your backup! Deploy guns crafted from past runs in drones to assist the next grunt. Every run is a story, but each gun is a heroic saga.

Boundless Exploration
Embark on a journey through diverse alien biomes, each meticulously molded by a distinct set of enemies and bosses. Every corner is teeming with specialized encounters and valuable resources to discover.

Assemble the Unthinkable
Break the game with your creativity. Collect insane weapon parts from airdrops and craft combinations so powerful, so bizarre, they have to be seen to be believed. Create your dream weapon, or a nightmarish contraption that defies all laws of physics and common sense.

Bio-Engineer your Evolution
Delve into unique progression systems where DNA modifications can evolve your future clones. Tailor your abilities and your drone's AI to complement your playstyle, and optimize your upgrade drops for pivotal enhancements.

Guns Over Glory
As the corporate overlords watch from above, you're constantly faced with hordes of relentless aliens. Complete insane missions, stack bodies, and remember: you probably won’t make it, but your guns definitely will.

Wishlist NIMRODS on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2086430/NIMRODS_GunCraft_Survivor/

description:
Master Wu want you to train, by slicing the bricks with your weapon.
BUT beware, if you miss them it gets harder !. There are a few special bricks that can help you.
Hope you enjoy the game :-) /Jens Olesen [JensODK]

Instructions:
Click SPACE to Start the game.
Then the game will rotate between the ninjas. When your favorite ninja is highlighted click SPACE to select it.
You will see bricks falling from the sky, click SPACE to rotate your ninja to slice the bricks.
If you miss, the bricks will elevate the platform you stand on.
If you get so elevated that you touch the Hazard behavioral brick at top, its game over.
There are certain special bricks:
1) Red brick with bomb : If you hit it with sword its game over. However if you let it hit floor, it will remove some of the bricks under your platform
2) Blue brick with clock : If you hit this, the drop rate will slow down for a few seconds.
3) Green brick with Heart : This will summon a few friends to help you for a few seconds.

author: CollinTift
description:
Order of the Labyrinth
----------------------
Waking up in an unknown space having forgotten who you are, you have an urge to escape this labyrinth. However, there are enemies abound, seemingly all belonging to some order of knights. Do what you can to remember who you are and escape in this roguelike.

Controls:
WASD - movement
Space (moving) - dash in direction of movement at cost of Chaos
Space (not moving) - apply shield at cost of Chaos (if you have at least 1 max shielding)
Left Click - attack in direction of mouse

Goals:
Find your memories by defeating foes and uncovering secrets they have placed in this labyrinth. Along the way, pick up items to help protect yourself and defeat your enemies. Harness powers of Chaos to aid you in your survival. Once you have remembered yourself fully, you may attempt to escape. Enter portals to spend memories to upgrade your abilities and venture deeper into the labyrinth.

Credits:
Astar Pathfinding Project - https://arongranberg.com/astar/front
Horror Elements by Anthon - https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/audio/sound-fx/horror-elements-112021

Please show a screenshot if you are able to win :)

description:
How to Play?
Use 'W' and 'S' or the Up arrow and Down arrow to move your paddle. Try your best to make sure the ball doesn't go in on your side.
How do you win?
With Payment Optimized Net Game, the fun never ends. It's a budding new take on an old game I'm sure you've never heard of before... With modern techniques, it's even better. Constant new features will be added while you play. Think of it as games as a service with some additional content needing more purchase. Fun right?!
Do you feel no shame?
For what? For vastly improving a classic with a new modern spin? Maybe you should feel ashamed for not enjoying all the fun given by Payment Optimized Net Game.
Real talk about assets used
Some sound effects and all music are assets that have been purchased and available for me to use. 
Everything else in the game is regrettably my doing.

author: KamiShiraSama_Neko
description:
Pikachu Volleyball (対戦ぴかちゅ～　ﾋﾞｰﾁﾊﾞﾚｰ編) is an old Windows game which was developed by "(C) SACHI SOFT / SAWAYAKAN Programmers" and "(C) Satoshi Takenouchi" in 1997. The source code is gained by reverse engineering the original game and implementing it into JavaScript by gorisanson. He opensource the code in his responsitory. Thanks to his kind works, we can play this game again nowaday.

https://github.com/gorisanson/pikachu-volleyball

I am a Unity green hand and repeat it with Unity. I've tried to improve on the game by using a realistic physics system, more realistic jumps, etc. Of course, there are still many imperfections in the game. The original game had a square window, which does not match the current 16:10 window, and it result in the extra blue squares being added to the sides. The balls remnant have not implied yet, the AI is too foolish... 

It is a little practice demo game for me. Wish you can like it. ; )

name: Pizza Express - Feed The Horde!
author: BeerHuntor
description:
VERSION 0.4 RELEASED Changelog Below -- ALL FUTURE UPDATES WILL BE ON ITCH.IO -- Follow the development at https://huntorgames.itch.io/pizza-express

A game developed in unity.  This is the first game of I hope many that I am developing in the Unity Game Engine with C#. 

You play as a pizza shop worker, who has to feed the hungry horde before they get to the counter and break it down - still in early development, but planned features include: 

* Full Shop Upgrade System
* Quirky boost system.  - Introduced in V0.3
* Highscores

New to development - Join our begginer community on discord at https://discord.gg/GaQXmGg


Changelog:
v0.4 - 
 * Added pause menu ui and an options menu from the main menu screen 
 * Added menu and game music -- Im sorry! 
 * Removed menu button animations and made them change colour. 
 * Added sound queues' for delivery crates and for fed customers
 * Added voice over sounds to accompany the new delivery icons. 
 * Added independant audio sliders for music and sfx - Still a little janky.
 * Re-added particle system to show when you have fed a customer. 
    
-- Gameplay Changes --
* Reduced starting money from 100 to 50 - Which was the original intended amount. 

---BUG FIXES---
* Fixed a bug where one of the delivery icons was not de activating
* Fixed a bug where the above delivery was not being called and activated. 


v0.3 -
 * Added a pause feature where the game stops when you press the ESC or P keys.
 * Added a delivery system into the game, where you collect the deliveries and they can boost you or give you a negative effect. 
 * Implemented a money system - Pizzas when cooked cost money, earn money from feeding the customers.  New delivery system complements this feature.
 * Designed And Added new UI icons to represent the counter health, and the customers remaining and money earned.
 * Pizza slices now despawn after going out of the game view.  And also when they hit the ground. 
 * Reworked main menu and game over screens -- Ad

name: Player Control Simulator Game in Unity---Ms. Ghosh's GID Instructional Model
author: Sree_2022
description: Embark on an exciting journey into the world of Game development with Unity in Ms. Ghosh's  GID Class! In this unit, you will dive into the Unity editor and workflow, gaining hands-on experience by programming a dynamic car game. Your mission? Navigate a car along a floating road, skillfully avoiding or strategically colliding with obstacles. This project serves as your initiation into C# scripting, where you'll create and manipulate scripts to control game elements. By the end of the unit, you'll not only master the art of calling basic functions but also confidently declare and fine-tune variables to customize the outcomes of your meticulously crafted game. Get ready to rev up your programming skills and unleash your creativity on the digital road!

description: Poultree es un juego de plataformas en 3D, desarrollado por 3 estudiantes de preparatoria, César Augusto González Zapata, Sergio Jesús Negroe Ruiz y William Morán Ramírez, para el concurso anual de la Universidad Anáhuac Mayab: Liga Internacional de Talentos, Game Jam 2020. El juego nos pone en las plumas de un pollito que perdió a su familia y a su hogar por la quema que hicieron un grupo de hombres en su granja, en busca de más recursos naturales para explotar. Nuestro protagonista deberá atravesar distintos escenarios en busca de semillas para recuperar su hogar y ponerle fin a este infausto acto.

name: Quick Drop
author: robmichael
description: This game is a simulation of the popular arcade game, Quick Drop.  You have 60 seconds to catch 50 balls in bins that rotate on a platform.  Once you click the "Start" button, the platform will begin to rotate and the game UI will be displayed.  The timer doesn't start until your first click of the left mouse button, or press of the space bar.  At the end of the game, a yellow splash will play for every 10 balls caught.  If you get all 50 balls, a special set of splashes and congratulatory message is displayed.  You can then click on the "Restart" button to try again.

name: Refrigerator
author: zzhhdaaa
description:
Watch Trial: https://youtu.be/j4BqDIkkD_w

Refrigerator is a locker people used to store food and other stuff. People can only see when they are trying to open the doors. Then what is happening in that? Outside atmosphere and the space in the refrigerator are two parallel worlds. People do not know what the conspiracies that the food inside the refrigerator are plotting.

Now, you are a piece of beef in a refrigerator. You are trying to escape from jail. When the doors are closed, you can transform into a cow and run around in the refrigerator. On the way to your escape, you can try to collect all the companions who are also pieces of meat in jail. You cannot be found as a small cow when the people open the door for inspection. Let’s try to escape!

Once you escape or get caught from the refrigerator, try to press F again, and see what happens…

WASD —---- move
Space —---- jump
Shift —----- dash
F —---- transform

name: Retro Escape
author: Alltoc
description:
Jump'n'Run von Julian Schmitt und Buck
Ton an!
Controller ist Plug and Play

Bewegung:
A/D oder Pfeiltasten : Links/Rechts
Leertaste/W : Sprung (funktioniert auch als Start Game)
1 und 3 beide gleichzeitig kurz gedrückt: Levelrestart
Rücktaste kurz gedrückt halten: Zurück zum Start Bildschirm

Controller:
D-Pad Links/Rechts : Bewegen
Button South : Sprung (funktioniert auch als Start Game)
ShoulderL und -R für Levelrestart
Start kurz gedrückt halten: Zurück zum Start Bildschirm

Start Game:
Sammle alle Kiwis und erreiche die Zielflagge, um ein Level zu beenden
Es gibt insgesamt 5 Level (Wüste, Reaktor, Weltraum, Eis, Burg)
Timer und Death-Counter wird im ersten Level beim Tod zurückgesetzt, damit man für einen Perfekten Start nicht das Spiel neustarten muss ;)
Nach dem letzten Level wird die benötigte Zeit angezeigt

Choose Level:
Timer und Death Counter nur für das eine Level

End Screen: Hard Mode
Bonus Level (Vorsicht! Sehr schwer!)

name: Rover Wash
author: Miramana
description:
Welcome to Rover Racing! 

Use the keyboard WASD keys to drive. 

Use the F key to shoot your autolaser, use SHIFT to boost, but be careful, they both draw power from the same source, destroy only what stands in your way, save that precious boost. 

Enemies will drop a variety of items when destroyed, these can be useful (ultra sticky goo gives you amazing grip temporarily) and or extremely annoying (shock crystals disable your vehicle temporarily!), so be careful when running the little ones over, you'll automatically pick up whatever they drop. Might be a good idea to destroy a few, and avoid the rest wink 

The game is difficult to play, but very rewarding to master, using real physics in a low gravity environment, weight transfer is the most important thing, learn to move the weight of your rover around on its wheels with judicious use of throttle and brake, and you'll soon master the challenging terrain! 

You score points by passing the checkpoints with the highest speed possible. Completing the track quickly will get you more checkpoints, but choosing to go fast into some checkpoints might be advantageous. Learn which checkpoints can be abused and which ones to respect! 

Enjoy, and Happy Holidays!

name: Saturday Morning Apocalypse
author: Unity Play
description:
Originally made for the Bracky's Game Jam 2021.2 in August. Music and Audio Design by Brian Paul Zimmerman. Art, animation, and coding by myself. The theme was "Let there be Chaos". For this, we created a bullet hell side scroller, with limited control and no form of blocking. The controls, and perspective change in a chaotic manner. You play as a telepath who will be the death of the world.

Story:

Shi Sakerarenai ( 避けられない 死 ), is a power telepath who has dissociative identity disorder. Each of her four personalities has a different psychic ability and she can not control when her personality changes. Believing that one day she will go nuclear, Shi was brought to a government lab to receive a lobotomy to neutralize her powers. However, before the operation could start, Shi escaped the government lab, destroying everything and everyone in her path.

In this fast-paced shoot ‘em up, inspired by 90’s Saturday morning cartoons, you play as Shi with access to her unique powers and abilities. Battle your way through the chaos of ferocious security bots before time runs out to complete your escape! All the while, you are unable to control your abilities causing massive chaos, each time your powers switch your perspective of the world changes based on your personality. Though do all this knowing that after you escape you will soon end the world. You are the villain, this is how it all ends, let there be chaos!

Power Types :

Telekinesis - Move floating knives with your mind to attack.
Pyrokinesis - Control fire itself to attack your enemies.
Psychic Blast - Release psychic energy to attack.
Electrokinesis - Control Lightning to attack your enemies.

Instructions / Controls :

author: Siuan
description:
--- UPDATE: tutorial level is done ---
Story mode objective, in case it wasn’t clear enough (was it?): for level 1 you must find and get the apple before the dragon gets you. If the dragon reaches you and you have no food to give it, or if you fall too far down, you lost. If you reach the apple you pick it up with magic, and if the dragon reaches you after you have the apple, you give it the apple and it flies away :D everybody's happy. For level 2 you need to get to the highest island in the scene (collect fruits and twigs for extra score) before the mist reaches you.
Still to do: put more trees on level 2 and make time mode; finish title screen; get saving working properly and then make it so you need to beat level 1 story mode to have access to time challenge mode and to level 2; set up the level 2 high scores. 
Known issues: On level 2 if you fall to the mist you get resurrected at the position of your last collision with the ground; if that was with the side of the island you'll resurrect there and just fall again.

name: slaughterfest_v0-2
author: Unity Play
description:
Imported some other assets to understand how animation and attack trigger work etc. 

For enemy placement I wrote a RNG script based on the item spawner that can spawn any prefab n times with random radius and angle into the world and attached it to one enemy. That one then serves as the spawning center => more enemies, less manual work for me :)

I did not figure out in time how to build an end trigger so instead I added a "hidden" final area to hack and slash around. 

Finally to get below 100MB to be able to upload, I also learned how to reduce texture size => 512x512px for many textures. I overshot my target and am around 58 MB now.

You may have to kite a few enemies to stay alive and the boss is a bit harder to hit. Try to taunt him around!

Feedback is very welcome!

Features:
- quick intro by in-game books
- more enemy types (various skeletons,Arthur)
- full equipment slots with prefabs
- color coded paths
- additional easter egg weapon
- SlaughterFarm unlock after endboss

name: Snap Ship Builder (POC)
author: mccorkle
description:
Build a ship with cubes, the put some thrusters on it.  

Right click on each thruster and set a key to activate that thruster (note, don't use wasd, cause those move the camera). 

Now fly your ship!

--- 

During the previous Unity cyber week sale, I purchased a lot of ship "part kits" and a few ship combat and space sim kits.  To bring those together with the Gestalt design, I first must be able to, ingame, snap parts of a kit together and make a functioning ship in Unity physics.  This is where I'll publish and update as I go along with that.  I am following along with quill18creates's tutorial initially, but will apply my own design and purchased art once I get closer to the end of the tutorials.

name: Snow Boarder
author: CH_HASSAAN
description:
Welcome to Snow Boarder, a thrilling snowboarding game where you glide down icy slopes, collect coins, and perform daring jumps. Your goal is to collect as many coins as possible while avoiding crashes to achieve the highest score. With challenging obstacles and exciting gameplay, you’ll need to master your snowboarding skills to win!

Controls:

Increase Speed: W or Up Arrow Key
Rotate Left/Right: A and D or Left and Right Arrow Keys

How to Play:

Collect Coins: Navigate your snowboarder to collect coins scattered along the icy path to increase your score.
Avoid Crashes: Watch out for obstacles and jump at the right time to avoid crashing. Keep your reflexes sharp to stay on course!
Speed and Rotation: Use the W key or Up Arrow to speed up and the A, D, or Left and Right Arrow keys to rotate your character for better maneuvering.
Score: The more coins you collect without crashing, the higher your score. Aim for a perfect run to achieve the best score possible!

name: Soccer Saturday
author: KhalimaAli
description: Use the up and down arrow keys to move forward and back and to hit the opposing balls.  Use the left and right arrows to turn to line up your player. I added a boost of speed and particle effects when you press the space bar, but you can only use once per second so you can’t spam the space bar.  You get a stronger bounce after you pick up the power-up, but use it before time runs out.  Waves of the opposing blue team increase in numbers and speed. Knock them into their own goal for 3 points.  They get a point for getting into your goal.  You get 3 pts for every power-up you grab. There are ten waves per game.  When game is over, you can replay by typing ‘S’. This game is for Create with Code Challenge 4, and all fixes and bonuses were done plus scoring, game over and restart, adding wall banners, soccer pitch instead of ground, textures to balls and particles.  Added code so space bar can’t be spammed.

name: Soul Currents
author: mebrfadhen
description:
ABOUT
Deep Below the waves, a team of researchers study the ancient rock found there. You play as Cara Roisin a Mechanical Engineering who has been tasked with maintaining the equipment stationed here.
In Soul Currents, your main mission is to help Cara with this daily routine in his 44-V6 submarine. Explore the vast Ocean and find the secrets within, but be careful… you only have so much power! 

CONTROLS
Simple controls! To move the submarine use WASD. If you would like it to move up and down use the Left and Right buttons on your Mouse. As you explore the ocean you will find objects you can interact with, in this case, use the button E...

WHY?
I wanted to make a game with a fantastic atmosphere that really pushed the LEGO Microgame sandbox. At the same time, I wanted to make something that relished and celebrated some Lego themes. This one being Lego ocean themes!

Btw there is a range of easter eggs to be found, comment below if you find any of them!

BUGS
- WebGL Lighting bug

name: SOUL CURRENTS 2133
author: bradstestaccount
description:
Lego ID = mebradhen 

Soul Currents 2133 is an epic 20 min long underwater adventure packed with a range of content. Around some remote islands in the Atlantic, a team of explorers are searching the seafloor for lost treasure and life. You join the crew in their day to day activities, in keeping equipment operational.


CONTROLS
Simple controls! To move the submarine use WASD. If you would like it to move up and down use the Left and Right buttons on your Mouse. As you explore the ocean you will find objects you can interact with, in this case, use the button E... USE HEADPHONES!


WHY?
I wanted to make a game with a fantastic atmosphere that really pushed the LEGO Microgame sandbox. At the same time, I wanted to make something that relished and celebrated some Lego themes. This Is the finished version of the original Soul Currents I posted over a month ago. But so much has changed I wanted to submit it as its own new game. With new art, videos and description.

name: Spacefreighter
author: msyoung2012
description:
Spacefreighter is a game about ships in space.
Select your crew and control and command your ship as you battle pirates and civilizations from beyond our star. This project is active and in very early, pre-alpha stages.

This is a fun side project for me, and one that was inspired by a few games I loved playing while growing up, most notably Treasure Planet: Battle at Procyon and Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker.

You can follow the development on the website here: https://www.spacefreighter.net/

name: Spacefreighter v 0.06 - The Torpedoening
author: msyoung2012
description: This new release includes lots of cool features. We've added torpedoes to the game - they track targets and can be shot down or intercepted. You can target them just like an enemy ship. The Pom-Pom gun was also added - it fires a short burst of low-damage bullets before reloading (excellent for tracking moving targets... maybe use it to intercept a torepdo!). We've also improved the sound system a tad, and improved the AI so behaves a bit more realistically... lots more work to do there. Finally, we squashed lots of small bugs and made improvements to make the game run much faster. Be sure to join the discord if you want more regular updates: https://discord.gg/jHYNAfs

name: Stargaze Storage Zone
author: eewrong
description:
The Cosmos, a sprawling network of interconnected blockchains, is far more than a mere technological marvel; it is a rich tapestry of interstellar communities, each with its unique destiny, yet all connected in the web of cosmic existence. It is here, in the Stargaze area of this digital Metaverse, that the Alpha Gamers and friends embark on a journey of exploration and connection, driven by their unquenchable thirst for knowledge and a desire to reach beyond the known Metaverse through the power of games. 

To play:
1) On Google Chrome, go to Google Settings, System and enable graphics accelerator.
2) When you load the game, the bottom right is to set your region, very important as you cant play with a high ping.
3) In Game Lobby, on the Left, change your loadout. 
4) At the top, you can set a server and invite your friends to join you.

name: Ten Nights With Two Monsters
author: kaovya
description:
INTRODUCTION:
Hi! This is the first fully functional and complete game I made in Unity.


This game is a spinoff of Five Nights At Freddy's. You wake up and find yourself in a mysterious room with doors on either side. You can hear the footsteps of the monsters outside each door. A counter is shown in the top right which tells you what Day it is. Once you reach Day 10, you are freed. To advance to the next night, look at the red button on the table and press E. However, with each button press, there is a chance that the monster will catch you, so be prepared.


EXPLANATION:
There is a 5% chance with each button press that you will be caught by the monster (2.5% the jumpscare will trigger for each monster). If the jumpscare is triggered, the player is “caught” and the game ends. If the player manages to advance through all nights without triggering either jumpscare, the player has “escaped” and the game ends.


Since each jumpscare is independent of the others and randomly occurs, with 2 jumpscares each having a 2.5% chance of occurring and 10 nights the player must survive, the player has a 50 % chance of winning the game (escaping) and a 50% of losing (getting caught by a monster). Good luck and have fun!

author: SirRaidenGalahad
description:
CLICK THE MAZE ENTRANCE TO START

Movement:
W-Forward
S-Backward
A-Turn Left
D-Turn Right
Left shift-Sprint

Abilities:
F-Use foodpack. Foodpacks restore 100 stamina and can be eaten every 10 seconds

Weapons:
1-Rock. Deals 1 damage
2-Bow. Deals 5 damage. Arrows can be picked up
3-Fish blade. Deals 3 damage. Can only be unlocked by orange vault.

Game rules:
You are a runner in a maze. Your goal is to escape. The obstacles: many. Every 90 seconds, the day becomes night. When night falls... well, you'll figure it out later. Your only hope is to run, and run fast. The rest you'll learn over time. Good luck, and don't smash your face into a wall.

Notes:
This game was made in 5 days. In other words, don't judge. If you make a masterful work of art while your goal was to just make a game in 5 days, do people criticize you? No, cause you did it, so leave me to hide in the hole I've dug myself. Alone.

name: The Old Smoke
author: takedadesmullier
description:
The Old Smoke: More than a game... it’s an universe.
Have you had this experience before? You arrive at a place you had visited years before and realise that it has changed. Buildings have disappeared, replaced by others, holes have been plugged in the road, an old telephone box has been removed. You then tell yourself that these are works carried out by the city. This is undoubtedly the case. But this is not necessarily the reality. There are a lot of strange things in this world that we don't know about. And world eaters are one of them.
These creatures come to our world at night with only one goal: to feed themselves. They feed on matter and it is not uncommon for them to devour entire buildings, so great is their hunger. So every night, holes appear in our cities and every day we try to fill them. This is why our neighbourhoods evolve and change their appearance.
World-eaters are intelligent beings. Like humans, they have learned how to store food. What disappears is not eating right away... but sending it to a pantry. An unusual pantry in another dimension: the K-dimension. There they can gradually liquefy the material to better digest it.
Since 2063, the Franco-British company Legspace has been exploring dimensions that were unknown to us. Its main objective: to find new materials whose exploitation could allow the development of new technologies. In particular, Legspace is looking for D-F45 or Blue Fagaril, a liquid charged with a temporal energy that could enable humanity to travel through time.
Was there any in the K-dimension, no one knew. That's why, after four years of testing, Legspace finally sent a reconnaissance mission in this dimension. The first expedition was disastrous. The crew mysteriously disappeared. It turned out, after several analyses, that this dimension was particularly hostile. The world-eaters that live there can be aggressive, and the liquefied matter, which has been named K-liquid, is toxic.
Agent Goera is leading the latest expedit

name: The Vegetation Engine
author: Unity Play
description:
The Vegetation Engine: http://u3d.as/1H9u​
Discord: https://discord.gg/znxuXET​
Website: https://boxophobic.com/​

OVERVIEW

A small scene showing The Vegetation Engine shaders, with next-level shading, player-vegetation interaction, bark blending, high-quality wind support, and real-time seasons changing using assets from the Book of the Dead, a short video created by Unity. 

THE VEGETATION ENGINE

The Vegetation Engine is a set of highly optimized vegetation shaders and tools designed to unify any vegetation asset from the Unity Asset Store, Megascans, Speedtree, Tree Creator, and more, or custom vegetation made by your team.

Enable high-quality wind motion, interaction, local wind, seasons, wetness, subsurface, gradient and noise tint, perspective correction, camera distance fade, glancing angle fade, crossfade, size fade, height blending, and more, for all vegetation assets and props with Standard, Universal, or HD Render Pipeline!

* Vegetation assets, props, and music used from the open-source project Book of the Dead by Unity Technologies.

name: The Wall at the End of World
author: schereralf
description: The introduction music, the footsteps, the mangled screams and the arrow sounds are free audio assets from the Unity Asset Store (check out Footsteps Essentials, Mangled Screams and Medieval Music Themes). The trees are also from the Unity Asset Store (Conifers and Beech Trees packages by the amazing Forst). The wall and towers, as well as the members of the Advancing Barbarian Host, are available as 3D printable files at my MyMiniFactory store (link https://www.myminifactory.com/object/3d-print-roman-style-wall-and-gate-96602 ). Note that the versions used here have considerably reduced poly counts. The wall textures that I used here are from https://polyhaven.com/ . This will not be the last version of The Wall. Barbarians should survive most arrows in the next version and just run away/back off for a while. Barbarians advancing on horses would also be nice. The ones that die should become real dead barbarians and not placeholder red blobs either.

name: THERMOSFEAR
author: hjonesjr
description:
LEGO Ideas username: HJonesJr 

THERMOSFEAR is an epic game that takes place in the Orbitron-C space station located in the Earth’s thermosphere. The game is based on an original suspense story in which you play as Astronaut “Brick” Jones who has been assigned to a recovery and extraction mission. Easy right? The catch is that something went terribly wrong inside the station one month ago and the crew had to be evacuated. Will you dare dock with the station, explore it and go out alive? Don’t let your FEAR dominate you…


WHY?
I think the most important aspect of a game is the story: it keeps the player motivated, it dictates the mood, defines the lighting and the music. I tried to combine all those aspects in this game plus the playability that any space and Lego fan would love. I had a blast building this game from scratch. I hope you have a blast playing it as well.

name: Top down tower defense
author: guigsc
description:
https://github.com/guigsc/TopDownTowerDefense

Top down tower defense survival game.

// abstraction
All over the code

// inheritance
on Enemy:
There are 2 types of enemies: close combat and ranged that inherits from the base class Enemy

on Target:
There are 2 types of targets: tower and enemy. Both share the same base class Target which identify the object as targetable with health and possibility of taking damage.

When the projectile hits, it finds the Target component (tower or enemy) and then emit an event so the projectile can check if it is supposed to hit one or another, by casting the base class into Enemy or Tower

// polymorphism
on Enemy:
For each enemy, the attack method is overriden.

on Tower:
the TakeDamage method is virtual and can be overriden in case it needs to add more functionality to it.

// encapsulation

We are happy to release v0.3 of this prototype!
- 4 new maps.
- New mechanics
- New Menu
- New HUD
- More VFX and SFX on both enemy and player
- Balancing old mechanic to make it more enjoyable

TRAIN CONDUCTOR is a hardcore first-person platformer come with lightning fast action, set in a dusty punk-realm. Jump, slide, dash and slash your way to the very end door!

The game is still in development. This is only a Prototype to show you the feel of what we want to present in the future. Please tune in for more update.

Controls:

MOVEMENT: [WASD]
JUMP: [Space]
DASH: [Left Shift]
CROUCH: [Left Control] or [C]
SLIDE: Run a bit then Crouch
INTERACT: Press [E] to interact with key and door
ATTACK: [LMB] (Left Mouse Button)
SLOW TIME: [Q]

Your mission is to collect three keys in order to unlock the path lead to final escape door. Feel free to kill everything on your path.

name: Uneased To Meet You!
author: Drion22
description: We'd love your feedback on the game! Just click on the link: https://forms.gle/N3DBXD2sHu8FNrUv9 Remember to unmute and full-screen recommended for proper scaling! Story-based Platformer where you play as a person who lives with social anxiety. You move with WASD or the Arrow keys, and Spacebar to move and jump. You also use the Spacebar to move on from the initial phone screen. While talking with people, you can pick an answer and then drag and drop the correct words to build it. If you say something wrong, take too long, or fall down, your anxiety will increase and conversations will get harder. If you get engaged in the conversation and pick longer sentences, your anxiety will decrease as you get into the habit of interacting with people. Some things get harder as you get more anxious!
