name: Virtual Tour of College (Government Polytechnic Thane)
author: Rohit764
description:
The Project gives an Immersive look of Government Polytechnic Thane.﻿

The 3D model of the college in virtual reality allows users to explore and interact with the environment as if they were physically present. Users can move around the college using controllers or their own movements and can interact with objects and elements in the environment. The 3D model can also be used for virtual tours or educational purposes, allowing users to learn about the college in an immersive and engaging way.
In summary, creating a 3D model of a college involves conceptualizing the 
design, gathering reference material, creating the model, texturing and lighting, adding interactivity, testing and refinement, and deployment. The 3D model allows users to explore and Interact with the environment in an immersive and engaging way and can be used for virtual tours or educational purposes.

Controls For Controlling the movement of Player: -

Keyboard Controls:
	W key/Up Arrow key: Front Movement.
	A key/Left Arrow key: Left Movement.
	S key/Down Arrow key: Back Movement.
	D key/Right Arrow key: Right Movement.
	F key: Switch to Fly mode.
	Space: Jump.
	Left Shift: Sprint.

Mouse Controls: 
	Move Mouse left, Right, Up, Down respectively to Navigate view.

Xbox Controller Controls:
  	Left Stick: Movement.
	Right Stick: View Navigation.
	Left Stick press: Sprint.
	A key: Jump.
	X key: Fly.

name: Winds & Temples
author: ManslyFred
description:
The villagers ask you to support them in their fight against the evil samurai Toshimoto. Help them and go out into the world to banish Toshimoto! 
Travel skillfully with the winds, visit the four temples and bring the artifacts into your possession. But be careful, there are many dangers lurking on your way: you have to stand up to thieves and ghosts, wind dragons corner you and you have to acquire various items to brave all dangers.
Wind & Temple is a two-dimensional board game in which you create the world you move through differently each turn. Winde&Tempel has a novel movement concept based on the use of the four different colored winds: The squares you can enter depend on the color of the wind blowing in that direction. Therefore, choose your moves carefully if you want to make it to the end and free the villagers from Toshimoto's yoke. 
This game is made by MaOw Games: Mansly Fred and Osamu Watanabe
If you like it please also download from Google Play store!

Winter Fox is a classic platformer. To save your abducted brother you must brave many challenges that test your reflexes. Squash monsters, collect coins and power-ups, and avoid nefarious traps! The game supports keyboard and controller (PS/XBOX). Controls are listed in the main menu. All artwork and characters are created by my son Tue (6) and this is our first game, made from scratch to learn Unity.

NOTE: Running the game in a browser can make the game lag on some computers, making it difficult to control. This is although the game has very low system requirements, locally. It may help to close other tabs, restart browser or not run it full screen.

TIPS: Jump on top of monsters to defeat them. Use snowballs to freeze them temporarily. Collect coins to gain extra lives. Use ice bridges to extend your jumps. Shields protect once against monsters, traps or flames.

description:
Kurze Bedienungsanleitung:
Beim ersten Aufruf zuerst rechts oben einen Spielernamen eingeben und dann ‚add‘ klicken. Später links oben den eigenen Spielernamen auswählen.
Auf eine der unteren Schaltflächen klicken, um ein Spiel zu starten. Zum Beenden <ESC> klicken.
Escape: Mit den Pfeiltasten die Bälle links oder rechts sortieren. Bälle, welche die Farbe schnell wechseln, nicht sortieren.
Water: Auf die Bälle in der unten angegebenen Reihenfolge klicken, um eine Brücke zu bauen. Mehrfarbige Bälle gelten als Joker und dürfen immer geklickt werden.
Collect: Mit den Pfeiltasten den Schmetterling zu allen Blumen außer den grauen steuern
Salad: Auf die Felder, welche nicht von Schnecken besetzt sind, klicken, um Salate zu säen.
Bounce: Mit der Maus das Kreuz bewegen, um zu verhindern, dass die gelben Bällchen mit den roten kollidieren. Wenn die roten Bällchen grün werden, sind diese harmlos.
Worms: Die Äpfel müssen die gleiche Farbe wie die Blumen darunter haben. Dazu entweder auf einen Apfel klicken, um die Farbe zu wechseln oder auf einen Wurm und danach auf einen Apfel klicken, um die Farbe eines Apfels auf einen anderen zu übertragen.
